tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (ka)༄༅/ /thob yig rgya mtsho bzhugs so/ /oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/chos kyi rje dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams las dam pa'i chos ji ltar nod pa'i tshul gsal ba
(ka)༄༅/ /thob yig rgya mtsho bzhugs so/ /oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/chos kyi rje dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams las dam pa'i chos ji ltar nod pa'i tshul gsal ba

tei:div.tei:p: (ka)༄༅// thob yig rgya mtsho bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ chos kyi rje dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams las dam pa'i chos ji ltar nod pa'i tshul gsal bar bshad pa thob yig rgya mtsho zhes bya ba/ rje btsun bla ma dam pa rin po che dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa bka' drin can rnams kyi zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// tshe rabs thams cad du rjes su gzung du gsol/ yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mi yi skur// ma dag gdul bya'i don du legs sprul nas// rnam dag chos kyi 'khor lo bskor mdzad pa'i// yang dag dge ba'i bshes la phyag 'tshal lo// mkhyen rab rta bdun dkyil 'khor rab rgyas pas// bdag blo rmongs pa'i mun pa rab bcom nas// dam chos snang ba'i mchog rab spel mdzad pa// dpal ldan bla ma rnams la rab tu 'dud// rnam dkar dkar ba'i lam bzang las grub pa'i// dal 'byor 'byor pa bcu ldan thob dus 'dir// yongs 'dzin 'dzin mar 'byon par dkon rnams la// dam chos chos bzhin nyan tshul mdo tsam bri// 'dir 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po las bdag brgal zhing*/ sems can gzhan rnams kyang thar pa bla na med pa'i skam sar phyin par 'dod pas/ rtse gcig tu rnam par mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin la rnal 'byor du bya dgos shing*/ de'i sngon rol du yang bsam pa dang thos pa'i shes rab 'gro dgos pas na/ thog mar yongs 'dzin dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams nye bar brten te thos pa byas pa'i tshul mdo tsam brjod na/ bdag cag gi 'dren mchog dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje chen po dang ldan zhing*/ sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa la mnga' brnyes pas sa'i steng na 'gran zla mtha' dag gis dben pa/ chos kyi rje dpal ldan bla ma dam pa ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i drung du mkhan po zhus shing*/ chos kyi rje rin po che 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros kyis las kyi slob dpon dang*/

ka bzhi 'dzin pa dpal ldan seng ges grib tshod pa dang*/ bla ma kun dga' rin chen pa dang*/ mkhas pa'i dbang po sangs rgyas dpal gyis kha skong gi dge 'dun mdzad nas/ lo dgu lon pa'i dus su/ dge bsnyen dang dge tshul gyi sdom pa mnos/ yang mkhan po chos kyi rje don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te/ ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pa dang*/ las kyi slob dpon mkhan chen blo gros dpal ba dang*/ gsang ste ston pa chos kyi rje rin po che 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros dang*/ grib tshod pa 'jam dbyangs dpal ldan gzhon nu la sogs pa/ dad pa'i dge 'dun bcu bdun gyi dbus su lcags pho 'brug rnam gnon gyi lo cho 'phrul chen po'i zla ba'i tshes brgyad kyi nyin snga dro'i cha grib tshod rkang pa gnyis dang skyes bu gcig gi dus su/ dpal ldan sa skya'i chos grwa chen por/ bsnyen par rdzogs pa dang dge slong gi sdom pa rnam par dag pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thub pa'i dbang po/ shā ri'i bu/ sras sgra gcan 'dzin/ bram ze sgra gcan 'dzin/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ gu ṇa mi tra/ rin chen bshes gnyen/ chos kyi bzang po/ gu ṇa pa ti/ chos kyi phreng ba/ 'byung gnas sbas pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta chen po shākya shrī/ mkhan chen rdo rje dpal ba/ mkhan chen 'od zer dpal ba/ mkhan chen bsod nams dpal/ mkhan chen bkra shis tshul khrims/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ des bdag la'o// dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed kyi sdom pa lan lnga'i bar du thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ thub pa chen po/ 'jam dbyangs/ klu sgrub yab sras/ zla ba grags pa/ slob pa'i rdo rje/ slob dpon dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung*/ paṇ+ḍi ta puṇ+ya shrī/ ba ri lots+tsha ba/ bla ma sa chen/ bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun pa/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'phags pa rin po che/ 'jam dbyangs 'khon ston/ byang sems rin chen mgon/

chos rje rgyal sras pa/ chos rje byang chub rtse mo/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan pa/ des bdag la'o// de ltar sdom pa gnyis kyis rgyud sbyangs nas/ rig 'dzin sngags kyi sdom pa'i chos skor zhus pa la/ rnal 'byor bla med dang*/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud dang*/ bya spyod dang gsum gyi dang po la/ pha rgyud dang*/ ma rgyud dang*/ gnyis med kyi rgyud dang gsum gyi dang po ni/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod rdo rje rgyud pa'i bka' babs bdun dang ldan pa'i dbang rgyas pa thob pa'i brgyud pa'i rim pa la/ thog mar rngog lugs kyi dbang dang bshad bka'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang chen po/ rdo rje chos/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ rgya gar lho phyogs o ḍi bi sha'i rgyal po bi su kalpa/ bram ze sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po/ rgyal bas lung bstan pa'i dge slong dpal ldan/ de la slob ma'i mchog bzhi ste/ shākya bshes gnyen/ 'phags pa lha/ klu'i byang chub/ zla ba grags pa/ de bzhis/ slob pa'i rdo rje la/ des nag po spyod pa la/ des dri med blo gros dang*/ sa 'dres pa gnyis la/ sa 'dres pas/ bīr+ya pra bha/ de wa ā ka ra tsan+d+ra/ rat+na ā ka ra shān+ti/ dpal sbas/ mar me mdzad/ de lnga las/ rje rin po che 'gos kyis shān+ti dpal sbas gnyis ma gtogs pa'i/ sa 'dres pa'i slob ma gsum/ rgya gar shar phyogs na rgyal po sprin gyi shugs can/ rdo rje gdan gyi nag po pa/ kha che khri brtan gyi tsan+d+ra ha ri/ bal po rdzong gi nā ka k+ṣa/ bal po mthil gyi tsa haṃ du/ sa ra ha pa rnams la zhus pa las/ 'dir paṇ+ḍi ta mngon shes can/ btsun mo can/ nag po pa gsum gyi lugs gtso che'o// rje 'gos la slob ma rgyud kyi ka ba tshugs pa bzhi/ man ngag gi gdung ma theg pa brgyad/ las tshogs dang phrin las la mkhas pa phyam dang dral ma gshibs pa ltar dpag tu med pa yod pa las/ 'dir mdzad pa po rang gi mar ston seng rgyal/ des rngog ye shes seng ge
des sras po nyi ma

mu na yang zer/ seng ge des brlan rtsad tsha/ des rngog mu ni'i sras po ār+ya de wa la/ de las stag pa rin chen grags dang*/ gtsang smra seng dang*/ mi nyag rdo rje grags rnams kyis gsan/ yang rngog nyi seng las/ gzhu'i phug ka ba phug ston shes rab grags kyis gsan/ de las kyang mi nyag rdo rje grags kyis gsan/ yang brlan rtsad tsha nyi ma lcam las/ rgya mkhar thang sde pa'i mkhan po 'phags pa skyabs kyis gsan/ de las gser sdengs pa gzhon nu 'od kyis gsan/ de dang skyid mkhar 'jug pe kha'i stag pa rin chen grags gnyis las/ bla ma chos sku bas gsan/ yang rong lha stengs kyi gtsang smra seng dang*/ cha kar mon mo grag gi mi nyag rdo rje grags gnyis las/ lce ston mdo seng gis gsan/ de la bla ma chos sku ba/ bla ma 'phags 'od/ kun mkhyen gnyis pa rin chen grub/ mkhas grub gzhon nu bsod nams/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan pa/ des bdag la'o// mar lugs kyi dbang dang*/ rgyud rkyang gi bshad pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ in+d+ra bhū ti/ ḍā ki bde ba'i zhabs/ ḍom+bi he ru ka rdo rje dril bu pa/ yan lag med pa'i rdo rje/ kaṃ pa la pa/ nag po spyod pa pa/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ mar pa lots+tsha ba/ mtshur dbang gi rdo rje/ 'khon gad pa kīrti/ 'gar ston shes rab rgyal po/ a phug pa rin chen seng ge rong pa sher seng*/ ston mo lung gi gdan sa pa/ ston mo lung pa ye shes mkhar/ chos 'od/ 'phags 'od/ bu ston rin po che/ mkhas grub gzhon nu bsod nams/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan pa/ des bdag la'o// yang sprul sku rin seng nas/ go lung pa ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rong ston mkhan po/ byang chub gzungs/ shangs blo brtan/ lo mchog dpal seng*/ chos rje bu ston/ mkhas grub gzhon nu bsod nams/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan pa/ des bdag la'o// mkhas pa paṇ+ḍi ta'i lugs kyi rtsa rgyud 'grel pa sgron gsal dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/

rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag na rdo rje/ in+d+ra bhū ti/ klu las gyur pa'i rnal 'byor ma/ rgyal po bi su kalpa/ bram ze sa ra ha/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ slob pa'i rdo rje/ nag po pa/ dri med blo gros/ nub du la k+ṣe tra'i mkhas pa ye shes snying po/ mar pa lots+tsha ba/ des mar pa'i bu bzhi'i nang nas/ mtshur dbang gi rdo rje/ 'khon gad pa kīrti/ mi nyag thur la pa/ dbus pa 'gar dga'/ grub thob zhang zhung pa ste thugs sras gsum/ de gsum las gangs dbar gser kha'i rin chen gling pa tshul khrims mdzes/ bla ma rgya rnal 'byor pho ba lung pa/ dge slong chos grags dpal bzang po/ bla ma shākya gzhon nu/ bla ma blo ldan pa/ bla ma 'phags 'od/ bu ston rin po che/ mkhas grub pa/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan pa/ des bdag la'o// jo bo lugs kyi dbang bka' dang bshad pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang bdag in+d+ra bhū ti che// nā ga dzo ki bram ze sa ra ha// nā gārdzun zla ba grags pa dang*// ku sa lī gnyis jo bo a ti sha /rong pa 'gar dge lha rje stod pa dang*// shes rab rgyal po shes rab gtsug tor dang*// lha rje chen po thang stong chos kyi 'od// blo chen klog skya bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang*// kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal ldan grags pa dpal// 'dus pa'i dbang dang phran rnams lung thos byas// phyis ni bla ma sgom ye'i zhabs drung du// bde dgyes gsang 'dus rgyud 'grel phran bcas thos// de la ār+yas rgyud 'grel phran bcas thos// de la bu ston rin po che/ mkhas grub gzhon nu bsod nams/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan pa/ des bdag la'o// chag lugs kyi dbang bka' dang bshad bka'i brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ sras kyi thu bo shākya bshes gnyen/ ār+ya de wa/ klu byang zla grags bzhi la gnang*/ ār+ya de was/ 'phags pa rta dbyangs/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ rdo rje dril bu pa/ rus sbal zhabs/ dza lan+dha ri pa/ dpe med dpal/

gam+bhi ra ma ti pa/ niska laṅka de wa/ chag lots+tsha ba/ yang klu byang gis/ ḍom+bi ba/ bi ra ṭi pa/ ma ti gar+bha/ rdo rje gdan pa/ re wen+d+ra pa/ chag lo/ zla grags kyis/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ skal ldan grags pa/ 'od zer 'byung gnas grags pa/ 'od mdzad lha/ chos 'byung zhi ba/ rnam par grags pa'i lha/ rnyog med lha/ re wan+d+ra pa/ chag chos rje dpal/ 'o yug dpal/ grags chen/ 'phags 'od/ bu ston rin po che/ mkhas grub gzhon nu bsod nams/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan pa/ des bdag la'o// sa lugs kyi dbang bka'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag na rdo rje/ slob dpon klu sgrub/ ār+ya de wa/ shākya bshes gnyen/ zla ba grags pa/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ skal ldan grags pa/ 'od zer 'byung gnas grags pa/ 'od mdzad lha/ chos kyi 'byung gnas zhi ba/ bi khyā ta de wa/ kha che shākya shrī bha dra/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'od zer shākya/ kha'u dar she se mo ri pa rin chen dpal/ bla ma gnyis pa rin rgyal/ sru lung pa kun smon/ bla ma grags chen pa/ bla ma 'phags 'od/ bu ston rin po che/ mkhas grub gzhon nu bsod nams/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan pa/ des bdag la'o// yang rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag na rdo rje/ klu sgrub yab sras/ ma taṃ gi rā hu la shrī/ bi khyā ta de wa/ kha che paṇa chen man chad sngar dang 'dra'o// dpyal lugs kyi dbang bka'i brgyud pa ni/ jo bo lugs dang 'dra'o zer ba bu ston rin po che'i gsan yig na snang yang*/ dpyal lots+tsha ba chos kyi bzang pos kha che paṇa chen la zhus par snang bas/ yan chad sa lugs dang 'dra la/ dpyal lo man chad btsal bar bya'o// de ltar brgyud pa bdun gyi phyag len gcig tu bsdus pa'i dbang thob nas/ sgrub thabs dngos grub char 'bebs/ bstod pa byin rlabs char 'bebs/ gtor chog 'dod don char 'bebs/ dkyil chog ye shes char 'bebs/ sbyin sreg phrin las char 'bebs rnams bu ston rin po ches mdzad pa dang*/

sgrub thabs mdor byas lo chen gyi 'gyur de'i rgya cher bshad pa bskyed rim gsal byed/ sgrub thabs mdo bsres/ klu byang gis mdzad pa'i rnam gzhag rim pa/ ār+ya de was mdzad pa'i ro sreg gi cho ga klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i dkyil chog nyi shu pa rnams lo chen gyi 'gyur/ klu'i blo yi dkyil chog nyi shu pa/ dpyal chos bzang gi 'gyur/ dkyil chog zung 'jug gsal ba sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i 'gyur/ gsang 'dus kyi dkyil chog dang rdo rje sems dpa'i mchod pa'i cho ga gnyis nag po pas mdzad pa 'gos 'gyur/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs zla grags kyis mdzad pa/ klog skya gzhon nu 'bar gyi 'gyur rnams thos so// yang de nyid las/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rtsa rgyud/ rgyud phyi ma 'grel chen sgron ma gsal ba rnams lo chen gyi 'gyur/ 'grel bshad mtha' drug gsal ba/ bshad thabs kyi yan lag gsang ba'i sgo 'byed rnams kyi steng nas bshad bka' thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rngog lugs/ mar lugs/ jo bo lugs/ chag lugs rnams kyi dbang gi brgyud pa dang 'dra'o// yang de nyid la/ bshad pa'i rgyud dgongs pa lung ston/ le'u bcu gnyis pa lo chen gyi 'gyur/ rdo rje phreng ba'i le'u drug cu rtsa brgyad pa hor kong can/ tho ling du lha bla ma zhi ba 'od kyis bsgyur ba/ lha mo bzhis zhus smṛ ti dz+nyā na kīrti'i 'gyur/ ye shes rdo rje kun las btus nag tsho'i 'gyur te/ bshad rgyud rnam pa bzhi'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ gsang bdag rdo rje chos/ in+d+ra bhū ti/ pad+ma zhabs/ rta mchog sa ra ha/ klu sgrub/ nā ga bo dhi/ bal yul phyag na rdo rje/ shān+ti pa/ shrī kīrti/ shrī legs smin/ shrī ku mā ra shān/ ba na yaka rat+na badz+ra/ zhu lots+tsha ba dharma bir+yā/ she ston/ mar lo/ jo gdan dkon seng*/ yang she ston la/ la stod tshul bzang*/ dpyal nyi ma dpal/ de gnyis ka las bla ma 'phags 'od pas gsan/ des bu ston rin po che la/

des mkhas grub gzhon nu bsod nams/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan pa/ des bdag la'o// yang de nyid las/ rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud lha ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur/ byang chub sems 'grel/ rab zhi chos kyi bshes gnyen gyi 'gyur la pa tshab nyi ma grags kyis bcos pa/ ya ra la wa sogs tshul bzhir bshad pa 'phags pa lhas mdzad pa/ lo chen gyi 'gyur rnams thos/ yang rdzogs rim zab mo lam rim pa lnga'i gzhung*/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa las/ rim pa gnyis pa shākya bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ rim pa lnga'i don 'grel mdor bsdus sgron ma/ bdag byin gyis brlab pa/ mngon par byang chub pa'i rim pa rnams 'phags pa lhas mdzad pa rnams lo chen gyi 'gyur/ rim pa khongs su bsdu ba klu byang gis mdzad pa ban+de nyi ma grags kyi 'gyur rnams thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rngog lugs dang mar lugs kyi dbang bka' dang 'dra'o// yang gsang ba 'dus pa ye shes zhabs lugs kyi dbang bka' dang*/ brgyud pa'i bka' babs gsum dang ldan pa thob pa la/ thog mar lo chen lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang gnyis su med pa'i a wa dhū ti pa/ ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ kun dga' snying po/ tha ga na/ shān+ti pa/ shrad+dhā ka ra/ pad+mā ka ra/ de gnyis las lo ts+tsha ba rin chen bzang pos zhus/ de nas rkyang po chos blo/ dge bshes skyabs seng*/ rdo rje sra brtan/ dkon mchog 'bar/ dge bshes dbang rin/ khams pa sa phug pa shākya rdo rje/ rong pa chos mgon/ lo mchog bla ma dpal ldan seng ge bu ston rin po che/ mkhas grub gzhon nu bsod nams/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o// gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud phyi ma/ bshad rgyud rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud rnams kyi brgyud pa'ang 'di dang 'dra'o// yang gnyos lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad/ 'jam dpal grags pa/

dpal sde pa/ dri med sbas pa/ yi ge pa/ kar+ṇa pa/ dz+nyā na shrī/ ba liṃ ā tsar+ya/ gnyos lots+tsha ba rdo rje bla ma/ gnyos dpal se/ grags pa dpal/ gzi brjid/ ston mo lung pa ye shes mkhar/ bla ma chos sku ba/ bla ma 'phags 'od/ bu ston pa/ mkhas grub gzhon nu bsod nams/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan pa/ des bdag la'o// rwa lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ dri med sbas pa yan gong dang 'dra ba las/ rin chen rdo rje/ rat+na kīrti/ sa man+ta bha dra/ dz+nyā na shrī mi tra/ rat+na kīrti/ puṇ+ya shrī/ rwa lots+tsha ba rdo rje grags/ rdo rje sra brtan/ dkon mchog mkhar/ dbang rin/ shākya rdo rje/ rong pa chos mgon/ lo mchog dpal ldan seng ge bu ston rin po che/ mkhas grub gzhon nu bsod nams/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o// sgrub thabs 'jam dbyangs yid 'phrog dkyil chog 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi byin rlabs kyi rnam 'phrul rnams kyang thos so// dpal gshin rje'i gshed dmar po lha lnga'i bdag nyid can gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob pa'i brgyud pa la/ thog mar chag lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das gshin rje'i gshed/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ bir+wa pa/ ḍom+bi he ru ka bi ra ḍi pa/ ma ti gar+bha/ gam+bhi ra ma ti/ niṣ+ka laṅka de wa/ ra wen+d+ra/ chag lots+tsha ba/ go lung pa mdo sde dpal/ shong lots+tsha ba blo brtan/ bla ma lots+tsha ba mchog ldan/ bla ma bsod nams dbang phyug bya sder ba byang chub rin chen/ ra ga brag pa shākya seng ge chos rje phyogs las rnam rgyal/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan pa/ des bdag la'o// dpyal lugs kyi dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed dmar po/ bir+wa pa/ ḍom+bi pa/ bi ra ḍi pa/ ma ti gar+bha/ gam+bhi ra ma ti/ ni ska laṅka de ba/ dpyal chos bzang*/ rje btsun rgwa lo/ rong pa sher seng*/ skyi ston grags rgyal/ chos rje kun mkhyen pa/ chos rje phyogs las rnam rgyal/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan pa/

des bdag la'o// dpyal pas rgwa lo la/ bum dbang yan chad las ma gnang ba la/ khong gi dā na shī la dang*/ 'jam gsar la brgyud nas dbang gong ma gsum yang mdzad do// da na shī la'i lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ bir+wa pa/ nag po pa/ sa li pa/ shī la tsan+d+ra/ dā na shī la/ 'jam gsar/ rje btsun rgwa lo man chad sngar dang 'dra zhing*/ dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs/ bir+wa pas mdzad pa thos so// yang rdzogs rim zab mo/ shin tu spros pa med pa'i de kho na nyid kyi man ngag gi nyams khrid lan gsum gyi bar du zhus nas/ spros med kyi byin rlabs/ rnam rtog 'od gsal gyi byin rlabs/ de'i rdo rje'i tshig rkang bir+wa pas mdzad pa/ de'i 'grel pa 'jug bde rnam gsal/ spros med rdo rje'i tshig rkang bir+wa pas mdzad pa/ de'i khrid yig thor bu pa/ glo bo lots+tsha ba shes rab rin chen gyis mdzad pa rnams legs par thos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ gshin rje'i gshed/ bir+wa pa/ ḍom+bi pa/ bram ze dpal 'dzin/ blo bzang snying po/ dar paṇa ā tsar+ya/ glo bo lots+tsha ba/ bla ma sa pa/ lots+tsha ba mchog ldan/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge bu ston rin po che/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ chos rje phyogs las rnam rgyal/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o// spros med bdud rtsi'i byin rlabs dang*/ de'i rdo rje'i tshig rkang bir+wa pas mdzad pa'i brgyud pa ni/ gshin rje'i gshed/ bir+wa pa/ ma taṃ ki pa/ bram ze dpal 'dzin/ la li ta badz+ra/ shān+ta rak+ṣa tra/ dharma badz+ra/ rat+na badz+ra/ dar paṇa ā tsar+ya/ glo bo lots+tsha ba man gong dang 'dra'o// gshed dmar lha bcu gsum ma'i dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ gshin rje'i gshed/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ bram ze dpal 'dzin/ ma ti gar+bha/ dza wa ri pa/ dar paṇa ā tsar+ya/ glo bo lots+tsha ba/ bla ma sa pa/ lots+tsha ba mchog ldan/ bla ma bsod nams dbang phyug bya sder ba byang chub rin chen/ ra ga brag pa shākya seng ge chos rje phyogs las rnam rgyal/

chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan pa/ des bdag la'o// dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed ro langs brgyad bskor gyi dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'jigs byed/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ la li ta badz+ra/ a mo gha badz+ra/ ye shes 'byung gnas sbas pa/ pad+ma badz+ra/ dī paṃ ka ra rak+ṣi ta/ rwa lots+tsha ba rdo rje grags/ rwa chos rab/ rwa ye shes seng ge rwa 'bum seng*/ klog skya dbang phyug grags/ ldong ston shes rab dpal/ 'gro mgon 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa bsod nams dpal/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal/ mkhan chen byang chub dpal bzang po/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan pa/ des bdag la'o// yang na/ rwa 'bum seng*/ rwa dkon mchog seng ge rwa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ zhang dkon mchog dpal man 'dra'o// yang na/ rdo rje 'chang*/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ dpal 'dzin/ nā ro pa/ a thu la badz+ra/ bla ma bha ro phyag rdum/ rje mal lots+tsha ba/ rje sa skya pa chen po/ rje btsun rin po che sku mched/ gan pa ston dar/ so ston/ chos rgyal/ rin rgyal/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan man 'dra'o// bde chen ral gcig gi rgyud khro phu lots+tsha bas bsgyur ba'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ kha sar+pā ṇi/ byang sems rin chen blo gros/ tai lo pa/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ mi tra dzo ki byams pa lots+tsha ba/ bla ma dbon ston/ chos rje kun spangs pa/ bla ma rin chen seng ge bu ston pa/ mkhas grub gzhon nu bsod nams/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan pa/ des bdag la'o// gnyis pa ma rgyud kyi skor la/ dpal kye'i rdo rje man ngag lugs kyi dkyil 'khor du rgyu dus kyi dbang gi chu bo ma nub par bskur ba'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ bdag med ma/ bir+wa pa/ nag po pa/ ḍā ma ru pa/ a wa dhū ti pa/ rje ga ya dha ra/ 'brog mi lots+tsha ba/ bla ma se mkhar chung ba/ zhang dgon pa ba/ rje sa skya pa chen po/

slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'phags pa rin po che/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ chos rje brag phug pa/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims pa/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan pa/ des bdag la'o// yang kye'i rdo rje lus dkyil gyi dbang*/ bdag med ma'i lus dkyil gyi byin rlabs rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ gong dang 'dra zhing*/ yab kyi lus dkyil gyi dbang chog blo brtan pas mdzad pa thos/ bdag med ma'i dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ sa chen yan yab dang mtshungs pa la/ de nas ne tso sbal ston/ bla ma shes rab grags/ gnam pa rwa chos she/ mngon pa ba dbang phyug brtson 'grus/ paṇ+ḍi ta rdor she zhang dkon mchog dpal man yab dang 'dra'o// yang na/ mngon pa ba nas/ 'phags pa rin po che/ dgongs ston shes rab 'bum/ dkar po brag pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan pa/ de las bdag gis ne tso ba'i dbang chog gi lung dang bcas pa zhus/ rdo rje gur rigs bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ bdag med ma/ bir+wa pa/ ḍom+bhi he ru ka a la la badz+ra/ nags khrod pa/ gar+bha ri pa/ bsod snyoms pa dza ya shrī/ mi thub zla ba/ dpa' bo rdo rje/ 'brog mi shākya ye shes/ mnga' ris pa gsal ba'i snying po/ 'khon sgyi chu ba/ rje sa skya pa chen po/ ne tso sbal ston/ rta stag so ba rin chen don grub/ gan pa ston dar/ gan pa so ston/ gan pa chos rgyal/ gan pa chos rin/ gan pa rin rgyal/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o// brgyud yig kha cig las sa chen yan chad kye rdor man ngag lugs dang 'dra bar byas pa ni ma dag ste/ dbang chog bzang po yongs bzung la byed pa'i phyir dang*/ chos rje bla ma'i gsan yig las mi 'byung ba'i phyir ro// zhes bdag gi bla ma lots+tsha bas gsungs so// yang de nyid kyi drung du/

dpal kye'i rdo rje'i rtsa ba'i rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i bshad rgyud rdo rje gur/ rgyud sde gzhan dang thun mong gi bshad rgyud/ dpal sam+bu ṭa rnams 'brog mi lots+tsha ba chen pos bsgyur ba dang*/ rgyud de dag gi rnam bshad dpal sa skya pa'i bla ma gong mas mdzad pa'i steng nas bshad bka' legs par thos pa'i brgyud pa la/ thog mar slob dpon ḍom+bi pa'i bshad srol 'grel pa lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ bdag med ma/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po bir+wa pa/ slob dpon chen po ḍom+bhi he ru ka grub thob a la la badz+ra/ dpal ldan nags khrod pa/ gar+bha ri pa/ bsod snyoms pa dza ya shrī/ slob dpon sbyang dka' zla ba/ de las slob ma'i mchog dpa' bo rdo rje/ seng ge rdo rje/ sgra gcan 'dzin dang gsum las/ 'dir dge slong dpa' bo rdo rje/ des lots+tsha ba chen po shākya ye shes la gnang*/ de las slob ma'i mchog 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po/ mnga' ris pa gsal ba'i snying po/ se mkhar chung ba rje btsun kun rig mchims lots+tsha ba 'od kyi snang ba dang bzhi las/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po/ rje sa skya pa chen po/ yang na/ bla ma mnga' ris pa/ 'khon sgyi chu ba dgra bla 'bar/ rje sa chen/ yang na/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po/ se mkhar chung ba/ rje sa chen/ yang na/ mchims lots+tsha ba/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po/ rje sa skya pa chen po/ de ltar brgyud pa'i bka' babs bzhi dang ldan pa'i bla ma sa skya pa chen pos/ slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo/ tshul khrims grags/ gtsug tor rgyal po dang gsum la gnang*/ de gsum gas rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan la/ des chos kyi rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po la/ des chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che/ dga' ldan pa bkra shis dpal/ chos rje brag phug pa bsod nams dpal/ bla ma blo gros brtan pa/ bla ma dam pa dpal ldan tshul khrims/

mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ de las bdag gis rtsa rgyud kyi bshad pa lan lnga/ rdo rje gur lan gnyis/ sam+bu ṭa lan gsum gyi bar du zhus shing 'chad nyan gyis gtan la phab bo/ yang rtsa rgyud rkyang pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa rin po che yan chad sngar dang 'dra ba las/ 'jam skya nam mkha' dpal/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o// rgyud gsum man ngag gi lugs kyi bshad srol gyi ring brgyud ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ bdag med ma/ bir+wa pa/ nag po pa/ ḍā ma ru pa/ a wa dhū ti pa/ ga ya dha ra/ 'brog mi lots+tsha ba/ de la slob ma'i mchog bzhi las/ 'dir se mkhar chung ba/ zhang dgon pa ba/ rje sa chen man sngar dang 'dra'o// nye brgyud ni/ rje btsun chen pos/ bla med phyogs ni ris bsgyur mig bcas pa// rig byed kyis gsal la lag pas ma la bgos// de 'od kun gsal chu gter 'byung bar babs// zhes dang*/ legs 'ongs mig gis yon tan gsal bar byas// me dang chu bos 'byung ba rab tu bskyed// ces pa ltar shes par bya'o// yang rdzogs rim zab mo brtag gnyis las 'byung ba'i dag pa gsum gyi brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa yan chad ḍom+bhi pa nas brgyud pa'i rgyud 'grel dang 'dra/ de nas dga' ldan pa bkra shis dpal/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ brag phug pa bsod nams dpal/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan pa/ des bdag la'o// rdo rje gur las 'byung ba'i thig le'i rnal 'byor gyi brgyud pa ni/ chos rje pa/ zhang mdo sde dpal/ 'jam skya/ dpal ldan seng ge chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa man chad sngar bzhin no// sam+bu ṭa las 'byung ba'i rang byin rlabs kyi dmigs pa nyi shu rtsa dgu'i brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa rin po che/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/

chos rje brag phug pa/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan man 'dra'o// yang shān+ti pa'i mdo rgyud bsre ba/ dz+nyā na shrī/ shes rab 'byung gnas sbas pa/ rin chen rdo rje gsum gyi bar chad gsum sel/ ngag dbang grags pa'i gnyug ma dran gsal/ nā ro pa'i phyag rgya chen po sdug bsngal gsum sel te/ sgo drug chos 'brel du grags pa'i brgyud pa ni/ shān+ti pa/ dz+nyā na shri/ shes rab 'byung gnas sbas pa/ rin chen rdo rje/ ngag dbang grags pa/ nā ro pa/ de so so las 'brog mis gsan la/ de la bar chad gsum sel/ 'brog mis se rog gnyis la/ des gnyos la/ des yer pa sgom seng*/ grub thob lha 'bar/ kha rag sgom pa/ lung phu ba/ bkra shis lung pa/ mkhas grub chos rje/ zhang byang she chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o// gnyug ma dran gsal gyi brgyud pa ni/ sgrol ma/ ngag dbang grags pa/ 'brog mi/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po/ bla ma shangs pa/ sa chen/ rje btsun pa/ lung phu ba man gong bzhin no// sdug bsngal gsum sel gyi brgyud pa ni/ nā ro pa/ 'brog mi/ mnga' ris pa/ sgyi chu ba/ sa chen man 'dra'o// mdo rgyud bsre ba'i brgyud pa ni/ shān+ti pa/ 'brog mi/ se mkhar chung ba/ zhang dgon pa ba/ sa chen man 'dra'o// zhen pa bzhi bral gyi man ngag gi brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ 'jam dbyangs/ rje sa chen/ rtse mo/ rje pa/ chos rje pa/ 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa/ bla ma dpal ldan pa/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ des bdag la'o// yang rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi chos bzhi las lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ bdag med ma/ bir+wa pa/ rje sa chen/ rje btsun chen po/ chos rje pa/ tshogs sgom/ nyan chen pa/ brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/

chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan pa/ des bdag la'o// yang brgyud pa de dang 'dra ba'i bir+wa pa'i byin rlabs dang bsrung ba'i skor/ lam sbas bshad/ grub chen bcu/ pra mo brgyad dang bcas pa thos/ rnam 'joms bir lugs kyi dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje rnam 'joms/ bir+wa pa/ sa chen/ rtse mo/ rje btsun/ paṇa chen/ skyo ston dri med/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ gan pa rin rgyal/ bla ma bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan pa/ des bdag la'o// yang na rje btsun pa/ gan pa ston dar/ gan pa so ston/ gan pa chos rgyal/ gan pa chos rin/ gan pa rin rgyal man 'dra'o// yang na/ skyo ston pa/ dharma ye shes/ bag ston pa/ bla ma tshul rgyal/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la gnang zhing*/ dkyil chog dga' ldan pa kun bsod kyis mdzad pa thos/ yang de nyid la/ bde mchog lo hi pa brgyud pa'i bka' babs bdun dang ldan pa'i dbang rgyas pa thob pa la/ sa lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag na rdo rje/ sa ra ha pa/ klu sgrub/ sha ba ri pa/ lo hi pa/ dha ri ka pa/ rdo rje dril bu pa/ rus sbal zhabs/ shrī dza lan+dha ra/ nag po spyod pa/ gu h+ya pa/ rnam rgyal zhabs/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ pham mthing pa sku mched/ klog skya shes rab brtsegs/ mal lots+tsha ba blo gros grags/ sa chen pa/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ bsod nams seng ge sangs rgyas 'bum/ lots+tsha ba mchog ldan/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge bu ston pa/ mkhas grub gzhon nu bsod nams/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o// mar do lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ lo hi pa/ ḍeṃ gi pa/ la wa pa/ in+d+ra bhū ti/ ka tse ṭa pa/ dril bu pa/ dza lan+dha ri pa/ nag po pa/ ku sha la/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ ma na ka shrī dz+nyā na/ bal po bha dan+ta/

mar pa do pa/ gze ba blo ldan/ gze ba jo bde/ slob dpon khu pa/ lhong tshad pa/ lo mchog dpal ldan seng ge bu ston pa/ mkhas grub gzhon nu bsod nams/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o// jo bo lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ lo hi pa/ dha ri ka pa/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ shān+ti pa/ jo bo rje/ rong pa 'gar dge lha rje stod pa/ steng zla gsal/ shod nyi ma kha gro/ gcen shes rab rgyal po/ gcung shes rab gtsug tor/ lha rje chen po/ chos 'od/ zhing chen/ grags pa dpal/ bde gshegs dpal/ bla ma sgom pa ye shes/ bla ma grags chen/ bla ma 'phags 'od/ bu ston pa/ mkhas grub gzhon nu bsod nams/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o// paṇa chen lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ bde mchog rdo rje phag mo/ lo hi pa/ ri khrod zhabs/ kan+ta pa/ 'dren mdzad zhabs/ bi khyā ta de ba/ paṇa chen shākya shrī/ bi bhū ti tsan+d+ra/ g.yag sde lots+tsha ba/ mnga' ris pa sangs rgyas ye shes/ bu ston pa/ mkhas grub gzhon nu bsod nams/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o// pu rong lo chung lugs kyi dbang bshad gnyis ka'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje phag mo/ lo hi pa/ ḍeṃ gi pa/ dha ri ka pa/ rdo rje dril bu pa/ dza lan+dha ri pa/ nag po spyod pa ba/ dge ba'i mgon po/ rus sbal zhabs/ bhu wa pa/ rnam rgyal zhabs/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ ma na ka shrī/ pradz+nyā rak+ṣi ta/ pham mthing pa gsum/ yang na ma na ka shrī dang*/ pradz+nyā rak+ṣi ta gnyis las/ ka ṇa shrī/ de dang pham mthing ba la bha dan+tas/ lo chung grags mchog dmar chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ mnga' ris kyi ston/ thur la ba/ thang dpe ba/ gser sdings pa/ bla ma chos 'od/ kun mkhyen 'phags 'od/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa/ mkhas grub gzhon nu bsod nams/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ des bdag la'o// mar lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ pham mthing pa yan chad sa lugs dang 'dra ba las/

de nas bal po bha dan+ta/ lo chung grags mchog shes rab/ dmar chen po/ dbon po shes rab rdo rje/ thub pa shes rab/ brtson 'grus rdo rje/ dmar chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ bla ma shākya gzhon nu/ lce blo ldan seng ge bla ma 'phags 'od/ bu ston pa/ mkhas grub gzhon nu bsod nams/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o// dpyal lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ lo hi pa/ dha ri ka pa/ mai tri pa/ n+ya ka pa/ kan+dha pa/ bi khyā ta de ba/ paṇa chen shākya shrī/ grub thob rdo rje gdan pa/ paṇa chen k+ṣi ti gar+bha/ dpyal lots+tsha ba chos bzang*/ rje btsun rgwa lo/ bla ma shes rab seng ge bla ma chos skyong dpal/ mkhas grub gzhon nu bsod nams/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o// sbal spang sna lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ slob dpon chen po tsaṇ+ḍi ka pa/ bram ze chen po me ko pa/ lo hi pa/ dha ri ka pa/ sdom pa bzang po/ jo bo rje/ de la lo chen rin bzang dang*/ nag tsho lots+tsha ba gnyis kas gsan/ bla ma rnam gnyis kyis/ lots+tsha ba rnam gnyis la'ang gsan/ jo bo la'ang gsan/ de la 'al pa ston mgon/ 'al pa jo bo btsun/ sgom pa mang sgom/ sbal spang sna ba/ me rag dar byang*/ rin chen rgyal po/ bla ma grags pa dpal/ bla ma 'phags pa 'od/ bu ston pa/ mkhas grub gzhon nu bsod nams/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o// yang lo hi pa'i sgrub thabs dpal mngon par rtogs pa/ lo chen gyi 'gyur la/ 'gos dang mar dos bcos pa/ de'i 'grel pa rngog gi 'gyur/ phyi rol mchod pa'i cho ga dang*/ lag mchod gnyis dpyal chos bzang gi 'gyur/ gtor ma'i cho ga rngog gi 'gyur/ de bzhi pradz+nyā rak+ṣi tas mdzad pa ste/ lo hi pa'i smad lngar grags pa dang*/ bde mchog gi rgyun bshags slob dpon bhu ri pas mdzad pa/ kha che rin chen rdo rje'i bkra shis/ brgyud pa bdun gyi phyag len gcig tu dril ba'i lo hi pa'i mngon rtogs rnal 'byor bzhi ldan/

mchod sprin bde chen rnam rol/ dbang chog de kho na nyid la gsal bar 'jug pa/ sbyin sreg phrin las kun 'grub rnams thos/ yang bde mchog nag po pa'i dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag na rdo rje/ sa ra ha/ klu sgrub/ sha ba ri/ lo hi pa/ dha ri ka pa/ rdo rje dril bu pa/ rus sbal zhabs can/ shrī dza lan+da ri pa/ nag po spyod pa/ gu h+ya pa/ rnam rgyal zhabs/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ pham mthing pa sku mched/ klog skya ba/ mal lo/ sa chen yab sras gsum/ chos rje khu dbon gnyis/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa/ blo gros brtan pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o// yang na/ 'phags pa rin po che/ stag ston shes rab gzhon nu/ bla ma brag dkar ba/ mkhas grub gzhon nu bsod nams/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o// yang na/ nag po spyod pas mdzad pa'i dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sgrub thabs/ dkyil chog lo chen gyi 'gyur la/ 'gos kyis bcos pa/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga dge slong rig pa gzhon nu'i 'gyur te/ bskyed rim skor gsum dang*/ rdzogs rim skor gsum ni/ dpyid kyi thig le mar do'i 'gyur/ gsang ba'i de kho na nyid rab tu gsal ba/ 'gos 'gyur la mar dos bcos pa/ o la pa tī grags 'byor shes rab kyi 'gyur te/ nag po gzhung drug gi brgyud pa ni/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta yan chad dril bu pa dang 'dra ba la/ de nas tshogs sgom rin po che/ 'o yug pa/ bla ma grags chen/ bla ma 'phags 'od/ bu ston pa/ mkhas grub gzhon nu bsod nams/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o// yang na/ rdo rje 'chang*/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ dza lan+dha ri pa/ nag po spyod pa/ dge ba'i mgon po/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ pham mthing pa/ mar pa do pa/ gze pa chen po/ sras sku mched/ bar thang ba/ kham pa yab sras/ bla ma shāka gzhon/ bla ma blo ldan seng ge sras rje btsun pa/ mkhas grub gzhon nu bsod nams/

chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o// yang bde mchog dril bu pa'i brgyud pa'i bka' babs gnyis dang ldan pa'i dbang thob pa'i brgyud pa la/ sa lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ rdo rje dril bu pa/ rus sbal zhabs/ 'bar ba 'dzin/ gu h+ya pa/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ pham mthing pa/ klog skya shes rab brtsegs/ mal jo lots+tsha ba/ rje sa chen yab sras gsum/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ bo dong rin po che/ rin po che khro phu ba/ yang rtse ba rin chen seng ge bu ston pa/ mkhas grub gzhon nu bsod nams/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o// yang na/ bo dong rin po che'i gnas su/ 'gro mgon 'phags pa'am/ tshogs sgom rin po che gang bcug kyang chog go /kha che lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje phag mo/ dril bu pa/ dga' ba'i rdo rje/ yan lag med pa'i rdo rje/ a bha yā ka ra gup+ta/ de ba puṇ+ya/ kha che paṇa chen/ spyi bo lhas pa seng ge dpal/ zhang 'bre lung pa/ rin po che khro phu ba/ yang rtse ba/ bu ston pa/ mkhas grub gzhon nu bsod nams/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o// yang na/ dril bu pa/ de ba pūr+ṇa/ kha che paṇa chen man chad 'dra'o// de nyid la slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs mal lo'i 'gyur/ dbang bskur bar bya ba'i rim pa mdor bsdus pa ban+de chos kyi shes rab kyi 'gyur/ rdzogs rim rim pa lnga pa rngog lo chen po'i 'gyur te/ dril bu skor gsum du grags pa dang*/ yang lus dkyil gyi mngon rtogs lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor gsal byed dbang chog zab don gsal ba rnams kyi lung thob/ yang dril bu pa'i dbang gi brgyud pa lugs gzhan ni/ 'phags pa rin po che/ 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan/ bla ma bya sder ba byang chub rin chen/ chos rje phyogs las rnam rgyal/ lo chen byang chub rtse mo/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/

des bdag la'o// yang de nyid la/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud mal lo'i 'gyur/ de'i 'grel pa mu tig gi phreng ba/ rnal 'byor ma kun spyod kyi rgyud/ de'i 'grel pa rje btsun chen pos mdzad pa rnams kyi steng nas bshad bka' thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ nag po pa'i brgyud pa gong ma dang 'dra'o// yang spyir ma rgyud thams cad dang*/ khyad par du bde mchog gi rdzogs rim zab lam rim pa lnga'i khrid thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rin po che khro phu ba yan dril bu pa'i dbang dang 'dra ba la/ de nas yang rtse ba/ bla ma gnyen mkhar ba bkra shis bzang po/ mkhas grub gzhon nu bsod nams/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o// yang dril bu pa lha lnga ma rdul tshan la brten pa'i dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje dril bu pa/ laṅka ling pa/ nag po spyod pa ba/ dge ba'i mgon po/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ ma na ka shrī/ pham mthing ba 'jigs med grags/ su ma ti kīrti/ mar pa do pa/ gze pa blo ldan/ gze pa jo bde/ shākya rdo rje/ rong pa chos mgon/ lo mchog dpal ldan seng ge bu ston rin po che/ mkhan chen rin rnam pa/ mkhas grub gzhon nu bsod nams/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o// yang de nyid la rdo rje dril bu pas mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs mar pa chos kyi dbang phyug gi 'gyur/ la ba pas mdzad pa'i dkyil chog mar do'i 'gyur rnams thos/ yang na/ dril bu pas lugs/ bo dong rin po che nas brgyud pa dang 'dra'o zer ba rin rnam pa'i gsan yig na snang ste brtag par bya'o// rdo rje phag mo shes rab gsal byed ma'i byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje phag mo/ kaṅka sbyin/ a bha yā/ kun spangs legs spyod/ rat+na rak+ṣi ta/ ma na ka shrī dz+nyā na/ chag lots+tsha ba/ go lung pa/ shong rdor rgyal/ dpang lots+tsha ba/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/

des bdag la'o// rje btsun ma ku ru kul+le'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun ma ku ru kul+le/ rgyal po lhan skyes rol pa/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung gnyis/ ba ri lots+tsha ba/ sa chen yab sras gsum/ chos rje pa/ 'o yug pa/ kun bsod/ nyi thog pa/ kun smon/ yon tan dpal/ bu lung ba kun dga' rdo rje/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ brag phug pa blo gros brtan pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o// rje btsun ma'i sgrub thabs lhan skyes sgeg pas mdzad pa/ dā na shī la'i rang 'gyur/ man ngag chen po lnga slob dpon zhi ba 'tshos mdzad pa/ bstod pa ḍom+bi he ru kas mdzad pa/ ku ru kul+le'i gsang sgrub sogs man ngag rnams tshang bar thos shing*/ bla ma dpal ldan pas man ngag rnams bla ma gzungs pa las thos gsungs/ yang rjes gnang*/ sgrub thabs lhan skyes rol pas mdzad pa che ba/ bla ma'i man ngag las sbyor/ bstod pa/ las kha tshar bzhi dang bcas pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ dga' ldan pa/ kun bsod yan chad sngar dang 'dra/ des bla ma gzhon tshul/ tshul rgyal ba/ bla ma ngag dbang grags pa/ mkhan chen byang chub seng ge chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o// tshogs bdag dmar chen gyi rjes gnang*/ bsnyen pa/ sgrub pa/ las sbyor/ sbags chog ste bzhi ston pa'i sgrub thabs/ sbyin sreg sgrub pa'i yan lag 'phags pas mdzad pa'i bstod pa/ phyag mtshan bcu gnyis kyi las tshogs/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro le'u bcu dgu pa nas phyung ba'i sgrub thabs/ zhal gdams kyis gnad la dbab pa'i sbyin sreg gzhan yang gdams pa 'ga'/ tshogs bdag gi snying po zhes bya ba'i gzungs rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje phag mo/ sa ra ha/ klu sgrub/ ri khrod mgon po/ hang du dkar po/ mal lots+tsha ba/ sa chen pa/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ chos rje pa/ rin po che skyob pa dpal/ rong pa sher seng*/

bla ma gzhon tshul/ bla ma tshul rgyal/ bla ma ngag dbang*/ byang seng ba/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan pa/ des bdag la'o// kag chol 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje gdan pa/ tha bi ra/ ba ri lots+tsha ba/ lcags thang pa/ sa chen/ rje btsun pa/ chos rje pa/ khong bsod nams 'bum/ bla ma gzhon tshul man sngar bzhin no// yang na/ chos rje pa/ shar pa gong ma sku mched/ 'dul 'dzin bsod ye/ bla ma bsod nams dar/ bag ston gzhon tshul man sngar bzhin no// 'di'i chos skor la/ sngags kyi rgyal po'i dam tshig gi dngos grub kyi cho ga zhes bya ba rin chen rdo rjes mdzad pa/ 'jig rten gyi dngos grub chen po sgrub pa'i thabs ba ri ba'i zhal gdams/ 'khor lo'i sgrub pa las sbyor/ gsang sngags rtsa ba'i 'khor lo sgrub pa/ sbyin sreg rjes gnang gi cho ga gsal byed/ nyi ma'i 'khor lo rdo rje gdan pas mdzad pa/ rgyal po dbang du bya ba'i man ngag dang sbyin sreg dngos grub chud mi za bar byed pa/ rab gnas/ gnad 'bebs/ nyi zla'i 'khor lo/ las bzhi'i man ngag rab gnas khyad par can/ yi dam la brten pa'i sgrub yig gdams pa gsum gyi ston pa/ gsang sgrub dam pa/ sgrub yig ba ri ba'i gdams pa/ thun mong ma yin pa'i lo rgyus rnams thob/ rdo rje nag po chen po'i rjes gnang thun mong pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur/ bram ze mchog sred/ bde ba'i rdo rje/ shrar+dha ka ra warma/ jo bo rin chen bzang po/ brag steng pa yon tan tshul khrims/ mal lo/ rje sa chen yab sras gsum/ chos rje khu dbon gnyis/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa/ de las chos rje bla ma bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ blo gros brtan pa gnyis kas gsan/ de gnyis ka las/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o// pu tra'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/

pad+ma 'byung gnas/ paṇ+ḍi ta dharmā pā la/ lo chen rin chen bzang po nas/ 'gro mgon 'phags pa'i bar gong dang 'dra ba la/ de nas dam pa kun dga' grags/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ gan pa rin rgyal/ bla ma bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o// 'di'i man ngag gi skor la/ gur mgon lha brgyad ma dang bcu gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs/ lha brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa sbags te sgrub pa'i lag len/ man ngag zhal gdams mar grags pa la/ gtor ma la brten nas dgra bsad pa/ gtor ma med par kha zas la brten nas dgra bsad pa/ gzhan gyi rig sngags dang rbod gtong bzlog pa/ rmi lam ngan pa dang ltas ngan pa bzlog pa/ byad sha sbags pa/ dgra bgegs tshogs su za ba ste shin tu zab pa'i shog dril drug dang*/ zab gtad gnad kyi gdams pa/ rten gtor gyi man ngag rtsa gsum la brten nas bsnyen sgrub las gsum du bsgrub pa/ gsang rten lus la bcang ba/ bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa'i mdos kyi cho ga bla ma spyan chen po'i bskang bzlog gi cho ga nag po chen po lcam dral 'khor bcas la bka' bsgo ba/ srung 'dzug thabs/ gtor ma zor du 'phang pa'i man ngag pu ṭa'i sgrub thabs gter ma/ de'i mdos chog dam pas mdzad pa rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o// las mgon zangs gri can gyi sgrub thabs/ chos skyong rno zhing las la nyan pa'i gdams ngag 'khon nag zas su za ba'i gdams ngag gur gyi mgon po'i bka' sdod zangs gri can gyi sgrub thabs/ pu tra ming sring gsum gyi sgrub thabs dam pas mdzad pa/ mnan pa'i thun bsgrub/ mnan pa dngos/ zor gyi bsad pa/ 'jam zhing zhi ba'i las kyi sgrub thabs/ pho rkyang dang mo rkyang du sgrub pa pu ṇ+yas mdzad pa/ mkha' 'gro sbags sgrub rten bca' thabs mnan pa'i yi ge

bsad las tsha ba'i nad kyis bsad pa/ sngags rings kyi bsad pa'i las sbyor/ zangs gri can gyi bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gyi rgya gzhung gcig bsnyen sgrub bsad gsum gyi man ngag las mgon zangs gri can gyi sgrub thabs gcig lha mo rkyang bsgrub/ las sbyor dam pas mdzad pa/ nag po chen po phur bu'i sgrub thabs kyi rgya gzhung*/ bram ze mchog sred kyi phur bu sgrub thabs kyi rim pa/ pho rkyang bka' sdod du sgrub pa bsnyen sgrub las sbyor mnan pa dang bcas pa/ gser gyi spu gri'i gdams pa dam pas mdzad pa/ ngag mnan/ ngag bsrung rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa rin po che/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ dpal ldan seng ge bla ma mnyam med pa/ bla ma gzungs kyi dpal/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims man 'dra/ gdong bzhi pa'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ ba liṃ ta pa/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ dpal sde/ bi ma la gup+ta/ rin chen rdo rje/ rin chen grags pa/ ri sul gyi rnal 'byor ma/ gnyan lo ts+tsha ba dar ma grags/ gnam kha'u pa/ rje sa chen yab sras gsum/ chos rje khu dbon gnyis/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa/ de las chos rje bla ma dang*/ blo gros brtan pa gnyis kyis gsan/ de gnyis ka las bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o// 'di'i skor la/ zhal bzhi pa'i lo rgyus/ bsnyen sgrub las gsum gcig tu bsdebs pa'i sgrub thabs/ gzhung mchan bshad dang bcas pa/ sngags kyi thems yig sngags kyi gnad/ g.yab pa dang thags kyis khams gsum dbang du sdud pa/ nor sgrub pa/ 'khor lo'i zhal gdams/ rwa zor/ sgong zor/ rang dang slob ma dang rdzas yo byad rnams gtad pa/ gtsug lag khang gtad pa/ gnas mal dang yo byad nor rdzas srung ba/ zhal gdams don drug ma/ rten bca' ba'i man ngag thugs dam bskang ba'i cho ga mdos kyi cho ga las 'grig sbyin sreg bskrad pa/

mnan pa/ rang srung dang*/ rten gyi 'khor lo'i man ngag la sogs pa chos skor rnams tshang bar nos shing*/ gnyan lots+tsha ba dar ma grags kyis mdzad pa'i bstod pa yang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa rin po che/ dam pa kun dga' grags/ kun bsod/ brag phug pa/ blo gros brtan pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o// yang bla ma dpal ldan pas/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan la'ang gsan to// yang de nyid las/ sgrol ma lha bcu bdun ma'i dbang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun sgrol ma/ nyi ma sbas pa'i dpal/ tsan+d+ra gar+bha/ dgra las rgyal ba/ ngag dbang grags pa/ dad byed go cha/ de bzhin gshegs pa bsrung ba/ dha na shrī/ mañdzu shrī/ mal lo ts+tsha ba/ bu rtse rwa lots+tsha ba/ dbang phyug rin chen/ mchims chos seng*/ mchims blo gros brtan pa/ mchims nam mkha' grags/ chos rgyal 'phags pa/ yang dgon pa blo chen/ mkhan po 'od mdzes/ nyi phug pa blo brtan/ chos rje kun mkhyen pa/ mkhan chen byang seng pa/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o// gsum pa gnyis med rgyud kyi skor la/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sku gsung thugs yongs su rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor chen por/ rwa lugs kyi dbang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ ston pa shākya thub pa/ rgyal po zla ba bzang po/ de nas rtsa rgyud ston pa'i chos rgyal drug des nas 'jam dpal grags pa nas/ rigs ldan nyer lnga byon pa dang*/ 'byon 'gyur gyi nang nas/ rigs ldan bcu gcig pa/ rgyal dka' 'das pa'i dus/ rigs ldan bcu gnyis pa nyi ma byon pa'i dus na/ slob dpon chen po tsi lu paṇ+ḍi ta byon zhing*/ des 'jam dpal gyi sprul pa las dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang*/ rgyud 'grel man ngag mtha' dag thos par 'dod cing*/ yang lugs gcig la/ tsi lu paṇ+ḍi tas sham+bha lar byon nas/ spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa dge slong zhig la/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang rgyud 'grel pa man ngag dang bcas pa thob par 'dod cing*/

de'i pi to ā tsar+ya dus 'khor zhabs chen po/ dus 'khor zhabs chung ba/ mañdzu shrī kīrti/ sa man+ta shrī/ rwa lots+tsha ba chos rab/ rwa ye shes seng ge rwa 'bum seng*/ rje btsun rgwa lo/ bla ma rong pa shes rab seng ge bla ma kyi ston 'jam dbyangs grags rgyal/ chos rje kun mkhyen chen po/ 'dren mchog chos kyi rgyal po/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o// dus 'khor 'gro lugs kyi dbang bka'i brgyud pa ni/ shākya thub pa/ rgyal po zla ba bzang po/ de nas rim pa ltar/ rigs ldan bcu gnyis pa nyi ma'i dus su/ dus 'khor zhabs pa chen po byon te/ tsi lu paṇ+ḍi ta dang gcig tu bzhed do// des rigs ldan bcu bdun pa dpal skyong la zhus par 'dod pa ni lo rgyus ma dag par mngon pas/ snga ma ltar 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul pa la zhus pa'am/ lugs gcig la dus zhabs pa chen po sham+bha lar byon pas/ spyan ras gzigs kyis lam nas bsus te/ sham+bha la'i yul gyi dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor gyi khang par dbang bskur nas/ 'grel pa bskor gsum man ngag dang bcas pa gnang bar 'dod do// de nas dus 'khor zhabs gnyis pa kha che zla ba mgon po/ bla ma lha rje/ sgom pa dkon mchog bsrungs/ bla ma sgro ston gnam la brtsegs/ grub chen yu mo/ sras dha rme shwa ra/ bla ma nam mkha' 'od zer/ grub thob se mo che nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ chos rje 'jam gsar shes rab 'od zer/ kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer/ chos rje kun spangs chen po/ chos rje yon tan rgya mtsho/ chos rje kun mkhyen chen po/ 'dren mchog phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o// dus 'khor rwa lugs kyi dbang gi brgyud pa gzhan ni/ rong pa rgwa lo nas/ bla ma dus 'khor ba chen po ye shes rin chen la chos rje kun spangs chen pos zhus te/ chos rje yab sras rnams la rim pa ltar brgyud pa yin no// yang 'bro lugs kyi brgyud pa gzhan ni/

chos rje 'jam gsar nas rje btsun rgwa lo/ rong pa shes rab seng ge skyi ston 'jam dbyangs/ chos rje kun mkhyen chen po/ 'dren mchog phyogs las rnam rgyal/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o// mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ dus 'khor 'gro lugs kyi dbang gi brgyud pa dang mthun zhing*/ dus 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi mngon rtogs/ lha dgu ma'i mngon rtogs/ bdag 'jug de dang sbyor ba'i dbang chog dbang gong ma'i cho ga sbyin sreg bsgom bya'i dkyil 'khor phyi nang kun gsal/ dus 'khor gyi bkra shis/ rdo rje shugs dang 'jigs byed kyi shan 'byed/ bstan rtsis rnams phyogs las rnam rgyal bas mdzad pa thob/ gnyis pa rnal 'byor rgyud kyi skor la/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang bka'/ stod smad kyi phyag len rnams gcig tu dril ba'i dbang rgyas pa thob nas/ rdo rje 'byung ba'i bshad pa stod smad kyi legs bshad rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa'i rnam bshad rgyas pa yid bzhin gyi nor bu thos so// de la rdo rje 'byung ba stod lugs kyi dbang bshad kyi brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad/ phyag na rdo rje/ rgyal po rab gsal zla ba/ sgra gcan 'dzin/ dpa' bo rta phal ye shes rdo rje/ pradz+nyā sid+dhi dang bzhis/ kun dga' snying po la/ des pradz+nyā wa li ta/ rab 'byor bskyangs/ dharma pā la/ lo chen rin bzang*/ ma nang gi gur shing brtson 'grus rgyal mtshan/ gnyal pa nyi she/ snub nyi ma 'od zer/ rtsa skya ston grags/ slob dpon shākya 'bum/ sangs rgyas 'bum/ bla ma chos 'od/ bla ma 'phags 'od/ bu ston pa/ mkhas grub gzhon nu bsod nams/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o// yang na/ snur chen po/ badz+ra sidha/ glan chos 'byung*/ rtsa skya ston 'bum/ rtsa skya khri brtan/ snur ye rgyal/ snur chos 'phags rgyal mtshan/ bla ma 'phags 'od man 'dra'o// yang smad lugs kyi dbang bshad kyi brgyud pa ni/

rab 'byor bskyangs yan chad 'dra ba la/ sangs rgyas zhi ba/ lo chen/ lo chung*/ lce zhar/ skru ston 'bar thog gtsang yang dag rdo rje/ smra seng*/ lce mdo seng*/ bla ma chos 'od/ lce blo ldan seng ge bla ma 'phags 'od man 'dra'o// yang lo chung las/ sum ston ye 'bar dang*/ lce zhar gnyis kyis gsan/ de nas skru ston man 'dra/ yang lo chen lo chung gnyis ka las/ rkyang pos gsan/ de la gdong sngon gyi skru ston 'bar thog gis gsan/ de man 'dra'o// yang zangs dkar lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag na rdo rje/ in+d+ra bhū ti che ba/ bar pa/ chung ba/ klu sgrub/ klu byang*/ ye shes rdo rje/ oṃ ḍi ya na'i smra ba'i gtsug gi nor bu/ kun snying*/ rab zhi bshes gnyen/ pad+mā ka ra/ lo chen/ lo chung*/ zangs dkar lots+tsha ba/ klog skya/ de las spyang tshang ston rtse dang*/ jo she gnyis kas gsan/ de gnyis las gtsang yang dag rdo rjes gsan te/ de man chad 'dra'o// yang rnal 'byor rgyud spyi'i chos 'byung ngam/ bshad thabs kyi man ngag rnal 'byor rgyud kyi rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru gzings thos/ 'jam dpal gsang ldan gyi dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ 'jam dbyangs/ 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ sgeg pa'i rdo rje/ nyi ma'i snying po/ sūr+ya sid+dhi/ chos kyi rdo rje/ mu ḍa sid+dhi/ de be shwa ra/ shān+ti gar+bha/ smṛ ti dz+nyā na kīrti/ tshang sde ngag gi dbang phyug kham pa shes rab rdo rje/ yang na/ shwan+ti gar+bha/ nyi ma'i dngos grub/ kyi bye ma lung pa/ de gnyis ka las sher rdor/ rngog chos rdor/ spa sba ba can/ rngog mdo sde/ gtsang smra seng*/ lce mdo seng*/ bla ma chos 'od/ 'phags 'od/ bu ston pa/ mkhas grub gzhon nu bsod nams/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o// yang na/ rngog pa/ rgya 'u ma can/ shākya seng ge khri ston kun dga' 'od/ chos rin/ chos sku ba/ lce blo ldan seng ge sras rje btsun bsod nams dpal/ mkhas grub gzhon nu bsod nams/

chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o// dkyil chog gzhon nu bsod nams pas mdzad pa thos/ ngan song sbyong ba kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sa lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ phyag na rdo rje/ rgyal po rab gsal zla ba/ rab 'byor skyong*/ kun dga' snying po/ shes rab skyong*/ zhi ba snying po/ dge mtshan bshes gnyen/ bde ba'i rdo rje/ shrad+dha ka ra warma/ lo chen rin chen bzang po/ brag steng pa/ mal lo/ sa chen/ rje pa/ chos rje pa/ tshogs sgom/ nyan chen/ ti shrī kun dga' blo gros/ bla ma dam pa/ blo gros brtan pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o// mchan bu/ sa bcad/ spyi don rnams rje btsun gyis mdzad pa'i steng nas bshad bka' rdzogs pa'i ngan song sbyong rgyud kyi brgyud pa ni/ rje sa skya chen po yan chad kun rig gi dbang dang 'dra ba la/ de nas gnyag ston dbang rgyal/ rje btsun chen po/ chos rje paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'phags pa rin po che/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ na bza' ba bsod nams dpal/ blo gros brtan pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ de la bdag gis so// yang na/ kha che lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje sems dpa'/ a nu pa ma rak+ṣi ta/ shān+ti pa/ a bha yā/ rdo rje gdan pa/ bi khyā ta de ba/ kha che paṇa chen shākya shrī/ bi bhū ti tsan+d+ra/ g.yag sde lots+tsha ba/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa/ blo gros brtan pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o// chag lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das kun rig slob dpon kun dga' snying po/ rab 'byor skyong*/ shān+ti pa/ rdo rje gdan pa/ a bha yā ka ra/ kha che dz+nyā na shrī/ ni ska laṅka/ rdo rje gdan pa chung ba/ re wen+d+ra/ chag lots+tsha ba chos rje dpal/ g.yag sde pa bsod nams seng ge paṇ+ḍi ta rdor she/ zhang dkon mchog dpal man chad sngar dang 'dra'o// yang na/

g.yag sde lots+tsha ba nas/ lo mchog bag ston/ tshul rgyal/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o// smad lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ phyag na rdo rje/ rgyal po rab gsal zla ba/ de'i slob ma'i mchog lnga ni/ pad dkar ye shes/ ye shes rdo rje/ rgyal bu sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po/ nyi ma'i snying po/ rgyal rigs sa ra ha pa'o// de lnga ka'i slob ma kun dga' snying po/ ta thā ga ta badz+ra/ shrar+dha ka ra warma/ lots+tsha ba rin chen bzang po/ lo chung legs pa'i shes rab/ sum ston ye shes 'bar/ gnyen ston tshul khrims 'bar/ thod pa dben tsha grags/ thod pa 'od zer/ slob dpon chos mgon/ bla ma chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che/ paṇ+ḍi ta rdo rje shes rab/ bla ma 'phags rgyal/ bla ma rin chen dpal bzang po/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o// gsum pa bya spyod kyi skor la/ tshe dpag med lha dgu'i dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ tshe dpag med/ slob dpon snying po'i zhabs/ dze tā ri/ byang chub bzang po/ ting nge 'dzin bzang po/ rdo rje gdan pa/ ba ri lots+tsha ba/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po/ bla chen bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ shar pa rdo rje 'od zer/ bla ma bkra shis 'od zer/ e pa 'khon ston/ bla ma 'jam dbyangs chen po/ byang sems rgyal ye/ grags pa dpal/ spru lung pa kun smon/ brag phug pa/ blo gros brtan pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan des bdag la'o// yang na ba ri lots+tsha ba/ mchims brtson 'grus seng ge rgya zhang phug pa/ dbus pa sangs rgyas 'bum/ bla ma cha gan/ grags pa dpal man 'dra/ yang na rgya zhang phug pa/ 'jad pa sher rin/ e pa 'khon ston man 'dra/ yang na grags pa dpal/ chos 'phags rgyal mtshan/ rin chen seng ge bu ston rin po che/

lots+tsha ba byang chub rtse mo/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan des bdag la'o// gzungs grwa lnga'i dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ phyag na rdo rje/ dze tā ri pa/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung gnyis/ ba ri lots+tsha ba/ sa chen yab sras gsum/ chos rje khu dbon gnyis/ dga' ldan pa bkra shis dpal/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ dpal ldan seng ge bu ston rin po che/ mkhas grub gzhon nu bsod nams/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan des bdag la'o// yang na ba ri ba/ gnyan ston grags/ gnyan rin chen grags/ lha sa'i gnas brtan kun seng*/ de'i sras rtog ston bya'u rgyal/ rgyal tsha lung mang po/ bla ma sher seng*/ 'phags 'od/ bu ston man 'dra/ 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na lha lnga'i dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ phyag na rdo rje/ rab gsal zla ba/ rab 'byor skyong*/ kun dga' snying po/ shes rab skyong*/ zhi ba snying po/ dge mtshan bshes gnyen/ bde ba'i rdo rje/ dad byed go cha/ lots+tsha ba rin chen bzang po/ brag steng pa yon tan tshul khrims/ mal gyo blo gros grags/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po/ rje btsun rin po che/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ chos rgyal 'phags pa/ 'jam dbyangs rin rgyal/ gyi ston grags rgyal/ bla ma shes rab rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen byang chub seng ge chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o// 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ 'jam dbyangs/ dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung gnyis/ ba ri lots+tsha ba/ sa chen yab sras gsum/ chos rje sa skya paṇa chen/ rje btsun rgwa lo/ sras ā ka ra/ brag kha ba grags pa seng ge bla ma bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan des bdag la'o// 'jam dbyangs smra seng gi rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ 'jam dbyangs/ pha dam pa/ kha che gu h+ya pa/ glan sgom yab sras/ bla ma 'od shāka slob dpon 'od zer mgon po/ slob dpon shāka gzhon/ spyan snga ba bkra rgyal/

mkhan po bzod pa dpal/ mkhan po bsod nams 'od zer/ mkhan chen shes rab mgon/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan des bdag la'o// 'jam dbyangs dkar po'i rjes gnang dang sgrub thabs/ paṇ+ḍi ta ma tis mdzad pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'jam dbyangs/ paṇ+ḍi ta ma ti/ paṇa chen shākya shrī/ byang chub dpal/ bde ba dpal/ sangs rgyas gzhon nu/ mkhan po bsod she/ mkhan po shes rab mgon/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o// mi g.yo ba dkar po'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ paṇ+ḍi ta a bha yā ka ra gup+ta/ ā nan+dā ka ra gup+ta/ slob dpon lhan cig skyes pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta dā na shī la/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ slob dpon 'u yug pa/ bcom ldan ral gri/ slob dpon bsod nams bzang po/ mkhan chen bsod nams bzang po/ dar bzang ba/ mkhan po bsod she/ mkhan po shes rab mgon/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan des bdag la'o// paṇ+ḍi ta dā na shī las mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs tshigs su bcad pa/ de'i gsal byed/ rjes gnang gi yi ge bstod pa/ zhal gzigs tshul rnams mkhas pa yon tan khris mdzad pa zhal shes dang bcas pa thos/ don zhags lha lnga'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ spyan ras gzigs/ e ra pa ti/ rigs ngan gyi rnal 'byor pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje/ ba ri lots+tsha ba rin chen grags/ rje btsun lho pa/ zhang nyi phug pa chos grags/ drang pho lung pa grags tshul/ ku ra mkhan po rgyal mtshan mgon/ slob dpon bsod nams grub/ dge bshes kun dga' tshul khrims/ mkhan chen bsod nams grags pa/ don zhags pa sangs rin/ mkhan chen shes rab mgon/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o// don yod zhags pa'i gzungs/ phar phyin drug gi gzungs/ lhan skyes rol pa'i sgrub thabs rnams thos/ sgrol ma dkar mo'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma/ paṇa chen shākya shrī/ lho brag pa byang chub dpal/ mkhan chen bde ba dpal/ ka bzhi pa grags gzhon/ rin po che bsod nams grags/

chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o// ngag dbang grags pa'i sgrub thabs 'chi bslu'i man ngag dang bcas pa thos/ gtsug tor rnam rgyal gyi rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ phyag na rdo rje/ dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung gnyis/ ba ri lots+tsha ba/ sa skya pa lnga/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa/ blo gros brtan pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o// mi g.yo ba sngon po'i sgrub thabs/ las tshogs/ chu bsrung gi rjes gnang dang bcas pa thos pa'i brgyud pa'ang de dang 'dra'o// rnam par 'joms pa ba ri lugs kyi rig gtad kyi brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ phyag na rdo rje/ dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa che ba la a sho ka shrī/ chung ba a mo gha badz+ra/ ba ri lots+tsha ba/ sa chen/ rtse mo/ rje btsun pa/ chos rje pa/ 'phags pa/ bla ma bsod nams dbang phyug bla ma rin chen dpal/ bla ma byang chub gzhon nu/ mkhan chen byang seng pa/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o// gtsug tor dri med kyi chos skor la/ mkhan chen bo bhi sa twas mdzad pa'i mchod rten brgya la sogs pa gdab pa'i cho ga rgyas pa lag len gyi khrigs dang bcas pa thos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ la stod pa dpal rin/ mkhan po mchims/ mkhan po ze'u/ bla ma grags chen/ bla ma 'phags pa/ bu ston pa/ mkhas grub gzhon nu bsod nams/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o// dpal rin gyi gong ma rnams btsal dgos so// sgrol ma'i bstod pa rnam dag gtsug nor gyi brgyud pa ni/ 'phags ma sgrol ma/ nyi ma sbas pa/ bai ro tsa na rak+ṣi ta/ u rgyan gyi mkha' 'gro ma/ paṇ+ḍi ta sūr+ya gu ha/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun pa/ chos rje pa/ khang ston 'od zer rgyal mtshan/ mkhan shag pa/ sang gzhon pa/ bsod she ba/ slob dpon shākya 'bum/ mkhan chen shes rab mgon/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/

des bdag la'o// sme brtsegs dud kha'i sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'jam dbyangs/ dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung gnyis/ ba ri lots+tsha ba/ bla ma sa chen pa/ rje btsun pa/ chos rje pa/ grwa thang pa/ bla ma kun bsod/ bla ma blo gros dpal/ dge bshes seng ge mkhan po bsod she ba/ mkhan chen shes rab mgon/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o// dbyu gu ma spun gsum gyi sgrub thabs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje gdan pa/ ba ri ba/ sa chen pa/ rje btsun pa/ chos rje pa/ bla ma khang*/ kyi ston grags pa rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen pa/ byang seng ba/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan pa/ des bdag la'o// sgrol ma dpal mo gser gyi snying thag can gyi man ngag gi brgyud pa ni/ sgrol ma/ gnyan lots+tsha ba/ dpyil ston rdo rje stobs chen/ yol thogs med/ bla ma grwa zhig pa/ dbus pa sangs rgyas 'bum/ bla ma 'phags pa/ bla ma kun bsod/ khams pa rdo rje dpal/ bla ma grags chen pa/ bla ma 'phags 'od/ bu ston rin chen grub/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o// khyung khra'i sgrub thabs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rgyal po zla ba bzang po/ rgyal po grags pa/ bla ma dus 'khor ba chen po/ dus 'khor ba chung ba/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ pham mthing pa sku mched/ mal jo lots+tsha ba/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ chos rje pa/ 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ brag phug pa/ bla ma blo gros brtan pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ des bdag la'o// rnam sras kyi sgrub thabs 'gro bzang snying pos mdzad pa las tshogs dang bcas pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ phyag na rdo rje/ spyod mdzad chos kyi rdo rje/ kun tu bzang po/ 'gro bzang snying po/ rin chen rdo rje/ kha che dgon pa ba/ zangs dkar lots+tsha ba/

g.yor po jo ston/ gcur bsod nams rin chen/ bla ma 'byid phu ba/ lha rje jo bzang*/ khro phu lots+tsha ba byams pa'i dpal/ dge slong byang chub dpal bzang po/ rin po che bsod nams grags pa/ 'dren mchog phyogs las rnam rgyal/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o// 'di'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ khro phu lots+tsha ba yan chad 'dra/ de nas bla ma 'bri lung pa/ rin po che bsod nams seng ge ka bzhi pa grags gzhon/ rin po che bsod nams grags pa/ mkhan chen bsod nams bzang po/ de gnyis kas 'dren mchog chos kyi rgyal po/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ des bdag la'o// 'di'i chos skor la/ sgrub thabs lo rgyus dang bcas pa/ g.yas kyi phyag mtshan rgyal mtshan brten nas bar chad bsal ba/ g.yon gyi phyag mtshan ne'u le la brten nas zas nor bsgrub pa/ yang dag shes kyis mngon shes dang dbang phyug bsgrub pa/ gang ba bzang pos dmag bzlog pa/ nor bu bzang pos nor bsgrub pa/ ku we ras chom rkun bcing pa/ lngas rtsen gyis tshe sgrub pa/ dzam+bha la'i bi dzā pū ra la brten te skye 'gro dbang du bsdu ba/ ne'u le la brten te zas nor bsgrub pa/ ba dan la brten te dmag drang pa dang bzlog pa gsum/ 'di'i sgos kyi brgyud pa ni/ rje mi tra ma su ri ma/ a ro la dh+ya li/ rje bud+dha shrī/ khro phu lots+tsha ba/ de man gong dang mthun/ yang 'brog gnas kyis dgra gsad pa/ kuṇ+ḍa lis chu 'gag bsrung ba rnams thos/ sgrol ma maṇ+ḍal bzhi pa'i gsol 'debs chos rje bla mas mdzad pa dang*/ phyag 'tshal nyer gcig yang thos/ sgrub thabs kun las btus sam rgya mtshor grags pa'i rjes gnang lung dang bcas pa rdzogs par thob pa'i sgrub thabs kyi rnam grangs la/ dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/ paṇ+ḍi ta chen po ku mu ta 'byung ba'i blo gros zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ dam tshig gsum gyi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnas sbas pa'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa/

dpal rdo rje gdan gyi man ngag gi cho ga dpal rdo rje gdan gyi sgrub thabs/ yi ge drug pa'i sgrub thabs lhan cig skyes pa'i rol pas mdzad pa/ za ma tog bkod pa'i man ngag gi yi ge drug pa'i sgrub thabs/ dpal ldan 'jig rten mgon po'i sgrub thabs/ yi ge drug pa'i sgrub thabs/ kha sar+pā ṇi 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs/ slob dpon rnyog pa med pas mdzad pa/ po ta la kha sar+pā ṇi'i sgrub thabs slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas blo gros zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ kha sar+pā ṇi'i sgrub thabs slob dpon bde byed kyis mdzad pa/ dpal ldan mkha' spyod 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs a nu pa ma rak+ṣi tas cung zad rgyas par mdzad pa/ dpal ldan mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs/ seng ge sgra'i sgrub thabs paṇ+ḍi ta a wa dhū ti dpal ldan 'jigs med rdo rje'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ 'jig rten mgon po'i sgrub thabs/ 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs/ seng ge sgra'i sgrub thabs/ 'phags pa seng ge sgra'i sgrub thabs/ dpal ldan seng ge sgra'i sgrub thabs/ 'jig rten dbang phyug ha la ha la'i sgrub thabs/ ha la ha la'i sgrub thabs lhan cig skyes pa'i rol pas mdzad pa/ rdo rje chos kyi sgrub thabs cho ga bsdus pa/ pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa/ pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs/ ha ri ha ri ha ri la zhon par gyur pa'i sgrub thabs sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa/ 'jig rten gsum po dbang du byed pa'i 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs sa ra ha'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ 'jig rten gsum dbang du byed pa'i 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs/ 'jig rten dbang phyug dmar po'i sgrub thabs/ 'jig rten dbang phyug gi lhag par dbang du bya ba'i cho ga 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug mgrin pa sngon po can gyi sgrub thabs/ sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rim pa'i 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs/

pad ma'i phyag gi gzungs nye bar spyod pa dang bcas pa/ sran ma ma sha'i zhal gyi gzungs/ 'jig rten dbang phyug don yod zhags pa'i sgrub thabs/ dpal ldan 'jig rten gsum po dbang du byed pa'i 'phags pa bhu ga ma'i sgrub thabs slob dpon shū n+yā ta sa ma d+dhi badz+ra pā da'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ dpal ldan 'jig rten mgon po'i sgrub thabs/ brtan pa'i 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs slob dpon bha ba ska na dhas mdzad pa dang*/ tshig lhug pa'i brtan pa'i 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs/ 'jam dpal seng ge sgra'i sgrub thabs/ 'jam dpal ngag gi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs paṇ+ḍi ta dpal ldan yid bzhin nor bus mdzad pa/ dpal ldan ngag gi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs/ ngag gi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sgrub thabs/ dpal ldan 'phags pa ngag gi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs/ a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs mi pham bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ shes rab 'phel ba'i gter ngag gi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs dpal ldan 'phrog byed 'jam pas mdzad pa/ tshig lhug pa'i a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs/ rje btsun 'phags pa 'jam dpal bsgom pa'i man ngag a ra pa tsa na 'phral du nyams su myong ba'i sgrub thabs/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs/ yan lag med pa'i sgrub thabs/ yan lag med pa'i rdo rje'i sgrub thabs/ chos dbyings ngag gi dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs sems can dbang du byed pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ chos dbyings ngag gi dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs/ a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs/ ngag gi sgrub thabs/ dpa' bo gcig tu grub pa'i sgrub thabs/ chos dbyings ngag gi dbang phyug gi sgrub thabs kyi dbang du bya ba'i cho ga ngag gi sgrub thabs/ 'jam dpal rgyal po chen po rol pa'i sgrub thabs/ 'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs/ 'jam dpal dpa' bo gcig tu grub pa'i sgrub thabs/ dpa' bo gcig tu grub pa'i sgrub thabs/ bung ba myos pa'i sgrub thabs/ lhag par dbang du byed pa'i 'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs/

'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod las bsdus pa 'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs/ rig pa 'dzin pa so so nas bsdus pa 'jam dbyangs kyi sgrub thabs/ shes rab 'phel ba'i cho ga mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i man ngag shes rab 'khor lo'i dngos grub mchog gi sgrub thabs/ chos kyi drung gi ting nge 'dzin 'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs/ 'phags pa mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i sgrub thabs/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i sgrub thabs/ yi ge gcig pa'i rab tu sbyor ba'i sgrub thabs/ gtum po chen po'i sgrub thabs cho ga dang bcas pa 'od zer 'byung gnas sbas pas mdzad pa/ gtum po chen po'i sgrub thabs/ seng ldeng nags sgrol gyi sgrub thabs sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa/ sgrol ma chen mo'i sgrub thabs/ mchog sbyin sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ dbang byed sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs slob dpon rdo rje myu gus mdzad pa/ rdo rje sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs tshul mi 'dra ba gsum las/ gcig slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ yang rdo rje sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs paṇ+ḍi ta slob dpon chos 'byung zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ sgrol ma dug sel ma'i sgrub thabs/ sgrol ma nor sbyin ma'i sgrub thabs/ 'od dpag med kyi snying po'i rgyud las 'phags ma sgrol ma'i rtog pa gsungs pa/ ngan song las sgrol ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ lha mo sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ 'chi ba bslu ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ sna tshogs yum gyi sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ don thams cad rab tu sbyin pa'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ de'i gzungs/ yang dug sel ma'i sgrub thabs/ de'i rig sngags sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa/ 'phags ma dug sel ma'i rtog pa ngam gu li'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs paṇ+ḍi ta rin chen 'byung gnas zhi bas mdzad pa/ de'i man ngag yang sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs paṇ+ḍi ta chen po gnas brtan dpe med kyis mdzad pa/

'jigs pa brgyad las skyob pa'i sgrub thabs/ rgya nag rim pa'i 'phags ma sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ rgya nag chen po'i rim pa'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs slob dpon rtag pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa/ 'chi ba bslu ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ 'chi ba bslu ba'i sgrol ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug gi slob ma thu bos mdzad pa/ sgrol ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs slob dpon yid bzhin nor bu'i rgyal pos mdzad pa/ sgrol ma dkar mo phyag drug ma'i sgrub thabs/ ral gcig ma'i sgrub thabs che chung mi 'dra ba lnga las/ gcig slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ tsun+da'i sgrub thabs mi 'dra ba gsum/ rtog pa las byung ba'i 'od zer can phyag bcu pa'i sgrub thabs/ yang rtog pa las gsungs pa'i 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs/ 'od zer can ser mo phyag brgyad ma'i sgrub thabs/ mya ngan med pa'i shing gi 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs/ rtog pa las gsungs pa'i 'od zer can dkar mo'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma'i sgrub thabs/ 'od zer can ser mo phyag brgyad ma'i sgrub thabs/ o ḍe ya na'i 'od zer can phyag bcu gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs/ o ḍe ya na'i 'od zer can dmar mo phyag bcu gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs slob dpon lhan cig skyes pa'i rol pas mdzad pa/ 'od zer can dmar mo phyag bcu pa'i sgrub thabs/ mya ngan med pa'i shing gi 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs/ de'i jag chings/ rtog pa las gsungs pa'i 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs/ slob dpon snying po'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa/ 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs/ 'od zer can pi tsu pa'i sgrub thabs/ yang 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs rgyas bsdus gnyis/ de'i gzungs bklag pa'i man ngag ri khrod lo ma can gyi sgrub thabs mi 'dra ba gnyis/ sher phyin dkar mo'i sgrub thabs/ ri khrod lo ma can gyi gzungs/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma sku mdog ser mo'i sgrub thabs rgyas bsdus gnyis/

sher phyin dkar mo'i sgrub thabs slob dpon dge 'dun byin gyi bus mdzad pa/ yang sher phyin dkar mo'i sgrub thabs paṇ+ḍi ta dpal ldan pad+ma 'phel gyis mdzad pa/ gser mdog can gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgrub thabs/ sher phyin gyis sgrub thabs/ yang gser mdog can gyi sher phyin gyi sgrub thabs/ sher phyin gyi sgrub thabs slob dpon 'phags pa thogs med kyis mdzad pa/ 'phags ma rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs slob dpon dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa/ dbyangs can ma chen mo'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs mi 'dra ba gnyis/ rdo rje pi wang ma dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs gshin rje nag po las gsungs pa/ yang rdo rje dbyangs can ma'i sgrub thabs/ 'phags ma khro gnyer can gyi sgrub thabs mi 'dra ba gnyis/ sgrol ma'i rtog pa las byung ba'i ku ru kul+le'i sgrub thabs/ sgrol ma'i rtog pa las byung ba'i rig byed ma'i sgrub thabs slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ de'i dbang du byed pa'i man ngag yang rig byed ma'i sgrub thabs mi 'dra ba gnyis/ u rgyan nas byung ba'i rig byed ma'i sgrub thabs/ slob dpon lhan cig skyes pa'i rol pas mdzad pa'i rig byed ma'i sgrub thabs/ kye'i rdo rje'i rim pa'i rig byed ma'i sgrub thabs/ kye rdor gyi rgyud nas byung ba'i rig byed ma'i sgrub thabs/ rig byed phyag drug ma'i sgrub thabs mi 'dra ba gnyis/ rig byed phyag brgyad ma'i sgrub thabs in+d+ra bhū tis mdzad pa/ yang rig byed ma'i sgrub thabs/ de'i man ngag gi rim pa/ rig byed ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs/ slob dpon nag po pas mdzad pa'i rig byed ma'i sgrub thabs/ ku ru kul+le'i las rab tu rgyas par sbyor ba/ rnam rgyal gyi sgrub thabs/ gdugs dkar gyi sgrub thabs rdo rje tsartsi ka'i sgrub thabs/

so so 'brang ma'i sgrub thabs mi 'dra ba gsum/ stong chen mo/ gsang sngags rjes 'dzin/ rma bya chen mo/ bsil ba'i tshal zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/ lha mo lnga'i sgrub thabs mdor bsdus pa/ phyir zlog ma'i sgrub thabs/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan gyi sgrub thabs/ gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje gan+dha ri'i sgrub thabs gnyis/ bsrung ba lnga'i cho ga rdo rje lcags sgrog gi sgrub thabs mi 'dra ba gnyis/ paṇ+ḍi ta chos kyi 'byung gnas blo gros kyis mdzad pa'i rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan gyi sgrub thabs/ gtsug tor rnam rgyal gyi sgrub thabs/ lha mo nor rgyun ma'i sgrub thabs mi 'dra ba gsum/ de'i gzungs kyi man ngag phag mo'i sgrub thabs a wa dhū ti pas mdzad pa/ phag mo shes rab gsal byed ma'i sgrub thabs/ byams pa'i sgrub thabs mi 'dra ba gnyis/ paṇ+ḍi ta 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas pas mdzad pa'i dzam+bha la nag po'i sgrub thabs/ dzam+bha la ser po'i sgrub thabs rgyas bsdus gsum/ ser po phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad pa/ ser po lha pho brgyad mo brgyad kyis bskor ba'i sgrub thabs rgyas bsdus gnyis/ de la chu rgyun du dbul ba'i man ngag gi rim pa mi 'dra ba gsum/ slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad pa'i rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs/ rtog pa bdun pa las gsungs pa'i rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs/ paṇ+ḍi ta shrār+dha ka ras mdzad pa'i rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs/ 'jig rten gsum las rnam rgyal gyi sgrub thabs/ rdo rje me dang nyi ma 'bar ba'i sgrub thabs/ rta mchog gi sgrub thabs/ gshin rje gshed dmar po'i sgrub thabs/ gshin rje nag po'i sgrub thabs mi 'dra ba gnyis/ yang dgra nag gi sgrub thabs/ gshin rje mthar byed kyi sgrub thabs mi 'dra ba gnyis/ bgegs mthar byed kyi sgrub thabs/ stobs po che'i sgrub thabs slob dpon shākya bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/

yang stobs po che'i sgrub thabs/ hūm̐ mdzad kyi sgrub thabs/ he ru ka'i sgrub thabs/ kye'i rdo rje phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs ta ra shrīs mdzad pa/ bdag med ma'i sgrub thabs rgyas bsdus gnyis/ 'byung po 'dul byed kyi sgrub thabs/ de'i cho ga dam pa thams cad 'dren pa'i 'jig rten gsum gyi rdo rjes mdzad pa/ nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs/ yang nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs rnams so// lha 'di dag gi rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ a bha yā ka ra/ shu bhaṃ ka ra gup+ta/ pu tsa ti gup+ta/ rat+na rak+ṣi ta/ go taṃ shrī/ kīrti paṇ+ḍi ta/ lots+tsha ba grags rgyal/ rgyal mtshan rin chen/ gar thig pa bsod rgyal/ ka bcu la gzhon nu seng ge bla ma mgon po 'bum/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o// de'i lung rkyang gi brgyud pa ni/ lots+tsha ba grags rgyal nas/ bcom ral/ 'od chung ba/ bsam gzhon/ re steng pa byang dpal/ bla ma mgon po 'bum man 'dra'o// yang sgrub thabs brgya rtsar grags pa sgrub thabs dgu bcu go drug gi lung dang bcas pa rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ phyag na rdo rje/ dze tā ri pa/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung gnyis/ ba ri lots+tsha ba/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ bla ma tshogs sgom pa/ nyan chen bsod nams brtan pa/ bla ma bsod nams skyabs/ bla ma gzungs kyi dpal/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o// yang chos rje de nyid kyi drung du/ lung sna tshogs zhus pa la/ rje btsun chos kyi rje rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpal sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po'i bka' 'bum gyi dkar chag ni/ ka pa la/ brtag gnyis kyi rgyud sde spyi'i rnam gzhag sa bcad/ ṭī ka rgyud kyi tho yig zer ba'i gur gyi don bsdus gcig glu bshad/ rtsa yi mngon rtogs/

gur gyi bshad pa'i chings/ rdo rje snying po'i 'grel pa snga 'gyur gyi yig sna sgrub thabs mtsho skyes kyi bsdus don/ lo rgyus/ de'i ṭī ka bdag med ma'i dbang gi tho yig bde mchog gi dka' gnad kyi zin bris gcig kha pa la/ bde mchog le 'grel/ de'i sa bcad/ de'i ṭī ka mu tig gi phreng ba/ nag po pa'i dkyil chog nag po pa'i dbang gi tho yig dbang gong ma gsum gyi tho yig sbyin sreg gi cho ga'i rim pa/ gsang ba'i de kho na nyid gsal ba'i 'grel pa/ de'i tshig don gnyis bsdus pa'i go 'byed/ o la pa ti'i man ngag de'i pin tar+tha/ gsang ba'i de kho na nyid gsal ba'i bsdus don/ o la pa ti'i mngon par rtogs pa'i bsdus don/ ro sreg gi tho yig gsang ba'i de kho na nyid gsal ba'i zin bris/ 'jigs byed rtog bdun gyi ṭī ka ga pa la/ rdo rje phur pa'i mngon rtogs/ de'i las byang*/ sgrol ma lha bcu bdun ma'i dkyil chog gces bsdus phreng ba/ uṣ+ḍi ṣa'i srung 'khor/ bha ya na sa'i srung 'khor/ skyu ra a skyabs la zhu yig de'i 'phro la slob dpon chen po'i bka' 'bum la/ rgyud sde spyi'i rnam gzhag chen mo/ brtag gnyis kyi ṭī ka rnam bshad nyi ma'i 'od zer/ nga pa la/ sim+bu ṭa'i sa bcad 'grel pa/ ca pa la/ sgrub thabs mtsho skyes kyi 'grel pa/ kye'i rdo rje'i dbang chu/ dkyil chog nas gling ma/ ḍom+bhi pa'i lugs kyi dkyil chog kye'i rdo rje'i mngon rtogs rgyas pa rab gnas bzang po drug rnams bzhugs/ cha pa la/ rdo rje dril bu pa'i dbang gi bya ba'i 'grel pa/ bde mchog gi mchod phreng*/ don zhags lo rgyus/ de'i sa bcad/ lha lnga'i bstod pa/ mdo'i rnam bshad rin chen phreng ba/ gtsug tor rnam rgyal gyi rtog pa'i ṭī ka sa bcad/ rdo rje gdan pa'i chos drug mi g.yo ba'i chos skor/ de'i rgya gzhung*/ rgyud nas phyung pa'i bstod pa/ spyod 'jug gi ṭī ka chos la 'jug pa'i sgo/

byis pa bde blag tu 'jug pa rnams so// ja pa la/ rje btsun chen po'i bka' 'bum la/ rje sa skya pa chen po'i rnam thar/ lam 'bras brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ bla ma bsten pa'i thabs sh+lau ka lnga bcu pa'i gsal byed/ byin rlabs tshar gsum khug pa/ dag ljon gnyis/ rgyud sde'i dum bu brgyad cu rtsa gnyis rnams so// nya pa la/ gur gyi sa bcad/ de'i rgyan/ de'i thig chog mngon par rtogs pa 'bring po yan lag drug pa/ dpa' bo gcig pa'i mngon rtogs/ kye'i rdo rje'i bstod pa rgyun chags/ kye'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi bkra shis/ de'i las bzhi'i sbyin sreg bdag med ma'i mngon par rtogs pa/ gang drin ma'i bstod pa/ lam 'bras brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs thung ngu gcig lha mo bco lnga'i bstod pa/ de'i bsdus don/ dga' ston rdo rje grags la springs pa/ rgyud sde bzhi'i dkar chag rags pa la sogs pa/ he ru ka'i byung tshul/ lū hi pa'i mngon rtogs rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum du phye ba/ nag po gzhung drug gi sa bcad/ nag po dkyil chog gi yig sna/ nag po pa'i dkyil chog ta pa la/ slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pa'i lo rgyus/ dril bu pa'i mngon rtogs/ rim lnga'i gsal byed/ tshes bcu la sogs pa'i dus kyi mchod pa'i yig sna/ phag mo zhal gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs/ sngags kyi de nyid sgrub pa'i don gsal ba/ phag mo las bcu ste/ mi dbang chos gsum du grags pa/ me tri mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs/ 'bum phrag gsum pa las phyung ba'i sgyu 'phrul drwa ba chen mo ral pa gyen du brdzes pa'i rgyud las byung ba btsun pa dar ma yon tan gyis bsgyur ba/ yang de'i sgrub thabs slob dpon gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa/ rjes gnang gi cho ga slob dpon rgyal ba'i sdes mdzad pa/ nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs/ bskyed pa'i rim pa'i cha bzlas bsgom gnyis la brten nas mkha' spyod kyi dngos grub sgrub thabs/
