byin rlabs kyi yi ge tshes bcu'i mchod pa/ sbyin sreg mar me'i sbyin sreg rtsa dbu ma'i man ngag lam gyi yan lag pra sen dbab pa/ gnod sbyin mo sgrub thabs/ tshangs pa'i bu mo sgrub thabs/ pad+ma pa ti'i man ngag khol po pa ti'i man ngag sman chen po'i bcud len/ nges brjod bla ma'i 'khrul 'khor bsgom pa dang*/ bris te bcangs pas las du ma 'grub pa sgrub pa'i thabs/ tshogs bdag dmar po'i sgrub thabs/ sbyin sreg zhal gdams dang bcas pa/ mkha' 'gro ma kun spyod kyi yig sna/ phur pa'i sgrub thabs tshigs bcad ma/ phur pa'i tho yig rgyun gyi man ngag la sogs pa las kha tshar ba 'ga'/ dgra nag gi sgrub thabs/ 'jigs byed kyi bstod pa gnyis/ sgrol ma zhi khro'i bstod pa 'don thabs/ rje btsun ma'i las kha tshar ba/ maṇ+ḍal phul ba'i man ngag bsdus pa/ phyag 'tshal nyer gcig gi bsdus don/ de'i rnam bshad gsal ba'i 'od zer/ phyag 'tshal nyer gcig gi las tshogs nyi ma sbas pas mdzad pa'i bsdus don sgrol ma spyi dang so so'i mngon par rtogs pa dang*/ bstod pa 'don thabs kyi brjed byang*/ phyag 'tshal nyer gcig gi las tshogs kyi 'grel pa/ rdo rje sgrol ma'i man ngag mchims chos seng la springs yig sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ yan lag drug pa/ maṇ+ḍal bzhi pa'i gsol 'debs/ bla ma rje btsun pa'i rnam thar mnal lam ma/ he ru ka'i chas drug nang gi lhung bzed brtag pa/ rtsa ltung gi rgya cher bshad pa 'khrul pa spong ba/ tha pa la/ ngan song sbyong rgyud kyi spyi don/ de'i sa bcad/ rdo rje 'byung ba'i yig sna/ kun rig gi cho ga gzhan phan 'od zer/ rab gnas don gsal/ gzhan phan nyer mkho/ arga'i cho ga ro sreg ste sdig pa sbyong ba/ kun rig nas 'byung ba'i phyag len/ kun rig gi zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya spyod rigs gsum spyi'i rig gtad kyi cho ga dpa' bo gcig tu grub pa'i rgyud kyi ṭī ka man ngag don gsal/ a ra pa tsa na lha lnga'i sgrub thabs dang dkyil chog

don yod zhags pa'i rtog pa lag tu blang ba'i rim pa/ de'i maṇ+ḍal bya thabs/ don zhags lha lnga'i bstod pa/ de'i srung 'khor/ lag na rdo rje'i don kun 'grub pa'i gzungs kyi lag tu blang ba'i rim pa/ da pa la/ rnam 'joms kyi rgyud kyi gsal byed 'od zer can rgyud kyi sa bcad/ dpung bzang gi mdo 'grel/ nam mkha' lding gi mngon rtogs/ sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i ṭī ka kha 'bar ma'i rgyud kyi dgongs pa/ don lnga'i lag tu blang ba'i rim pa/ tshom bu bco lnga pa/ gtor ma brgya rtsa byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan gyi rjes su 'brang ba/ mang pos bkur ba'i rgyal rabs/ sde pa'i gyes mdo/ 'khon gyi gdung rabs bsdus pa/ dus tshod nges par gzung ba'i yi ge 'grub sbyor/ ga ring rgyal po la bskur ba'i yi ge sdom pa nyi shu pa'i rnam bshad/ las dang po pas nyams su blang ba'i rim pa rin chen phreng ba/ nyams dbyangs chen mo/ spyod 'jug gi bsdus don/ sman dpyad rgyal po'i dkor mdzod/ na pa la/ gsung ngag rin po che'i skor bzhugs/ 'di rnams kyi lung dang*/ glegs bam dang po na phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa ma byung ba la/ dus phyis bla ma dpal ldan seng ge'i thugs dgongs rdzogs pa'i phyir du/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ mkhan po shes rab rdo rje dang*/ dbus pa rin rgyal gnyis phyogs bcur btang ste/ lung su yod la zhus shing dpe rnams kyang phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pas na lung thams cad phyogs gcig brgyud pa ni med mod/ 'on kyang mkhan chen sher rdor bas bla ma so so las gsan/ des mkhan chen rgyal ba bzang po la/ des mkhan chen byang chub seng ge thams cad mkhyen pa ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ des bdag la'o// de las lam 'bras sogs lam skor dgu/ lam gces bsdus dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sa chen pa/ bsod nams rtse/ rje btsun pa/ chos rje pa/ 'phags pa/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/

dpal ldan seng ge chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ des sher rdor la'o// yang na 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ na bza' brag phug pa/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan la'o// yang na chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ tshogs sgom pa/ nyan chen pa/ brag phug pa/ dpal ldan seng ge de gnyis las chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan pas gsan no// rgyud sde spyi'i stong thun/ dag ldan/ mngon rtogs ljon shing*/ gur gyi sa bcad/ gur rgyan rnams sa chen/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun pa/ chos rje pa/ zhang mdo sde dpal/ 'jam skya/ dpal ldan seng ge chos rje bla ma dam pa/ sher rdor/ nag po po'i dkyil chog de'i ṭī ka nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs/ me tri mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs/ rdzogs rim rtsa dbu ma/ lam gyi yan lag pra phab pa/ gnod sbyin mo'i sgrub thabs/ tshangs pa'i bu mo'i sgrub thabs/ pad+ma pa ti'i man ngag khol po pa ti'i man ngag sman chen po'i bcud len/ me tri mkha' spyod kyi rjes gnang rnams brag phug pa/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa/ sher rdor ro// sgrol ma spyi sgrub/ so so'i sgrub thabs/ bstod pa 'don thabs/ nyi ma sbas pas mdzad pa'i phyag 'tshal nyer gcig gi sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa'i ṭī ka sa chen gyis mdzad pa'i lha bcu bdun ma'i dkyil chog rnams/ rin po che bsod nams grags pa/ chos rje bsod nams pa/ sher rdor ro// sgrol ma'i bstod sgrub gnyis kyi brgyud pa ni/ nyi sbas/ tai lo/ nā ro/ nag po pa/ gu rub lots+tsha ba/ rong pa/ brang ti dar ma snying po/ bla ma sa chen/ mchims khu dbon gnyis/ bla ma 'jam gsar/ lce mdo seng*/ bla ma rgwa lo/ rong pa sher seng*/ rin po che bsod nams grags pa man chad gong dang 'dra/ dkyil chog gi brgyud pa ni/ sgrol ma/ klu sgrub/ nyi ma sbas pa/ dha na shrī/ mañdzu shrī/ mal lots+tsha ba/ sa chen pa/ mchims chos seng*/ mchims blo brtan/ bla ma 'jam gsar/

sri'u/ rje btsun rgwa lo/ sher seng*/ rin po che bsod nams grags pa man chad sngar dang 'dra/ sgrol ma maṇ+ḍal bzhi ma'i brgyud pa ni/ mkhan po shes rab rgyal mtshan grub pa dpal bzang po/ bla ma bzang po pa/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa man gong dang 'dra/ rnam 'joms byab srung dang bcas pa/ dpal ldan pa/ chos rje bsod nams pa man 'dra'o// dkar mo nyi zla ni/ 'gro mgon 'phags pa/ kun bsod/ bla chen kun blo/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa man 'dra'o// sa chen pa'i rgyud sde spyi'i rnam gzhag brtag gnyis kyi sa bcad/ ṭī ka bde mchog rtsa rgyud kyi le 'grel/ sa bcad/ mal lo'i gsung la zin bris byas pa'i ṭī ka che ba/ 'jigs byed rtog bdun gyi ṭī ka che ba rnams bla ma sa chen/ gan pa ston dar/ gan pa so ston/ gan pa chos rgyal/ gan pa rin rgyal/ bla ma ye shes dpal/ sher rdor ro// rje btsun rtse mo'i saṃ bu ṭi'i ṭī ka rje btsun pa'i rab gnas don gsal/ he ru ka'i chas drug gtor ma brgya rtsa rnams bsod rnams rtse mo/ rje btsun pa/ paṇa chen pa/ zhang mdo sde dpal/ 'jam skya/ dpal ldan pa/ sher rdor ro// sgrol ma zhi khro'i thugs sgrub thabs ni/ rje btsun pa/ paṇa chen pa/ shar pa sher 'byung*/ ye shes 'byung gnas rgyal mtshan/ dkon mchog 'byung gnas/ bde ba can pa ye shes mgon po/ seng ge rgyal mtshan/ sher rdor ro// rje btsun rtse mo'i mi g.yo ba'i chu bsrung ni/ rje btsun sku mched/ chos rje pa/ mdo sde dpal/ lo mchog bag ston/ sher rdor ro// ku ru kul+le'i sgrub thabs ni/ rje btsun pa/ chos rje pa/ 'o yug pa bsod seng*/ spru lung pa kun smon/ la ru pa yon tan dpal/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ bag ston sher rdor ro// gnyan gyi sgrol ma yan lag drug pa ni/ rje btsun chen po/ paṇa chen pa/ shar pa sku mched/ 'jam dbyangs chen po/ bag ston man 'dra'o// bdud rgyal thod phreng gi gtor chog ni/

chos rje khu dbon/ 'od ldan dpal/ 'jam rtog gzhon tshul man 'dra'o/ dur khrod bdag po'i sgrub thabs ni/ byang chen pa/ bag ston man 'dra'o// ma rgyud kye'i rdo rje'i sbyor drug yang gzhon tshul man chad gsum mo// rdo rje 'byung ba'i ṭī ka ni/ rje btsun pa/ chos rje khu dbon/ spru lung pa kun smon/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ slob dpon rin chen dpal/ bla ma rgyal ba dpal/ bla ma thogs med pa/ sher rdor ro// don zhags kyi lo rgyus/ sa bcad/ rgyud chung ṭī ka lag tu blang ba'i rim pa rnams rje btsun pa/ chos rje paṇa chen pa/ gtsang po zho ra ba/ la ru pa/ grags chen pa/ 'phags 'od/ bu ston rin po che/ mkhan chen dwang ma ba/ sher rdor ro// dril bu pa'i dbang chu/ sgrub thabs gnyis/ paṇa chen pa yan gzhan dang 'dra zhing*/ des bo dong rin po che/ khro phu rin po che/ yang rtse ba rin chen seng ge kun mkhyen rin chen grub/ rin po che bsod nams grags pa man sngar bzhin no// sdom pa nyi shu pa'i ṭī ka mtshan brjod 'don thabs rnams/ ka bzhi grags gzhon/ rin po che bsod nams grags pa/ mkhan chen gzhon nu mgon/ sher rdor ro// kye'i rdo rje'i dbang chu chen mo/ dbang chog nas gling ma/ chos la 'jug pa'i sgo/ byis pa bde blag tu 'jug pa/ mngon rtogs yan lag drug pa/ bdag med mngon rtogs/ lū hi pa'i mngon rtogs gsum/ phag mo zhal gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs/ sngags kyi byin rlabs/ las bcu/ mchims chos seng la springs yig gzhan phan nyer mkho/ arga'i cho ga kha 'bar ma'i gtor chen rnams paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'phags pa/ 'jam rgyal/ bla ma a mo gha/ sher rdor ro// dril bu pa'i lo rgyus/ rim lnga/ tshes bcu'i mchod pa/ nges brjod bla ma'i 'khrul 'khor bri thabs rnams/ steng lo/ slob dpon a mo gha/ sher rdor ro// sgrol ma phyag 'tshal nyer gcig gi sa bcad/ ṭī ka nyi ma sbas pa'i nyer gcig ma'i las tshogs dang bcas pa'i sa bcad rnams/

bla ma thub pa mgon/ a mo gha/ sher rdor ro// rigs gsum spyi'i rig gtad a ra pa tsa na'i mngon rtogs/ dkyil chog rnams kyang gong dang 'dra'o// dpa' bo grub pa'i rgyud kyi ṭī ka ni/ chos rje pa/ shong pa bsod rin/ slob dpon gzungs lus/ rin po che bsod nams 'byung ba/ sher rdor ro// brtag gnyis kyi ṭī ka rnam bshad nyi ma'i 'od zer/ chos rje khu dbon/ de gnyis ka las shong pa bsod rin/ sras kun rin/ sher rdor ro// rab gnas bzang po drug dus tha ma'i cho ga bstod pa daṇ+ḍa ka kye rdor dkyil 'khor gyi bkra shis rnams/ 'phags pa rin po che/ cog ro ston gzhon/ chos brtson/ sangs rgyas rin chen/ sher rdor ro// 'dod rgyal dmar po'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje myu gus mdzad pa'i ṭī ka sa chen/ rje btsun pa/ paṇa chen/ kham pa dbon po/ rje btsun rgwa lo/ ā ka ra/ sangs rgyas rin chen/ sher rdor ro// tshogs bdag gi sgrub thabs che chung*/ rje btsun pa/ paṇa chen pa/ skyob pa dpal/ gzhon nu bkra shis/ rdo rje dpal/ gu ru sher rin/ sangs rgyas rin chen man 'dra'o// kye'i rdo rje'i mngon rtogs rgyas pa/ chos rje bsod rgyal/ sher rdor ro// glu'i bshad pa la sogs pa ṭī ka mngon rtogs/ bstod pa la sogs pa drug cu rtsa dgu'i brgyud pa/ sa chen pa yab sras gsum/ chos rje paṇa chen pa/ dmar chos rgyal/ gzhon nu rgyal mtshan/ ka bcu pa gzhon nu seng ge sher rdor ro// gnyen gyi sgrol ma yan lag drug pa'i brgyud lugs gcig ni/ klu sgrub nas/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ dpal bde ba/ bi ma la gup+ta/ rin chen rdo rje/ rin chen grags pa/ ri sul gyi rnal 'byor ma/ gnyan lots+tsha ba/ gnam kha'u pa/ rje sa chen/ rje btsun pa/ chos rje pa/ byang chub dpal/ bde ba dpal/ ka bzhi pa grags pa gzhon nu/ rin po che bsod nams grags pa/ rin po che grags tshul ba/ sher rdor/ mkhan chen rgyal bzang ba/

mkhan chen byang seng pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ de la bdag gis rdzogs par zhus shing*/ gsung ngag rin po che'i skor rnams nyams khrid ma gtogs bklag lung byed pa'i srol med do// //mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug chos kyi rje dpal ldan sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po'i bka' 'bum gyi dkar chag ni/ ka pa la/ legs bshad/ rol mo'i bstan bcos/ blo gsal zhing don du gnyer ba'i skye bo rnams la ji ltar dri ba'i tshul rtsom 'phro la bzhag pa/ mkhas pa 'jug pa'i sgo/ sgra la 'jug pa zhes bya ba'i rnam par bshad pa/ smra sgo'i gnad kyi gnas bsdus pa/ byis pa bde blag tu 'jug pa'i rnam bshad byis pa la phan pa yi ge'i sbyor ba/ sgra nye bar bsdu ba'i tshigs su bcad pa tshig gi gter/ sdeb sbyor sna tshogs kyi me tog gi chun po/ bde bar gshegs pa'i thugs rje la bskul ba/ rje btsun chen po'i rnam thar thun mong du grags pa/ nga brgyad ma rtsa 'grel rnams bzhugs/ kha pa la/ rigs gter rtsa 'grel gnyis/ rje btsun chen po la bstod pa ste gnyis bzhugs/ ga pa la/ dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed kyi cho ga de'i lung sbyor/ thub pa'i dgongs pa gsal ba zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos/ sdom pa gsum gyi rab tu dbye ba/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la zhu ba'i phrin yig skyes bu dam pa rnams la 'phrin du spring ba'i phrin yig lung rigs rnam dag dang mthun par 'chad dgos tshul gyi tshigs su bcad pa/ rtogs ldan gcig gis dris pa'i lan/ zhang lots+tsha ba la gdams pa'i tshigs su bcad pa bcu gsum pa/ bstan pa la dga' ba'i lha rnams la springs yig yang tshigs su bcad pa thor bu ba gong 'og gnyis/ mi nyag gi rgyal khams dpal bde ba chen po lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang chen por gnyug mar bzhugs pa'i mkhan slob dge 'dun rnams la phul ba'i yi ge nyi ma la spring pa rnams bzhugs/

nga pa la/ lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ sgrub pa lung sbyin/ yang gcig rten 'brel lnga'i yi ge lam sbas bshad kyi 'grel pa/ aṣ+ṭa'i gzhi bshad snying po don gsal/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga de la dgos pa'i rdo rje gur gyi lung sbyor/ rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi rgyud kyi bshad pa bdud rtsi spel ba zhes bya ba/ a ra pa tsa na dang*/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs bsdus pa/ gza' yum gyi mchod chog dri ma med pa'i rgyan gyi 'grel pa/ bla ma la thun mong ma yin pa'i sgo nas gsol ba gdab pa'i tshul/ bla ma dam pa la gsol ba gdab pa'i rab tu byed pa/ bde mchog gi bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba gdab pa/ mthu stobs dbang phyug la gsol ba gdab pa/ bod yul la bsngags pa/ shākya'i rgyal po la gsol ba gdab pa'i tshigs su bcad pa bco lnga pa/ bde bar gshegs pa khams gsum gyi mgon po la gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa dgu pa/ 'jig rten dbang phyug la gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa bcu gcig pa/ lha sa'i bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la rab tu bsngags pa/ rje btsun chen pos mdzad pa'i 'jam dbyangs kyi bstod pa'i rnam bshad yi ge nyung ngu zhes bya ba/ bsam yas su 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi phyag mtshan ri mor bris pa'i yi ge mu stegs kyi ston pa 'phrog byed dga' bo la sogs pa drug btul ba'i tshe sbyar ba'i tshigs su bcad pa/ pa gor zhes bya ba'i sgra las drangs pa'i bstod pa/ rta nag ri khud kyi rnga bo che la bstod pa/ gdong bzhi pa la bstod pa/ theg pa chen po'i lam gyi rnam gzhag mdor bsdus pa/ snang ba mtha' yas kyi bsgom don mdor bsdus pa/ spyod pa rnam par dag pa'i chos tshigs su bcad pa bcu gnyis pa/ sems kyi gnas lugs rnal du mtshon par byed pa'i man ngag tshigs su bcad pa brgyad pa/ 'chi kha'i gdams ngag ngo mtshar can/ chag lo'i dris lan/ glo bo lots+tsha ba la springs yig dge ba'i bshes gnyen sgrub pa rtse gcig tu mdzad pa'i dris lan/

yang dris lan mdor bsdus pa gcig snye mo sgom chen la spring yig phyag rgya chen po yan lag bdun ldan gyi rtsa ba/ bsngo ba'i yon bshad rnams bzhugs pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos rje pa/ 'phags pa rin po che/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa/ bla ma don yod rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon 'dul 'dzin/ byang seng ba/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o// yang na 'phags pa nas/ dga' ldan pa bkra shis dpal/ kun bsod/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge bla ma don yod pa man chad 'dra'o// //bla ma dam pa chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che'i bka' 'bum gyi dkar chag ni/ ka pa la/ lam 'bras brgyud pa'i phyag 'tshal/ brtag gnyis kyi 'grel pa/ ku mu ti dang bcas pa gsol 'debs/ ba ri brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ 'jigs byed brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ bla ma brgyud pa'i mtshan 'bum/ bla ma dam pa la gsol ba 'debs pa'i rab byed la spel ba gong 'og gnyis/ bla ma spyi'i bstod pa mu tig gi phreng ba/ chos rje pa la bstod pa gnyis/ gsol 'debs yan lag bdun pa/ rtse lngar sbyar ba/ dkon mchog gsum la bstod pa/ chos rje pa'i mtshan la spel ba'i bstod pa gnyis/ yang chos rje pa la bstod pa bdun/ thogs med sku mched la sogs pa la bstod pa/ yang chos rje la bstod pa gnyis/ thos pa rgya mtsho ma mchog brgyad la bstod pa/ bla ma la thun mong ma yin pa'i sgo nas gsol ba 'debs pa'i 'grel pa/ rtsa ba'i bla ma la maṇ+ḍal 'bul zhing gsol ba gdab pa'i man ngag bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma la thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba gdab pa/ chos rje pa la bstod pa me tog phreng ba/ lam 'bras lam skor sogs kyi brgyud pa mang du yod pa bkra shis rgyal mtshan gyis zhus nas mtshal mdor bsdebs pa/ kye'i rdo rje'i rgyud kyi bsdus don/ mngon rtogs/ dag ldan/ spyi don gsal ba/ gur gyi le 'grel/ sam+bu ṭi'i bsdus don/ he ru ka'i yig brgya zlos pa'i man ngag

kye'i rdo rje'i sgrub thabs srung 'khor dang bcas pa/ sgrub thabs rgyas pa yid bzhin nor bu rnams bzhugs/ kha pa la/ bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi pa dang drug pa mi 'dra ba'i khyad par bstan pa/ bsnyen pa'i grangs tshad sogs zhus pa'i lan/ dam tshig gsum gyi glu'i rjes la smon lam gdab tshul/ kye'i rdo rje'i bdag 'jug gi cho ga dbang la 'jug pa/ lam dus kyi dbang rgyas pa blang ba'i lag len dbon mo go go can gyi don du mdzad pa/ dbang gong ma gsum gyi lag len tshigs bcad ma/ kye'i rdo rje'i lus dkyil kyi sgrub thabs/ kye'i rdo rje'i tshogs 'khor gyi cho ga bdud rtsi'i bum pa/ de'i lung sbyor/ yang kye'i rdo rje'i tshogs 'khor bsdus pa gcig bdud rtsi 'byung ba/ bdag med lha mo bco lnga'i mngon rtogs/ bstod pa rnam dag gi phreng ba/ dag pa gsum gyi khrid yig 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor/ khro bo bcu'i bstod bskul/ seng ge mtha'i dris lan/ dris lan rnam nges zhes bya ba/ dbang phyug 'bum gyi dris lan/ dus 'khor thugs dkyil gyi mngon rtogs/ lnga bsdus/ sgra gcan/ gza' lnga dang bcas pa'i rtsis gzhi/ nyi khyim 'pho ba'i nges pa/ yang dus kyi 'khor lo'i rtsis dus gsal ba'i sgron ma/ de'i don yang dag par bsdus pa/ gdod ma'i dus gsal bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i rtsis/ rtsis kyi gtsug lag mthun par nges pa zhes bya ba/ dh+rū pa gnyis ba zhes bya ba'i rtsis/ lo bdag gi rtsis nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i gtsug lag gi de kho na nyid nyung ngus bde blag tu rtogs par byed pa rin po che'i sgron ma/ rgyal bu jim gyim gyi chos 'khor bskor ba'i dus kyi bstan rtsis/ bde mchog nag po pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i cho ga'i sdom tshig de'i bdag 'jug gi cho ga de'i mngon rtogs/ sgrub thabs snying po/ de'i mchod phreng kun tu bzang po'i mchod phreng*/

de'i sbyin sreg gi sdom nyi shu bdun pa/ de'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga rgyas pa/ bde mchog dril bu pa lus dkyil gyi sgrub thabs nyung zhing gsal ba rnams bzhugs/ ga pa la/ bde mchog lū hi pa'i sgrub thabs rim par gsal ba/ yang de'i sgrub thabs bsdus pa/ bde mchog gi rgyun bshags nā ro ta pa las brgyud de 'ongs pa/ 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor la bstod pa'i rab tu byed pa/ dril bu pa'i dbang gi bya ba bsdus pa/ lus dkyil kyi bdag 'jug rim lnga'i khrid yig bde mchog lha lnga'i sgrub thabs/ bde mchog lhan skyes kyi sgrub thabs yan lag bcu pa/ yang de'i sgrub thabs jo sras phag gru'i don du mdzad pa/ za byed rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sgo nas sdig pa sbyong ba'i cho ga bde mchog gi bkra shis kha che rin chen rdo rjes mdzad pa la/ de'i tshig rkang ma snyoms pa la sogs pa'i zhu dag dang*/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad kyi kha skong*/ rgyal bu jim gyim dang go go can ma la mdzad pa'i bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad gnyis/ phag mo lha so bdun ma'i mngon rtogs/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mkha' spyod ma'i sgrub thabs nā ro ta pa'i rjes su 'brang ba/ sgo mtshams ma rnams la bstod cing bskul ba/ dpal sgyu ma chen mo'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dbang rnam par rol pa/ de'i sgrub thabs sgyu 'phrul rol pa/ yang de'i sgrub thabs mdor bsdus pa/ de'i tshogs 'khor/ sgrol ma lha bcu bdun ma'i sgrub thabs/ phyag 'tshal nyi shu rtsa gcig gi lha mo'i sgrub thabs/ gur nas 'byung ba'i rdo rje sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ sgrol ma lus dkyil gyi sgrub thabs/ 'jigs pa brgyad las skyobs pa'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs slob dpon thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa bla ma nyid kyis cang tor bsgyur ba/ gnas kyi dbang phyug ma zhes bya ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/

rdo rje gur gyi rjes su 'brang ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ phyag drug sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dbang rab gsal ba/ mdor byas kyi bsdus don rnams bzhugs/ nga pa la/ sgrol ma lha bcu bdun ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dpal ye shes zhabs kyi rnam thar dang*/ bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa/ gsang ba 'dus pa lha bcu dgu ma'i sgrub thabs rin po che'i phreng ba/ dgra nag gi sgrub thabs/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi mngon rtogs/ rdo rje 'jigs byed phyag drug pa'i sgrub thabs tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga dang bcas pa/ yang 'jigs byed phyag drug pa'i sgrub thabs a rog che'i don du sbyar ba/ 'jigs byed phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs gong 'og gnyis/ 'jigs byed kyi bdag 'jug de'i sbyin sreg 'jam dpal zhi khro rnam par rol pa'i sgrub thabs/ gshin rje'i gshed dmar po lha bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs/ lha lnga ma'i sgrub thabs/ gshin rje'i gshed lhan skyes kyi sgrub thabs 'jigs med rnam rol cho gas 'khor dang bcas pa/ yang lhan skyes kyi sgrub thabs bsdus pa gcig rtsa ba dang yan lag gi ltung ba'i rnam bshad dam tshig rab gsal/ bla ma lnga bcu pa'i bsdus don/ rab tu gnas pa'i phyag len mdor bsdus pa/ sbyong rgyud nas gsungs pa'i tshe dpag med kyi sgrub thabs/ tshe sgrub zab mo gcig tshe dpag med kyi bstod pa pad+ma'i phreng ba/ tshe dpag med kyi bsgom thabs ba ri lots+tsha ba nas brgyud pa/ mi 'khrugs pa'i sbyin sreg phyag na rdo rje'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi sgrub thabs byab srung sbyin sreg dang bcas pa/ 'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs/ 'jam dpal dpa' bo grub pa'i sgrub thabs/ thugs rje chen po dang phyag rgya chen po zung 'jug tu nyams su blang ba'i tshul/ yang thugs rje chen po'i sgrub thabs gcig seng ge sgra'i sgrub thabs/

byams pa'i sgrub thabs/ rta mgrin khyung gshog can gyi sgrub thabs/ mi g.yo ba sngon po'i sgrub thabs/ mi g.yo ba phyag bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs/ rnam rgyal gyi sgrub thabs/ gtsug tor gdugs dkar can gyi bsgom thabs dang*/ gzungs bklag thabs/ ri khrod lo gyon ma'i sgrub thabs dang bstod pa/ skul byed ma'i sgrub thabs/ 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs mya ngan med pa'i 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs bstod pa dang bcas pa bzhugs/ ca pa la/ 'od zer can gyi sbyin sreg de'i bstod pa rgyas pa/ spyan ma'i sgrub thabs/ gza' yum gyi sgrub thabs/ 'dod lha'i bstod pa/ rig ma bcu drug gi mchod pa'i tshigs bcad tshan pa gnyis bsrung ba lnga'i sngon 'gro/ bsrung ba lnga'i sgrub thabs bsdus pa dang rgyas pa gnyis/ lha mo lnga'i bstod pa/ bsrung ba lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la bstod pa/ phyogs bzhi'i gtor ma/ gza' dang rgyu skar rnams kyi gtor ma sogs btang ba'i cho ga dbang bskur ba'i sngon du byur bsal ba'i cho ga dbang bskur dngos/ de'i cho ga'i sdom tshig dzam+bha la ser po'i sgrub thabs/ rgyud sde'i dkar chag rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral gyi bsnyen sgrub las sbyor dang bcas pa'i yi ge bdud rtsi lnga mchod/ mgon po'i bstod pa gang thugs ma/ mgon po dang lha mo'i gtor chog bshags pa/ gdong bzhi pa'i bstod pa/ phyogs bzhi'i gtor ma/ chos rje sa skya pa yab sras kyi nyin zhags phrugs gcig la thugs dam du mdzad pa'i gtor ma'i rim pa/ klu gtor/ chu gtor/ bstod dbyangs rgya mtsho snyan dngags rin po che'i rgyan rnam par bkra ba/ thub pa'i bstod pa/ 'jam dpal la mtshan don gyi sgo nas bstod pa tshigs su bcad pa nyi shu lnga pa/ yang 'jam dpal la bstod pa/ nye bar bsngags pa me tog gi phreng ba/ 'jam dbyangs la ri bo rtse lngar bstod pa nor bu'i phreng ba/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal brtan pa'i 'khor lo'i bstod pa/

rtse lnga'i ri bo'i rtse mo so so'i rigs su mthun par bstod pa/ ā nan+da kīrti'i don du dpa' bo'i 'khor lo nyid la bris pa/ yang 'jam dbyangs la bstod pa gcig skyid grong gi 'phags pa wa ti la mnal lam du bstod pa/ byams mgon la bstod pa/ gnas brtan bcu drug gi bstod pa/ chos spyod yan lag bcu pa cung zad rgyas par spel ba/ yan lag bdun pa/ phyag 'tshal dang mchod cing bshags pa/ bsngo ba dang bcas pa'i tshigs bcad/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i cho ga bsdus pa/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bsngo ba dang bcas pa 'bring du bstan pa/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bsngo ba dang bcas pa bsdus pa yul skyong mgon po dpal bzang po'i don du mdzad pa/ skyabs 'gro'i rnam gzhag bo lod kyi don du sbyar ba/ yang skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ dbang bskur gyi bslab bya nyung 'dus rgyal po a rog che'i don du mdzad pa/ rgyal po la gdams pa'i rab tu byed pa/ de'i bsdus don/ theg pa chen po gsal ba zhes bya ba/ yi ge'i ma mo la spel ba'i rab byed/ de'i bsdus don/ shes bya rab gsal/ las 'bras gsal ba'i me long tshigs bcad bzhi bcu pa/ rgyal bu ji big de mur la gtam du bya ba nor bu'i phreng ba/ rgyal bu mang ga la gtam du bya ba bkra shis kyi phreng ba/ cha pa la/ rgyal bu no mo gan la spring yig theg pa che chung gi chos kyi rnam gzhag rgyal po ho ko'i don du mdzad pa/ rgyal bu de gus bo ga la gdams pa/ rgyal bu the mur bho ga la gdams pa/ bsgrub pa'i rim pa rab tu gsal ba zhes bya ba dbon mo pun+dha ri'i don du mdzad pa/ rgyal bu jim gyim la spring yig gsum/ a tsa ra la gdams pa/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gcig la bskur ba'i yi ge ye shes 'bum la gdams pa bdud rtsi'i thig le/ rig pa smra ba grags bzang la springs pa/ bden gnyis rnam nges/ zab mo snang ba'i rab byed/ phyag rgya chen po nyams su blang ba'i man ngag

yang de'i khrid yig yan lag bdun ldan/ yan lag bdun gyi gtam/ dam chos pad+ma dkar po'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'ga' zhig la phyin ci log tu brtag pa dgag tshul/ bu mo rin chen gyis zhus pa'i mdo'i don yang dag par bsdus pa/ zab mo mdo sde'i sa bcad/ rgyud bla ma'i sa bcad/ skyo ba'i gtam tshigs su bcad pa/ sum cu rtsa lnga pa/ ngan pa'i spyod tshul la khrel ba'i gtam/ theg pa'i rnam dbye mdor bsdus/ bsam gtan shes rab kyi dris lan/ byang chub lam gyi snying po bsgom pa'i rim pa/ gzhan tshigs bcad thor bu pa gcig dbus gtsang du chos 'khor bskur ba'i bka' yig dge bshes tsha ba rong pa la springs pa/ yang sdom brtson gcig la springs pa/ zab mo nyams su len tshul/ rgyal bu ji big de mur la springs pa/ yi kyang byus par glegs bam bsgrub pa la bsngags pa/ rgyal bu byang chub sems dpa' la gnang ba'i bka' yig rgyal bu algo dang*/ rin chen pak+shi la spring yig bram ze'i paṇ+ḍi ta lak+ṣ+mi ka ra dang*/ shong ston la bskur ba'i bka' yig rwa dbon la bskur ba/ ral gri la springs pa/ spring yig rin chen phreng ba zhes bya ba/ spyi bo lhas pa la bskur ba/ chag lo la bskur ba/ chos 'khor phyi ma'i dus su dbus gtsang gi mtshan nyid pa spyi/ dbus kyi bka' gdams pa spyi/ stag lung pa/ dbus kyi sgom chen pa spyi la bskur ba'i sh+lau ka re/ rgyal bu ji big de mur la bskur ba'i spring yig gsum/ dbon mo du gal du mig la bskur ba'i spring yig gnyis/ yang tshigs bcad thor bu pa gcig rgyal po jim gyim/ ho ko grags bzang*/ ston gzhon rnams la spring yig re re/ gos dar lnga stong dang dgu brgya bzhi bcu phul ba'i dus kyi mchod brjod dang*/ bsngo ba/ tshe dpag med la bstod pa sh+lau ka gcig dang*/ tshigs bcad thor bu ba gnyis/ mgon g.yag la bsngags pa'i tshigs bcad/ rgyal bu jim gyim gyis bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab 'gyur ro 'tshal bzhengs pa'i gsal byed/

sdeb sbyor gyi rgyan rnam par bkra ba/ yang rgyal bu jim gyim gyis rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum dang*/ shin tu rgyas pa'i sde snod bzhengs pa la bsngags pa gnyis/ rgyal bu maṅga la yab yum gyi rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum dang*/ phal po che bzhengs pa'i mtshon byed/ rgyal po ji big de mur gyis phal po che gser 'od dam pa stong phrag brgya pa bzhengs pa'i mtshon byed/ rgyal po a rog ches 'bum bzhengs pa'i mtshon byed/ rgyal po go pe las rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum bzhengs pa'i mtshon byed/ dge 'dun bzang po sogs kyis rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum bzhengs pa'i mtshon byed/ rin chen dpal gyis 'bum bzhengs pa'i mtshon byed/ zin shing gi ston pa btul ba'i tshigs bcad/ theg pa chen po'i slob dpon dang*/ slob mas lam nyams su blang tshul bstan pa/ las chog rgyas bsdus gnyis/ bsnyen gnas kyi cho ga rgyal po yab sras kyi mchod rten rin po che bzhengs pa la bsngags pa'i sdeb sbyor daṇ+ḍa ka bsngags par 'os pa bsngags pa'i rab byed/ rgyal rabs bsngags pa'i tshigs bcad/ gsan yig rgyal po go pe la sras dang btsun mor bcas pa la/ shing mo yos/ me pho 'brug me mo sbrul/ sa pho rta/ lug spre'u gnyis mi snang*/ lcags mo bya/ chu pho khyi/ chu mo phag shing pho byi ba/ shing mo glang*/ stag mi snang*/ me mo yos/ sa pho 'brug sa mo sbrul/ lcags pho rta/ lcags mo lug chu pho spre'u/ chu mo bya/ shing pho khyi/ shing mo phag me pho byi ba/ me mo glang*/ sa pho stag sa mo yos/ lcags pho 'brug rnams kyi lo gsar pa shar ba'i tshe phul ba'i bkra shis kyi phreng ba nyi shu rtsa gsum/ yang maṅga la yab yum/ ji big yab yum/ dbon mo chen mo rnams la bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa/ gzhan yang bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad sh+lau ka gcig rnams bzhugs pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa rin po che/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa bsod nams dpal/

bla ma don yod pa/ slob dpon 'dul 'dzin/ byang seng ba/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o// yang na 'phags pa/ dga' ldan pa bkra shis dpal/ kun bsod/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge bla ma don yod pa man 'dra'o// yang de nyid kyi drung du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan 'grel pa bcas pa'i bshad pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ gnyis med gsung ba thub pa'i dbang po dang*// byams pa thogs med dbyig gnyen rnam grol sde// btsun pa grol sde mchog sde dul ba'i sde// rnam snang mdzad dang seng bzang ye shes zhabs// yon tan bshes gnyen rin chen bzang po dang*// zla bzang bstan skyong blo ldan shes rab dang*// shes rab 'bar dang byang chub ye shes dang*// gzhon nu tshul khrims dang ni shes rab 'bum// byang chub 'bum dang 'jam pa'i rdo rje dang*// dar tshul brtson 'grus rdo rje rin po che// grub pa seng ge tshad ma'i skyes bu dang*// kun mkhyen rin chen grub dang tshul khrims 'bum// mkhas pa chen po ye shes rgyal mtshan zhabs// de las bdag gis/ ṭī ka lung gi snye ma/ mkhan chen dharma shrīs mdzad pa'i zin bris rnams kyi steng nas/ bshad bka' lan bzhi'i bar du zhus/ mngon pa kun las btus kyi bshad pa thos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ thub pa/ byams pa/ thogs med/ dbyig gnyen/ blo brtan/ gang ba spel/ dā na shī la/ dzi na mi tra/ ka ba dpal brtsegs/ cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan/ zhang ye shes sde/ nam nang zla ba'i rdo rje/ khu lung dpal gyi rdo rje/ sbas rgyal ba ye shes/ de gsum ka la cog gru rgyal ba ye shes/ se btsun dbang phyug gzhon nu/ gar mi yon tan g.yung drung*/ rgyal tshul le/ ra ston khri bzang*/ li ston chos grags/ brang ti dar ma snying po/ rog chos brtson/ yar nag pa/ yar ther mgo pa bzad pa/ stag ston shes rab 'od zer/ lho pa grub pa seng ge

slob dpon tshad ma'i skyes bu/ bu ston rin po che/ mkhas pa chen po dharmā shrī bha dra/ sde snod 'dzin pa tshul khrims 'bum/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ de las bdag gis thos/ dbu ma rtsa she/ de'i 'grel pa tshig gsal/ dbu ma 'jug pa/ de'i rang 'grel rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ ār+ya de wa/ zla grags/ gzhon nu 'bum/ gser gyi go cha/ pa tshab nyi ma grags/ rma bya byang brtson/ mtshur gzhon nu seng ge rma bya shākya seng ge zhang chos kyi bla ma/ mchims nam mkha' grags/ bcom ral/ de gnyis las lo mchog bag ston/ bla ma mgon po 'bum/ bla ma dpal ldan pa/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o// yang na mchims/ phag 'gur dkon ye/ 'jam dbyangs thur she/ drang po lung pa yon tan mgon/ bla ma mgon po 'bum/ bla ma dpal ldan pa/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o// byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa'i brgyud pa ni/ slob dpon zhi ba lha/ thams cad brtsegs/ rin bzang*/ shākya blo gros/ yon tan bsod nams/ blo gros bzang po/ rngog lots+tsha ba/ khyung rin chen grags/ stod lung rgya dmar/ slob dpon phywa pa/ 'jad pa ston skyabs/ mus srad pa chen po/ gtsang po bsod nams mdzes/ mkhan chen byang chub dpal/ bde ba dpal/ ka bzhi pa grags pa gzhon nu/ rin chen bsod nams grags/ chos rje bla ma/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o// yang na/ phywa pa chos kyi seng ge rje btsun bsod nams rtse mo/ gcung grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ mkhan chen byang chub dpal man 'dra/ de ltar na/ chos kyi rje de nyid lo bcu drug gi bar du bsten te/ chos dang zang zing gis nye bar bskyangs pas na shin tu bka' drin che ba yin no// thob yig rgya mtsho las/ chos kyi rje dpal ldan bla ma dam pa mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos rjes su bzung ba'i skabs te dang po'o//

//phul du byung ba'i yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa la mnga' brnyes pa'i bdag nyid chen po drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po dpal ldan tshul khrims pa'i drung du/ kye'i rdo rje'i man ngag lugs kyi dbang bskur dang*/ kye rdor lus dkyil gyi dbang rnams thos/ kye rdor nas gling ma'i dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ bi la s+ya badz+ra/ yan lag med pa'i rdo rje/ mtsho skyes rdo rje/ in+d+ra bhū ti/ lcam legs smin/ nag po spyod pa/ bram ze dpal 'dzin/ ga ya dha ra/ 'brog mi/ se mkhar chung ba/ zhang dgon pa ba/ sa chen/ rta stag so ba khu dbon/ dpal chu bo ri pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa/ bla ma blo gros brtan pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ des bdag la'o// brtag gnyis kyi 'grel pa slob dpon bha wa bha dras mdzad pa'i rnam bshad bsod rnams rgyal mtshan gyi 'gyur gyi lung gi brgyud pa ni/ badz+ra pā ṇi/ ga ya dha ra/ 'brog mi/ ting nge 'dzin dpal bzang po/ bya'u rgyal/ chos dbang*/ lo mchog blo chen/ bag ston/ mgon po 'bum/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ des bdag la'o/ sgrub thabs mtsho skyes kyi brgyud pa ni/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ tshogs sgom rin po che/ grags seng*/ bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ sher rdor/ bla ma gar thig pa bsod rgyal/ mgon po 'bum man gong dang 'dra'o// mi thub zla bas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs yan lag drug pa/ bdag med ma'i sgrub thabs/ gur rigs bsdus kyi sgrub thabs/ 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor ma'i cho ga dkyil chog bzang po yongs bzung rnams dang*/ las dang po pa'i bya ba rin chen 'bar ba rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa rin po che/ 'jam dbyangs rin rgyal/ ye shes mgon po/ seng ge rgyal mtshan/ bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ sher rdor/ bla ma gar thig pa/ mgon po 'bum man 'dra'o// skabs kyi 'grel chung brgyad du grags pa la/ rtsa'i 'grel pa che chung gnyis/

dur khrod kyi 'grel pa che chung gnyis/ brda'i bshad pa gnyis/ rdo rje'i glu'i 'grel pa che chung gnyis/ dgongs pa'i skad kyi 'grel pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ dur khrod brgyad kyi 'grel pa slob dpon rnal 'byor pas mdzad pa rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ chos rje sa skya pa/ zhang rgyal pa dpal/ bla ma rdo rje 'od zer/ rgyal tsha lung mang po/ lo mchog blo chen/ bag ston/ pradz+nyā badz+ra/ gar thig pa/ mgon po 'bum man sngar bzhin no// bde mchog dril bu pa'i dbang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pa/ rus sbal zhabs/ shrī dza lan+dha ra/ nag po spyod pa/ gu h+ya pa/ rnam rgyal zhabs/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ pham mthing pa sku mched/ klog skya pa/ blo gros grags pa/ sa chen pa/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun pa/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ de las 'phags pa rin po che/ tshogs sgom rin po che/ bo dong rin po che gsum gyis zhus/ de gsum ka las khro phu rin po ches gsan/ de la bla ma dpal ldan seng ge chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ des bdag la'o// yang na/ 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan no// yang na 'phags pa/ dga' ldan pa bkra shis dpal/ kun dga' bsod nams/ de las bla ma dpal ldan seng ge dang*/ ti shrir kun blo gnyis kas gsan/ de gnyis ka las chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan pas so// yang na 'phags pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta rdo rje shes rab/ 'phags rgyal/ bla ma rin chen dpal bzang*/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan no// yang na 'phags pa/ tshogs sgom rin po che/ nyan chen pa/ de las dpal ldan seng ge dang*/ kun blo gnyis kas gsan/ de gnyis ka las chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis so// yang na sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta las/ nyan chen pa dgung lo bco lnga lon pa'i dus/ bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa/ dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed/

snang ba mtha' yas kyi 'pho ba/ dril bu pa'i dbang bskur rnams zhus/ nyan chen pa las/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan pas/ dgung lo lnga lon pa'i dus su dril bu pa'i dbang gsan gsung*/ yang na/ bo dong rin po che/ bla ma dkon mchog rin chen/ bla ma rin chen dpal bzang*/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ des bdag la'o// yang na/ chos rje brag phug pa/ bla ma blo gros brtan pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ yang na/ chos rje nyan chen pa/ bla ma rin chen seng ge bla ma dam pa dpal ldan tshul khrims/ des bdag la'o/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud dang*/ rnal 'byor ma kun spyod gnyis kyi lung yang thob/ yang phag mo zhal gnyis ma'i byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ la wa pa/ rgyal po in+d+ra bo dhi/ lcam legs smin/ bir+wa pa/ sha ba ri pa/ mai tri pa/ rgya gar phyag na/ bha ren+t+ra tsa ru ce/ bal po ye shes rdo rje/ sa chen yab sras gsum/ chos rje khu dbon gnyis/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa/ blo gros brtan pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims pa/ de las bdag gis/ las bcu sgrub thabs/ sngags kyi de kho na nyid dang bcas pa'i gzhung dang*/ de gsum gyi don 'grel rje btsun chen pos mdzad pa thos/ nā ro mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pa/ ḍeṃ gi pa/ an+ta raṃ pa/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ pham mthing pa gcen 'jigs med grags/ gcung dus 'khor ba/ klog skya ba/ mal lo// rje sa chen man chad zhal gnyis ma dang 'dra ba las/ bskyed pa'i rim pa nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs/ nā ro pas mdzad pa/ gong ma'i 'grel pa/ phyi mchod/ tshogs mchod/ tshes bcu'i mchod pa/ sbyin sreg mar me'i sbyin sreg mkha' spyod kyi dngos grub sgrub thabs/ byin rlabs kyi cho ga rdzogs pa'i rim pa rtsa dbu ma/ lam gyi yan lag pra sen dbab pa/

gnod sbyin mo sgrub pa/ tshangs pa'i bu mo sgrub pa/ pad+ma pa ti'i man ngag khol po pa ti'i man ngag sman chen po'i bcud len rnams thos/ yang 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs/ dkyil chog tshogs 'khor sbyin sreg rnams thos/ me tri mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ spyan ras gzigs/ byang sems blo gros rin chen/ ri khrod dbang phyug mai tri pa/ rgya gar phyag na/ ka ma la badz+ra/ dza ya se na/ lots+tsha ba dar ma yon tan/ rje btsun rin po che man zhal gnyis ma dang 'dra ba las/ rgyud nas phyung ba'i sgrub thabs/ mai tri pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs/ nyan chen pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs byin rlabs kyi cho ga rgyal ba'i sdes mdzad pa rnams thos/ 'di gsum gyi brgyud pa lugs gcig ni/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ tshogs sgom/ nyan chen pa/ brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ des bdag la'o/ yang na/ nyan chen pa/ 'jam skya/ dpal ldan seng ge chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ des bdag la'o// rdo rje phur pa'i dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje sems pa/ pad+ma 'byung gnas/ 'khon klu'i dbang po/ gcung rdo rje rin po che/ de'i sras shes rab yon tan/ yon tan tshul khrims/ rdo rje gtsug tor/ tshul khrims rgyal po/ dge 'byung*/ dge skyabs/ shākya blo gros/ shes rab tshul khrims/ de'i gcung dkon mchog rgyal po/ sa chen yab sras gsum/ gan pa ston dar/ gan pa chos rgyal/ gan pa chos rin/ gan pa rin rgyal/ chos rje bla ma/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ des bdag la'o// de nyid las phur pa rtsa dum chos rje pas bsgyur pa/ pad+mas mdzad pa'i lam rim/ chos rje bla mas mdzad pa'i dkyil chog sgrub thabs rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi lung thob/ yang na/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po/ glo bo rdo rje srin po/ glo bo rdo rje 'dzin pa/ glo bo lots+tsha ba shes rab rin chen/

chos rgyal 'phags pa/ slob dpon 'od ldan pa/ pu lung pa kun dga' rdo rje/ lots+tsha ba mchog ldan/ dga' ldan kun bsod/ gan pa rin rgyal/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dam pa dpal ldan tshul khrims/ des bdag la'o// phur pa drag po'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun pa yan dbang gi brgyud pa dang 'dra ba las/ de nas chos rje pa/ chos rgyal/ lo mchog bag ston/ bla ma tshul rgyal/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ des bdag la'o// dkar mo nyi zla'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ dkar mo nyi zla/ 'khon rog shes rab tshul khrims/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po/ rje sa chen yab sras gsum/ chos rje pa/ bla ma chos kyi rgyal po/ bla ma 'od ldan pa/ kha'u pa kun dga' rdo rje/ mchog ldan legs pa'i blo gros/ bag ston gzhon nu tshul khrims/ bla ma mgon po 'bum/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ des bdag la'o// bdud rgyal thod phreng can gyi rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje gzhon nu/ pad+ma 'byung gnas/ klu'i dbang po/ rdo rje rin chen/ tshul khrims rgyal po/ rdo rje gtsug tor/ shes rab yon tan/ dge skyabs/ dge mthong*/ bal po/ shākya blo gros/ 'khon rog shes rab tshul khrims/ gcung dkon mchog rgyal po/ rje sa chen/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ bla ma chos kyi rgyal po man dkar mo nyi zla dang 'dra'o// sbyong rgyud dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis kyi dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ phyag na rdo rje/ rgyal po rab gsal zla ba/ bram ze dzi na mi tra/ swa sti pha la/ sgra gcan 'dzin/ pradz+nyā wa li ta/ ye shes rdo rje/ pra hi ta/ slob dpon kun dga' snying po/ rab 'byor skyong*/ kha che dharmā pā la/ lo chen rin bzang*/ gnyal pa nyi she/ snur nyi ma 'od zer/ gshen rdo rje seng ge rgya gsar pa/ 'gro dzi ti pa/ snye mdo ba bsod nams dpal/ gnyal pa chos grags/ bya rin chen 'od/

glo chen sangs rgyas sras/ bag ston gzhon nu tshul khrims/ bla ma tshul rgyal ba/ bla ma dpal ldan pa/ des bdag la'o// gtsug tor gdugs dkar can gyi dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ thub pa chen po/ phyag na rdo rje/ dze tā ri pa/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung*/ ba ri lots+tsha ba/ ldan ma'i skyu ra a skyabs/ rje sa chen pa/ rje btsun pa/ pho rog pa mdo sde mgon/ rgan mo lhas pa/ 'jam dbyangs chen po/ rong pa ā ka ra/ dkon mchog tshul khrims/ bag ston tshul rgyal/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ des bdag la'o// gtsug tor mchog grub ma/ dga' ldan pas mdzad pa'i dkyil chog rnams thos/ thugs rje chen po dmar khrid kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ grub thob tshem bu pa/ mkhan po spyi bo lhas pa/ brag dmar ba byang chub tshul khrims/ lha btsun dgon gsar ba/ kun spangs pa/ sgro mon pa rin chen dpal/ chos rje bla ma/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ des bdag la'o// yang na kun spangs pa nas/ brag kha ba grags pa seng ge bla ma dam pa man sngar dang 'dra ba las/ khrid yig chos rje bla mas mdzad pa thos/ phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gyi khrid kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ mar pa/ mi la ras chen/ dwags po lha rje/ phag mo gru pa/ kun ldan ras pa/ rgyal tsha chen po/ 'dzal phu ba/ khro phu rin po che/ yang rtse ba/ bu ston rin po che/ chos rje bla ma/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ de las bdag gi khrid yig bla ma dam pas mdzad pa thos/ yang bu ston rin po ches mdzad pa'i rgyud sde spyi'i rnam gzhag rgyud sde rin po che'i mdzes rgyan gyi brgyud pa ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che/ rin chen grub/ bla ma dam pa dpal ldan tshul khrims/ des bdag la'o// bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhal shes dang bcas pa bla ma dam pas mdzad pa dang*/ yi ge brgya pa'i bzlas lung*/ de'i man ngag rje sa chen gyis mdzad pa/ uṣ+ḍi ṣa'i bzlas lung*/

lam 'bras kyi gegs sel gyi man ngag 'ga' zhig rnams thos so// thob yig rgya mtsho las/ chos kyi rje dpal ldan bla ma dam pa dpal ldan tshul khrims kyis rjes su bzung ba'i skabs te gnyis pa'o// //lung dang rtogs pa'i dpal gyis mngon par mtho ba drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa grub chen chos kyi rje bud+dha shrī pa'i drung du/ gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams ngag rnams yongs su rdzogs par thob pa la/ lam 'bras/ lam skor/ zhar byung gi gdams ngag dang gsum gyi dang po la/ smin grol gnyis kyi thog mar smin byed dbang gi skor la/ dpal kye'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje bdag med ma/ bir+wa pa/ nag po pa/ ḍā ma ru pa/ a wa dhū ti pa/ ga ya dha ra/ 'brog mi shākya ye shes/ se mkhar chung ba/ zhang dgon pa ba chos 'bar/ sa chen kun dga' snying po/ slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ sa skya paṇa chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ chos rgyal 'phags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ chos rje brag phug pa bsod nams dpal/ chos rje rin po che bsod rnams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ bla ma dam pa dpal ldan tshul khrims/ bla ma dam pa bud+dha shrī/ des bdag la'o// yang na/ chos rje brag phug pa/ bla ma blo gros brtan pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ bla ma dam pa bud+dha shrī/ des bdag la'o// kye'i rdo rje'i lus dkyil gyi dbang*/ rdo rje bdag med ma'i lus dkyil gyi byin rlabs/ lam dus kyi dbang rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ gong dang 'dra'o// yang kye'i rdo rje yab bka'i brgyud pa lugs gzhan ni/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ tshogs sgom kun dga' dpal/ nyan chen bsod nams brtan pa/ chos rje brag phug pa man gong bzhin no// yang kye'i rdo rje'i phyi rdul tshon gyi dbang dang*/

nang lus dkyil gnyis ka'i brgyud pa ni/ chos rje nyan chen pa/ dkar po brag pa rin chen seng ge bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ bla ma dam pa bud+dha shrī/ des bdag la'o// yang kye'i rdo rje phyi'i dkyil 'khor gyi brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa rin po che/ paṇ+ḍi ta rdo rje shes rab/ bla ma 'phags rgyal/ bla ma bzang po dpal/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ bla ma dam pa bud+dha shrī/ des bdag la'o// kye rdor lus dkyil gyi dbang gi brgyud pa lugs gzhan ni/ 'phags pa rin po che/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ bla chen kun dga' blo gros/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan no// yang na/ 'phags pa/ bla ma 'phags rgyal/ bla ma rin chen dpal bzang po/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan no// yang na/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ tshogs sgom pa/ nyan chen pa/ bla ma gzhon nu dpal/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ bla ma dam pa bud+dha shrī/ des bdag la'o// rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma lha mo bco lnga'i dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ rje sa chen yan chad yab bka' dang 'dra ba la/ de nas ne tso sbal ston/ bla ma shes rab grags/ gnam pa rwa chos she/ mngon pa ba dbang phyug brtson 'grus/ 'phags pa rin po che/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ chos rje brag phug pa/ de las chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa/ bla ma blo gros brtan pa gnyis kas gsan/ de gnyis ka las bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ bla ma dam pa bud+dha shrī/ des bdag la'o// yang na/ mngon pa ba/ paṇ+ḍi ta rdor she/ zhang dkon mchog dpal man 'dra/ yang na/ mngon pa ba/ 'phags pa rin po che/ dgongs ston shes rab 'bum/ dkar po brag pa rin chen seng ge bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ bla ma dam pa bud+dha shrī/ des bdag la'o// yi ge brgya pa'i bzlas lung man ngag dang bcas pa dang*/ aṣ+ṭa'i bzlas lung gzhi bshad/ byad bzlog dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/

zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ bla ma dam pa bud+dha shrī/ des bdag la'o// gnyis pa grol byed lam gyi skor la/ gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gzhung ji lta ba bzhin du bkri ba'i nyams khrid legs par thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang nas/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta yan chad dbang bka' dang 'dra ba las/ de nas tshogs sgom rin po che/ nyan chen bsod nams brtan pa/ chos rje brag phug pa/ de las chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa dang*/ bla ma blo gros brtan pa gnyis kas gsan/ de gnyis ka las/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ bla ma dam pa bud+dha shrī/ des bdag la'o// yang na/ chos rje pa/ 'phags pa rin po che/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa man 'dra/ yang na/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa man 'dra/ yang na/ nyan chen pa/ bla ma 'jam skya/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge man 'dra/ yang na/ nyan chen pa/ dkar po brag pa rin chen seng ge bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ bla ma dam pa bud+dha shrī/ des bdag la'o// rnam 'grel bcu gcig gi nang nas/ tshig nyung la don rgyas pa'i lam 'bras gnyag ma dkar chag gi nang bzhin tshang bar thos pa la/ rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang*/ de'i bsdus don/ 'grel pa/ kun gzhi rgyu rgyud/ gdan sogs/ lam la sogs pa'i chos nyi shu la/ lus kyi dkyil 'khor/ bum dbang gi 'da' ka ma'i skabs su/ 'chi ltas/ 'khrul 'khor/ 'chi bslu dang bcas pa/ bum dbang gi snang ba bsgyur ba'i 'da' ka ma/ gsang dbang gi skabs su theg le'i rnal 'byor bzhi/ shes rab ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i mtshan nyid/ dbang bzhi ka'i 'da' ka ma dang*/ bum dbang dang thun mong du yi ges sgo dgag pa dang bcas pa/ bar do bzhi'i gdams ngag go /lam dus kyi dbang*/ tshad ma bzhi/ gdams ngag drug rten 'brel lnga/ grib sel gyi sbyin sreg bsdus pa/

dri ma khrus kyi sel ba dang*/ sā ts+tshas sel ba dang*/ thig le bsrung ba/ yi ge brgya pa'i 'don thabs/ 'jig rten pa'i lam gyi skabs su rlung gi sbyor ba bdun gyis lam khrid pa/ bha ga'i yi ge bcu bzhi/ 'das pa'i lam la gsang dbang gi skabs su 'khor lo bzhi'i rgya/ bzhi pa'i skabs su dbang phyug gi don brgyad/ sa bcu gsum pa'i sa phyed kyi mngon rtogs so// de thams cad kyi don bsdus pa'i tshigs su bcad pa dang*/ de dag las 'phros pa la/ kun gzhi rgyu rgyud las 'phros nas/ 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi lta ba rtsa 'grel gnyis/ gdan sogs las 'phros nas dbang gi chu bo ma nub par bskur ba ste/ de la dbang bzhi'i cho ga mtha' dag mdor bsdus pa man ngag gi gnad/ mchog dbang gsum grol ba'i lam la brten te bskur ba/ lam sogs nyi shu las 'phros nas phyi bskyed pa'i rim pa mdor bsdus pa/ dam tshig las 'phros nas bdud rtsi ril bu sgrub pa/ byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ma nyams pa/ srung ba sum cu dang*/ gdams ngag gi gnad bdun cu las 'phros nas gegs sel lo// de la yi ge bzhi ste bsam gtan 'dor ba'i 'phrang bdun/ byung rgyal du mi gtong ba'i gnad bzhi/ 'byung ba lus 'khrugs rlung dang spyod lam gyis bsal ba/ rnal 'byor gyi phrin las sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ las dang po pa dang*/ thun mong gi chos bdun te lam rgyas pa dang*/ rtsa ba med pa'i lam 'bring po dang*/ rang gi gzhung cung zad yod pa sgrub pa'i lung sbyin pa lam bsdus pa ste/ de ltar na lam rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum dang*/ lam de dag rnal 'byor pas nyams su blang zhing rtogs tshad bskyed pa'i phyir lam gyi gzhung shing bzhi dang*/ rtogs pa bskyed pa'i chos lnga yod de/ gzhung shing chen po bzhi ni/ gang zag gzhung ji lta ba bzhin du bkri ba'i gzhung shing*/ man ngag gi gnad drug gis bkri ba'i gzhung shing*/ brtson 'grus can man ngag gi gnad bcu gcig gis bkri ba'i gzhung shing*/

gang zag dbang po rab 'bring gsum du bkri ba'i gzhung shing ngo*// rtogs pa bskyed pa'i chos lnga ni// lam 'jug ldog phyag rgya 'jug ldog shes pas phan 'dogs pa'i man ngag bdun/ lam bsre ba/ phyi nang gi mdzad pa bcu gnyis so// rtogs pa bskyed pa'i dpe chung la/ 'chi ltas kyi 'khor lo gnyis/ rtsa rtsa'i dpe chung*/ bha ga'i yi ge bcu bzhi po'i dpe chung*/ rnal 'byor gyi phrin las sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi dpe chung*/ gegs sel gzhan gyi dpe chung gnyis rnams ni gang zag tha ma'i man ngag yin la/ 'bring gi lam dam tshig dang sdom pa ni/ de dag gi gseb tshag tu 'du'o// gang zag rab kyi man ngag bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi yi ge de thams cad kyi rgyab brten/ lung 'di nyid dang mdor bsdus te sbyar ba/ zhib tu sbyar ba/ lung mtha' dag dang mdor bsdus te sbyar ba/ bla ma bod dang rgya gar ba'i lo rgyus rnams so// de dag gi brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa rin po che/ zhang dkon mchog dpal ba/ chos rje brag phug pa/ bla ma blo gros brtan pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ bla ma dam pa bud+dha shrī/ des bdag la'o// yang sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ tshogs sgom pa/ nyan chen pa/ brag phug pa man 'dra/ yang bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar ngo mtshar snang ba/ gzhung bshad man ngag gi mdzod/ gzhung ji lta ba bzhin bkri ba'i gzhung shing sbas don gsal ba/ gnad bcu gcig gis bkri ba'i gzhung shing gnad kyi sgo 'byed/ gnad drug gis bkri ba'i gzhung shing gnad kyi lde mig dbang po rab 'bring gsum gyis bkri ba'i gzhung shing nyung ngu rnam gsal/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhal shes kyi yi ge dang bcas pa/ lus dkyil gyi dbang chog lam dus kyi dbang ste/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos mdzad pa'i lam 'bras pod nag tu grags pa dang*/ gsal byed nyer gnyis la sogs pa gnyag ma yig chung rnams dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos rje brag phug pa/

chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ bla ma dam pa bud+dha shrī/ de bdag la'o// yang na/ nyan chen pa/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge 'gro mgon bsod nams rgyal mtshan man 'dra/ bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar zhib mo/ rdo rje gzhung bshad dmar ma zin bris bar ston ma rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ dmar chos kyi rgyal po/ dgongs ston shes rab 'bum/ dkar po brag pa rin chen seng ge yang na/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ tshogs sgom pa/ nyan chen pa/ dkar po brag pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ bla ma dam pa bud+dha shrī/ des bdag la'o// lus dkyil gyi khrid kyi brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa rin po che/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ chos rje brag phug pa/ chos rje rnam gnyis/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ bla ma dam pa bud+dha shrī/ des bdag la'o// lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid dang byin rlabs/ dbang bzhi'i ngo sprod/ sgrub pa lung sbyin rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ tshogs sgom rin po che/ nyan chen pa/ brag phug pa/ chos rje rnam gnyis/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims man 'dra/ khrid kyi dkar chag gi brgyud pa ni/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ lung phu ba/ bkras lung pa/ mkhas btsun gzhon nu grub/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ brag phug pa/ chos rje rnam gnyis/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims man 'dra/ man ngag gsang ba bcu'i brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ brag phug pa/ chos rje rnam gnyis/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims man 'dra/ tshar gsum khug pa yan lag drug dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ni/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ lung phu ba/ bkras lung pa/ mkhas grub chos rje/ zhang byang she/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims man 'dra/ tshogs sgom pa/ nyan chen pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ chos rje brag phug pa/ bla ma blo gros brtan pa/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan/

bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims kyi rnam thar/ lus sbyong nyi shu pa/ nyams chen mo/ chung ba/ bar chad gsum sel che ba/ chung ba/ gegs sel gces bsdus/ gsang ba bdun pa/ gegs sel bka' rgya ma/ gling bzhi ma/ brda gcig brgyud/ dbang gi rab dbye/ gsang dbang gi rab byed bir+wa pas mdzad pa/ phyi nang gsang gsum gyi maṇ+ḍal/ rten 'brel lnga'i yi ge phyag rgya chen po'i dbye ba rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa rin po che/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ chos rje brag phug pa/ chos rje rnam gnyis/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims man 'dra/ man ngag de dag gi brgyud pa gong ma ni/ kye'i rdo rje'i dbang gi brgyud pa dang 'dra ba shes par bya'o// brda don gsal ba'i khrid byin rlabs dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ bdag med ma/ bir+wa pa/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po/ rje btsun rin po che/ chos rje pa/ lung phu ba/ bkras lung pa/ mkhas grub pa/ bla ma kun bsod/ brag phug pa chen po/ chos rje rnam gnyis/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims man 'dra/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi chos bzhi las/ lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi byin rlabs man ngag dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ bdag med ma/ bir+wa pa/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po/ rje btsun rin po che/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ tshogs sgom rin po che/ chos rje nyan chen pa/ chos rje brag phug pa/ bla ma blo gros brtan pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims man 'dra/ bir+wa pa'i byin rlabs srung ba'i man ngag dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos rje brag phug pa yan gong dang 'dra ba la/ de nas chos rje rnam gnyis/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims man 'dra/ lam sbas bshad kyi thugs rdo rje'i khrid/ 'khrul 'khor/ grub chen bcu phra mo brgyad dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ bir srung dang 'dra'o// de'i 'khrul 'khor so gnyis kyi brgyud pa ni/ nyan chen pa/ gnyags snying po rgyal mtshan/ bla ma rgyal mtshan 'bum/

chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims man 'dra/ sbas bshad pho brang lnga'i khrid 'khrul 'khor dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ nyan chen pa/ dkar po drag pa rin chen seng ge bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims man 'dra/ gnyis pa lam skor la/ phyag rgya chen po yi ge med pa'i byin rlabs dang*/ man ngag gi brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma/ slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa/ de ba ā ka ra tsan+d+ra/ de gnyis ka las/ jo bo a mo gha badz+ras gsan/ de las 'brog mis gsan te/ de man lam 'bras dang 'dra'o// bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i man ngag gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rta mchog bi na pa ta/ in+t+ra bo ti/ legs smin pa ta/ sgeg pa'i rdo rje/ gun dha ri pa/ pad+ma badz+ra/ chos kyi dpal/ bzang po'i zhabs/ tog tse pa/ bhu sha na pa/ dharma pa/ kar+ṇa pa/ dpa' bo rdo rje/ 'brog mi man 'dra'o// de'i byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ni/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'od shag la ru pa/ ye shes mgon/ bag ston gzhon tshul/ bla ma tshul rgyal/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ bla ma dam pa bud+dha shrī/ des bdag la'o// chos rje pa yan gdams ngag gi brgyud pa dang 'dra'o// mchod rten drung thob kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag na rdo rje/ sa ra ha/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ ār+ya de wa/ dge slong nag po zhabs/ zla ba grags pa/ bram ze dpal 'dzin/ dpa' bo rdo rje/ 'brog mi man lam 'bras dang 'dra'o// gtum mo lam rdzogs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ slob dpon dril bu pa/ rus sbal zhabs can/ dza lan dha ra pa/ nag po spyod pa/ shrī dha ra/ ga ya dha ra/ 'brog mi man 'dra'o// yon po srong ba'i brgyud pa'ang de dang 'dra'o// in+d+ra bhū ti'i lam gyi brgyud pa ni/ dang po dpal bde ba'i zhal snga nas// de bzhin du'ang tshangs pa dang*// bram ze mo ni rdo rje grub// de nas shrī badz+ra bhū ti rgyal// de'i slob dpon de'i phyi ma// gos bral zhal snga de bzhin no// dpal ldan dz+nyā na bhū ti rgyal// de bzhin shrī yo bhū ti dang*// slob dpon pad+ma badz+ra dang*// ḍom+bhi'i zhal snga de bzhin no// yan lag bar ma dpal lha mo/

bung ba'i pad+ma de bzhin no// dur khrod du ni ki lar bzhugs// lha lcam legs smin de bzhin no// bdag kyang dang po grub pa yin// ces pa ltar/ rdo rje 'chang*/ dpal bde ba chen po/ in+d+ra bhū ti/ dpal tshangs pa'i zhabs/ bram ze mo grub pa'i rdo rje/ rgyal po in+d+ra bhū ti bar pa/ slob dpon u pa ma'i zhabs/ slob dpon gos bral zhabs/ rgyal po dz+nyā na bhū ti/ shrī yo bhū ti/ slob dpon pad+ma badz+ra/ ḍom+bhi he ru ka yan lag bar ma'i zhabs/ lha mo bung ba'i pad+ma/ lcam legs smin/ rgyal po in+d+ra bhū ti chung ba/ de'i slob ma bram ze rin chen rdo rje/ de las kha che shes rab gsang bas gsan/ de las 'brog mis te/ de man 'dra'o// nye brgyud ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ in+d+ra bhū ti che ba/ lcam legs smin/ shes rab gsang ba'o// pad+ma badz+ra'i lam gyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ bi ma la s+ya badz+ra/ yan lag med pa'i rdo rje/ mtsho skyes rdo rje/ in+d+ra bhū ti/ lcam legs smin/ nag po spyod pa/ bram ze dpal 'dzin/ rje ga ya dha ra man 'dra'o// ḍom+bhi pa'i lhan cig skyes grub kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ ḍom+bhi pa/ a la la badz+ra/ nags khrod pa/ gar+bha ri pa/ bsod snyoms pa/ mi thub zla ba/ dpa' bo rdo rje/ 'brog mi man sngar dang 'dra'o// yang ḍom+bhi he ru ka'i byin rlabs/ nyin srung*/ mtshan srung*/ sngags kyi bzlas lung dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ lhan cig skyes grub dang 'dra ba las/ chos rje pa/ 'phags pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta rdo rje shes rab/ bsod nams 'bum/ bag ston gzhon tshul/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje bud+dha shrī/ des bdag la'o// gsum pa zhar byung gi man ngag la/ dag pa gsum gyi khrid kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ bdag med ma/ bir+wa pa/ ḍom+bhi pa nas lhan cig skyes grub dang 'dra ba las/ 'phags pa rin po che/ dga' ldan pa bkra shis dpal/

dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ chos rje brag phug pa/ chos rje rnam gnyis/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims man 'dra/ rang byin rlabs kyi dmigs pa nyi shu rtsa dgu'i brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa rin po che/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa/ chos rje rnam gnyis/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims man 'dra/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ paṇ+ḍi ta rin chen rdo rje nas brgyud rgyas par ma dran gsungs/ rje btsun rin po che/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa/ bla ma blo gros brtan pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims man 'dra/ rten 'brel bsrung ba'i byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun pa yan lam 'bras dang 'dra/ de nas dkar shākya grags/ slob dpon rin po che/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ brag phug pa/ bla ma blo gros brtan pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims man 'dra/ shān+ti pa'i mdo rgyud bsre ba/ dz+nyā na shrī/ shes rab 'byung gnas sbas pa/ rin chen rdo rje gsum gyi bar chad gsum sel/ ngag dbang grags pa'i gnyug ma dran gsal/ nā ro pa'i phyag rgya chen po sdug bsngal gsum sel te/ sgo drug chos 'brel du grags pa'i brgyud pa ni/ shān+ti pa/ dz+nyā na shrī/ shes rab 'byung gnas sbas pa/ rin chen rdo rje/ ngag dbang grags pa/ nā ro pa/ de so so las 'brog mis gsan la/ de las bar chad gsum sel/ 'brog mis se rog gnyis la/ des gnyes la/ yer pa sgom seng*/ grub thob lha 'bar/ kha rag sgom pa/ lung phu ba/ bkras lung pa/ mkhas grub chos rje/ zhang byang she/ chos rje bla ma/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje bud+dha shrī/ des bdag la'o// gnyug ma dran gsal gyi brgyud pa ni/ sgrol ma/ ngag dbang grags pa/ 'brog mi/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po/ bla ma shangs pa/ sa chen/ rje btsun pa/ chos rje pa/ lung phu ba man gong bzhin no// sdug bsngal gsum sel gyi brgyud pa ni/ nā ro pa/ 'brog mi/ mnga' ris pa/

sgyi chu ba/ sa chen man 'dra'o// mdo rgyud bsre ba'i brgyud pa ni/ shān+ti pa/ 'brog mi/ se mkhar chung ba/ sa chen man 'dra/ gces bsdus rgyas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rje sa chen/ rje btsun sku mched/ chos rje pa/ chos kyi rgyal po/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan man 'dra/ bir+wa pa'i man ngag dug bcos pa/ drang srong bcos pa/ khyi smyon bcos pa/ gnyan bcos pa ste/ man ngag zu lum mar grags pa dang*/ 'chi med kyi gzhung*/ go cha lnga srung*/ dbyug pa'i rtsa ba gu ṇa mi tras mdzad pa/ gegs sel gyi 'khrul 'khor bzhi/ glan gyi gegs sel/ ti phu pa'i 'khrul 'khor nyi shu pa/ sa ra ha'i brgyad rnams legs par thos so// 'chi med grub pa'i gzhung dpal bir+wa pas mdzad pa man ngag dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rnal 'byor ma/ bir+wa pa/ bram ze zla ba nag po/ dur khrod nag po/ 'brom ston/ rin po che ston ye/ gnyags shes rab 'od zer/ spang por zhang ston/ bla ma rin chen 'od/ kun spangs kun tu bzang po/ bla ma rin chen dpal bzang po/ 'gro mgon bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ bla ma dam pa bud+dha shrī/ des bdag la'o// dbyug pa'i gzhung gu ṇa mi tras mdzad pa/ man ngag dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ gu ṇa mi tra/ ā tsar+ya pradz+nyā badz+ra/ bkras lung pa/ gzhon nu grub/ zhang byang she/ 'gro mgon bsod nams rgyal mtshan man 'dra/ bir+wa pa'i man ngag zu lum skor gyi brgyud pa ni/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ bla ma dam pa bud+dha shrī/ des bdag la'o// brgyud pa gong ma rnams lam 'bras dang 'dra bya ba dpe kha cig la snang yang*/ bir+wa pa nas/ dam pa rgya gar du brgyud pa'i man ngag tu snang ngo*// yang de nyid las gsang 'dus mi bskyod rdo rje'i dbang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/

phyag na rdo rje/ in+d+ra bhū ti/ klu las byung ba'i ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ rgyal po bi su kalpa/ sa ra ha/ slob dpon klu sgrub/ ār+ya de wa/ zla grags/ slob pa'i rdo rje/ spyod pa pa/ sa 'dres pa/ des dpal sbas/ bīr+ya bha dra/ de ba ā ka ra rnams la/ de gsum gyis bla ma 'gos lots+tsha ba/ des dbus pa dge ser la/ bla ma gnam kha'u pa sku mched/ rje sa chen/ kha'u rdo rje bdud 'joms/ rje btsun rin po che/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'phags pa rin po che/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ chos rje brag phug pa/ bla ma blo gros brtan pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ bla ma dam pa bud+dha shrī/ des bdag la'o// yang na/ sangs rgyas/ phyag na rdo rje/ 'phags pa klu grub/ ār+ya de wa/ shākya bshes gnyen/ zla ba grags pa/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ skal ldan grags pa/ 'od zer 'byung gnas grags pa/ 'od mdzad lha/ chos kyi 'byung gnas zhi ba/ rnam par bzod pa'i lha/ kha che paṇa chen/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta man sngar dang 'dra/ yang na/ rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag na rdo rje/ klu sgrub/ ār+ya de wa/ ma tang gi rā hu la shrī/ bi khyā ta de wa/ kha chen paṇa chen/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta man 'dra'o// gsang 'dus lus dkyil gyi dbang bka'i brgyud pa ni/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ mkha' 'gro ma pad+ma zhabs/ zla sgron ma/ nyi ma 'od/ su kha ma hā sid+dhi/ chu shing snye ma can/ mar pa/ mtshur dbang po/ gad pa kīrti/ rin chen gling pa/ rgya thams cad mkhyen pa/ chos kyi grags pa/ slob dpon ston pa/ slob dpon bsod dbang*/ bla ma mchog ldan/ bag ston gzhon tshul/ bla ma tshul rgyal/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ bla ma dam pa bud+dha shrī/ des bdag la'o// mchog ldan gyi yig cha'i lung yang thos/ rdzogs rim zab mo gsang 'dus rim lnga'i dmar khrid dbang gong ma dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ byang sems blo gros rin chen/ klu sgrub/ ma tang gi pa/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/

mar pa lots+tsha ba/ dbang gi rdo rje/ rje gad pa/ bya khong pa bsod nams rin chen/ mi nyag thur la ba tshul khrims skyabs/ rgya mkhar thang dpe pa 'phags pa skyabs/ grub thob gser sdings pa gzhon nu 'od/ kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer/ bla ma 'phags 'od/ bu ston rin po che/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ bla ma dam pa bud+dha shrī/ des bdag la'o// yang na/ bu ston pa/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ bla ma dam pa bud+dha shrī/ de las bdag gis/ khrid yig bu ston rin po ches mdzad pa/ ngo sprod yu mo khug pa/ dharma shrī pa'i zin bris rnams thos/ yang na/ bu ston pa/ lots+tsha ba byang chub rtse mo/ bla ma dam pa bud+dha shrī/ de las bdag gi khrid yig zin bris mar grags pa thos/ yang man ngag nag khrid du grags pa'i skor la/ bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar/ bskyed rdzogs gnyis gdan thog gcig tu bsgom pa/ lam rtags dang 'brel ba'i man ngag don lnga ma dang*/ don bzhi ma dang*/ rim lnga stan gcig gi steng du bsgom pa'i man ngag 'khor lo can dang*/ 'khor lo med pa dang*/ srog rtsol la brten nas gtum mo bsgom pa rim lnga dang sbyar ba dang*/ rim lnga sems dpa' sum brtsegs kyi gdams pa dang*/ 'khor ba 'jug ldog la brten nas/ ma rig pa rtsad nas bcad pa dang*/ skye 'chi gnyis la brten nas 'pho ba grong 'jug gis le lo can 'chi khar sangs rgyas pa'i man ngag dang*/ mnyam gzhag sgyu ma'i man ngag rmi lam sgyu ma'i man ngag bar do sgyu ma'i man ngag sku gsum gyi 'pho ba'i man ngag btsan thabs su 'pho ba'i man ngag chags can 'og sgo la brten nas bde ba bsgom pa'i man ngag bsre ba drug pa'i man ngag rdo rje sems dpa'i gseb lam/ sdig po che btsan thabs su sangs rgyas pa'i man ngag mgrin par rmi lam la brten nas sangs rgyas pa'i man ngag sgyu ma btsan thabs su bzung ba'i man ngag snying khar mi shigs pa'i thig le la brten nas ma rig pa rtsad nas gcod pa'i man ngag

rim lnga gcig char ba'i man ngag gsang ba thugs rgyud kyi rim lnga'i man ngag da lta nyid nas 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi bzhugs tshul gtan la dbab pa/ pha rgyud yang snying*/ ma rgyud yang snying rnams thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ gong dang 'dra ba las/ bu ston pa dang*/ chos rje bla ma gnyis ka las bla ma dpal ldan pas gsan no// mar lugs kyi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs ci bsam kun 'grub/ 'gos lugs kyi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs yon tan rjes dran rnams kyang thos/ yang de nyid las/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rdzogs rim/ zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i khrid thob pa'i 'bro lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ dus kyi 'khor lo/ chos rgyal so gnyis/ dus zhabs pa chen po/ dus zhabs chung ba gnyis pa/ kha che zla mgon/ brag sgom dkon mchog srung*/ sgro ston gnam la brtsegs/ yu mo dad pa rgyal po/ sras dharme shwa ra/ khang sar nam mkha' 'od/ grub thob se mo che/ chos rje 'jam gsar/ bla ma chos sku 'od zer/ kun spangs kun tu bzang po/ kun mkhyen 'phags 'od/ bu ston rin chen grub/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ bla ma dam pa bud+dha shrī/ des bdag la'o// yang sha ba ri nas brgyud pa ltar na/ rdo rje 'chang*/ sha ba ri dbang phyug bi bhū ta tsan+d+ra/ dpyal a mo gha/ mar ston g.yeng 'bar/ rnal 'byor seng 'bum/ kun spangs chen po man gong dang 'dra ba las/ sngon 'gro/ thog mar dge ba/ bar du dge ba/ tha mar dge ba rnams kyi khrid yig ngo sprod gcer mthong ngo shes rnams bu ston rin po ches mdzad pa/ zin bris dharma shrī pas mdzad pa rnams thos/ yang kun spangs chen po/ bla ma rin chen dpal bzang*/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan man 'dra/ yang na/ kun spangs chen pa/ brag kha ba grags pa seng ge bang mo zhu ba gzhon nu dpal/ chos rje pa man 'dra ba la/ sha ba ri'i gzhung*/ de'i lo rgyus/

sa bcad 'grel pa rnams bi bhū ti tsan+d+ra'i gsung las/ mi bskyod rdo rjes btus pa/ sngon 'gro/ thog mar dge ba/ bar du dge ba/ tha mar dge ba rnams kyi khrid yig kun spangs pas mdzad pa/ ngo sprod skal ldan sgom bzang gis mdzad pa rnams thos/ yang dpe med 'tsho'i sbyor drug ltar na/ slob dpon dpe med 'tsho/ dpal 'dzin/ paṇ+ḍi ta 'od byed lha/ paṇ+ḍi ta chos kyi 'byung gnas zhi ba/ slob dpon nyi ma ye shes/ bi bhū ti tsan+d+ra/ yang na/ chos kyi 'byung gnas zhi ba/ paṇ+ḍi ta grags pa'i lha/ paṇ+ḍi ta chos bzang*/ bi bhū ti tsan+d+ra/ bla ma ko brag pa/ g.yung phug pa/ nyeg po chos ldan/ de gsum ka las go lung pa gzhon nu dpal gyis zhus/ de las thar pa lots+tsha ba nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ bu ston rin po che/ chos rje pa man 'dra'o// rwa lugs ltar na/ grub thob tsi lu ā tsar+ya/ ba ren+d+ra'i paṇ+ḍi ta ā tsar+ya/ tsor ya sha'i dus zhabs che ba/ mañdzu de shar 'khrungs pa'i dus zhabs pa gnyis pa/ mda' 'jim grags pa'am rin chen 'byung gnas sbas pa/ 'jam dpal grags pa/ mkhas pa kun bzang dpal/ go lung pa/ thar lo/ bu ston pa/ chos rje man 'dra'o// yang na/ dus zhabs pa chung ba/ 'jam dpal grags pa/ mañdzu kīrti/ rwa chos rab/ rwa ye shes seng ge rwa 'bum seng*/ rje btsun rgwa lo/ rong pa sher seng*/ kun mkhyen 'phags 'od/ bu ston pa/ chos rje pa man 'dra/ nā ro pa dang*/ shākya shrī'i sbyor drug ni/ nā ro pa/ 'jigs med grags pa/ kha che paṇa chen/ dpyal chos bzang*/ dpyal a mo gha/ rje btsun rgwa lo/ sher seng*/ bu ston pa/ chos rje man 'dra/ khyad par du srog rtsol gyi brgyud pa ni/ dus zhabs chung ba/ dpe med 'tsho/ a bha ya/ rnam bzod lha/ dad byed lha dbang*/ paṇa chen shākya shrī/ sa skya paṇa chen/ rgyus pa gzhon seng*/ dol po pa ye shes mgon po/ kun spangs kun tu bzang po man 'bro lugs dang 'dra'o// yang na/ kun spangs pa/ sron pa kun dga' rgyal/

sron pa chos dpal bzang po/ chos rje pa man 'dra/ yang na/ chos rje chos dpal bzang po/ rin chen bsod nams grags pa/ chos rje man 'dra ba las/ srog rtsol gsang ba'i nye lam/ de'i 'grel pa chos rje pas mdzad pa/ rlung sbyor bcu gnyis kyi zin bris/ rtsa 'dab kyi nyams khrid rdo rje lus kyi mdud 'grol nyams kyi skya rgyal/ rtsa 'dab rgyan can/ rgyan med/ rtsa 'dab thor bu pa/ gegs sel lam gyi go cha/ gegs sel gyi 'khrul 'khor/ nges don sku bzhi'i lam 'jug rnams thos so// de ltar brgyud pa thams cad kyi man ngag gcig tu dril ba'i sngon 'gro thar lam gsal sgron/ thog mar dge ba'i khrid yig stong nyid gsal sgron/ bar du dge ba'i khrid yig srog 'dzin gsal sgron/ tha mar dge ba'i khrid yig bde chen gsal sgron/ bsgom bya'i ngo bo'i zin bris/ ngo sprod sbas don gsal ba rnams chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos mdzad pa rnams thos/ yang sor sdud bsam gtan gyi brgyud pa lugs gcig ni/ kun spangs kun tu bzang po/ bla ma brag kha pa grags pa seng ge bla ma blo gros brtan pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims man 'dra/ yang sbyor drug dbang rgyal lugs kyi skor la/ chos rje kun spangs chen po/ bla ma dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/ bla ma rin chen dpal/ bla ma dbang phyug rin chen/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ bla ma dam pa bud+dha shrī/ de las bdag gis sha ba ri'i gzhung chung 'grel pa/ srog dus bzhi pa srog rtsol gyi mdzub tshugs yid bzhin nor bu ngo sprod gegs sel mig sgron rtags yig chen mo/ dbu ma gsum gyi ngos 'dzin/ zag pa gsum 'gag pa'i rgyu mtshan/ bar do'i gdams ngag sangs rgyas sgyid lugs rnams bla ma dbang rgyal bas mdzad pa thos/ yang 'gro ba'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi brgyud pa ni/ kun spangs pa yan 'bro lugs kyi khrid dang 'dra ba la/ de nas kun mkhyen 'phags 'od/

bu ston rin po che/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ bla ma dam pa bud+dha shrī/ des bdag la'o// yang na/ dus zhabs snyan brgyud/ nyi zla sgrub pa/ sbas pa mig 'byed/ ye shes spyan sgrub/ nyi ma dpal ye shes kyi sbyor drug rnams thos so// gshed dmar lha bcu gsum ma'i dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das gshin rje'i gshed/ bram ze dpal 'dzin/ bi ra ḍi pa/ gaṃ bhī ra ma ti/ ni ska laṅka de wa/ re ben+d+ra bha dra/ glo bo lots+tsha ba/ 'phags pa rin po che/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ chos rje brag phug pa/ bla ma dkon mchog rgyal mtshan pa/ bla ma dam pa bud+dha shrī/ des bdag la'o// yang na/ gshin rje'i gshed/ dpal 'dzin/ dpe med 'tsho/ chos kyi 'byung gnas zhi ba/ rin chen 'byung gnas zhi ba/ rnam par grags pa'i lha/ kha che paṇa chen/ dā na shrī la/ g.yag sde lots+tsha ba/ zhang dkon mchog dpal man 'dra/ yang nye brgyud ni/ gshin rje gshed/ dā na shrī la man gong dang 'dra/ sgrol ma lus dkyil gyi dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ sgrol ma/ bai ro tsa na rak+ṣi ta/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun pa/ chos rje pa/ 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa/ blo gros brtan pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ bla ma dam pa bud+dha shrī/ des bdag la'o/ sgrol ma lha bcu bdun ma'i sbyin sreg spru lung pa kun smon gyis mdzad pa thos so// bde mchog dril bu pa'i dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa yan chad gzhan dang 'dra/ 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ chos rje brag phug pa/ bla ma dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dam pa bud+dha shrī/ des bdag la'o// yang sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ tshogs sgom pa/ nyan chen pa/ brag phug pa man 'dra/ nā ro mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs/ rdzogs rim rtsa dbu ma'i nyams khrid/ nā ro pa'i gzhung lam gyi yan lag sogs gong ma'i yig rnying thams cad thos te/ bla mas/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims las gsan no// yang chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan/

bla ma gzungs kyi dpal/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ bla ma dam pa bud+dha shrī las nā ro mkha' spyod kyi man ngag bla ma gzungs pas phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa'i lung thos/ phag mo zhal gnyis ma/ don grub ma/ dbu bcad ma gsum gyi byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ lcam legs smin ka ra/ bir+wa pa/ a wa dhū tī pa/ sha ba ri pa/ bsod snyoms pa che chung*/ bal po hang du dkar po/ dpyal kun dga' rdo rje/ yang dben pa bsod seng*/ dpyal pa kun dga' grags/ lha lung pa/ dpyal chos bzang*/ rong pa rgwa lo/ bla ma shes rab seng ge bag ston gzhon tshul/ bla ma tshul rgyal ba/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ bla ma dam pa bud+dha shrī/ des bdag la'o// yang na/ dpyal kun dga' rdo rje/ 'od grags slob dpon jo gdan/ khams pa lho tshad pa/ lots+tsha ba mchog ldan/ bag ston man 'dra/ gur gyi mgon po lcam dral gyi rjes gnang thun mong ba/ gur gyi mgon po lha brgyad kyi rjes gnang thun mong ma yin pa zab mo/ de'i gtor chog bla ma dpal ldan pas mdzad pa/ dpal nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa'i rjes gnang rnams thos shing*/ bla mas rje dpal ldan pa las gsan no// ni gu chos drug khrid kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ ni gu ma khyung po rnal 'byor/ rmog cog pa rin chen brtson 'grus/ dbon ston skyer sgang pa ye shes seng ge ri gong pa/ gnyan ston thog rdugs/ sangs rgyas ston pa/ mkhas grub gzhon nu grub/ ba lung ba bsod grags/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ bla ma dam pa bud+dha shrī/ des bdag la'o// 'di'i chos skor la/ khyung po'i rnam thar 'bring po/ rmog cog pa/ skyer sgang pa/ gnyan ston/ sangs rgyas ston pa rnams kyi rnam thar/ ni gu'i tshig rkang*/ de'i khrid yig mkhas btsun pas mdzad pa/ khyung po'i thems yig tshig gsal/ bar do'i ngos 'dzin/ khyad 'phags bco lnga ma'i man ngag sgyu ma rab tu gsal bar byed pa'i rin po che'i 'od phreng*/

sgyu lus 'dzin med rang grol/ sgyu lus gdan thog gcig ma 'od gsal 'char sgo ngos 'dzin/ rnam 'joms gsang sgrub/ gnad drug gi man ngag thar lam/ sgyu lus/ rmi lam 'od gsal/ 'pho ba/ bar do rnams kyi dbang bka' re re/ chos drug spyi'i dbang la sgyu lus dbang mo cher grags pa'i dbang*/ de dag gi yig cha khyung pos mdzad pa bdun/ rgyud sde lha lnga'i mngon rtogs/ dbang gi sngon 'gro sangs rgyas ston pas mdzad pa/ smon lam bka' rgya ma/ mkha' spyod ma dmar mo'i byin rlabs/ de'i mngon rtogs/ byin rlabs kyi yi ge khyung po'i mgur brgyad man ngag dang bcas pa dang*/ ga'u ma'i khrid dang byin rlabs zhus nas/ de'i tshig rkang*/ tshig gsal/ byin rlabs kyi yi ge khrid yig mkhas grub pas mdzad pa dang*/ 'phyugs med kyi dbang de'i rdo rje'i tshig rkang*/ de'i man ngag khyung pos mdzad pa rnams thos pa'i brgyud pa'ang gong dang 'dra'o// 'on kyang mkha' spyod dmar mo'i skor mgur brgyad dang bcas pa khyung pos bla ma rā hu la las gsan par 'dug gsungs/ 'chi med kyi byin rlabs/ 'khrul 'khor/ de'i yi ge sangs rgyas ston pas mdzad pa rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ dbu bcad ma/ bir+wa pa/ bram ze nag po pa/ dur khrod nag po pa/ la stod mgon po/ gnyan ston/ sangs rgyas ston pa/ mkhas grub chos rje/ ba lung ba bsod grags man ni gu dang 'dra/ mgon po phyag drug pa'i phyi'i dbang*/ sha ba ri pa'i sgrub thabs gtor chog rjes gnang gi yi ge rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ ye shes mgon po/ sha ba ri pa/ mai tri pa/ at+ma badz+ra/ khyung po rnal 'byor man ni gu dang 'dra/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyi dbang*/ de'i sgrub thabs/ grib sel gyi man ngag rnams thob pa'i brgyud pa'ang gong ltar ro// yang bla ma yang dgon pas mdzad pa'i ri chos dgos pa kun 'byung*/ bar do gnad kyi 'phrang sgrol/ rdo rje lus kyi sbas bshad de/

ri chos skor gsum du grags pa/ de'i zhal shes ma drug tu grags pa rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ mar pa lho brag pa/ mi la/ dwags po/ mtha' rtsa ba/ 'bri khung pa/ spyan snga ba/ yang dgon pa/ yang na/ gling ras pa/ rgya ras pa/ rgod tshang pa/ yang dgon pa/ sgom rin/ zur phug pa/ ri pa gzhon nu rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ bla ma dam pa bud+dha shrī/ des bdag la'o// bka' gdams lam rim gyi brgyud pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang po/ rgyal tshab mgon po byams pa/ 'phags pa thogs med/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen/ 'phags pa grol sde/ btsun pa grol sde mkhan po rnam snang mdzad/ slob dpon seng ge bzang po/ ku su lu che ba/ ku su lu chung ba/ gser gling pa chos kyi grags pa/ dpal ldan a ti sha dge bshes 'brom ston pa/ pu to ba chen po/ sha ra ba/ gtum ston blo gros grags/ rdo ston shes rab grags/ gro ston bdud rtsi grags/ mchims nam mkha' grags/ skyo ston smon lam tshul khrims/ rgyang ro byang chub 'bum/ mchims blo bzang grags/ mkhan chen rgyal bzang ba/ mkhan chen kun dga' dpal bzang*/ bla ma dam pa bud+dha shrī/ de las bdag gis ya ru 'od 'phan rtsa 'grel dang bcas pa zhus so// dbu ma lta khrid kyi brgyud pa ni/ shākya'i rgyal po/ byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rin chen/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ ār+ya de wa/ zla ba grags pa/ rig pa'i khu byug ku su lu pa che chung gnyis/ bal po thang spe/ ha ra rgyal ba 'byung gnas/ byang sems zla rgyal/ rje lung pa 'od zer grags/ spyil bu ba grags pa seng ge spyi bo lhas pa byang chub 'od/ dpal ldan gro mo che ba bdud rtsi grags/ rtsi 'dul ba thugs rje byang chub/ bde ba can pa shākya byang chub/ mkhan chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen byang chub dpal bzang po/ mkhan chen byang chub seng ge mkhan chen blo gros rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen kun dga' dpal bzang*/

bla ma dam pa bud+dha shrī/ des bdag la'o// yang de nyid las/ slob dpon zhi ba lha'i spyod 'jug gi lung yang zhus shing*/ nyid kyis bla ma dkon mchog rgyal mtshan pa las gsan no// chos nyid rang gi ngo bo tha dad du snang ba'i mdo la sogs pa mdo sil bu pa bcu bdun/ mchims nam mkha' grags kyi sa bcad dang bcas pa thos shing*/ bla ma bas/ bla ma mgon po 'bum las gsan gsung ngo*// theg pa chen po blo sbyong don bdun mar grags pa'i khrid thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ thub pa chen po/ mi pham mgon/ 'phags pa thogs med/ rgyal sras dbyig gnyen/ 'phags pa rnam grol sde/ btsun pa rnam grol sde/ gu ṇa mi tra/ slob dpon seng ge bzang po/ gang ba spel/ ku su lu/ ku su lu gnyis pa/ gser gling pa/ mar me mdzad/ 'brom ston pa/ pu to ba rin chen gsal/ sha ra ba yon tan grags/ 'chad ka ba ye shes rdo rje/ se 'od zer gzhon nu ba/ lha 'od zer bla ma/ lha sdings pa byang chub 'bum/ lha sdings dbon/ yon tan dpal/ bde ba dpal/ ka bzhi pa grags pa gzhon nu/ rin chen bsod nams grags pa/ rgyal sras thogs med/ bla ma dam pa bud+dha shrī/ de las bdag gis dpal ye'i zin bris kyi lung dang bcas pa lan gnyis thos/ rten 'brel snying po'i khrid kyi brgyud pa ni/ thub pa chen po/ spyan ras gzigs/ byams pa mgon po/ gser gling pa chos kyi grags pa/ a ti sha 'brom rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas/ pu to ba rin chen gsal/ rgyal ston lcags ri pa/ rnal 'byor pa chos kyi g.yung drung*/ snyi phu pa yer sgom zhig po/ rgya sgom ri pa/ bo dong rin po che/ nyan chen bsod nams brtan/ rin po che shes rab 'bum/ rgyal sras thogs med/ bla ma dam pa bud+dha shrī/ des bdag la'o// skyid sdug lam khyer gyi brgyud pa ni/ paṇa chen shākya'i shrī/ lo chen byams pa'i dpal/ mkhan chen byang chub dpal/ mkhan chen bde ba dpal/ mkhan chen ka bzhi pa/ mkhan chen bsod nams grags pa/
