rgyal sras thogs med/ bla ma dam pa bud+dha shrī/ des bdag la'o// dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed kyi cho ga'i brgyud pa ni/ thub pa chen po/ mgon po 'jam dbyangs/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ ār+ya de wa/ zla ba grags pa/ rig pa'i khu byug slob pa'i rdo rje/ dgra las rnam rgyal/ rdo rje gdan pa chen po/ gnyis pa/ paṇa chen pu ṇ+ya shrī/ ba ri lots+tsha ba/ rje sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'phags pa rin po che/ 'jam dbyangs 'khon ston/ byang sems rin chen mgon/ rgyal sras thogs med/ bla ma dam pa bud+dha shrī/ des bdag la'o// yang na/ sa skya paṇa chen/ dbu ma pa shes rab 'bum/ sgro mon can rin chen dpal/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dam pa bud+dha shri/ des bdag la'o// yang na/ 'phags pa rin po che/ sgro mon can pa man chad sngar dang 'dra ba las/ chos rje rgyal sras pas mdzad pa'i yig cha'i steng nas lan gnyis thos/ sems tsam lugs kyi sems bskyed kyi cho ga'i brgyud pa ni/ thub pa chen po/ byams pa/ 'phags pa thogs med/ dbyig gnyen/ 'phags pa rnam grol sde/ btsun pa rnam grol sde/ mchog gi sde/ dul ba'i sde/ slob dpon seng ge bzang po/ ku su lu che ba/ ku su lu chung ba/ gser gling ba/ a ti sha 'brom ston/ spyan snga ba/ bya yul ba gzhon nu 'od/ shar chen pa/ gro ston bdud rtsi grags/ sangs rgyas sgom pa/ mchims chen po mkhas btsun pa bsod nams ye shes/ mkhan chen bsod nams grags pa/ rgyal sras thogs med/ bla ma dam pa bud+dha shri/ de las bdag gis chos rje rgyal sras pa'i yig cha'i steng nas thos so// thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal gyi smyung gnas gyi brgyud pa ni/ spyan ras gzigs/ dge slong ma dpal mo/ paṇ+ḍi ta zla ba gzhon nu/ ye shes bzang po/ bal po'i paṇ+ḍi ta pe nya ba/ byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan/ grub thob nyi phug pa/ sprul pa rdo rje rgyal po/

zhang ston dgra 'jigs/ rtsi 'dul 'dzin/ bde ba can pa/ chu bzang ba/ rin po che shes rab 'bum pa/ rgyal sras thogs med/ bla ma dam pa bud+dha shrī/ de las bdag gi zhus so// yang chos rje rgyal sras rin po che'i bka' 'bum gyi lung thob pa'i rnam grangs la/ 'jam dbyangs 'khon ston thugs rje rin chen la bstod pa/ byang sems rin chen mgon la bstod pa/ rin po che'i cod paṇa dang*/ dad pa skyed byed gnyis dpang lots+tsha ba/ bu ston rin po che/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa rnams la bstod pa re re/ phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor/ dmar khrid/ blo sbyong*/ rten 'brel snying po/ bcu gcig zhal gyi smyung gnas/ don zhags/ sems bskyed dbu ma lugs/ sems tsam lugs/ so thar sdom rgyud/ sum pa lots+tsha ba'i snyan brgyud/ skyid sdug lam khyer/ snying po don gsum rnams kyi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs re re/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas/ sman bla'i lha tshogs/ byang sems bcu drug jo bo rin po che/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ spyan ras gzigs la gnyis/ byams pa sgrol ma rnams la bstod pa re re/ rgyal sras lag len/ chos sku la sh+lau ka re re ba gnyis/ chos sku la rin chen phreng ba/ chos skul rin chen rgyan/ rang la gros 'debs/ gros 'debs ang drug ma/ slob ma rnams la snying gtam gsungs pa/ rang la bskul ba che chung gnyis/ smon 'jug sems bskyed kyi cho ga jo bo lugs/ sems bskyed rang gis blang ba'i cho ga sems bskyed kyi cho ga spyod 'jug lugs/ smyung gnas kyi cho ga blo sbyong don bdun ma'i khrid yig rten 'brel snying po'i khrid yig skyid sdug lam khyer gyi khrid yig kun rig thugs rje chen po/ 'od dpag med gsum gyi mngon rtogs re re/ thugs rje chen po'i brul gtor/ chos spyod/ byang sems rin chen mgon gyi nang rten gyi dkar chag bsod nams 'od zer la gdams pa/

pha jo g.yung drung dpal la gdams pa/ de'i don du mdzad pa'i yan lag bdun pa spyod 'jug lugs/ la shing mkhan po shes rab grub/ bshes gnyen shes rab rtse/ nam mkha' grub/ stag lung ba shākya bzang po rnams la gdams pa re re/ shāka bzang la gdams pa chos brgyad lam du blang ba/ shāka bzang la gdams pa sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang ba'i blo sbyong*/ stag lung bka' drug pa la/ dpon chen byang pa la phul ba'i zhu yig rdzogs chen pa chos nyid rgyal mtshan gyi dris lan/ gnod lan du phan 'dogs pa'i dam bca' dang smon lam/ dam chos tshul bzhin sgrub thabs zla chos kyis bskul ma/ lta sgom spyod 'bras/ gzhi lam 'bras bu'i ngos 'dzin/ chos rje kun mkhyen pa'i dris lan/ byang pa shāka bzang la gdams pa/ stag lung pa sangs rgyas dpal gyis dam bca' brtan pa'i don du gdams pa/ slob dpon chen po nam mkha' rin chen la gdams pa dang*/ khong gi bskul ba'i phar phyin drug gi ngos 'dzin/ dkon mchog gsum gyi ngos 'dzin rong po chos blo'i don du sbyar ba/ bon po khyi thul can la gdams pa/ mkhan chen byang rtse ba'i dris lan/ sa skyar dge bshes gcig gis nad sogs byung na lam du ji ltar khyer zhus pa'i lan/ dge bshes shākya bsod nams la/ slob dpon nam dpal ba la gnyis/ gnas rnying pa rgyal dbang la/ slob dpon chen po grags rin la/ slob dpon ldong ston la/ chos blo dbon po la gsum/ mkhan chen gros pa la/ slob dpon chos mchog la gnyis/ bla ma po rtog pa la/ spud kra'i rtogs ldan bsod rin gyi dam bca' brtan don du gdams pa/ 'od zer bzang po la/ yang dgon pa bla ma ri pa gzhon nu rgyal mtshan la/ rtsib ri ba gzhon nu byang chub la/ sgom chen pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan la/ kham pa blo gros dpal la/ mi nyag rgyal mtshan 'bum la/ mi nyag rab ston la/ rin po che skyob pa dpal la/ rgyal sras lag len gyi pha yul spong ba'i skabs su blang dor byed pa dang brjed pa'i zhal gsal/

nam mkha' bzang po la/ dge slong chos dbang rin chen grogs mched gnyis la/ bshad gsal ba'i don du mdzad pa'i mo lha/ ma ṇi ba'i drang gtam/ bsngo ba'i byed tshul/ dbon rin dang*/ kham pa ma ṇi ba'i don du mdzad pa'i smon lam re re/ bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad dbon rin gyi don du mdzad pa/ ras chung zhal chems dris lan rnams te/ mdor na/ bka' 'bum thor bu pa la chos kyi rnam grangs brgya dang bdun gyi lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos rje rin po che rgyal sras thogs med/ chos rje lots+tsha ba byang chub rtse mo/ bla ma dam pa bud+dha shrī/ des bdag la'o// sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs rdo za ba'i man ngag dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ dam pa rgya gar/ byang sa gu lots+tsha ba/ yon po chos grags/ bla ma khyung po/ chos kyi shes rab/ dar ma dbang phyug dbus pa sangs rgyas 'bum/ cha gan bla ma mnyam med grags rgyal/ chos rje lots+tsha ba byang chub rtse mo/ bla ma dam pa bud+dha shrī/ des bdag la'o// tshe dpag med kyi tshe sgrub rlung sbyor dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ srin po ri pa/ dbus pa 'jam gzhon/ bo dong pa dar shag kun mkhyen shes rab mtsho/ mus srad pa dpal ldan seng ge bla ma dam pa bud+dha shrī/ des bdag la'o// gzhan yang sgra mi snyan pa'i tshe sgrub/ de kho na nyid kyi tshe sgrub/ dbu ma'i bzlog pa/ dmu chu bcos thabs sogs man ngag phran tshegs 'ga' yang zhus shing*/ khro phu lots+tsha bas mdzad pa'i smon lam rin po che'i sil ma yang thos so// thob yig rgya mtsho las/ chos kyi rje bud+dha shrī rjes su bzung ba'i skabs te gsum pa'o// //tshad med thugs rje'i mnga' bdag bla ma chen po kun dga' rgyal mtshan pa'i drung du/ dpal kye'i rdo rje ḍom+bhi he ru ka'i lugs kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ bdag med ma/ bir+wa pa/ slob dpon chen po ḍom+bhi he ru ka

a la la badz+ra/ nags khrod pa/ gar+bha ri pa/ dza ya shrī dz+nyā na/ mi thub zla ba/ dpa' bo rdo rje/ 'brog mi lots+tsha ba chen po/ mnga' ris pa gsal ba'i snying po/ 'khon sgyi chu ba/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ rong pa rgwa lo/ rong pa shes rab seng ge zhang grags 'byor/ bla ma bsod nams lhun grub/ bla ma ngag gi dbang phyug grags/ bla ma kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o// rje btsun ma sgrol ma lha bcu gsum ma dang*/ lha bcu bdun ma'i dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma/ slob dpon nyi ma sbas pa/ tsan+d+ra gar+bha/ dze tā ri pa/ wa kī shwa ra kīrti/ shrad+dhā ka ra warma/ ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi ta/ dā na shī la/ mañdzu shrī/ mal lots+tsha ba/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po/ ne tso sbal ston/ gnam pa rwa chos she/ mngon pa ba dbang phyug brtson 'grus/ paṇ+ḍi ta rdo rje shes rab/ bla ma zhang dkon mchog dpal/ chos rje brag phug pa/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma chen po kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o// yang na/ mal lots+tsha nas/ pug cer lots+tsha ba/ la stod dbang rin/ mchims chos seng*/ mchims blo brtan/ mchims nam mkha' grags/ 'phags pa rin po che/ bla ma ye shes/ rin chen/ bla ma mkhan chen pa/ bla ma klu byang ba/ lots+tsha ba mchog ldan/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma chen po kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o// rnal 'byor dbang bskur gyi byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ni/ dga' rab rdo rje/ dgra las rgyal ba/ s+tha bi ra chung ngu*/ ba ri lots+tsha ba/ rje sa chen/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ grub thob yon tan dpal/ bla ma rwa gnyis pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa bsod nams dpal/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma chen po kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ des bdag la'o// yang na/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ khar 'od zer rgyal mtshan/

de'i slob ma re mda' ba gcig la/ zhang dkon mchog dpal gyis zhus/ de man 'dra/ yang bde mchog rim lnga'i byin rlabs/ gshed dmar bdud rtsi'i byin rlabs/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor rnams kyang thos/ sum pa lots+tsha ba'i blo sbyong gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje phag mo dang sgrol ma gnyis kyis/ sum pa lots+tsha ba la gnang*/ de nas chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta nas/ 'phags pa rin po che/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa bsod nams dpal/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ de la bdag gis chos rje bla mas mdzad pa'i yig cha'i steng nas thos so// thob yig rgya mtsho las/ bla ma chen po kun dga' rgyal mtshan pas rjes su bzung ba'i skabs te bzhi pa'o// //rmad du byung ba'i yon tan gyi tshogs du ma la dbang 'byor ba'i bdag nyid chos rje sa bzang 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros pa'i drung du/ rgyud sde rin po che bzhi dang 'brel ba'i dbang bka'/ byin rlabs rjes gnang rig gtad lung man ngag sogs zhus pa las/ thog mar dbang bka' la/ spyi dang bye brag gnyis las/ dang po rgyud sde spyi'i dgongs 'grel/ slob dpon chen po a bha yā ka ras mdzad pa'i rdo rje phreng bar gsungs pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob pa'i rnam grangs la/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud las gsungs pa'i gsang 'dus ye shes zhabs lugs lha bcu dgu ma/ 'phags lugs lha so gnyis ma/ kha sbyor nas gsungs pa'i rdor sems lha so bdun ma/ gdan bzhir gsungs pa'i ye shes mkha' 'gro lha bcu gsum ma/ kha sbyor nas gsungs pa'i kye'i rdo rje lha bcu bdun ma bzhi dang*/ bdag med ma nyer gsum/ brtag gnyis nas gsungs pa'i bdag med lha mo bco lnga ma dang*/ ku ru kul+le'i lha mo bco lnga ma/ rdo rje bdud rtsi nyer gcig ma bzhi/ brtag gnyis kye'i rdo rje lha dgu ma bzhi/ ma hā mā yā lha lnga ma/ sangs rgyas thod pa lha dgu ma/

khams gsum rnam rgyal nas bshad pa'i rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad bcu gcig ma/ bde mchog drug bcu rtsa gnyis ma gsum/ phag mo so bdun ma gsum/ sangs rgyas thod pa nyer lnga ma/ gdan bzhir gsungs pa'i rnal 'byor nam mkha' nga brgyad ma/ dgra nag bcu gsum ma/ gur nas gsungs pa'i rdo rje sgrol ma bcu gcig ma/ 'od zer can nyer lnga ma/ gzungs grwa lnga bcu gsum ma/ de nyid 'dus par gsungs pa'i rdo rje dbyings nga gsum ma/ rnam snang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba nas gsungs pa'i 'jam rdor zhe gsum ma/ 'jam dpal sgyu 'phrul drwa ba nas gsungs pa'i chos dbyings ngag dbang gnyis brgya bcu gsum ma/ sbyong rgyud nas gsungs pa'i gtsug dgu so bdun ma/ 'byung po 'dul byed so gsum ma/ gur rigs bsdus nga gsum ma/ bde mchog 'khor lo sgyur drug drug cu rtsa gsum ma/ dus 'khor lha stong dang bzhi yod pa rnams te/

ji ltar na/ a bha yas bla ma so so las gsan mod/ de dag gi brgyud pa ni bod du ma dar bas/ 'dir rdo rje rnal 'byor mas dkyil 'khor thams cad phyogs gcig tu bsdu pa'i gnang ba thob pa la brten nas/ dkyil 'khor bzhi bcu zhe gnyis kyi dbang bka' rnams dang*/ phreng bskor gsum gyi lung gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ a bha yā ka ra/ a nu sa ma rak+ṣi ta/ bi khyā ta de wa/ paṇa chen shākya shrī/ bhū mi shrī/ bi ma la shrī/ bo dhi sidha/ skyi ston 'jam dbyangs/ kun mkhyen chen po/ ma ti paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// yang na/ a bha yā ka ra/ nā ya ka pa/ dha sha bha la shrī/ bi khyā ta de wa man sngar dang 'dra/ yang na paṇa chen shākya shrī/ glang bang so ba/ gnyag rdo rje 'dzin pa/ kham pa dkon mchog rin chen/ lots+tsha ba mchog ldan/ de las kun mkhyen chen pos ye shes zhabs lugs kyi gtso byas pa phal che ba zhus/ de las ma ti paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// yang dkyil 'khor srung ba lnga/ mkha' 'gro lnga/ 'khor lo sgyur drug rnams so sor phye na/ lnga bcu rtsa lngar phye ba'i dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ a bha ya/ shākya rak+ṣi ta/ gho ṭa gu ru/ bi bhū ti tsan+d+ra/ go de wa shrī/ k+ṣan+ti shrī/ paṇ+ḍi ta bud+dha shrī/ paṇ+ḍi ta nā tha/ skyi ston 'jam dbyangs/ kun mkhyen chen po/ sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// yang na/ a bha ya/ legs spyod 'byung gnas sbas pa/ bde ba'i 'byung gnas sbas pa/ rat+na rak+ṣi ta/ zhang lots+tsha ba grub pa dpal/ kham pa shākya rdo rje/ bla ma dbus pa/ lots+tsha ba mchog ldan/ skyi ston man 'dra'o// yang dkyil 'khor nyer brgyad du bsdus pa'i brgyud pa ni/ kha che paṇa chen yan chad sngar dang 'dra/ de nas lho pa thams cad mkhyen pa/ lha khang dkar ru pa/ yar lung pa slob dpon ral gri'i gcung po shes smon/ bla ma byang seng*/ skyi ston pa man 'dra'o// yang na/

a bha yā/ a nu sa ma rak+ṣi ta/ bi khyā ta de wa/ paṇa chen shākya shrī/ dbon po bha mi shrī/ de'i sras bi ma la shrī bha dra/ lots+tsha ba blo brtan/ byang seng ba/ mkhas mchog pa/ kun mkhyen chen po/ sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// yang slob dpon chen po dar paṇa ā tsar+yas mdzad pa'i kri ya sa muts+tsha zhes bya ba/ rdo rje slob dpon rnams la nye bar mkho ba'i cho ga mtha' yas pa phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa'i bstan bcos chen po nas 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam grangs la/ sngar rdo rje phreng bar gsungs pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhi bcu zhe gnyis po ci lta bar bzhugs la/ de'i steng du gza' yum gyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ nor rgyun ma'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ rnam rgyal gyi dkyil 'khor te/ gsum bsnan pas dkyil 'khor zhe lnga'i dbang bskur ba'i cho ga rgyas pa dang*/ de nyid kyi gzhung gi lung dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang chen po/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ dar paṇa ā tsar+ya/ sa man+ta bha dra/ dz+nyā na dz+yo ti/ shrī ha nu man+t+ra/ shrī mañdzu bha dra/ shrī bha dra/ dharmā dz+yo ti bha dra/ ma na dza ya bha dra/ sho taṃ shrī bha dra/ shrī bi dza ya bha dra pā da/ shrī mā da na bha dra pā da/ shrī lak+ṣ+mī bha dra pā da/ ga ga na bha dra/ u da ka dzī ba bha dra/ shrī ha ra ka bha dra pa da/ bha gi bha dra/ bal yul ye rang gi paṇ+ḍi ta dza ga ta ā nan+da dzī ba bha dra/ de'i sras paṇ+ḍi ta ma hā bo dhi/ 'dir mchan zhig yod kyang ma dper gsal po med/ des sa bzang 'phags pa ku mā ra ma ti/ des bdag la'o/ ten nau/ /gzhung 'di nyid sngon chad bod du ma 'gyur ba la/ dus phyis dpal ldan sa skyar 'jam dbyangs don yod rgyal mtshan pa'i phyag tu/ sa muts+tsha'i rgya dpe gcig bal yul gyi tshong pa'i lag nas byung ba/ de kun spangs chos grags dpal bzang po'i phyag tu byung nas/ de nyid kyi bka' lung snyan pas bskul zhing*/

mthun rkyen phun sum tshogs pa bsgrubs pa la brten nas/ bi ka ma la shī la'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po mañdzu shrī dang*/ bod kyi lots+tsha ba sa bzang ba blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos bsgyur nas/ dbang lung gsan sa ma rnyed pa yod pa'i tshe/ mnga' ris pa rdo rje dpal gyis/ ye rang du sa muts+tsha'i dbang zhus zer ba'i gtam gsan nas/ 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros pa dpon slob bdun bal yul ye rang du byon nas/ paṇ+ḍi ta ma hā bo dhi dza ga ta paṇ+ḍi ta la sras med pa la/ rdo rje gdan du byang chub chen po la gsol ba 'debs tu byon pas yum mngal dang ldan par gyur nas/ sras gcig bltams pa la ma hā bo dhi btags so// la dbang lung yongs su rdzogs par gsan nas/ sa bzang du phebs te dar zhing rgyas par mdzad do// de la bdag gis rdo rje phreng ba dang*/ kri ya sa muts+tsha gnyis kyi sgrub thabs dang*/ dkyil chog rin chen phreng mdzes/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga ye shes me dpung rnams zhus shing*/ lag len rnams kyang legs par bslabs so// gnyis pa bye brag gi dbang bka' la bzhi las/ thog mar rnal 'byor bla med kyi skor la/ thabs kyi rgyud/ shes rab kyi rgyud/ gnyis su med pa'i rgyud dang gsum gyi dang po ni/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ sa lugs kyi dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ dpal sde/ bi ma la gup+ta/ rat+na badz+ra/ rat+na kīrti/ bla ma spen ta ba/ gnyan lots+tsha ba/ gnam kha'u pa/ sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ bla ma 'phags pa/ bla ma kun dga' grags/ slob dpon bkra shis dpal/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ kham pa rdo rje dpal/ bla ma kīrti shrī/ kun mkhyen gangs pa/ ma ti paṇa chen/ 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros/ des bdag la'o// yang kha che lugs ni/ paṇa chen shākya shrī/ kha che paṇ+ḍi ta ga ga dha ra/ paṇ+ḍi ta bi na shrī/

de la go pe la'i pho brang du kham pa rdo rje dpal gyis zhus/ de las bla ma kīrti shrī/ spang sgang ba grags pa dpal/ sa bzang paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// kha reg gnyos lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ 'jam dpal grags/ dpal bde ba'i rdo rje/ rnal 'byor pa yi ge pa rat+na badz+ra/ kha che dz+nyā na shrī/ pa liṃ ā tsar+ya/ gnyos lots+tsha ba/ sras badz+ra gu ru/ dbon po gnyos kīrti shrī/ gnyos lha nang pa/ rin po che do pa/ mdo stod gser ma klas pa rdo rje tshul/ g.yas ru pa rngog ston rin chen rgyal mtshan/ bla ma kīrti shrī bha dra/ kun mkhyen gangs pa/ sa bzang ma ti/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// gsang 'dus gnyis med rnam rgyal gyi dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ klu sgrub/ ma tang gi pa/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ mar pa/ mtshur ston dbang nge*/ rgya pho ba lung pa/ snye mdo ba bsod nams dpal/ gnyal pa chos grags/ bya rin chen 'od/ blo chen sangs rgyas sras/ bag ston gzhon tshul/ bla ma tshul rgyal/ bla ma ngag dbang grags pa/ mkhas btsun byang seng*/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// gshin rje'i gshed dgra nag rwa lugs kyi dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ pra dz+nyā rak+ṣi ta/ meñdza gling pa thugs rje chen po/ rwa rdo rje grags/ rwa chos rab/ rwa ye shes seng ge rwa 'bum seng*/ rje btsun rgwa lo/ rong pa sher seng*/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston/ mkhan chen rin chen rnam rgyal/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// gdong drug rwa lugs kyi dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ nag po pa/ bha da pa/ dharma pa/ de wa pa/ dze tā ri/ a naṃ ga badz+ra/ dharmā ka ra ma ti/ bal po thugs rje chen po man chad dgra nag dang 'dra/ rdo rje 'jigs byed ro langs brgyad skor gyi brgyud pa ni/

rdo rje 'chang*/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ la li ta badz+ra/ a mo gha badz+ra/ ye shes 'byung gnas sbas pa'i dpal/ pad+ma badz+ra/ dī paṃ ka ra/ lots+tsha ba rdo rje grags/ rwa chos rab/ rwa ye shes seng ge rwa 'bum seng*/ rje btsun rgwa lo/ rong pa sher seng*/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge rin po che bu ston/ mkhan chen rin chen rnam rgyal/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// yang na/ dpal seng gi tshab tu rong pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan bcug kyang 'dra'o// nag po skor gsum gyi dbang gi brgyud pa gzhan ni/ rong pa rgwa lo yan sngar bzhin las/ de nas 'o yug ba dpal gyi rgyal mtshan/ bla ma klog skya grags chen/ spang sgang pa grags pa dpal/ ma ti paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma'i dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'jigs byed/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ la li ti badz+ra/ a mo gha badz+ra/ ye shes 'byung gnas sbas pa/ pad+ma badz+ra/ dī paṃ ka ra/ rak+ṣi ta/ rwa lots+tsha ba rdo rje grags/ rwa lots+tsha ba chos rab/ rwa ye shes seng ge rwa 'bum seng*/ rong pa rgwa lo/ rong pa sher seng*/ nyang stod 'phags pa/ bla ma grags chen/ kun mkhyen gangs pa/ ma ti paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// 'jigs byed lha bzhi bcu zhe dgu ma'i dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ la li ta badz+ra/ 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ a mo gha badz+ra che ba/ a mo gha chung ba/ skyo 'od 'byung*/ skyo sku mched/ jo sras kham pa/ gnyan rin chen brtan/ de'i sras gnyan 'od srungs/ gnyan chos rgyal/ 'dzim pa rin she/ 'jam dbyangs gzhi thog pa/ bla ma la ru pa/ bla ma klog skya pa/ spang sgang pa grags pa dpal/ ma te paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// 'jigs byed gnod sbyin mo brgyad skor gyi brgyud pa ni/ 'dzim pa rin she yan lha bzhi bcu zhe dgu ma dang 'dra ba las/ de nas 'dzim pa yon tan rgya mtsho/ bla ma klog skya grags chen/

spang sgang pa grags pa dpal/ ma ti paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rdzogs rim mtshan ma gyen 'greng*/ rwa la sems bzung ba/ mtshan mo rgyu ba ste gsum gyi brgyud pa ni/ 'dzim pa rin she yan 'jigs byed zhe dgu ma dang 'dra ba las/ de nas e pa 'khon ston/ gzhi thog 'jam dbyangs/ bla ma cha gan/ klog skya grags chen/ kun mkhyen gangs pa/ ma ti paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// gshed dmar lha lnga ma chag lugs kyi dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ bir+wa pa/ ḍom+bhi he ru ka bir ṭi pa/ gam+bi ra ma ti/ ni ska laṅka de wa/ rwa wen+d+ra/ chag chos rje dpal/ g.yung phug pa rgyal mtshan dge ba/ shong lots+tsha ba blo brtan/ lots+tsha ba mchog ldan/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge kun spangs chos grags/ ma ti paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// yang na/ chag lo/ shangs pa tshul she dpal gyi rgyal mtshan/ klog skya pa/ spang sgang pa/ ma ti paṇa chen man 'dra/ yang na/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge bu ston rin po che/ mkhan chen rin chen rnam rgyal/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// dpyal lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ ni ska laṅka nas/ dpyal lots+tsha ba chos bzang*/ rje btsun rgwa lo/ rong pa sher seng*/ kun mkhyen 'phags 'od/ bu ston rin po che man 'dra/ dā na shī la'i lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ bir+wa pa/ nag po pa/ sa li pa/ shī la tsan+d+ra/ dā na shī la/ 'jam gsar/ rgwa lo/ shes rab seng ge dpal ldan seng ge bu ston rin po che man 'dra/ yang na/ ni ska laṅka/ dā na shī la/ 'jam dbyangs gsar ma/ rgwa lo/ sher seng*/ kun mkhyen 'phags 'od/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa man 'dra/ yang na/ rong pa rgwa lo/ dpal gyi rgyal mtshan/ klog skya pa/ spang sgang pa/ ma ti paṇa chen man 'dra/ yang na/ rong pa rgwa lo/ ze dmar ba/ dpal ldan seng ge kun spangs chos grags/ ma ti paṇa chen man 'dra/ gshed dmar dā na shī la'i lugs lha bcu gsum ma'i dbang gi brgyud pa ni/

bcom ldan 'das gshin rje'i gshed/ bram ze dpal 'dzin/ a nu/ ma rak+ṣi ta/ rat+na ā ka ra shān+ti/ dharmā ka ra shān+ti/ nā ya ka pa/ bi khyā ta de wa/ shākya shrī bha dra/ dā na shī la/ g.yag sde lots+tsha ba/ grub chen ze dmar ba/ thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston/ lots+tsha ba rin chen rnam rgyal/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// yang na/ gshin rje'i gshed/ bram ze dpal 'dzin/ ma ti pa/ dar paṇa ā tsar+ya/ glo bo lots+tsha ba shes rab rin chen/ sprul sku sa pa/ lots+tsha ba mchog ldan/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston/ lots+tsha ba rin chen rnam rgyal/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// yang na/ gshin rje gshed/ chag lugs/ dpal 'dzin/ bī ra ḍi pa/ ma ti pa/ ni ska laṅka de wa/ re wen+d+ra/ chag chos rje dpal/ g.yung phug pa/ shong ston blo gros brtan pa/ lots+tsha ba mchog ldan man 'dra/ yang na/ g.yag sde lots+tsha ba/ rgwa lo/ sher seng*/ skyi ston grags rgyal/ kun mkhyen chen po/ ma ti paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ de las bdag gis gshin rje'i gshed dmar nag thams cad kyi sgrub thabs/ dbang chog bdag 'jug rnams bla mas phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa'i lung thos so// yang dgra nag zhang lugs kyi dbang bskur ba dang*/ drag po'i dbang thob nas dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dang*/ mchod rten gyi cho ga la li ta badz+ras mdzad pa/ dgra nag gi rdzogs rim rim bzhi'i bye brag de wa ā ka ra tsan+d+ras mdzad pa/ bstan pa/ srung ba'i 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs mar me mdzad kyis mdzad pa/ tshigs su bcad pa sum cu pa ā tsar+ya sid+dhār+tha dang shes rab bla mas bsgyur ba/ thig gi cho ga nyi shu pa shes rab bla mas mdzad pa/ spros pa'i sdom rin po che'i phreng ba/ gcen rdo rje rtse mos mdzad pa rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ 'jam dpal/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad/ la li ta badz+ra/ sau su ra pa/ she na pa/ a wa li na pa/ gu ṇa pa bha dra/ wā gī shwa ra/ kīrti de wa/ ā ka ra tsan+da/

a mo gha badz+ra/ pradz+nyā gu ru/ saṃ gha bha dra/ rin po che gcen/ gcung*/ dpal gti mug rnam par dag pa'i rdo rje/ dpal rdo rje gsang ba'i ye shes/ rje bsam gtan gling pa/ kun mkhyen 'dzim pa rin she/ bla ma shar pa kun dga' seng ge chos rje 'dzim pa rgyal mtshan dpal/ kun spangs chos grags/ ma ti paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// yang gshin rje'i gshed dmar lha lnga'i sgrub thabs/ dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs/ gtor ma'i cho ga gshin rje mthar byed kyi 'khrul 'khor gyi cho ga 'khrul 'khor gyi phreng ba rnams/ bir+wa pas mdzad pa/ gshed dmar sgrub thabs blo bzang snying pos mdzad pa/ rnam snang srung bas mdzad pa/ rang byin gyis brlab pa'i man ngag blo gros bzang pos mdzad pa/ gshin rje gshed dmar po'i 'khrul 'khor gyi de nyid nges par bshad pa'i sgrub thabs slob dpon byang chub snying pos mdzad pa/ las tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i de kho na nyid gsal bar byed pa dā na shī las mdzad pa dang*/ lha bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs/ maṇ+ḍal gyi cho ga dmar nag thun mong pa'i mchod chog gtor ma'i cho ga dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga me lha'i mchod pa rnams slob dpon dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa ste/ lung de rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge yan btsal dgos/ de nas kun spangs chos grags/ ma ti paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// phyag na rdo rje 'khor lo chen po'i dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ phyag na rdo rje/ mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can/ sa wa ri pa/ dza wa ri pa/ bal po'i paṇ+ḍi ta de wa pu ṇ+ya ma ti/ lots+tsha ba 'gar chos kyi bzang po/ gshen ston rin chen dngos grub/ dmar chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ shes rab rdo rje/ thub pa shes rab/ brtson 'grus rdo rje/ dmar chos gyi rgyal po/ gan chag pa dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/ chos rje 'dzin pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ ma ti paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ de las bdag gis sgrub thabs dang*/

dkyil chog bsod nams dbang phyug gis mdzad pa'i lung yang thob/ gnyis pa shes rab kyi rgyud la/ slob dpon nag po pa'i lugs kyi kye'i rdo rje dkyil 'khor bzhir dbang bskur ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ bdag med ma/ slob dpon nag po dam tshig rdo rje/ bram ze nag po pa/ 'gos khug pa lhas btsas/ mnga' ris pa gsal ba'i snying po/ 'khon sgyi chu ba/ rje sa skya pa chen po/ rje btsun bsod nams rtse mo/ bla ma rje btsun/ dkar shākya grags/ bde lung pa kun bzang dpal/ bla ma dar ma ye shes/ bag ston gzhon tshul/ bla ma tshul rgyal/ bla ma dpal ldan don grub/ bla ma 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// sgrub thabs de kho na nyid gsal ba/ dkyil chog nag po gzhung 'grel rnams kyi lung yang thos so// sam+bu ṭa nas gsungs pa'i dpal kye'i rdo rje lha bcu bdun ma'i dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ bdag med ma/ bir+wa pa/ ḍom+bi he ru ka a la la badz+ra/ nags khrod pa/ gar+bha ri pa/ dza ya shrī dz+nyā na/ mi thub zla ba/ dpa' bo rdo rje/ 'brog mi lots+tsha ba/ bla ma dkon mchog rgyal po/ rje sa chen/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ khang 'od zer rgyal mtshan/ bla ma gzhon nu seng ge gnyal pa bde legs dpal/ bla ma dpal ldan don grub/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// sgrub thabs bla mas mdzad pa'i lung thos shing*/ dkyil chog bzang po yongs bzung gi steng nas mdzad do// sam+bu ṭa rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor du/ dbang bskur ba thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ bdag med ma/ bir+wa pa/ ḍom+bi he ru ka a la la badz+ra/ dpal ldan nags khrod pa/ gar+bha ri pa/ bsod snyoms pa rgyal ba dpal/ mi thub zla ba/ dge slong dpa' bo rdo rje/ bla chen 'brog mi/ mnga' ris pa gsal ba'i snying po/ sgyi chu ba dgra lha 'bar/ sa skya pa chen po/ rje btsun chen po/ chos rje pa/ tshogs sgom pa/ gnyags snying po rgyal mtshan/

zhang bkra shis dpal/ spang sgang pa grags pa dpal/ paṇa chen ma ti/ bla ma 'phags pa/ des bdag la gnang ba'o// gur rigs bsdus rngog lugs kyi dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje snying po/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ klu sgrub/ ma tang gi pa/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ mar pa lho brag pa/ rngog chos kyi rdo rje/ sras mdo sde/ ram klu gong pa/ gror bsam phug pa/ mnga' ris kyi ston pa dkon mchog 'bar/ rgya mkhar ngo mar gyi mkhan po 'phags skyabs/ rgyang ro gser sdings kyi grub thob ston gzhon/ ma ngag dge sdings kyi slob dpon chos 'od/ bla ma sangs rgyas 'bum/ lo mchog mkhas mchog kun mkhyen chen po/ byang seng ba/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// yang na/ mchog ldan/ bag ston/ bla ma tshul rgyal/ bla ma ngag dbang*/ byang seng ba man 'dra'o// bde mchog 'khrul spong gi dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ a bha yā ka ra/ shu bhā ka ra gup+ta/ ā nan+dā ka ra gup+ta/ rat+na rak+ṣi ta/ zhang lots+tsha ba grub pa dpal bzang po/ nye po chos ldan/ bla ma gzhon nu dpal/ bla ma gzhon nu tshul/ glo bo lots+tsha ba/ mkhan po lots+tsha ba/ ma ṇi ka shrī dz+nyā na/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// slob dpon a bha yās mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs 'khrul spong yang thos shing*/ dkyil chog rdo rje phreng ba ltar mdzad do// bde mchog rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ rat+na shrī/ ka l+yā ṇa shān+ti/ ma ti/ wa ni te bha dra/ bhu mi shrī/ bi ma la shrī/ shong blo brtan/ lots+tsha ba mchog ldan/ bde ba can pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ g.yung ston rdo rje dpal/ mkhan chen sher rdor ba/ de gnyis ka las/ rin po che grags tshul ba/ mkhas btsun byang seng pa/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sgrub thabs/ byang chub kyi sems kun tu gzigs pa'i phreng ba/ slob dpon ka la kalpas mdzad pa'i brgyud pa ni/

bla ma gze ba chos dpal bzang po/ rin po che grags tshul ba man dbang dang 'dra/ dpal bde mchog gi dang po'i dbang bskur ba'i rgyud dang*/ cho ga sna tshogs las btus pa mnyes pa'i snying po zhes bya ba/ slob dpon dpa' bo rdo rjes mdzad pa thos/ bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ spyan ras gzigs/ byang sems blo gros rin chen/ sha wa ri/ mai tri gup+ta/ rgya gar phyag na/ ka ma la badz+ra/ dza ya se na/ sum pa lots+tsha ba dar ma yon tan/ rje btsun grags rgyal/ sa skya paṇa chen/ rin po che skyob pa dpal/ rgyal tsha chos dbang*/ lots+tsha ba mchog ldan/ bag ston gzhon tshul/ bla ma tshul rgyal/ bla ma ngag dbang*/ bla ma byang seng ba/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// yang na/ rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag na rdo rje/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ rdo rje gdan pa/ dha byang sems/ a bha ya rak+ṣi ta/ dza ya se na/ sum pa lots+tsha ba dar ma yon tan/ mkhas pa sam+bu ṭa/ seng ge rgyal mtshan/ grags pa dpal rdo rje/ yang na/ sum pa lots+tsha ba/ rgya thams cad mkhyen pa/ srin po ri pa/ sgrad ston rdo rje dpal/ mtshur phu ba tshul rin/ rang byung rdo rje/ snye mdo ba kun dga' don grub/ bsod nams 'od zer/ bag ston gzhon tshul man 'dra/ sgrub thabs/ dkyil chog gtor chog sbyin sreg rnams/ dza ya se nas mdzad pa thos/ bde mchog sdom 'byung lha bcu gsum pa'i dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ lo hi pa/ dha ri ka pa/ rdo rje dril bu pa/ rus sbal zhabs/ dza lan+dha ri pa/ dpe med dpal/ rin chen 'byung gnas sbas pa/ a bha yā ka ra/ dge ba'i 'byung gnas/ legs spyod zhabs/ rat+na rak+ṣi ta/ chag lots+tsha ba/ go lung ba mdo sde dpal/ g.yung phug pa rgyal mtshan dpal/ shong lo/ lo mchog dpal ldan seng ge bu ston rin po che/ lots+tsha ba rin chen rnam rgyal/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// yang na/ lo mchog 'jam skya/ dpal seng ngo*// yang na/

lots+tsha ba shong blo brtan/ lots+tsha ba mchog ldan/ bla ma sangs rgyas sras/ bde ba can pa bla ma ye shes mgon/ bde ba can pa bla ma dar bzang*/ de nyid las bla ma grags chen la/ kun mkhyen gangs pa/ paṇa chen ma ti/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// sgrub thabs rat+na rak+ṣi tas mdzad pa thos/ bde mchog dkar po'i byin rlabs dang man ngag gi brgyud pa ni/ 'khor lo bde mchog paṇa chen shākya shrī/ sa skya paṇa chen/ g.yag sde lots+tsha ba/ yang na/ paṇa chen dpyal chos bzang*/ jo gdan rdo rje dpal/ g.yag sde lots+tsha ba/ mnga' ris pa sangs rgyas ye shes/ rin po che bsod nams grags pa/ rin po che grags tshul ba'o// yang rin po che bsod rnams grags pa/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen sher rdor/ de gnyis ka las rin po che grags tshul ba/ mkhas btsun byang chub seng ge sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// bde mchog yab kyi go cha drug dang*/ yum gyi cho ga drug gi byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ni/ sha ba ri/ mai tri pa/ rgya gar phyag na/ mar pa do ba/ gze pa blo ldan/ don ye chos blo/ rdor rgyal/ byang chen pa/ bde ba can pa/ bla ma seng ge rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen sher rdor ba/ bla ma nor bu dpal bzang po/ bla ma 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros/ des bdag la'o// ka na ka shrīs mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs gnyis kyang thos/ phag mo rin chen rgyan 'dra'i byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ ye shes mkha' 'gro/ jo bo rje/ lha byang chub 'od/ 'am pa lcags ri ba/ rgya lcags ri ba/ rdzing phu ba/ thang ston/ klog skya chen po/ zhing chen pa grags pa dpal/ bde gshegs dpal/ bla ma sgom ye/ bla ma grags chen/ bla ma 'phags 'od/ thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston/ rin po che grags tshul ba/ yang jo bo rje yan sngar bzhin la/ des rgya lcags ri gong kha ba/ dgas po rin po che bsod nams rin chen/ gyer sgom ye shes rdo rje/ glan sgom ras pa/ khu ston shes rab grub/

'ba' ston gzi brjid/ g.yung ston rdo rje dpal/ rin po che grags tshul/ mkhas btsun byang seng*/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// rgya gzhung sgrub thabs/ byin rlabs kyi yi ge gzhon nu ma'i mchod pa/ gtor chog tshogs/ bstod pa rnams thob/ mkha' spyod ma dkar mo'i byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ jo bo rje/ rong pa 'gar dge 'u grags pa/ skyer sgang pa/ yang na/ khyung po rnal 'byor/ rmog cog pa/ skyer sgang pa/ dar ma ye shes/ gnyan ston/ sangs rgyas ston pa/ shang ston tshul khrims 'bum/ 'jag pa rgyal mtshan 'bum/ de gnyis ka las/ khyung po tshul khrims mgon/ rin po che grags tshul ba/ mkhan chen byang seng ba/ 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros/ des bdag la'o// sgrub thabs/ ril bu sgrub pa/ dam tshig gso ba/ gtor ma/ 'pho ba/ jo bo rjes mdzad pa'i gzhung chung rnams thos/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor rigs bsdus lha brgya dang bdun gyi dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ kun tu bzang po/ rgyal ba rigs lnga/ phyag na rdo rje/ lits+tsha byi dri ma med pa/ rgyal po ja/ u pa rā dza/ ku ku rā dza/ mu da ta/ nyi zla rdo rje/ bā hu ta/ mus to ba hu ta/ kuk+ko ta/ bi ma la mi tra/ ā tsar+ya rin chen mchog gye re phyogs skyong*/ tsug ru rin gzhon/ mgo bo tshul byang*/ cog ro rgyal ba'i yon tan/ las gsum gzhon nu mchog rdo rje 'jam dpal/ de gsum ka las byang chub 'od/ blo gros rgyal mtshan/ rong ban rin chen tshul khrims/ ldong ston chos bzang*/ ya shud blo chung*/ mgo zla ba 'bar/ mgo zla 'bum grags/ mgo dngos grub rgyal mtshan/ mgo chos rdor/ mgo dngos grub mgon/ dbus pa sangs rgyas 'bum/ yang bi ma la mi tra/ rin chen mchog ku mā ra/ de gnyis ka las khyung po dbyig 'od/ cog ro rgyal 'bum/ dam pa/ khu dro dpal gzhon/ de gsum ka las cog ro rgyal ba'i yon tan/ de bzhi las yon tan bzang po/ cog ro byang chub 'byung gnas/

za rigs 'phags pa/ rmugs byang snying*/ dmar sgom chen yon tshul/ lce bsod bzang*/ de gnyis ka las 'gar ston tshul bzang*/ de nas ya shud blo bzang man chad sngar bzhin no// dbus pa sangs rgyas 'bum la/ gser sdings pa chos 'od/ grum bskyod rdo rje/ mkhan po bsod nams 'phel/ bag ston tshul rgyal/ ngag dbang ye shes mgon/ bla ma dam pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ 'khon shes rab rdo rje/ yang lugs gcig la/ gru mi bskyod rdo rje/ byang chen pa/ lots+tsha ba mchog ldan/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge 'khon mkhas btsun/ mkhas btsun byang chub seng ge bla ma 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// mnyam sbyor rdo rje sems dpa'i dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag na rdo rje/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ spyod mdzad chos kyi rdo rje/ 'gro bzang snying po/ kha che rin chen rdo rje/ te dza de wa/ zangs dkar lots+tsha ba/ gnyan tshul khrims 'bar/ mgos mi sa bzang*/ gzhon nu seng ge dbang phyug rin chen/ shākya rdo rje/ chos grags/ sangs rgyas 'bum/ lots+tsha ba mchog ldan/ bag ston pa/ bla ma tshul rgyal/ ngag gi dbang phyug mkhas btsun byang seng*/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// kha che rin chen rdo rjes mdzad pa'i dkyil chog kyang thos/ rdo rje gdan bzhi'i yab bka' dang yum bka'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ klu sgrub/ ār+ya de wa/ rnal 'byor pa rus phreng can/ bal po spyi ther ba/ mar lo/ rngog chos rdor/ rngog mdo sde/ rtsag dharma rā dza/ rtsag gu h+ya sing ha/ rgya rin chen 'bum/ rgya bsod nams 'bum/ bya rin chen 'od/ blo chen bag ston/ yang ār+ya de wa/ tai lo/ nā ro/ mar pa/ rngog chos rdor/ gnyal pa rngog ston/ rngog chos tshul/ rngo kun rdor/ rngog gzi brjid/ kham pa kun rin/ mchog ldan/ blo chen/ bag ston/ bla ma tshul rgyal/ bla ma ngag dbang*/ gnyags ston byang seng*/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// blo chen gyis mdzad pa'i sgrub dkyil yang thos/

gdan bzhi'i dkyil 'khor rgyas pa'i dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ kri ya sa muts+tsha dang mthun gsung zhing*/ sgrub thabs dza gad ā nan+d+ra dzi bas mdzad pa thos/ dbang chog kri ya ltar mdzad do// ma hā mā yā lha lnga'i dbang*/ jo bo lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag na rdo rje/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ ku ku ri pa/ nā ro pa/ shān+ti pa/ jo bo rje/ rong pa 'gar dge klog skya ston pa/ steng pa thur gsal/ 'phar lung ba rgyal sras/ skyar po nyi she/ 'da' tsha dar rgyal/ 'da' tsha grags she/ spen phug pa bsod nams mdzes/ grags chen pa/ 'phags bod/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston/ mkhan chen rin chen rnam rgyal/ 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros/ des bdag la'o// yang rngog lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ slob dpon ku ku ri pa/ mtsho skyes rdo rje/ ḍom+bi pa/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta zhi ba bzang po/ mar pa lho brag pa/ rngog gzhung pa chos rdor/ sras jo sras mdo sde/ rngog chos sku/ rngog tsha dkon mchog dpal/ klog skya dbang phyug grags/ ldong ston shes rab dpal/ 'gro mgon 'phags pa/ mkhan po gzhon nu 'bum/ bla ma kīrti shrī/ kun mkhyen gangs pa/ paṇa chen ma ti/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// yang na/ 'phags pa/ khro phu rin po che/ 'jam skya/ dpal ldan seng ge bu ston rin po che/ rin chen rnam rgyal/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// yang na/ rngog chos rdor/ spa sba ba can/ rngog zhe sdang rdo rje/ gtsang lha steng pa/ lce jo mdo/ chos 'od/ 'phags 'od/ bu ston rin po che/ mkhan chen rin chen rnam rgyal/ 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros/ des bdag la'o// sangs rgyas thod pa lha nyer lnga ma'i dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ ye shes mkha' 'gro/ byang sems blo gros rin chen/ sa ra ha/ klu sgrub/ sha ba ri/ mai tri pa/ mar pa lots+tsha ba/ rgya rnal 'byor pa/ ro mnyam rdo rje/ yon tan grags/

kham pa shākya rdo rje/ gnyal pa chos grags/ mkhan chen rgan mo lhas pa/ bsod nams 'phel/ bag ston man 'dra/ yang na/ rgan lhas pa/ bla ma ye shes rin chen/ 'jam dbyangs chen po/ rgya ston thams cad mkhyen pa/ bag ston gzhon tshul/ g.yung ston rdo rje dpal/ rin po che grags tshul/ chos rje byang seng ba/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// yang lugs gcig la/ bla ma ye shes rin chen/ bla ma smon lam mgon/ zhu ston pa/ dmar byang chen pa/ bag ston gzhon tshul/ g.yung ston pa/ mkhan chen grags tshul ba/ chos rje byang seng pa/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// dpal sangs rgyas thod pa lha dgu ma'i dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ phyag na rdo rje/ sa ra ha/ klu sgrub/ ār+ya de wa/ nag po zhabs/ de wa ā ka ra tsan+d+ra/ a mo gha badz+ra/ mar pa lots+tsha ba/ mtshur dbang gi rdo rje/ mgon gad pa kīrti/ yar lung gi snyeg dmar po/ mgos ri khrod dbang phyug bal po dbang mgon/ rin chen bzang po/ gan pa rin chen rgyal mtshan/ kun bsod pa/ bag ston gzhon tshul/ g.yung ston rdo rje dpal/ mkhan chen grags tshul ba/ chos rje byang seng ba/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// mi g.yo ba bla med lha dgu ma dang lha bcu gsum ma'i dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das mi g.yo ba/ be dza ya rak+ṣi ta/ rgya gar shar phyogs na len+d+ra'i gnas brtan rā hu la/ rā hu la gnyis pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta rat+na shrī/ lots+tsha ba grags pa rgyal mtshan/ rong pa shes rab seng ge de gnyis ka las bag ston gzhon nu tshul khrims/ bla ma tshul rgyal/ ngag dbang pa/ mkhas btsun byang seng*/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// sgrub dkyil blo chen gyis mdzad pa thos/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug pad+ma drwa ba'i dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ slob dpon pad+ma badz+ra/ paṇ+ḍi ta bi ma la shrī/ bi bha wa bhi ma shrī/ su ma na shrī/ rat+na ā ka ra/

shrī a ma ra bha dra/ pha la shrī/ su ma na shrī/ lots+tsha ba bu ston kha che/ lots+tsha ba rin chen rnam rgyal/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// sgrub thabs rin po che bu ston pas mdzad pa dang*/ dkyil chog rin rnam pas mdzad pa rnams thos/ sgrol ma lha bcu bdun ma'i dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ mchims nam mkha' grags yan gzhan dang 'dra ba las/ de nas 'phags pa rin po che/ dus 'khor ba ye shes rin chen/ bla ma kun dga' seng ge 'dzim pa rgyal mtshan dpal/ spang sgang pa grags pa dpal/ ma ti paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// sgrol ma lus dkyil gyi dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa rin po che yan gzhan dang 'dra/ de nas bla ma khang ston/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ de gnyis ka'i las bag ston gzhon tshul/ bla ma tshul rgyal/ bla ma ngag dbang*/ mkhan chen byang chub seng ge rin po che sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// mchog gi sgrol ma'i dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ klu sgrub/ nag po pa/ wa gu paṇ+ḍi ta/ dā na shī la/ khang rnal 'byor pa/ mkhan chen gzhon dbang*/ dge slong bsam 'grub/ lots+tsha ba mchog ldan/ skyi ston grags rgyal/ kun mkhyen chen po/ byang seng ba/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// sgrub thabs rnying pa dang*/ dkyil chog dga' ldan pas mdzad pa thos/ gur mgon lha bcu bdun ma'i dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ bram ze mchog sred/ bde ba'i rdo rje/ shrad+dha ka ra/ rin chen bzang po/ dge tshul pūr+ṇa/ lcags ri gong kha ba/ rdzing phu kha ba/ spen phug pa/ zhang ye/ gze ba don grub/ bar thang pa yab sras/ dar shag pur ston bsod dbang*/ mchog ldan/ skyi ston pa/ kun mkhyen chen po/ byang chub seng ge sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// sgrub thabs dang dkyil chog bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa thos/ khro bo reg tshig gi dbang dang*/ reg tshig gi dam tshig gsang ba'i sgrub thabs/ reg tshig gi sgrub thabs/ dkyil chog reg tshig 'bigs ma'i sgrub thabs/

sngags bzlog nag po'i man ngag rnams ār+ya de was mdzad pa/ bsgom khog las byung ba ri pas mdzad pa/ bha ya na'i phyir bzlog lo rgyus phran tshegs 'ga' zhig gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ klu sgrub/ ār+ya de wa/ rat+na saṃ gī ti/ bud+dha saṃ gī ti/ ba ri lots+tsha ba/ pad+ma laṃ ki ti/ dge bshes dbus pa/ mnga' ris khyab ston/ jo bo stag bzang*/ nag tsho rig 'dzin grags/ bu sgang pa/ nag tsho sher rgyal/ gron gyi slob dpon 'brog ston/ gcung pa bsod dbang*/ lha rje pak+shi chos rgyal/ bsod nams 'od zer/ bag ston/ bla ma tshul rgyal/ ngag dbang*/ gnyan ston byang chub seng ge sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// gsum pa gnyis med rgyud la/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ dang po'i sangs rgyas/ chos sku rdo rje 'chang chen/ longs sku dus kyi 'khor lo/ sprul sku shākya thub pa/ chos rgyal sum cu rtsa lnga/ grub chen dus zhabs pa chen po/ dus zhabs pa gnyis pa/ rgyal sras na len+d+ra pa/ kha che zla ba mgon po/ 'bro ston lots+tsha ba/ bla ma lha rje sgom pa/ bla ma sgro ston gnam la brtsegs/ grub thob yu mo/ sras dharme shwa ra/ mkhas pa nam mkha' 'od zer/ bla ma grub thob se chen/ chos rje 'jam dbyangs gsar ma/ kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer/ kun spangs kun tu bzang po/ dpal ldan byang sems rgyal ba ye shes/ mkhas btsun yon tan rgya mtsho/ ma ti paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// yang na/ mkhas btsun pa/ kun mkhyen chen po/ ma ti paṇa chen no// yang na/ kun mkhyen chen po/ phyogs las rnam rgyal/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// dus 'khor nas gsungs pa'i 'khor lo sdom chen gyi dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje sems dpa'/ 'chi med 'tsho/ gnyis med dpal 'dzin/ chos kyi 'byung gnas/ bik+ṣa ti/ shākya shrī/ kaṣ+mi ra/ bhū mi shrī/ shā shwa ta/ a pa ra/ karmi ta/ blo ston lots+tsha ba/ bla ma chos 'dzin/ bla ma ngag dbang*/

mkhan chen byang chub seng ge sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// gnyis pa rnal 'byor rgyud la/ chos kyi dbyings gsung gi dbang phyug gi dkyil 'khor chen po'i dbang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ 'jam dpal/ dz+nyā na pa/ 'jam dpal grags pa/ dpal sbas bzang po/ bram ze ye shes rdo rje/ shes rab 'byung gnas sbas pa'i dpal/ bram ze bzhad pa'i rdo rje/ pad+ma ka ra/ shrad+dhā ka ra/ de gnyis ka la lo chen/ lo chung*/ rngog dge ser ba/ rgyang po dar ma grags/ khri ston kun dga' 'od/ mkhan po chos rin/ bla ma chos 'od pa/ bla ma 'phags 'od pa/ chos rje bu ston pa/ mkhan chen rin chen rnam rgyal/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// dkyil chog mkhas pa'i dga' ston thos/ sbyong rgyud nas 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis kyi dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ phyag na rdo rje/ rgyal po rab gsal zla ba/ bram ze dzi na mi tra/ swa ti pha la/ sgra gcan 'dzin/ pradz+nyā wa li ta/ ye shes rdo rje/ pra ha ni/ kun dga' snying po/ rab 'byor skyong*/ kha che paṇa chen/ rin chen bzang po/ gnyal pa nyi she/ gnur nyi ma/ gshen rdo rje seng ge rgya gsar ba/ 'bro 'dzi ti ba/ snye mdo ba bsod nams dpal/ gnyal pa chos grags/ bya rin chen 'od/ bla ma blo chen/ bla ma mchog ldan/ bla ma bsod dbang*/ kun mkhyen seng ge 'bum/ paṇa chen ma ti/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// dkyil chog blo chen gyis mdzad pa thos/ gsum pa spyod rgyud la/ rnam snang mngon byang gi dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ 'jam dpal/ dze tā ri/ a sho ka shrī/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ don yod rdo rje/ ba ri lots+tsha ba/ mchims brtson seng*/ mchims don ne/ mchims chos seng*/ mchims blo brtan/ mchims nam mkha' grags/ slob dpon dar ma rgyal mtshan/ byang chen pa bsod nams 'phel/ lots+tsha ba mchog ldan/ bla ma dpal ldan pa/ lots+tsha ba bu ston/ mkhas btsun byang chub seng ge sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// dkyil chog bu ston rin po ches mdzad pa thos/

bzhi pa bya ba'i rgyud la rigs gsum spyi'i dkyil 'khor du dbang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ kha che ye shes rdo rje/ lo chung grags 'byor shes rab/ sa skya pa chen po/ rje btsun pa/ sa skya paṇa chen/ de gnyis ka las do pa dkar ston shākya grags/ bde lung pa kun bzang dpal/ gung pa dar ma ye shes/ bag ston gzhon tshul/ bla ma tshul rgyal/ bla ma ngag dbang*/ gnyags ston byang chub seng ge sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// gtsug tor gdugs dkar can lha zhe gcig ma'i dbang bskur khyad par gyi rjes gnang dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ gtsug tor dkar mo/ tsan+d+ra go mi/ gi ra wa ti/ badz+ra dak+ṣi/ shu rang ga bha dra/ sangs rgyas gsang ba/ kha che paṇ+ḍi ta dkar po/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po/ sa chen/ rtse mo'i zhabs/ rje btsun pa/ chos rje pa/ rig 'dzin grags/ bla ma shes 'byung*/ bla ma ye/ slob dpon rin ye/ zhang ye/ dkon tshul/ bla ma gzhon tshul/ bla ma tshul rgyal ba/ bla ma ngag dbang pa/ mkhas btsun byang seng ba/ sa bzang 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros/ des bdag la gnang ba'o// yang na/ sangs rgyas/ phyag na rdo rje/ mkha' 'gro ma bde ba sbyin/ rat+na badz+ra/ bram ze sadz+dza na/ sras man dza na pā la/ gnyal pa ston pa ye shes dbang phyug dge bsrungs/ gdong sngon pa/ spru ston 'bar thog pho rog dar ma mdo sde/ thod pa jo 'bur/ jo ldan dbang rin/ shākya rdo rje/ ston pa dar shag bsod dbang*/ lots+tsha ba mchog ldan/ bla ma gzhon tshul/ bla ma tshul rgyal/ bla ma ngag dbang*/ mkhas btsun byang seng*/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// sgrub thabs gi ri wa tis mdzad pa/ dkyil chog pad+ma lcags kyus mdzad pa thos/ bcu gcig zhal lha so bdun ma'i dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ spyan ras gzigs/ dpal ldan a ti sha des lha btsun pa byang chub 'od/ 'brom ston pa/ rnal 'byor pa shes rab rdo rje gsum la gnang ba las/ 'dir 'brom ston pa/ spyan snga rin po che/ bya yul ba/

mus sman pa/ dpal ldan gro chen po/ stag ston shes rab 'od zer/ dmar ston/ bsod nams 'phel/ slob dpon grags 'bum/ don zhags pa sangs rgyas rin chen/ mkhan chen grags pa tshul khrims/ mkhan chen rgyal bzang*/ mkhas btsun byang chub seng ge sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// sgrub thabs klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa dang*/ dkyil chog grags tshul pas mdzad pa thos/ mi 'khrugs pa lha bcu gsum ma'i dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ kha che ye shes rdo rje/ lo chung grags 'byor shes rab/ sa chen/ rje btsun pa/ chos rje pa/ bla ma dus 'khor ba chen po/ bde ba can pa ye shes mgon/ bla ma seng ge rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ lots+tsha ba ma ṇi ka shrī dz+nyā na/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// yang na/ rje btsun pa/ nub pa rig 'dzin grags/ bo dong ra lung pa/ bla ma lung phu pa/ nam mkha' bsod nams/ nub gog pa/ dge bshes dar gzhon/ ston pa don yod/ slob dpon rin rgyal/ bla ma grags chen pa/ kun mkhyen 'phags 'od/ bu ston rin po che/ mkhan chen sher rdor man 'dra/ dkyil chog nam mkha' bsod nams kyis mdzad pa thos/ mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu ma'i dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ 'jam dpal/ ye shes snying po/ ye shes zhi ba/ sangs rgyas zhi ba/ sangs rgyas gsang ba/ ku su lu che ba/ chung ba/ gser gling pa/ jo bo rje/ go mi sgom chen/ skyi nor dz+nyā na/ gnyags ldom bu ba/ spug thams cad mkhyen pa/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ bya rin chen 'od/ blo chen/ bde ba can pa/ bla ma seng ge rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ lots+tsha ba ma ṇi ka shrī dz+nyā na/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// sgrub thabs/ dkyil chog sbyin sreg rnams dze tā ri pas mdzad pa thos/ rnam 'joms ba ri lugs kyi rig gtad kyi brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ gsang bdag dze tā ri/ paṇ+ḍi ta a sho/ rdo rje gdan pa ka pi/ paṇ+ḍi ta a mo gha badz+ra/ ba ri lots+tsha ba/ dbus pa zi ston/ gnam kha'u pa/

gtum ston blo gros grags/ yar lung pa lha rje shes rab dpal/ glo bo lots+tsha ba/ shes rab rin chen/ 'gro mgon chos rgyal/ rong pa dus 'khor ba shes rab seng ge kun dga' tshul khrims/ gzhon tshul/ bla ma tshul rgyal/ bla ma ngag dbang pa/ mkhan chen byang seng*/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o/ yang na/ 'gro mgon chos rgyal/ blo chen/ bag ston gzhon tshul man 'dra/ dkyil chog gzhon tshul bas mdzad pa thos/ rnam 'joms dza ya warma'i lugs kyi rig gtad kyi brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ byams pa/ ga ga dha ra/ ma ṇi badz+ra/ dza ya warma/ dz+nyā na shrī/ cog gru rab bzhi/ yon tan legs/ 'gar dbyi mo ba/ slob dpon jo gdan/ kham pa shākya rdo rje/ slob dpon chos grags/ slob dpon sangs rgyas 'bum/ pur ston bsod nams dbang*/ bla ma byang chub gzhon nu/ byang seng*/ 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros/ des bdag la'o// sgrub thabs/ dkyil chog sbyin sreg bum chog bzhi dza ya warmas mdzad pa dang*/ gtso bo'i sgrub thabs ga ga dha ras mdzad pa rnams thos/ rnam 'joms lha bcu dgu ma ma ṇi badz+ra'i lugs kyi rig gtad kyi brgyud pa ni/ yon tan legs pa yan chad sngar bzhin las/ de nas bsam gtan dbang phyug don grub ye shes/ chos kyi blo gros/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ don grub ye shes/ dkon mchog rdo rje/ shes rab 'bum/ rong pa chos mgon/ lots+tsha ba mchog ldan/ pur ston bsod dbang*/ bya sder ba byang chub rin chen/ bya sder ba byang chub gzhon nu/ bya sder ba mkhan po byams pa rin chen/ bya sder ba byang chub seng ge sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// 'di dang gong ma gnyis ka la kha cig dz+nyā na shrī'i lugs zer ro// rnam 'joms gnur lugs kyi rig gtad kyi brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ phyag na rdo rje/ byams pa/ gaṃ ga dha ra/ sangs rgyas gsang ba/ sa man+ta bha dra/ paṇa chen dz+nyā na shrī/ shu nyen pa ston legs/ lots+tsha ba chos bzang*/ gnyal pa nyi she/ gnur nyi ma/

gnur singha/ mnga' gar zhang*/ na bza' shākya seng ge bla ma shāka mchog bla ma tshul rgyal/ bla ma ngag dbang pa/ mkhas btsun byang seng*/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// dkyil chog gnur chos 'phags rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa thos/ phyag na rdo rje 'gro bzang gi dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ phyag na rdo rje/ spyod mdzad chos kyi rdo rje/ kun tu bzang po/ 'gro bzang snying po/ te dza de wa/ zangs dkar lots+tsha ba/ gtum ston chos kyi blo gros/ gtum ston lung khu sgom pa/ mkhan po lung ston pa/ byang ston jo sras/ bla ma sangs rgyas byang chen/ bla ma bsam grub rgyal mtshan/ bla ma legs pa'i shes rab/ bla ma 'jam dbyangs gsar ma/ dpal ldan ri pa/ mkhan chen byams pa rin chen/ mkhas btsun byang seng ba/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// sgrub dkyil bya sder ba byang chub rin chen gyis mdzad pa thos/ 'jam dbyangs smra seng gi rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ smra ba'i seng ge pha dam pa/ kha che gu h+ya pa/ glan sgom yab sras/ slob dpon 'od shag mchog ldan/ skyi ston/ kun mkhyen pa/ ma ti paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// sgrub thabs dam pa rgya gar gyis mdzad pa sogs man ngag las tshogs dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ dam pa/ phyar chung*/ grub thob shol po ba/ kham sgom/ slob dpon 'od shag slob dpon dbu mdzad/ bla ma mchog ldan no// yang na/ shong pa nag po/ byang pa chos rdor/ 'bum chung zhen log de'i sras slob dpon 'od shag go /yang na/ dam pa so chung*/ dam pa so ring*/ gshen 'khor lo/ gshen 'bum grags/ slob dpon ston nam/ slob dpon 'od shag mchog ldan man 'dra'o// rje btsun a ra pa tsa na dkar po'i sgrub thabs kyi brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ 'jam dbyangs/ dga' rab rdo rje/ mi pham bshes gnyen/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung gnyis/ ba ri lots+tsha ba/ sa chen/ rje btsun pa/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ do pa ston tshul/ rgyal tsha/ mchog ldan/ bsod nams dbang phyug

brag lung pa rin chen dpal/ kun spangs chos grags/ paṇa chen ma ti/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// 'jam dbyangs nag po'i sgrub thabs man ngag dang bcas pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ phyag na rdo rje/ dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa/ ba ri lots+tsha ba/ bla ma sa skya pa/ rje btsun rin po che/ sa skya paṇa chen/ zhang mdo sde dpal/ 'jam skya/ mnyam med pa/ bla ma shākya/ bla ma gzhon nu blo gros/ des bdag la'o// par+ṇa sha ba ri'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ phyag rdor/ dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa che ba/ chung ba/ ba ri lots+tsha ba rin chen grags pa/ kun snying*/ bsod nams rtse mo/ grags rgyal/ sa paṇa/ shar pa sku mched/ rin ye/ blo chen sangs rgyas sras/ bag ston gzhon tshul/ bsam gtan grub/ glo bo lots+tsha ba shrī māṃ bo dhi/ lots+tsha ba ma ṇi ka shrī dz+nyā na/ sa bzang 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros/ des bdag la'o// rje btsun seng ge sgra'i sgrub thabs/ thun mtshams kyi bya ba/ gzungs sgrub/ rmi lam brtag pa/ srung 'khor gdags pa/ gdon sgrol gyi cho ga rnams phyogs gcig tu snying po rgyal mtshan gyis bsdebs pa thos/ brgyud pa ni/ seng ge sgra/ tsan+d+ra go mi/ de'i slob ma gcig la jo bo nā ro ta pas/ de las pham mthing pa sku mched/ a thu la badz+ra/ bha ro phyag rdum zhes pa man tsha gling pa/ de gnyis las bla ma mal lots+tsha bas/ de las rje sa chen/ gdon sgrol ni shrad+dhā ka ra/ rin chen bzang po/ brag steng pa/ bla ma mal lots+tsha ba/ rje sa chen/ gtsug tor rgyal po/ rje btsun chen po/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ shar pa sher 'byung*/ ye shes rin chen/ kun dga' byang chub/ mkhan po rgyal bzang dpal/ bla ma grags pa dpal/ ma ti paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// don yod zhags pa'i sgrub thabs kyi brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ dha byang chub sems dpa'/ shrī dha na/ byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan/ nyin phug pa/ drang po lung pa/

mnga' ris pa bde mdzes/ rin chen rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen rgyal ba grub/ chos rje 'dzim pa/ chos rje gangs pa/ paṇa chen ma ti/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// yang na/ nyin phug pa man chad sngar bzhin las/ 'phags pa nas/ shī la ā ka ra/ bai ro tsa na rak+ṣi ta/ ba ri ba/ yang na/ sa bzang 'phags pa nas/ e ra wa ti/ rigs ngan rnal 'byor ma/ don yod rdo rje/ ba ri ba/ yang na 'phags pa nas/ dharma ka pā la/ bsod snyoms pa chen po/ rdo rje gdan pa/ ba ri ba te bka' babs bzhir grags pa yin no// sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa dang*/ gzungs sgrub kyi zin bris bla ma pas mdzad pa thos/ thugs rje chen po skyer sgang lugs kyi rig gtad kyi brgyud pa ni/ thugs rje chen po/ byang sems blo gros rin chen/ a la la badz+ra/ ka ta ya na badz+ra/ rā hu la bha dra/ jo bo rje/ nag tsho lots+tsha ba/ mnga' ris sher rgyal/ lce sgom pa/ grub thob skyer sgang pa/ mkhan po pa/ bkra shis bsod nams/ mkhan chen bde ba dpal/ ka bzhi pa grags gzhon/ bsod nams grags pa/ rgyal sras thogs med/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// yang lha lnga'i sgrub thabs/ bstod pa/ rig gtad byed tshul rnams thos/ lha mo dbyangs can ma'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ lha mo dbyangs can ma bram ze phur bu/ gtum po/ bde chen/ mchod sdong*/ seng ge nyi ma'i seng ge dpe med 'tsho chen po/ sum pa lots+tsha ba/ kun dga' bla ma/ spyi bo lhas pa/ 'dzim pa mkhan po zla 'od/ nye gnas lho pa rin chen grags/ 'dzim pa'i mkhan po bde gshegs/ 'dzim pa rgyal mtshan dpal/ kun spangs chos grags/ paṇa chen ma ti/ ku ma ra ma ti/ des bdag la'o// 'di'i lo rgyus/ rjes gnang gi cho ga bsnyen pa'i man ngag sbyin sreg rtsod pa las rgyal ba/ dug zhi ba/ dbang du bya ba ste las sbyor gyi man ngag gsum/ sum pa lots+tsha ba'i snyan brgyud lnga pa/ nor sgrub pa/ chags pa bsrung ba/ gtor ma'i cho ga gegs sel/ ye shes dbab pa/

rdzas kyis shes rab bskyed pa/ byis pa gzhon nu'i shes rab bskyed pa'i man ngag rjes gnang gi cho ga nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa/ sgrub thabs bram ze phur bus mdzad pa/ sgrub thabs gegs sel dang bcas pa dmar gyis mdzad pa/ shes rab gsum gyi gegs sel ba'i man ngag paṇ+ḍi ta nag mo'i khol dang*/ bram ze phur bus mdzad pa'i bstod pa rnams thos/ lung 'di rnams/ bla mas 'jam dbyangs kha che las gsan gsung*/ rta mgrin jo bo lugs kyi rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ spyan ras gzigs/ mar me mdzad/ yol grub thob/ mtha' bzhi grub thob/ rin po che smon lam/ rin po che lam pa/ lha ye shes 'od/ slob dpon legs pa shes rab/ byang chub rin chen/ byang chub gzhon nu/ mkhan chen byams pa rin chen/ mkhas btsun byang seng*/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// sgrub thabs jo bo rjes mdzad pa thos/ rta mgrin nag po'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das rta mgrin/ byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan/ zhang skyi tsha ba 'od chen/ zhang dbu dkar ba/ zhang lots+tsha ba/ zhang byang rin/ dpal rgyal ba grub/ chos rje 'dzim pa/ chos rje spang sgang ba/ sgrub pa po bla ma rin chen brtson 'grus chen po/ mkhas btsun byang chub seng ge sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// sgrub thabs/ rjes gnang*/ nad pa gso ba/ steng gdon gzir ba/ lus bsrung ba/ ser ba bsrung ba/ phyir bzlog pa rnams thos/ phyag na rdo rje u tsar+ya'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ rdo rje 'dzin/ pad+ma badz+ra/ nā gārdzu na/ tsan+d+ra go mi/ rā dza dharma/ zangs gling pa/ kham pa a seng*/ zhang ston dkon mchog ru smon mkhar ba/ skyi ston ru zhang*/ dkon mchog blo gros/ chos grags/ yang na/ kham pa a seng*/ dkon mchog rgya mtsho// jo sras me 'bar/ ston grags/ don zhags pa/ slob dpon lha rje/ chos grags/ e pa 'khon ston/ lots+tsha ba mchog ldan/ bla ma rgyal 'od/ slob dpon smra ba'i seng ge

chos rje byang seng ba/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang gi cho ga bla mas mdzad pa thos/ rme brtsegs ljang gu'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ phyag na rdo rje nas brgyud de/ jo bo chen po/ gung thang pa/ phyag sor ba/ sangs rgyas bya 'dul/ chos dbang*/ chos kyi byang chub/ chos kyi shes rab/ mchog ldan/ mnyam med grags rgyal/ bla ma shākya/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// sgrub thabs jo bos mdzad pa yang thos/ rnam sras zhi drag gnyis kyi rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag na rdo rje/ spyod mdzad chos kyi rdo rje/ dpal ldan kun tu bzang po/ slob dpon 'gro bzang snying po/ paṇ+ḍi ta rin chen rdo rje/ kha che dgon pa ba/ bla ma zangs dkar lots+tsha ba/ g.yor po byang ston/ pur bsod nams rin chen/ 'byid phu ba pad+ma bkra shis/ ltag pa jo bzang*/ lots+tsha ba byams pa'i dpal/ bla chen bsod nams dbang phyug rin po che khro phu ba bsod nams seng ge bla ma yang rtse ba rin chen seng ge bu ston rin po che/ lots+tsha ba rin chen rnam rgyal/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// sgrub thabs dgos 'dod 'byung ba/ bstod pa chen po/ rjes gnang gi yi ge rnams bu ston rin po ches mdzad pa thos/ yang de nyid kyi drung du/ rdzogs rim zab mo'i skor zhus pa la/ u rgyan snyan sgrub kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ grub thob u rgyan pa/ bsod nams 'od zer/ chos rje gangs pa/ paṇa chen ma ti/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// rdo rje'i tshig rkang*/ 'grel bshad bsod nams 'od zer gyis mdzad pa rnams thos/ bsnyen sgrub kyi skor zla seng gis mdzad pa la/ lo rgyus rin chen phreng ba/ khrid yig shog dril gsum/ thugs rdo rje'i khrid yig byang sems 'gyur med/ 'pho ba/ ngo sprod kyi zin bris/ ltag 'then gyi yig chung*/ nyams myong gi phreng ba/

chos rje'i gsung sgros/ dbyug chos/ sel byed dka' 'phreng gegs sel thun mong ma yin pa/ gnad kyi zhus lan/ snyan brgyud gdams pa/ gegs sel rin chen phreng ba/ nyams myong gi yi ge bdud rtsi'i phreng ba'am gces grub brgyad cu pa/ 'grel bshad yid bzhin nor bu gsal ba/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu/ 'khrul 'khor gyi gdams pa gser srang ma/ dpe'u ris dang bcas pa rnams thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ grub thob u rgyan pa/ zla ba seng ge bla ma bsod nams mgon/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po tai lo pa'i man ngag bde mchog snyan brgyud rin po che'i skor la/ brgyud pa yid bzhin nor bu la/ tai lo/ nā ro/ mar pa/ mi la/ ngam rdzong ras pa/ ras chung pa/ gung thang ras pa/ rgya pho ba lung pa ste/ rnam thar brgyad do// rmi lam yid bzhin nor bu la/ yab bka' la gzhung tai los mdzad pa/ de'i bu yig thig tshon gsal ba/ dag pa smin byed dbang gi cho ga brda dbang ste rdul tshon skor drug go /lus dkyil gsang ba rin po che tai los mdzad pa/ de'i bu yig dpag bsam ljon shing ste/ lus dkyil skor gnyis so// lha lnga'i mngon rtogs gsang ba nyi zla kha sbyor nā ro pas mdzad pa/ bu yig bde chen bsgrub pa ste lha lnga'i skor gnyis/ lha bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs rdo rje bdud rtsi/ lha bcu bdun ma'i mngon rtogs rdo rje nyi ma ste man ngag las byung ba gnyis so// dpa' bo drug gi sgrub thabs ka na shrīs mdzad pa/ de'i bu yig rjes gnang ste dpa' bo drug skor gsum mo// lhan skyes mngon rtogs gsang ba rin chen bsdus pa nā ro pas mdzad pa/ bu yig dngos grub 'byung ba/ bstod pa rdo rje tshig drug ste lhan skyes skor gsum mo// tshe sgrub/ mchod phreng*/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg thab thig shog khra/ char 'bebs te/

nyer mkho skor drug ste/ mdor na yab skor nyi shu bzhi'o// yum bka' la/ rdo rje phag mo/ rdul tshon mngon rtogs/ lus dkyil/ yum bka'i tho yig lha mo bcu gnyis ma'i mngon rtogs/ lha bdun ma'i mngon rtogs te yum skor lnga'o// dpa' mo drug gi sgrub thabs ka na shrīs mdzad pa/ de'i bu yig rjes gnang ste dpa' mo drug gi skor gsum mo// phag mo lhan skyes nā ros mdzad pa/ bu yig rjes gnang ste lhan skyes skor gsum mo// thod sgrub rtsa ba de'i 'grel ba ste skor gnyis so// lag mchod dang de'i 'grel pa/ phag mo zhal gsum ma'i lhan skyes rdzogs rim dang bcas pa/ ṭī ka mngon rtogs rjes gnang ste lhan skyes skor gsum mo// phag mo'i mngon rtogs rgyas pa ste yum skor bcu dgu'o// grol lam yid bzhin nor bu la/ gzhung rdo rje'i tshig rkang tai los mdzad pa/ de'i ṭī ka ga ga ma'i gzhung sa bcad/ snyan brgyud brgyad dang*/ nā ro pas mdzad pa'i sbyor drug snyan brgyud/ gzhung khrid/ 'pho ba/ ngo sprod khrid yig skor gsum mo// gtum mo'i gzhung tai los mdzad pa/ gtum mo'i gzhung bdud rtsi'i 'od zer nā ro pas mdzad pa/ gtum mo'i khrid yig ngo sprod de gtum mo skor bzhi'o// in+d+ra bhū ti'i gzhan lus shes rab bsten tshul sha ba ri pa'i glu stong nyid lta ba/ nā ro pa'i glu/ la ba pa'i glu/ lu hi pa'i glu/ ḍom+bi pa'i glu ste rdo rje'i glu lnga'o// rgyud nas gsungs pa'i rdo rje'i glu bar do'i lhan thabs/ 'khrul 'khor shog khra dang bcas pa/ spyi skor bco brgyad do// bka' srung gi skor la/ phyi sgrub klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa dang*/ bu yig gtor dbang ste phyi sgrub skor gsum mo// nang sgrub/ bu yig rjes gnang ste nang sgrub skor gsum mo// gsang sgrub/ klu sgrub kyi rkang brgyad/ nag po pa'i bstod pa/ rtsa ba'i bstod pa ste bstod pa skor gsum mo// chos skyong dmar po/

shog khra rnams so// chos skyong skor dgu'o// tshe ring ma la/ tshe dpag med kyi sgrub thabs/ tshe ring ma'i sgrub thabs/ rjes gnang ste tshe ring skor gsum mo// mdor na rnam thar brgyad/ yab skor nyer bzhi/ yum skor bcu dgu/ spyi don bcu dgu/ lus med skor drug bka' srung skor dgu/ tshe ring ma'i skor gsum ste/ chos skor brgyad cu rtsa brgyad/ gsang ba'i man ngag brgyad do// de la yab bka' la lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dbang*/ lus dkyil lha lnga ma/ lha bcu gsum ma/ lha bdun ma/ dpa' bo drug dang*/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyis bskor ba lha bco lnga ma'i dbang ste drug dang*/ yum bka' la lha so bdun ma/ lus dkyil bco lnga ma/ bdun ma/ bcu gsum ma rnams kyi dbang dang*/ yab yum lhan skyes kyi byin rlabs dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ mar pa/ mi la/ ras chung pa/ khyung tshang ba ye shes rdo rje/ shangs pa dmar ston tshul khrims 'byung gnas/ ma gcig ang jo/ zhang lots+tsha ba grub pa dpal/ se sgom jo khro/ mkha' 'gro ma ye shes rgyan/ rgyal thang pa/ rtogs ldan shes gzhon/ tsa ri ba bde chen rdo rje/ kun mkhyen 'dzam gling pa/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ lots+tsha ba ma ṇi ka shrī dz+nyā na/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// yang drug cu rtsa gnyis ma/ lha lnga ma/ lus dkyil rnams kyi dbang gi brgyud pa ni he ru ka ye shes mkha' 'gro/ tai lo/ nā ro/ mar pa/ mi la/ ras chung pa/ khyung tshang pa ye shes bla ma/ rong dgon pa rin chen rdo rje/ nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ sangs rgyas 'bum/ lots+tsha ba mchog ldan/ bla ma gzhon tshul/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje/ lots+tsha ba ma ṇi ka shrī dz+nyā na/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// lhan skyes kyi byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ni/ ras chung pa/ khyung tshang pa/ lha phu dge sdings pa/ srin po ri pa/ dge brag pa khu dbon/ gzhon nu bla ma/ bla ma gzhon tshul/

mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje man chad 'dra'o// yum bka' sin+dhū ra'i dbang dang*/ lus med mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs gnyis kyi brgyud pa ni/ karma pak+ṣi/ rma bya byang brtson/ gangs dkar ba/ rma bya byang brtson gyi sras po slob dpon don grub/ bla ma nyi ma 'bum/ bla ma gzhon tshul/ mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje man 'dra'o// grol lam gyi skor gyi lung dang man ngag thams cad kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ tai lo pa/ nā ro/ mar pa/ mi la/ mar pa mgo yag slob dpon a tsi/ spyan snga nyer brgyad pa/ slob dpon sangs gzhon/ lots+tsha ba ma ṇi ka shrī dz+nyā na/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// ༈ /nā ro chos drug gi khrid kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ mar pa/ mi la/ sgam po ba/ phag mo grub pa/ chos rje dbon rin po che/ gcung rin po che/ bla ma artsi/ spyan snga ba rdo rje rgyal po/ lots+tsha ba nor bu dpal bzang po/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// yang na chos rje spyan snga ba/ thog rdugs pa/ gser thogs rin po che/ spyan snga grags pa'i mtshan can/ bla ma lots+tsha ba ma ṇi ka shrī dz+nyā na/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// nā ro chos drug gi khrid dang ngo sprod/ lots+tsha ba nor bu dpal gyis mdzad pa/ thabs lam tshigs bcad ma/ yang dgon pa'i khrid yig tshar chos dang bcas pa rnams thos/ phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor kyi khrid kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ mar pa/ mi la/ dwags po lha rje/ phag mo grub pa/ gling ras/ rgya ras/ me lung pa gcung po/ yang dgon pa/ bla ma rin chen ldan/ chos rje zur phug pa/ kun mkhyen gangs pa/ sa bzang paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// khrid yig yang dgon pas byas pa/ gsang spyod bzlog bsgom thon chos dang bcas pa/ ro snyoms dgang dril/ bla ma sku gsum sgrub pa'i man ngag rnams thos pa'i brgyud pa'ang gong dang 'dra'o// yi ge bzhi pa'i brgyud pa ni/

mi la yan chad lhan cig skyes sbyor dang gcig de nas dag po snyi sgom/ kham sgom chos kyi bla ma/ gtsang pa jo sras/ sangs rgyas ri ma/ lce sgom/ dga' ldan pa hūm̐ 'bar/ bla ma khams chen/ skyes mchog sprul sku/ mnga' ris mkhas grub/ kun mkhyen gangs pa/ paṇa chen ma ti/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// phyag rgya chen po thog babs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang*/ byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rin chen/ su ma ti kun tu bzang po/ tai lo pa/ nā ro paṇa chen/ mar pa lots+tsha ba/ mi la ras pa/ dwags po lha rje/ lce sgom 'gar mo rdzong pa/ sangs rgyas lam pa/ chos rje rngog chos rje dar ma rgyal mtshan/ sangs rgyas shes rab dpal/ sangs rgyas jo btsun/ bla ma lha dbang*/ bla ma dam pa 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// yang dwags po lha rje yan gong dang 'dra ba la/ dwags po lha rje/ khams pa rdor rgyal/ gling ras/ gtsang pa rgya ras/ chos rje rgod tshang pa/ me lung gcung pa'o// de gnyis kas yang dgon pa la/ spyan snga rin chen ldan/ chos rje zur phug pa/ kun mkhyen gangs pa/ bla ma lha dbang*/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ de las bdag gis zung 'jug ngo sprod dang bcas pa thos/ phyag rgya chen po gaṅgā ma yang thos/ brda rtsa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rin po che/ sha ba ri pa/ mai tri pa/ gtsang shod pa/ dar ma seng ge dge bshes ston pa/ jo btsun me 'bar/ g.yu lung pa/ lce sgom rdzong pa/ dga' ldan pa/ bla ma khams chen/ byang chub dpal/ chos rje 'dzim pa/ bla ma sprul sku ri pa chen po/ bla ma 'dzim chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ bla ma grags pa dpal bzang po/ paṇa chen ma ti/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// brda rgyud gsal sgron gyi brgyud pa ni/ mai tri pa yan chad gong dang 'dra/ de nas rgya gar phyag na/ rgya gar gsang spyod pa/ gnyal pa skal ldan/ dbus pa mar ston/ dbus pa zhang sgom/ bla ma lce sgom/ ra sgom zhig po/ ta mo zhang sgom/

bla ma dkon ne byang dpal/ zhang sgom ye shes dpal/ mnga' ris bzang po'i mtshan can/ grags pa dpal bzang po/ paṇa chen ma ti/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o/ ri gong pa'i bdud gcod kyi brgyud pa ni/ 'og min du yum chen mo/ g.yu lo bkod par rje btsun sgrol ma/ rgya gar dur khrod gnas brgyad du su kha sid+dhi/ pha rgyud ni/ bya rgod phung por shākya mu ne/ ri bo rtse lngar 'phags pa 'jam dpal/ rgya gar gyi spyil po kha spyod du ār+ya de wa/ ding ri bla 'khor du dam pa rgya gar/ des su kha sid+dhi la'ang thos so// ra pa ya phug tu skyo ston bsod nams bla ma/ zangs ri mkhar dmar du byang chub lab sgron/ e chung glang lung du khu sgom chos seng*/ lung smad lcang tshal du dol pa zang thal/ g.yo stod chu rir rgya nag gcer bu/ rab grong du sangs rgyas rab ston/ zal mo brag tu sangs rgyas dge slong*/ mi mngon chos dbyings su ras pa chos rdor/ ri gong bsam gtan brag gong du sangs rgyas ston pa/ gang bzhugs bkra shis gnas mchog tu dbus pa dbu ma/ 'dzim pa phu chos lung du sprul sku zhang sgom/ dga' ldan chos lung gi gzims khang du chos rje 'dzim pa/ rdo rje gdan gyi sgrub khang du kun mkhyen gangs pa/ dben gnas dam pa sa bzang du chos rje paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// phar phyin gyi khrid kyi brgyud pa ni/ gser gling pa/ jo bo rje/ 'brom ston/ rtsa nam mkha'/ klog skya shes rab rgyal mtshan/ 'brom chos kyi blo gros/ 'bal tshad ma ba rdo rje grags/ skag pa ston gzhon/ skyer sgang pa ye shes seng ge bshes gnyen seng ge skyabs/ mchims nam mkha' grags/ skyo ston smon lam tshul khrims/ rgyang ro paṇa chen/ mchims blo bzang grags/ lha dbang pa/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// khrid yig mchims nam mkha' grags kyis mdzad pa yang thos/ blo sbyong don bdun ma'i brgyud pa ni/ byams pa/ thogs med/

dbyig gnyen/ blo brtan/ ku su lu che chung gnyis/ gser gling pa/ jo bo rje lha gcig 'brom ston pa/ glang ri thang pa/ pu to ba/ shar pa/ 'chad dka' ba/ se spyil bu pa/ byang chen pa/ byams gling pa/ mkhan po gzhon nu grub/ slob dpon kun dga' tshul khrims/ chos rje gangs pa/ sa bzang paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// blo sbyong tshig rkang brgyad pa'i brgyud pa ni/ mkhan po gzhon nu grub yan chad gong dang 'dra/ byang chen pa/ rat+na gu ru/ rin chen gsal/ des bsod nams rdo rje/ des chos rje gangs pa/ sa bzang paṇa chen man 'dra/ yang na 'chad ka ba/ lhas pa ba/ ser sgang pa yon tan/ mkhan po bde ba dpal/ mkhan po ka bzhi pa/ grags pa gzhon nu/ mkhan chen bsod nams grags pa/ chos rje gangs pa man chad 'dra/ skyid sdug lam khyer/ rten 'brel snying po rnams thos te/ bla mas chos rje rgyal sras pa las gsan gsungs so// ༈ /yang de nyid kyi drung du rgyud sde rin po che rnams kyi lung zhus pa la/ rgyud thams cad kyi bdag po 'phags pa 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' don dam pa'i mtshan yang dag par brjod pa phan yon dang bcas pa dang*/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud/ de'i rgyud phyi ma rgyud kyi snying po dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rje dang po'i sangs rgyas/ rigs ldan sum cu so gnyis/ seng ge rnam par rgyal ba/ dus zhabs pa yab sras/ kha che zla ba mgon po/ brag mkhar ba dkon mchog bsrungs/ snor bzang gnam la brtsegs/ grub chen yu mo/ sras dharme shwa ra/ khang sar ba nam mkha' 'od/ grub thob se mo che/ 'jam dbyangs gsar ma/ de gnyis ka las bo dong rin po che/ de la kun mkhyen 'dzim pa/ bla ma glo bo chen po/ mkhan po rgyal bzang dpal/ chos rje gangs pa grags pa dpal/ sa bzang paṇa chen/ 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros/ des bdag la'o// dus kyi 'khor lo'i rtsa rgyud nas byung ba/ dbang mdor bstan pha rgyud kyi snying po bkol ba/

dpal dus kyi 'khor lo bsdus pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ dus 'khor rgyud kyi snying po phyi ma ste bzhi'i brgyud pa ni/ sku bzhi'i bdag nyid dus kyi 'khor lo/ chos rje rigs ldan rnams/ grub chen dus zhabs pa chen po/ dus zhabs pa gnyis pa/ rgyal sras na len+d+ra pa/ paṇa chen zla ba mgon po/ bla ma 'brom ston lots+tsha ba/ lha rje sgom pa/ sgro ston gnam la brtsegs/ grub chen yu mo/ sras dharme shwa ra/ ma gcig sprul sku jo 'bum/ mkhas pa nam mkha' 'od zer/ grub thob se mo che ba/ chos rje 'jam gsar/ chos sku 'od zer/ kun spangs jo nang pa/ byang sems rgyal ba ye shes/ mkhas btsun yon tan rgya mtsho/ kun mkhyen dol po pa/ sa bzang paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// dbang gi rab tu byed pa dang*/ don dam bsnyen pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ chos rgyal rigs ldan rnams las brgyud nas/ tsi lu paṇ+ḍi ta/ dus zhabs pa che ba/ dus zhabs pa gnyis pa/ de gnyis kas rtsa mi sangs rgyas grags la/ se lots+tsha ba tshul khrims grags/ dus 'khor bsod snyoms pa/ bkra shis rin chen/ dus 'khor ba sangs rgyas rdo rje/ bla ma glo bo chen po/ mkhan po rgyal bzang dpal/ mkhan chen grags pa dpal/ sa bzang paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// shes rab kyi rgyud gtso che ba dpal kye'i rdo rje'i rgyud/ brtag pa gnyis pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ bdag med ma/ bir+wa pa/ ḍom+bi he ru ka a la la badz+ra/ nags khrod pa/ gar+bha ri pa/ bsod snyoms pa/ mi thub zla ba/ dpa' bo rdo rje/ 'brog mi lots+tsha ba/ mnga' ris pa gsal ba'i snying po/ 'khon sgyi chu ba/ sa chen pa/ rje btsun sku mched/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ chos rgyal 'phags pa/ slob dpon ston gzhon/ bla ma rdor rgyal/ ri phug pa mkhan chen dar rgyal/ sa bzang paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// kye rdo rje'i bshad rgyud mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur le'u bco lnga pa/

rgyud mang po'i thun mong gi bshad rgyud dpal sam+bu ṭa brtag pa bcu la rab byed bzhi bzhir phye ba dang*/ de'i rgyud phyi ma gnyis kyi brgyud pa ni/ chos rgyal 'phags pa yan chad brtag gnyis dang 'dra zhing*/ de nas 'o yug pa bsod seng*/ ri phug pa shāka seng*/ bla ma dbang rgyal/ sa bzang paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// cha mthun gyi rgyud phyag rgya chen po thig le zhes bya ba/ rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po le'u nyer brgyad pa/ ye shes snying po rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po le'u bzhi pa/ dpal ye shes thig le rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po le'u nyer dgu pa/ dpal de kho na nyid kyi sgron ma zhes bya ba'i rnal 'byor ma chen mo'i rgyud sde chen po bzhi'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ in+d+ra bhū ti/ shrī bh+ya ni/ sid+dhi badz+ra/ u ma pa/ dz+nyā na bhū ti/ shri yo bhū ti/ pad+ma badz+ra/ ḍom+bi pa/ yan lag 'bar ma zhabs/ bung ba'i pad+ma/ in+d+ra bhū ti/ lcam la k+ṣiṃ ka ra/ rat+na badz+ra/ pra dz+nyā gu/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po/ sa chen pa/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun pa/ sa skya paṇa chen/ khong ston/ glo chen pa/ mkhan po rgyal bzang dpal/ mkhan chen grags pa dpal/ sa bzang paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// dpal rnyog pa med pa/ rdo rje a ral+lī/ ṛ gi a ral+lī gsum gyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ u rgyan a ra l+lī/ sing ga gling gi bram ze mo/ ga ya dha ra/ 'brog mi/ mtshur dbang gi rdo rje/ yug zhang dbon/ bya rin chen 'od/ blo chen pa man chad sngar dang 'dra'o// bde mchog nyung ngu'i rgyud du grags pa phyi ma'i phyi ma'am/ bla ma'i bla ma zhes pa'i le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa dang*/ bde mchog bshad pa'i rgyud du grags pa mngon brjod dam pa/ nges brjod bla ma'i rgyud le'u drug cu rtsa dgu pa gnyis kyi brgyud pa ni/

rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag na rdo rje/ sa ra ha/ klu sgrub/ sha ba ri/ lo hi pa/ dha ri ka pa/ gan+dha ra pa/ rus sbal zhabs/ dza lan+d+ra ra/ kar+ṇa pa/ gu h+ya pa/ rnam rgyal zhabs/ bar ma'i slob dpon/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ pham mthing pa sku mched/ klog skya shes rab brtsegs/ mal lots+tsha ba/ sa chen pa/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun pa/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ khang ston 'od zer rgyal mtshan/ bla ma blo chen man 'dra/ rnal 'byor ma kun spyod kyi brgyud pa ni snga ma dang 'dra/ dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro le'u lnga bcu pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ lo hi pa/ ḍom+bi pa/ dha ri ka pa/ ka tsa ta pa/ ghan+ḍa pa/ la wa pa/ dza lan dha ra/ nag po pa/ dge ba'i mgon po/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ pham mthing pa sku mched/ ma ṇi ka shrī dz+nyā na/ kha che byang chub bzang po/ de bzhi ka'i slob ma mar pa lots+tsha ba chos kyi bzang po/ gze ba blo ldan/ de'i sras don ne/ kham pa shākya rdo rje/ dbus pa sangs rgyas 'bum/ lots+tsha ba mchog ldan/ bla ma 'khon ston/ bla ma 'jam dbyangs rin rgyal/ blo chen pa/ mkhan po rgyal bzang dpal/ mkhan po spang sgang pa/ sa bzang paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ spyan ras gzigs/ byang sems blo gros rin chen/ sha wa ri/ mai tri gup+ta/ rgya gar phyag na/ ka ma la badz+ra/ dza ya se na/ sum pa lots+tsha ba dar ma yon tan/ rje btsun grags rgyal/ sa skya paṇa chen/ rin po che skyob pa dpal/ rgyal tsha chos dbang*/ lots+tsha ba mchog ldan/ blo chen pa/ bla ma ye shes mgon/ dar ma bzang po/ grags chen pa/ chos rje spang sgang pa/ ma ti paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o/ dpal bde mchog sdom pa 'byung ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ rat+na shrī/ ka la shān+ti ma ti/ ba ni dhi bha dra/ bhū mi shrī/ bi ma la shrī/ shong blo brtan/

lots+tsha ba mchog ldan/ bla ma sangs rgyas sras/ bla ma ye shes mgon/ bla ma dar ma bzang*/ bla ma grags chen/ mkhan chen spang sgang ba/ sa bzang paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// he ru ka mngon 'byung ngam khrag 'thung mngon 'byung zhes bya ba rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud le'u bzhi bcu rtsa lnga pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ nag po spyod pa'i rdo rje/ rje bhan dhe ba/ rje dharma/ rje bhu ṣa pa/ dze tā ri pa/ a mo gha badz+ra/ dharma ā ka ra ma ti/ meñdza gling pa/ rwa rdo rje grags/ rwa chos rab/ rwa dharma seng ge rwa dkon seng*/ rwa sher rgyal/ bla ma blo chen man chad 'dra'o// rnal 'byor ma bzhi kha sbyor gyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ blo gros rin chen/ sa ra ha/ klu sgrub/ ri khrod mgon po/ mai tri pa/ rgya gar phyag na/ ba reg gtsang shod pa/ sum pa 'jam mgon/ ba reg rat+na 'bar/ ba reg 'od zer/ ba reg jo 'bum/ steng phu lung pa nam mkha' 'gro/ ba reg bkra shis/ lots+tsha ba mchog ldan pa/ blo chen man chad gong dang 'dra'o// phag mo mngon 'byung gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ pradz+nyā rak+ṣi ta/ meñdza dza gling pa/ rwa rdo rje grags/ rwa chos rab/ rwa dar ma seng ge rwa dkon seng*/ rwa sher rgyal/ glo chen man chad sngar dang 'dra'o// mgon po mngon 'byung zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ klu sgrub/ pen+ta pa ba che ba/ pen+ta pa ba chung ba/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ pradz+nyā rak+ṣi ta/ rat+na rak+ṣi ta/ mañdzu kīrti/ sa man+ta shrī bha dra/ rwa chos rab/ rwa dar ma seng ge rwa dkon seng*/ rwa sher rgyal/ lots+tsha ba mchog ldan/ glo chen man chad sngar bzhin no// bde mchog nam mkha' dang mnyam pa le'u gsum pa ye shes rdo rje'i 'gyur/ dpal kye'i rdo rje gsang ba'i mdzod ces bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po rnams thos te/
