gnyis ka brdzun mar snang ngo*// dpal sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor mkha' 'gro ma sgyu ma bde mchog ces bya ba'i rgyud phyi ma'am bla ma rtsa rgyud rtag pa bcu pa dang*/ de'i rgyud phyi ma'i phyi ma brtag pa lnga pa gnyis kyi brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ badz+ra pā ṇi/ rdo rje gdan pa che ba/ gnyis pa/ gsum pa/ puṇ+ya shrī mi tra/ steng pa lots+tsha ba tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ so thams cad mkhyen pa/ so 'dzam gling rgyan/ lho pa thams cad mkhyen pa/ glan bang so ba/ rgya pho lung pa/ gnyal pa chos grags/ dbus pa sangs rgyas 'bum/ lots+tsha ba mchog ldan/ sangs rgyas sras/ mkhan po rgyal bzang dpal/ mkhan chen spang sgang pa grags pa dpal/ sa bzang paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// ma hā mā yā'i sgyu 'phrul chen po zhes bya ba'i rgyud le'u gsum pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ byang sems rdo rje snying po/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ ku ku ri pa/ mtsho skyes rdo rje/ ḍom+bi pa/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ bal po zhi ba bzang po/ mar pa lots+tsha/ rngog chos rdor/ rngog jo sras/ rngog mdo sde/ rngog tsha chos sku/ rngog tsha dkon mchog dpal/ klog skya dbang phyug grags/ bla ma ldong shes rab dpal/ bla ma 'phags pa/ bla ma sangs rgyas sras/ mkhan po rgyal bzang dpal man chad 'dra'o// sangs rgyas thod pa zhes bya ba rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po le'u bcu bzhi pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ lo hi pa/ ti lo pa/ nā ro pa/ dha ra shri/ ga ya dha ra/ 'brog mi lots+tsha ba dang*/ 'gos gnyis ka'i slob ma/ mtshur ston dbang nge*/ spug thams cad mkhyen pa/ spug dharma ke tu/ jo gdan gnyal pa/ bla ma glo chen/ bla steng pa dbang rgyal/ chos rje spang sgang pa/ ma ti paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// yang na ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ byang sems blo gros rin chen/ klu sgrub/ sha wa ri/ mai tri pa/ mar pa chos kyi blo gros/

lho brag gi ro mnyam rdo rje/ bya ston rnal 'byor/ mi mnyam rdo rje/ yon tan grags/ bar thang pa shākya rdo rje/ sras chos grags/ byang chub dpal/ snar thang pa bsod nams 'phel/ bde ba can pa ye shes mgon/ g.yas ru ba dngos ston rin rgyal/ mkhan chen grags pa dpal/ sa bzang paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// dpal gdan bzhi zhes bya ba rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po gdan re re la rim par phye ba bzhi bzhi ste bcu drug yod pa dang*/ gdan bzhi las btus pa/

sngags kyi cha mchan/ man+t+ra aṃ sa le'u brgyad pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ mar pa lots+tsha/ rngog chos rdor/ rngog mdo sde/ gtsags dharma rā dza/ rgya gsar pa rin chen 'bum/ rgya bsod nams 'bum/ bya rin chen 'od/ glo chen man chad 'dra zhing*/ yang na rdo rje 'chang*/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ klu sgrub/ ār+ya de wa/ rnal 'byor pa rus pa'i phreng ba can/ bal po spyi ther ba nas mar pa man chad 'dra ba'o// dpal gtum po khro bo chen po'i rgyud kyi rgyal po rim par phye ba nyer lnga pa mi g.yo ba pad+ma pa tis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa yod zer/ rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ shar phyogs ra ḍa'i grong du bal po'i paṇ+ḍi ta bi dza rak+ṣi ta/ jo ki paṇ+ḍi ta/ de gnyis ka las rat+na shrīs zhus/ shud ke lots+tsha/ mchog ldan lots+tsha/ glo chen pa/ bla ma gzhon tshul/ bla ma mgon po 'bum/ bram nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ sa bzang paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// yang na mi g.yo ba/ de'i zhal gzigs gnas brtan rā hu la/ rā hu la gnyis pa/ rat+na shrī man chad 'dra'o// rdo rje bdud rtsi le'u bcu gcig pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ 'bar ba 'dzin/ spyod pa'i rdo rje/ dge ba'i mgon po/ rnam rgyal zhabs/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ pan+te da pa/ mar pa lots+tsha/ ro mnyam rdo rje/ gser rje pa/ sha ba gling pa/ dgon pa gling pa/ rong kha ba/ sbrag tshang pa/ rgya yab sras/ kham pa shākya rdo rje/ bla ma sangs rgyas 'bum/ mchog ldan/ glo chen/ mkhan po rgyal bzang dpal man chad 'dra'o// rigs kyi 'jig rten mgon po spyan ras gzigs lnga bcu pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rat+na shrī a le na/ gan ti ma ti/ bi ni ti bha dra/ bhū mi shri/ bi ma la shrī/ blo ldan/ mchog ldan/ glo chen/ mkhan po rgyal bzang dpal man chad 'dra'o// phur pa rtsa dum kyi brgyud pa ni/ kun tu bzang po/

rdo rje sems dpa'/ pad+ma 'byung gnas/ sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms/ kham sgom/ mchog gi legs/ 'khon rog shes rab tshul khrims/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po// de'i sras sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ chos rje pa/ bla ma khang 'od zer rgyal mtshan/ glo bo pa chen po/ mkhan po rgyal bzang dpal man chad 'dra'o// ji bzhin brnyes pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ ma ti rat+na/ sa ra ha/ klu sgrub/ ri khrod mgon po/ mai tri pa/ rgya gar phyag na/ ba reg gtsang shod pa/ sum pa 'jam mgon/ ba reg rat+na 'bar/ ba reg 'od zer/ ba reg jo 'bum/ stod lung pa nam mkha' 'gro/ ba reg bkra shis/ lots+tsha ba mchog ldan/ glo bo pa chen po man 'dra'o// thabs kyi rgyud gtso che ba ni/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rtsa rgyud le'u bcu bdun pa/ de'i rgyud phyi ma le'u bco brgyad pa/ bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng ba mngon par brjod pa/ rgyud thams cad kyi snying po gsang ba rnam par phye ba le'u drug cu rtsa brgyad pa/ dgongs pa lung ston le'u bcu gnyis pa/ ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa/ lha mo bzhis zhus le'u bzhi pa ste drug gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ klu sgrub/ ār+ya de wa/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ mar pa lots+tsha ba/ mtshur ston dbang nge*/ 'khon ston gad pa kīrti/ 'gar ston jo sras/ a 'bug ri ston/ seng ge rdzong pa/ drod chung gi khyung ston zhig po/ drod chung mkhan po tshul snying*/ chos sdings kyi mkhan po rdor snying*/ chos sdings pa 'og ma/ shrī ri zur phug gi bla ma dar bzang*/ mkhan po bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ sa bzang paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// gsang 'dus bshad rgyud rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud le'u bcu bdun pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ kun dga' snying po/ tha ga pa/ shān+ti pa/ shrad+dhā ka ra warma/

pad+mā ka ra/ gnyis ka las lots+tsha ba rin chen bzang pos/ gsum ka las lha bla ma ye shes rgyal mtshan/ chos kyi blo gros/ skyabs seng*/ sra brtan/ dkon mchog mkhar/ dbang rin/ bar thang pa yab sras/ dam pa kun dga' grags/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ bla ma gzhon tshul ba gsum/ bla ma mgon po 'bum/ bram nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ sa bzang paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o/ cha mthun gyi rgyud la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs gshin rje gshed nag po'i rgyud rim par phye ba bco brgyad pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ la li ta badz+ra/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ pradz+nyā rak+ṣi ta/ meñdza gling pa/ rwa rdo rje grags/ rwa chos rab/ rwa dar ma seng ge rwa dkon seng*/ rwa sher rgyal/ glo chen/ sangs rgyas sras man chad sngar dang 'dra'o// gshin rje'i gshed nag po'i 'khor lo las thams cad 'grub par byed pa gzhon nu gdong drug gi rgyud dang*/ gshin rje'i gshed kyi 'khor lo'i rtog pa gnyis kyi brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ mañdzu shrī/ dz+nyā na badz+ra shrī/ dī pa dhi pa ya/ la li ta badz+ra/ sau su ra pa/ she na pa/ a wa mi na pa/ gu ṇa bha dra/ wā gī shwa ra kīrti/ de wa sā ka ra tsan+d+ra/ a mo gha badz+ra/ pra dzā gu ru/ saṃ gha bha dra/ gcen gtsang 'od/ gcung rdo rje rtse mo/ rtse ril nyi ma 'od/ rgyal ba gdan bzang pa/ zhang g.yung rgyal/ 'dzim pa/ bla ma sangs rgyas bzang po/ bla ma glo bo ba chen po/ de gnyis ka las mkhan po rgyal bzang dpal gyis zhus/ de las chos rje yang dgon pas zhus/ de las sa bzang paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyud rtog pa bdun pa dang*/ rtog pa gsum pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ 'jam dpal/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ la li ta badz+ra/ a mo gha badz+ra che ba/ a mo gha badz+ra chung ba/ skyo 'od 'byung*/ yang skyo sku mched/ skyo khams pa/ gnyan rin chen brtan/

gnyan 'od srung*/ gnyan chos rgyal/ glo chen man chad 'dra'o// gshin rje'i gshed dmar po le'u bcu dgu pa'i brgyud pa ni/ gshin rje'i gshed/ bram ze dpal 'dzin/ bi ra ḍi pa/ ma ti gar+bha/ ni skaṃ la ka ra wen+d+ra pa/ chag lots+tsha ba/ dpal gyi rgyal mtshan/ klog skya/ don mo ri pa grags chen/ mkhan po spang sgang pa/ sa bzang paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// zla gsang thig le'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ badz+ra pā ṇi/ rdo rje gdan pa che ba/ gnyis pa/ gsum pa/ puṇ+ya shrī/ steng pa lots+tsha ba/ so thams cad mkhyen pa/ so 'dzam gling rgyan/ lho pa thams cad mkhyen pa/ glan bang so ba/ rgya pho lung pa/ gnyal pa chos grags/ dbus pa sangs rgyas 'bum/ bla ma mchog ldan/ sangs rgyas sras/ mkhan po rgyal bzang dpal/ bla ma grags pa dpal/ sa bzang paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// rnam par snang mdzad sgyu 'phrul drwa ba rim par phye ba bcu pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ phyag na rdo rje/ rab gsal zla ba/ ye shes rdo rje kun dga'/ pradz+nyā bo dhi/ mu ti ko ḍa/ shrad+dhā ka ra warma/ lots+tsha ba rin chen bzang po/ lo chung legs pa'i shes rab/ sum ston ye shes 'bar/ 'or ston lha'i dbang phyug 'or ston sangs rgyas 'bar/ lho pa thams cad mkhyen pa/ chos kyi seng ge kig ston chos mgon/ dbus pa sangs rgyas 'bum/ mchog ldan lots+tsha/ glo chen/ sa bzang paṇa chen man 'dra/ phyag na rdo rje drag po gsum 'dul gyi rgyud/ de'i bshad rgyud gsang ba'i rgyud kyi rnam par 'byed pa drag po gsum 'dul le'u gsum pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can/ sa wa ri pa/ dza wa ri pa/ de wa pūr+ṇa ma ti/ lots+tsha ba 'gar chos kyi bzang po/ gshen ston rin chen dngos grub/ dmar sgang phu pa chos kyi rgyal po/ gan chag pa dbang phyug rgyal mtshan/ chos rje 'dzim pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ bla ma dharma kīrti/ sa bzang paṇa chen man 'dra'o// rnal 'byor gyi rgyud ni/

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi de kho na nyid bsdus pa rigs lnga rigs bzhir bsdus nas mnyam par ston pa/ rtsa ba'i rgyud dum bu bzhi/ rgyud phyi ma/ phyi ma'i phyi ma/ rgyud nye bar bsdu ba dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ phyag rdor/ rab gsal zla ba/ rgyal bu sgra gcan 'dzin/ swa sti pha la/ ye shes rdo rje/ pradz+nyā sid+dhi/ de bzhi ka las kun dga' snying pos zhus pa/ pradz+nyā wa li ta/ pradz+nyā bo dhi/ rab 'byor skyong*/ dharma pha la/ rin chen bzang po/ ma nang gur shing brtson 'grus rgyal mtshan/ gnyal pa nyi she/ rtsa skya ston grags/ gnyal gad pa chen po/ glan chos 'byung*/ rtsa skya shāka 'bum/ dbus pa sangs rgyas 'bum/ mchog ldan lots+tsha ba/ glo bo ba chen po man chad 'dra'o// de'i bshad pa'i rgyud gsang ba rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud rdo rje rtse mo zhes bya ba brtag pa bcu las/ 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i brtag pa yan chad rdzogs nas/ phyi rol rdo rje'i rigs kyi mtshan brgya rtsas gsol ba gdab pa dang bcas pa/ brtag pa phyed dang lnga ma tshang ba'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ byams pa/ gaṅgā dha ra/ sa man+ta bha dra/ kha che dz+nyā na shrī/ gnyal pa nyi she/ gnur nyi ma 'od zer/ gnur singha/ glan chos 'byung*/ rtsa skya shag 'bum/ 'dzim pa rin she/ mchog ldan pa/ glo chen man 'dra'o// 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i rtog pa rgyal po chen po'i rtsa rgyud/ rgyud phyi ma dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rtsa skya shaka 'bum yan chad de nyid 'dus par 'dra zhing*/ des 'dzim pa rin she/ glo chen/ bla ma gzhon tshul/ rdo rje gling pa bla ma mgon po 'bum/ ri phug pa bram ze chen po/ sa bzang paṇa chen man 'dra/ thams cad gsang ba'i rgyud/ rin chen bzang pos bsgyur ba'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ phyag na rdo rje/ rab gsal zla ba/ de'i slob ma lnga ni/ pad dkar ye shes/ kha che dz+nyā na shrī/ rgyal po sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po/

nyi ma bzang po/ rgyal rigs sa ra ha'o// de lnga char las slob dpon kun dga' snying pos zhus/ de nas/ ta thā ga ta badz+ra/ shrad+dhā ka ra/ lots+tsha rin chen bzang po/ le chung grags she/ sa skya pa lnga/ glo chen man sngar dang 'dra'o// dpal mchog dang po zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i rtog pa'i rgyal po'i dum bu dang po sher phyin gyi dum bu/ dum bu gnyis pa rtsa ba'i rgyud/ rgyud phyi ma/ dum bu dang po dang gnyis pa'i rtog pa thams cad bsdus pa'i rgyud dum bu gnyis pa nyid kyi rtog pa thams cad kyi phyi ma'i rtsa rgyud dang*/ gsang ba ras bris kyi cho ga dang*/ phyag rgya'i rgyud/ rtog pa thams cad kyi rgyud phyi ma'i rtsa rgyud dang*/ rtog pa thams cad sgrub pa'i cho ga dang rgyud thams cad kyi don gtan la 'bebs pa/ rtog pa thams cad bsdus pa'i mchog tu gsang ba'i cho ga dang*/ rgyud nye bar bsdu ba dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ de nyid 'dus pa dang mtshungs so// ngan song yongs su sbyong ba'i gzi brjid kyi rgyal po'i brtag pa'i brgyud pa ni/ shākya thub pa/ phyag na rdo rje/ rgyal po rab gsal zla ba/ sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po/ kun dga' snying po/ pradz+nyā wa li ta/ dharma pha la/ jo bo rje/ go mi sgom chen/ skyi nor dz+nyā na/ gnyal pa nyi she/ gnur nyi ma 'od zer/ gnur rdo rje seng ge mkhan po sgo thang pa/ snya ston rdo rje rgyal po/ go lung pa/ g.yu phug pa/ lha khang pa/ mkhan po gser khang pa/ bla ma gzhon nu 'bum/ mkhan po bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ sa bzang paṇa chen man 'dra'o// sbyong rgyud kyi brtag pa phyogs gcig pa'i brgyud pa ni/ kun dga' snying po yan sbyong rgyud snga ma dang 'dra/ de nas bi ra ṭi pa/ ma ti/ gam+bī ra/ ni ska laṅga de ba/ ra len+da bha dra/ chag lots+tsha ba/ gnubs chos dpal/ bla ma glo chen/ mkhan po rgyal bzang dpal/ bla ma grags pa dpal/ sa bzang paṇa chen man 'dra/ yo ga rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud dang*/

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba rgyan gyi bkod pa/ 'phags pa gsang ba nor bu'i thig le'i rgyud de/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas bsgyur ba gsum po'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ badz+ra pā ṇi/ sa ra ha/ klu sgrub yab sras/ ma taṃ ki pa/ bi khyā ta de wa/ paṇa chen shākya shrī/ ta thā ga ta shrī/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ skyob pa dpal/ rgyal tsha lung mang po/ mchog ldan pa/ glo chen man 'dra'o// spyod pa'i rgyud ni/ rnam par snang mdzad chen po mngon par byang chub pa rnam par 'phrul pa byin gyis rlob pa'i rgyud rtsa rgyud rim par phye ba nyer drug pa dang*/ rgyud phyi ma gsang ba mchog gi rim par phye ba la/ rim par phye ba bcu bdun yod pa gnyis kyi brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ 'jam dpal/ dze tā ri/ mya ngan med pa'i dpal/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ don yod rdo rje/ ba ri lots+tsha ba/ sa skya pa lnga/ sangs rgyas sras/ mkhan po rgyal bzang dpal/ spang sgang pa chen po/ sa bzang paṇa chen man 'dra'o// phyag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba'i rgyud chen po bam po bcu gnyis pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ phyag rdor/ dgra las rnam rgyal/ mya ngan med pa'i dpal/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ jo bo puṇ+ya shrī/ steng pa lots+tsha ba tshul khrims 'byung gnas/ so chos she/ lho pa thams cad mkhyen pa ting 'dzin dpal bzang po/ dbus pa sangs rgyas 'bum/ rgyal tsha chos dbang*/ gnyis ka las mchog ldan pas zhus/ rwa sa rong star gyi bla ma ston shāka bla ma gzhon tshul/ bla ma mgon po 'bum/ bla ma bram ze'o// bya ba'i rgyud la/ rigs gsum so so'i dang po/ 'jam dpal gyi rgyud la/ dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i rgyal po le'u bcu dgu pa'i brgyud pa ni/ ba ri lots+tsha yan chad rnam snang mngon byang dang 'dra zhing*/ de nas/ mchims brtson seng*/ mchims don ne/ chos seng*/ blo brtan/ nam mkha' grags/ glo chen man 'dra'o// 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rtog pa le'u sum cu so drug yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/

sangs rgyas/ 'jam dbyangs/ rgyal po rab gsal zla ba/ bram ze sgra gcan 'dzin/ swa sti ba la/ ye shes rdo rje/ pradz+nyā sid+dhi/ kun dga' snying po/ rab 'byor skyong*/ shes rab skyong*/ zhi ba'i snying po/ dge mtshan bshes gnyen/ bde ba'i rdo rje/ dad byed go cha/ lots+tsha ba rin chen bzang po/ rkyang po chos blo/ bra bo 'bum lha 'phen/ bra bo chos tshul/ bra bo mi mnyam rdo rje/ ldong stong ye shes rdo rje/ zhang bya ru ba/ glo chen man chad 'dra'o// 'jam dpal khro bo rnam par rgyal ba'i rtog pa gsang ba'i rgyud ces bya ba rtsa ba'i rgyud phyi ma/ phyi ma'i phyi ma dang bcas pa le'u nyer gnyis byas pa dang*/ 'jam dpal gsang rgyud ces pa dang*/ khro bo rnam par rgyal ba'i rtog pa pra khog ces pa gsum ni ming tsam ma gtogs par don gcig par snang zhing*/ brgyud yig mi 'dug go /dpa' bo gcig tu grub pa zhes bya ba le'u bzhi yod pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa che ba/ gnyis pa/ ba ri lots+tsha ba/ sa skya pa lnga/ glo chen man chad 'dra'o// 'jam dpal gyi zhal nas gsungs pa/ 'jam dpal gyi dmod btsugs pa/ 'jam dpal gyi shes rab blo 'phel/ 'jam dpal yi ge 'bru gcig pa/ 'jam dpal gyi dam bcas pa/ 'jam dpal gyi mtshan zhes bya ba'i gzungs kyi brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ phyag rdor/ dze tā ri/ mya ngan med pa'i dpal/ don yod rdo rje/ ba ri lots+tsha ba/ sa chen pa/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun pa/ sa skya paṇa chen/ rgyal tsha chos dbang*/ rong pa sher seng*/ de nas bla ma gzhon tshul man chad 'dra'o/ spyan ras gzigs kyi rgyud pad+ma drwa ba'i brgyud pa ni/ thub pa/ 'jam dpal/ dze tā ri/ a sho ka shrī/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ don yod rdo rje/ ba ri lots+tsha ba/ mchims brtson seng*/ blo brtan/ sangs rgyas 'bum/ mchog ldan man 'dra'o// 'phags pa a mo gha pā sha'i rtog pa chen po cho ga zhib mo bam po nyer lnga pa'i brgyud pa ni/

thub pa chen po/ 'jam dpal/ dze tā ri/ a sho ka shrī/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ don yod rdo rje/ ba ri lots+tsha ba/ sa chen pa/ mchims brtson seng*/ mchims don ne/ mchims chos seng*/ blo brtan sangs rgyas 'bum/ mchog ldan pa/ glo chen man gong dang 'dra'o// yang na/ sangs rgyas/ 'jam dpal/ bsam gtan pa bcu gnyis/ dad byed go cha dpal/ dza ya se na/ dza ya ta thā ga ta/ nor bu gling pa bde ba'i rdo rje/ u rgyan pa sangs rgyas zhi ba/ kha che shrad+dhā ka ra/ lots+tsha ba rin chen bzang po/ jo bo gang gnas pa/ jo bo lha btsun/ gdong sngon gyi bla ma dge bsnyen/ khyung ston phyag rdor/ khyung ston dngos grub/ dbang phyug rin chen/ lho pa thams cad mkhyen pa/ sngog lha sa ba/ rgyal tsha yar lung pa/ mchog ldan lots+tsha ba/ bla ma glo bo pa chen po man 'dra'o// don yod zhags pa'i snying po/ yang don yod zhags pa'i gzungs/ don yod zhags pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs pa'i gzungs/ don yod zhags pa sa bcu pa'i gzungs/ sgo mtha' yas pa'i gzungs/ spyan ras gzigs phyag stong spyan stong dang ldan pa thogs pa med pa'i thugs rje chen po'i sems rgya cher rdzogs pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ de'i cho ga zhib mo/ spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gsang ba'i mdzod thogs pa med pa'i yid bzhin gyi 'khor lo'i snying po zhes bya ba'i gzungs te bdun gyi brgyud pa ni 'og nas 'byung ba'i gzungs 'dus kyi brgyud pa dang 'dra'o// zhal bcu gcig pa'i gzungs kyi brgyud pa ni/ jo bo rje/ nag tsho lots+tsha ba/ rgya lcags ri gong pa/ 'al pa rtsa ri gong pa/ yol chos dbang*/ gnyen ston khug pa/ gnas brtan gzhon seng*/ dbang rin/ kham pa shākya rdo rje/ sangs rgyas sras/ mchog ldan/ glo chen/ bla ma gzhon tshul/ bla ma mgon po 'bum/ bla ma bram chen/ sa bzang paṇa chen man 'dra/ pad+ma cod paṇa dang 'jig rten dbang phyug gi rtog pa gnyis po'i brgyud pa ni/ pad+ma drwa ba dang mtshungs so// kun tu bzang po'i gzungs/

nī la kaṇ+ṭha'i gzungs/ me kha la'i gzungs/ snying rje mi bshol ba'i gzungs/ spyan ras gzigs kyi yum gyi gzungs/ spyan ras gzigs kyi gzungs te drug gi brgyud pa ni/ gzungs 'dus dang 'dra'o/ spyan ras gzigs kyi snying po'i brgyud pa ni/ zhal bcu gcig pa'i gzungs dang 'dra'o// phyag na rdo rje'i rgyud ni gos sngon can gnod sbyin drag po rdo rje me lce'i rgyud le'u bco lnga pa'i brgyud pa ni/ gzungs 'dus dang 'dra'o// rdo rje sa 'og le'u nyer bzhi pa/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas bsgyur ba 'di'i brgyud pa yo ga rdo rje snying po rgyan dang 'dra'o// rdo rje sa 'og le'u bdun pa 'byung po 'dul byed kyi rgyud stong phrag bcu drug pa las ji snyed pa rim par phye ba gnyis pa/ lag na rdo rje go cha'i gzungs/ phyag na rdo rje gos sngon can/ 'jig rten gsum 'dul/ gos sngon can gyi cho ga'am/ rdo rje be con gyi rgyud/ rdo rje be con chen po'i rgyud/ rdo rje bde khros le'u bcu bdun pa ste bdun gyi brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ phyag na rdo rje/ ye shes dbang phyug las kyi rdo rje/ thang lo pa/ shing lo pa/ kar+ṇa ri pa/ wa la tsan+d+ra/ ras chung*/ 'gro sgom/ zangs ri rgya ras/ rlung ring 'bum grags/ sher rgyal/ bya rin chen 'od/ sangs rgyas sras/ mkhan po rgyal bzang dpal/ spang sgang pa chen po/ sa bzang paṇa chen man 'dra/ rdo rje rnam 'joms rgyud kyi brgyud pa ni/ thub pa chen po/ 'jam dbyangs/ dze tā ri/ dgra las rnam rgyal/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung gnyis/ ba ri lots+tsha ba rin chen grags/ sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags rgyal/ sa skya paṇa chen/ chos rgyal 'phags pa/ 'o yug pa bsod seng*/ ri phug pa shākya seng ge bla steng pa dbang rgyal/ sa bzang paṇa chen man 'dra/ rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi bshad rgyud 'phags pa rdo rje ri rab chen po'i rtse mo'i khang pa brtsegs pa'i gzungs/

rdo rje mi pham pa me ltar rmongs byed ces pa'i gzungs/ rdo rje phra mo thogs pa med pa'i gzungs/ lag na rdo rje sa bcu pa'i snying po/ rdo rje mchu'i gzungs/ gnam lcags mchu'i gzungs/ lcags mchu gnyis/ lcags mchu nag po'i gzungs/ sog ma med kyi rtog pa/ sog ma med kyi dam tshig gi rgyud ces bya ba bcu'i brgyud pa ni/ gzungs 'dus dang 'dra'o// gsang sngags kyi spyod pa spyir ston pa/ phyag na rdo rje rig pa mchog gi rgyud chen po'i brgyud pa ni/ thub pa/ 'jam dpal/ dze tā ri/ mya ngan med pa'i dpal/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ don yod rdo rje/ ba ri lots+tsha ba/ mchims brtson seng*/ mchims don ne/ mchims blo brtan/ sangs rgyas 'bum/ mchog ldan/ blo chen/ bla ma gzhon tshul/ bla ma mgon po 'bum/ bram chen po/ sa bzang paṇa chen man 'dra'o/ legs par grub par byed pa'i rgyud chen po las sgrub pa'i thabs kyi rim par phye ba so brgyad pa dang*/ bsam gtan phyi ma dang*/ 'phags pa dpung bzang gis zhus pa'i rgyud le'u bcu gcig pa'i brgyud pa ni/ dpa' bo gcig grub dang 'dra zhing*/ yang lugs gcig la rig pa mchog dang 'dra ba yang yod do// yang khro bo'i rgyud ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi khro bo'i rgyal po mi g.yo ba'i stobs dpag tu med pa rtul phod par 'dul bar gsungs pa'i rtog pa/ mi g.yo ba'i rtog pa dngos grub thams cad 'byung ba/ mi g.yo ba'i gzungs/ mi g.yo ba gsang ba'i rtog pa ste bzhi'i brgyud pa ni/ rig pa mchog dang 'dra zhing*/ rgyud rang the tshom cung zad za bas mkhas pa rnams kyis dpyad par bya bar rigs so// stobs po che/ mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi gzungs/ bdud rtsi thob sbyor gyi snying po sde bzhi'i brgyud pa gzungs 'dus dang 'dra'o// rig pa'i lha mo'i rgyud ni/ sgrol ma las sna tshogs pa'i rgyud sgrol ma phyag 'tshal nyi shu rtsa gcig pa'i brgyud pa ni/

sangs rgyas/ sgrol ma/ kun dga' bo/ nyi ma'i gung pa/ sha na'i gos can/ kṛṣ+ṇa'i gos can/ nyi ma sbas pa/ rā hu la shrī/ bo dhe da shri/ shākya shrī/ lots+tsha ba byams pa'i dpal/ rin chen 'bum/ sangs rgyas 'bum/ mchog ldan pa/ sangs rgyas sras/ mkhan po rgyal bzang dpal man chad 'dra/ sgrol ma'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ sgrol mas dam bcas pa'i gzungs/ 'jigs pa chen po brgyad las sgrol ba'i gzungs/ sgrol ma ku ru kul+le'i rtog pa le'u lnga pa ste bzhi'i brgyud pa ni/ gzungs 'dus dang 'dra'o// stong chen rab 'byams/ rma bya chen mo/ so sor 'brang ma/ bsil pa'i tshal/ gsang sngags rjes su 'dzin pa/ dpal shākya thub pas gsungs pa ngan 'gro thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i gtsug tor rnam rgyal ye shes sde'i 'gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gtsug tor rnam rgyal zhes bya ba'i gzungs rtog pa dang bcas pa ba ri'i 'gyur/ yang rnam rgyal gyi gzungs rtog pa dang bcas ba ri'i 'gyur rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ 'jam dpal/ dze tā ri/ dgra las rnam rgyal/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung gnyis/ ba ri lots+tsha ba/ sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun pa/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po/ bla chen 'phags pa/ glo chen/ bla ma gzhon tshul/ slob dpon mgon po 'bum/ bla ma bram chen/ sa bzang paṇa chen man 'dra'o// rnam rgyal gyi gzungs gzhan gnyis kyang snang na'ang*/ gong gi gnyis po las don logs pa mi ston par 'dug pas gong gi las lung logs su mi dgos sam snyam du bsam mo// gtsug tor gdugs dkar che ba lha yul mar grags pa/ 'od zer can gyi gzungs/ 'od zer can gyi rtog pa gnyis kyi brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa che ba/ bar pa/ chung ba/ ba ri lots+tsha ba/ sa skya pa lnga/ glo chen man chad 'dra'o// kun nas sgor 'jug pa'i 'od zer gtsug tor dri med kyi brgyud pa ni/ glo chen yan chad gtsug tor rnam rgyal dang 'dra zhing*/

des bde ba can pa ye shes mgon/ skyi ston 'jam dbyangs/ chos rje kun mkhyen pa/ sa bzang paṇa chen man 'dra'o// yang gtsug tor gdugs dkar mchog grub ma/ 'od zer 'byung ba'i rgyud stong phrag bcu gnyis pa las 'od zer can gyi rtog pa brgya phrag bdun pa phyung ba rdzogs so zhes pa/ ri khrod lo ma can/ skul byed ma'i gzungs/ dbyig ldan ma'i gzungs/ grags ldan ma'i gzungs/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rgyal ba can/ rgyal ba can gyi gzungs/ sgrol ma mchog lha mo brgyad kyi gzungs/ lha mo sgra dbyangs la bstod pa/ lha mo chen mo dpal lung bstan pa/ 'phags pa dpal chen mo/ dpal gyi lha mo'i mtshan bcu gnyis pa ste/ bcu bzhi po'i brgyud pa ni/ gzungs 'dus dang 'dra'o// bya ba'i rgyud yin yang thams cad dgos pa thun mong gi rgyud dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi cho ga gsang ba spyi rgyud kyi brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ phyag rdor/ rab gsal zla ba/ de'i slob ma lnga ni/ pad dkar ye shes/ kha che dz+nyā na shrī/ rgyal bu sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po/ nyi ma'i snying po/ rgyal rigs sa ra ha'o// de lnga ka las kun dga' snying pos zhus so// de la ta thā ga ta badz+ra/ shrad+dhā ka ra/ lots+tsha ba rin chen bzang po/ lo chung grags mchog shes rab/ sa skya pa lnga/ glo chen/ mkhan po rgyal bzang dpal man chad 'dra'o// yang lugs gcig ni/ sangs rgyas/ phyag na rdo rje/ dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung gnyis/ ba ri lots+tsha ba/ sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ paṇ+ḍi ta/ khang ston/ glo chen man chad sngar dang 'dra'o// rab gnas mdor bsdus kyi brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ byams pa/ gaṅgā dha ra/ sa man+ta bha dra/ kha che dz+nyā na shrī/ gnyal pa nyi she/ gnur nyi she/ gnur nyi ma/ gnur sidha/ glan chos 'byung*/ rtsa skya shag 'bum/ 'dzim pa rin she/ bla ma 'jam dbyangs pa/ bla ma gzhon tshul man chad sngar bzhin no// gar mkhan mchog gi brtag pa snga phyi le'u bcu drug pa'i brgyud pa ni/

phyag na rdo rje/ spyod mdzad chos kyi rdo rje/ kun tu bzang po/ 'gro bzang snying po/ kha che dgon pa ba/ zangs dkar lots+tsha ba/ g.yor po bya ston/ mar 'gro ba rdo rje rtse mo/ mkhas pa kyus ston/ de gsum ka las dge bshes gcur ston bsod nams kyis zhus/ 'jid pa/ pan da ba/ bla ma rin chen gling pa/ mkhan po rgyal bzang dpal/ spang sgang pa chen po/ paṇa chen ma ti/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// //yang

gzungs 'dus sam gzungs 'bum zhes grags pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs la/ 'phags pa nor bu chen po rgyas pa'i zhal med khang shin tu rab tu gnas pa gsang ba dam pa'i gsang ba'i cho ga zhi ba mo'i rgyal po le'u bdun pa/ 'chi med rnga sgra'i gzungs/ tshe dpag med kyi snying po gzungs/ shākya thub pa'i snying po/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi snying po/ rgyal ba'i bla ma'i snying po/ sangs rgyas kyi snying po/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yan lag dang ldan pa/ sangs rgyas bcu gnyis pa/ sangs rgyas bdun pa/ snang ba mtha' yas kyi gzungs/ snang ba mtha' yas rjes su dran pa'i gzungs/ zla 'od kyi mtshan rjes su dran pa'i gzungs/ de bzhin gshegs pa spyi'i snying po rjes su dran pa'i gzungs/ rin chen gtsug tor can gyi mtshan rjes su dran pa/ dri ma med pa'i gzungs/ 'phags pa khyad par can gyi gzungs/ dkyil 'khor brgyad pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug byams pa/ nam mkha'i snying po/ kun tu bzang po/ phyag na rdo rje/ 'jam dpal/ sgrib pa rnam sel/ sa'i snying po rnams kyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa/ spyan ras gzigs mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ byang chub rgyan 'bum bsdus pa/ mchod rten gcig btab pas mchod rten bye ba byas par 'gyur ba'i gzungs/ gsang ba ring bsrel gyi za ma tog 'phags pa yangs pa'i grong khyer du 'jug pa'i mdo/ sangs rgyas kyi chos gsal zhing yangs pa snang brgyad ces bya ba'i mdo/ sgo bzang po/ chos kyi rgya mtsho/ tshigs su bcad pa gnyis pa/ sgo drug pa'i gzungs/ yi ge drug pa'i gzungs/ gser can gyi gzungs/ snying rje mchog gi gzungs/ me tog brtsegs pa'i gzungs/ gzungs chen mo/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan/ sa'i dbang chen mo/ gtsug gi nor bu'i gzungs/ tsan+dan gyi yan lag gi gzungs/

phyir bzlog rgyal ba can gyi gzungs/ mdangs phyir mi 'phrog pa'i gzungs/ gzhan gyis mi thub pa rin po che'i phreng ba/ gzhan gyis mi thub pa mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa/ gdon mi za ba'i gzungs/ gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i rig pa chen mo/ dbang bskur ba/ mig rnam par sbyong ba/ bar chad rnam par sbyong ba/ 'gro lding ba'i rig sngags/ mchod pa'i sprin/ yon tan bsngags pa dpag tu med pa/ chos thams cad kyi yum/ phyir bzlog stobs can/ mdangs phyir 'phrog pa/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo dbugs chen mo/ nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa/ mig nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa/ yang*/ nad rab tu zhi bar byed pa/ rims rab tu zhi bar byed pa/ mig nad rab tu zhi bar byed pa/ 'brum bu'i nad rab tu zhi bar byed pa/ gzhang 'brum rab tu zhi bar byed pa/ chom rkun nam mi rgod rnam par 'joms pa/ bu mang po rton pa zhes pa dang*/ bu mang po so sor 'brang ba/ stong 'gyur ba/ ye shes ta la la/ 'od zer dri ma med pa rnam par dag pa'i 'od ces bya ba'i gzungs/ shes pa thams cad mthar phyin par grub pa'i mchod rten gyi gzungs sam bi ma le u ṣ+ṇī ṣa'i gzungs zhes kyang bya ba/ rten 'brel snying po'i gzungs/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba/ rten 'brel snying po/ rin po che dar ba/ gtsug tor 'bar ba/ sman la sngags kyi btab pa/ bskor ba bya ba gnyis/ yon yongs su sbyong ba gnyis/ thos pa 'dzin pa/ shes rab bskyed pa gnyis/ sh+lau ka brgya lob pa gnyis/ sh+lau ka stong lob pa gsum/ mi brjed pa/ phyag bya ba/ gos brgya thob pa/ pad+ma'i spyan/ ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba/ skran nad zhi ba/ ma zhu ba'i nad 'byang ba/ sdang ba thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa/ sdig pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa/ khro ba rab tu zhi bar byed pa gnyis/ tshig btsan pa/ bdag srung ba/ yid du 'ong ba/ mgrin pa snyan pa/ don thams cad grub pa/ las grub pa/ dug thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa/

bcings pa las grol ba/ bdud skrag par byed pa/ rma 'byor bar byed pa/ me'i zug rngu zhi bar byed pa/ mkhris pa'i nad sel ba/ bad kan gyi nad sel ba/ k+ṣa ya'i nad sel ba/ rims dang srog chags kyis mi tshugs pa/ sman la sngags kyis gdab pa/ mchog thob pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa'i gzungs/ 'phags pa brgyad stong pa'i snying po/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi snying po/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug bzung bar 'gyur ba/ pha rol tu phyin pa bcu thob par 'gyur ba/ tshad med pa bzhi thob par 'gyur ba/ sdong po bkod pa'i snying po/ ting nge 'dzin rgyal po gzung bar 'gyur ba/ so sor 'brang ma chen mo gzung bar 'gyur ba/ sprin chen po/ sprin chen po klu thams cad kyi snying po/ klu'i rgyal po gzi can gyis zhus pa/ tshogs bdag gi snying po/ nor bu bzang po'i gzungs/ de'i snying po/ gza' yum gyi gzungs/ nor rgyun ma'i gzungs/ nor rgyun ma'i rtog pa/ nag po chen po'i gzungs lha mo nag mo'i gzungs/ nag po chen po'i rims nad thams cad las thar bar byed pa/ lha mo nag mo'i bstod pa/ de'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ ro langs bdun pa'i gzungs/ mchil ma dang*/ lud pa dang*/ snabs dang*/ lus kyi dri ma dang*/ dri chen dang*/ dri chu rnams yi dwags la sbyin pa'i gzungs/ rgyud dngos min yang skabs su babs pa ni legs grub las byung ba'i smon lam/ yid bzhin nor bu'i rtog pa las byung ba'i smon lam stong chen rab 'joms/ rma bya chen mo las byung ba'i smon lam dang bden pa'i tshig sbyin pa'i rab byung ba'i smon lam/ yangs pa can gyi bde legs kyi tshigs bcad/ lhas zhus pa'i bde legs kyi tshigs bcad/ bde legs su 'gyur ba'i tshigs bcad/ lhas zhus pa'i bkra shis/ yo ga'i lha sum cu so bdun gyi bkra shis/ sangs rgyas rabs bdun gyi bkra shis/ rigs lnga'i bkra shis/ rigs gsum gyi bkra shis/

dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis/ mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi bkra shis/ bcom ldan 'das kyis khyim bdag des pa la gsungs pa'i bkra shis/ de ltar bya spyod kyi rgyud du gtogs shing*/ gzungs 'dus sam gzungs 'bum du grags pa snga phyi rnams dril bas/ gzungs kyi rnam grangs nyis brgya lhag gcig gi brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ phyag rdor/ dze tā ri/ mya ngan med pa'i dpal/ don yod rdo rje/ ba ri lots+tsha ba rin chen grags/ sa chen kun dga' snying po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ chos rje rin po che/ rgyal tsha chos dbang*/ rong pa sher seng*/ bla ma gzhon tshul/ bla ma mgon po 'bum/ bla ma nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ sa bzang paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// yang na ba ri lots+tsha ba/ sum pa lots+tsha ba/ 'bum lnga lots+tsha ba/ spang khang grags rgyal ba/ grags pa seng ge zhal snga bsod rin/ thar gling pa/ mkhan po gzhon ye/ rong pa sher seng*/ bla ma gzhon tshul/ bla ma bram chen man sngar dang 'dra'o// //phar phyin theg pa'i skor la/ bka' dang bstan bcos gnyis kyi dang po theg pa chen po'i mdo sde sna tshogs kyi skor la/ chos kyi rnam grangs shin tu mang ba'i phyir/ dang po nyid nas lung dang brgyud pa phyogs gcig pa ni med mod/ 'on kyang skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis dka' spyad rgya chen po'i sgo nas bla ma mi 'dra ba so so la zhus te/ rim gyis phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa yin no// de yang*/ rgya gar na/ puṇ+ya shrī dang*/ dz+nyā na shrī/ bod na steng pa lots+tsha ba dang*/ lho pa thams cad mkhyen pa gnyis mdo'i lung mang bar grags shing*/ dus phyis nor bzang gi rnam par thar pa dang mthun par skyes bu dam pa bsten pas bla ma gzhon nu tshul khrims pa nyid lung gi rgya mtsho chen por grags so// de las dpal ldan bla ma dam pa dharma kīrti/ de las paṇa chen ma tis gsan/ de las chos rje sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// bskal pa bzang po/

rgya cher rol pa/ pad dkar/ gser 'od dam pa le'u nyer dgu pa/ gser 'od dam pa mchog tu rnam par rgyal ba le'u nyer gcig pa dang nyer gnyis pa gnyis/ glang po che'i rtsal gyi mdo/ 'jam dpal rnam rol/ 'jam dpal rnam 'phrul/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod yul thabs kyi rnam par 'phrul pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyi ye shes rgyas pa mthar phyin pa'i mdo/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yul la 'jug pa ye shes snang ba'i rgyan/ dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su 'dzin pa/ bzung gi mdo/ khye'u snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pas bstan pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan brjod pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs dgongs pa nges 'grel/ lang kar gshegs pa rgya gar nas bsgyur ba/ lang kar gshegs pa rin po che'i mdo las/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung gi snying po'i le'u 'gos chos grub kyi rgya nag nas bsgyur ba/ ga ya gau ri/ dam chos pad dkar/ snying rje pad dkar/ snying rje chen po pad dkar/ myang 'das/ myang 'das chung ba/ 'da' ka ye shes 'di rgya nag las 'gyur cing*/ the tshom med par dkar chag ldan kar mar bris/ sangs rgyas kyi mdzod 'di dkar chag chen po gsum du mdor mdzad/ kha cig the tshom gyis gzhir 'chad do// rgyan stug po bkod pa bam po bzhi pa yan chad 'gyur ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin rlabs sems la gzigs shing*/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi bkod pa kun tu ston pa/ chos thams cad kyi yon tan bkod pa'i rgyal po/ bde ba can gyi bkod pa/ za ma tog gi bkod pa/ dkon mchog za ma tog dkon mchog 'byung gnas/ rin po che'i mtha'/ gser gyi bye ma lta bu'i mdo/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin mnyam pa nyid rnam par spros pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po/ rab tu zhi ba rnam par nges pa'i cho 'phrul gyi ting nge 'dzin/ sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i ting nge 'dzin/

dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ da ltar gyi sangs rgyas mngon sum du bzhugs pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ bsod nams thams cad bsdus pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin/ khye'u bzhi'i ting nge 'dzin/ ting nge 'dzin mchog dam pa/ 'dus pa chen po rin po che tog gi gzungs/ sgo mtha' yas pa sgrub pa'i gzungs/ sgo drug pa'i gzungs/ rnam par mi rtog pa la 'jug pa'i gzungs/ tshigs su bcad pa gnyis pa/ theg pa chen po la dad pa rab tu bsgom pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying rje chen po bstan pa gzungs kyi dbang phyug rgyal pos zhus pa/ nam mkha' mdzod kyis zhus pa/ rnam par 'phrul pa'i rgyal pos zhus pa/ byams pas zhus pa/ spobs pa'i blo gros kyis zhus pa/ theg pa chen po'i man ngag bu mo rin chen gyis zhus pa/ blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa/ klu'i rgyal po rgya mtsho'i zhus pa che ba/ chung ba/ dge bcu bshad pa/ yang klu'i rgyal po rgya mtshos zhus pa chung ngu sh+lau ka bcu/ spyan ras gzigs kyis zhus pa/ chos bdun pa/ klu'i rgyal po ma dros pas zhus pa/ mi'am ci'i rgyal po ljon pas zhus pa/ tshangs pas zhus pa/ tshangs pas byin gyis zhus pa/ tshangs pa khyad par sems kyis zhus pa/ lha'i bu rab rtsal sems kyis zhus pa/ dpal dbyig gis zhus pa/ rin chen drwa ba can gyis zhus pa/ khye'u rin chen zla bas zhus pa/ bde byed kyis zhus pa/ yul 'khor skyong gis zhus pa/ lha mo dri ma med pa 'od kyis zhus pa/ bram ze mo dpal ldan mas zhus pa/ bgres mos zhus pa/ 'jam dpal gyis zhus pa/ bdag med pas dris pa/ 'jig rten 'dzin gyis yongs su dris pa/ blo gros mi zad pas bstan pa/ dri ma med par grags pas bstan pa/ 'jam dpal gyis bstan pa/ sbyin pa'i phan yon bstan pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa bstan pa/ kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i bden pa bstan pa/ chos thams cad 'byung ba med par bstan pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan dang ye shes bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i yul la 'jug pa bstan pa/

sangs rgyas kyi stobs bskyed pa'i cho 'phrul gyi yul la rnam par 'phrul pa brtan pa/ sangs rgyas kyi chos bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pa/ mar me mdzad kyis lung bstan pa/ tshangs pa'i dpal lung bstan pa/ bud med 'gyur ba lung bstan pa/ bu mo zla mchog lung bstan pa/ lha mo chen mo dpal lung bstan pa/ bde ldan ma lung bstan pa/ rgyal ba'i blo gros kyis zhus pa/ spyan ras gzigs kyi mdo/ 'jam dpal gnas pa/ byams pa bdud rtsi brjod pa/ byams pa 'jug pa/ 'jig rten dang rjes su mthun par 'jug pa/ dad pa'i stobs bskyed pa la 'jug pa phyag rgya'i mdo/ nges pa dang ma nges par 'gro ba'i phyag rgya la 'jug pa/ mar me 'bul ba/ chos kyi phyag rgya/ grong khyer gyis 'tsho ba'i mdo/ zas kyis 'tsho ba yongs su dag pa'i mdo/ sgra chen po seng ge sgra sgrogs pa/ sā lu ljang pa/ rten cing 'brel pa 'byung ba bstan pa/ rten cing 'brel pa 'byung ba dang po dang rnam par dbye ba bstan pa/ 'di theg pa chung ngur grags kyang dbyig gnyen gyi 'grel par rnam shes tshogs brgyad dang*/ rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs min la sogs pa bstan pa'i phyir theg pa thun mong du 'thad do// sor mo'i phreng ba la phan pa/ ma skyes dgra'i 'gyod pa bsal ba/ dpal sbas kyi mdo/ las kyi sgrib pa rnam par dag pa/ las kyi sgrib pa rgyun gcod pa/ sangs rgyas kyi sde snod tshul khrims 'chal ba tshar gcod pa/ rgyal po la gdams pa/ rnga bo che chen po'i le'u sum cu so gsum pa'i le'u/ lhag pa'i bsam pa bstan pa'i le'u/ chos yang dag par sdud pa/ rnam par 'thag pa thams cad bsdus pa/ sangs rgyas 'gro ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'gro ba/ chos kun 'gro ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa dpal gyi dam tshig dkon mchog sprin/ sprin chen po/ sprin chen po las phyogs bcu'i byang chub sems dpa'i rgya mtsho 'dus pa'i dga' ston chen po la rnam par rtse ba'i le'u/

sprin chen po rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi le'u/ sprin chen po'i mdo/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor las sprin chen po'i le'u bam po phyed dang gsum byas pa/ char dbab pa'i le'u drug cu rtsa bzhi pa/ 'di sprin chen po chung ngu sh+lau ka brgya nyi shu pa dang gcig mi gcig dpyad/ bcom ldan 'das kyi gtsug tor chen mo'i mdo/ 'di bka' yin min the tshom gyi gzhir klu mes dbang phyug grags 'chad/ gtsug tor bam po dgu pa las bdud kyi le'u nye tshe phyung ba/ 'di dkar chag snga ma gsum gar bkar bshad do// sa'i snying po 'khor lo bcu pa/ phyir mi ldog pa'i 'khor lo/ ting nge 'dzin gyi 'khor lo/ bsngo ba'i 'khor lo/ chos kyi rgyal po'i mdo/ 'di dang ting nge 'dzin gyi mchog dam pa gnyis dkar chag snga ma gsum gar mdor mdzad do// chos kyi tshul/ chos kyi phung po/ don dam pa'i chos kyi rnam par rgyal ba/ chos dang don dam pa rnam par 'byed pa/ byang chub sems dpa' so sor thar pa'i chos bzhi sgrub pa/ chos bzhi bstan pa/ chos bzhi pa/ chos bzhi ma btang ba/ bzhi pa sgrub pa/ chos gsum pa/ chos kyi rgya mtsho/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ chos kyi rgyal mo/ nyi ma'i snying po/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po/ yi ge med pa'i za ma tog rnam par snang mdzad kyi snying po/ nam mkha'i snying po/ yang dag pa'i spyod pa'i tshul nam mkha' mdog gi 'dul ba'i bzod pa/ thabs la mkhas pa theg pa chen po/ sangs rgyas kyi mtshan lnga stong bzhi brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum pa/ thar pa chen po phyogs su rgyas pa 'gyod tshangs kyi sdig sbyangs te sangs rgyas su grub pa rnam par bkod pa/ rtog pa chen po yongs su rgyas pa'i mdo las mtshan brjod pa'i yon tan gyi gleng gzhi me tog gi tshogs/ dpang skong phyag brgya pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyal po/ phyogs bcu'i mun sel/ sangs rgyas bdun pa/ sangs rgyas brgyad pa/ sangs rgyas bcu gnyis pa/

sangs rgyas kyi dbu rgyan/ sangs rgyas kyi sa/ sangs rgyas mi spong ba/ dkyil 'khor brgyad pa'i mdo sde/ bkra shis brgyad pa/ dkon mchog rjes su dran pa/ bslab pa gsum gyi mdo/ sku gsum gyi mdo/ phung po gsum pa'i mdo/ byang chub kyi ltung ba bshags pa/ 'di nye bar 'khor gyis zhus pa las 'byung ba yin/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi sngon gyi smon lam gyi khyad par rgyas pa sh+lau ka brgyad brgya pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa sman gyi bla baiḍūr+ya 'od kyi rgyal po'i sngon gyi smon lam gyi khyad par rgyas pa/ gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba'i mdo/ srid pa 'pho ba'i mdo/ mya ngan las 'das pa chen po'i mdo rgya nag las 'gyur ba bam po lnga bcu rtsa drug pa mu stegs kyi rgyal po bad sa las gdung ma thob pa yan chad tshang ba/ ri'i kun dga' bo'i mdo/ klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang nye dga' bo btul ba'i mdo/ 'od srungs chen po'i mdo/ nyi ma'i mdo/ bkra shis chen po'i mdo/ byams pa'i mdo/ byams pa bsgom pa'i mdo/ bslab pa lnga'i phan yon gyi mdo/ chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor ba'i mdo/ skyes pa rabs kyi gleng gzhi'i mdo/ lcang lo can gyi pho brang gi mdo/ mdo chen po stong pa nyid chen po/ bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis la dgongs pa'i rgyud kyi phreng ba chen po las yongs su bsngo ba chen po'i rgyal po/ yongs su bsngo ba'i rgyal po chen po sngags dang bcas pa mjug cung zad ma tshang ba/ bsam pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'i bsngo ba/ 'gro ba thams cad yongs su skyob par byed pa'i bsngo ba/ bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam gyi rgyal po/ byams pa'i smon lam/ mchog gi spyod pa'i smon lam/ rgyal po gser gyi lag pa'i mar me'i smon lam/ rgya che rol pa bshags pa'i le'u nas 'byung ba'i smon lam/ rgya cher rol pa nas 'byung ba'i tshong dpon ga gon dang bzang po la gsungs pa'i shis pa brjod pa'i tshigs su bcad pa/

sangs rgyas phal po che las 'byung ba'i bcom ldan 'das la brgya byin gyis bstod pa'i bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa/ bcom ldan 'das la lha'i rgyal po rab mtshe mas bstod pa'i bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa/ bcom ldan 'das la lha'i rgyal po rab dga' ldan gyis bstod pa'i bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad do// gang pos zhus pa dang*/ glog thob kyis zhus pa dang*/ rin po che'i phung po dang*/ sangs rgyas bcu pa rnams dkon mchog brtsegs pa'i le'u yin pas mdo sna tshogs su mi bgrang zhing*/ gzhan yang phal chen dang*/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa la sogs pa mdo che ba rnams kyi nang nas 'byung ba'i mdo chung ba rnams ni de dag nyid du 'dus pas lung dang brgyud yig zur pa mi dgos so// de ltar brjod bya gtso cher ston pa'i dbang du byas nas phye ba ni/ gzhan dag la'ang shes par bya zhing*/ 'khor lo gong ma don dam rnam par nges pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs mdo sde sna tshogs pa nyis brgya dang bcu gcig gi brgyud pa/ yang dgon pa kun dga' 'od zer la rgyud chen la brgyud pa dag po yod zer ba ni/ sangs rgyas/ kun dga' bo/ dgra bcom pa rak+ṣi ta/ dgra bcom pa kṛṣ+ṇa'i gos can/ dgra bcom pa sha na'i gos can/ dgra bcom pa nyi ma'i gung pa/ rgyal rigs thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen/ klu sgrub/ ār+ya de ba/ 'jam dpal grags pa/ dharma ā ka ra shān+ti/ rdo rje gdan pa che ba/ bar pa/ chung ba/ paṇa chen shākya shrī/ lho pa thams cad mkhyen pa/ kong nag ral gri/ jo gdan zas gtsang*/ shangs pa grags seng*/ zhal snga ba bsod rin/ mkhan po gzhon nu ye shes/ se ston 'byung ldan/ mang mkhar byang sems/ bla ma kun dga' 'od zer/ bla ma gzhon nu tshul khrims pa/ bla ma dharma kīrti/ paṇ+ḍi ta ma ti dhā dza shrī bha dra/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// lugs gcig ni paṇa chen shākya shrī yan chad 'dra la/ de nas dpyal chos bzang*/ dpyal pad+ma can/

mkhan po gzhon nu ye shes/ rong pa shes rab seng ge bla ma gzhon tshul ba'o// yang lugs gcig la/ kong nag ral gri yan chad 'dra la/ de nas shangs grags seng*/ zhal snga ba bsod rin/ dpyal thar gling pa gzhon nu ye shes/ se ston 'byung ldan/ shes rab dpal/ dge slong kun nyi/ bla ma gzhon nu tshul khrims pa rnams so// yang stag ston shes rab 'od zer la/ bla ma chos kyi rgyal po'i gsung gis mdo mangs kyi lung dag pa gcig tshol gsungs nas btsal bas/ mnga' bdag nyang nas brgyud pa dag po gcig shangs pa grags seng la yod pa thos nas/ de la stag ston shes rab 'od zer gyis gsan/ de las glo chen gyis mdo phyed dang sum brgya tsam gsan pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ byams pa/ thogs med/ dbyig gnyen/ sangs rgyas skyong*/ sangs rgyas ye shes/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ dri med sbas pa/ rin chen rdo rje/ dharmā ka ra shān+ti/ de las dz+nyā na shrī dang*/ puṇ+ya shrī gnyis kas gsan/ de gnyis ka las paṇ+ḍi ta su ma ti kīrtis gsan/ de nas rim par brgyud de/ rong ston chos kyi bzang po/ mnga' bdag nyang rin chen bzang po/ mnga' bdag nyang ral/ lho pa thams cad mkhyen pa/ spang sgang pa grags rgyal/ shangs pa grags seng*/ stag ston shes rab 'od zer/ glo chen sangs rgyas sras/ bla ma gzhon tshul ba rnams so// yang rngog lo'i bu chen gro lung pa chen pos/ steng pa lots+tsha ba rgya gar du mdo mang gi lung tshol du btang nas gsan pa 'di lta ste/ mdo'i rnam grangs mi 'dra ba sum brgya so brgyad tsam gyi brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ 'jam dbyangs/ klu sgrub/ ār+ya de ba/ 'jam dpal grags pa/ rat+na ā ka ra shān+ti/ se'u ri pa/ a bha yā ka ra/ dge ba'i 'byung gnas sbas pa/ rdo rje gdan pa/ bar pa/ chung ba/ puṇ+ya shrī/ steng pa lots+tsha ba/ so thams cad mkhyen pa/ so 'dzam gling rgyan/ lho pa thams cad mkhyen pa/ kong nag ral gri/ shangs pa grags seng*/ zhang kun dga' 'bum/

phag khur dkon ye/ phag khur dkon bla/ de gnyis ka las bla ma gzhon tshul bas gsan no// yang*/ thar los bsgyur ba'i mdo bcu gsum gyi brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ 'jam dpal/ ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ sman zhabs/ rgyal bas byin/ rat+na shrī/ shān+ti badz+ra/ karma badz+ra/ puṇ+ya shrī/ dza ya shrī/ bi dza ya rak+ṣa/ thar lo nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ phag khur dkon bla/ bla ma gzhon nu tshul khrims/ bla ma dharma kīrti/ chos rje ma ti paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// yang mchod rten bskor ba'i tshigs su bcad pa/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa'i mdo/ rgyal po gzugs can snying po la gdams pa/ bad sa la'i rgyal po 'char byed la gdams pa rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ jo bo rje/ nag tsho lots+tsha ba/ pu to ba/ sha ra ba/ bya yul ba/ mus sman pa/ snar thang pa yab sras rnams/ byang chen pa/ bla ma gzhon nu tshul khrims/ kun spangs chos grags dpal bzang po/ chos rje blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros/ des bdag kun dga' bzang po la'o// de ltar brgyud pa mi 'dra ba'i mdo rnams kyi mtshan tha dad du bris pa'ang snang mod/ phal cher zlos nas bris par snang zhing*/ yid ches shing khungs btsun par bya ba'i phyir yin la/ 'dir ni mdo'i mtshan rnams ma chad cing*/ brgyud lugs so so'i rgyu mtshan rnams dang*/ brgyud pa rnams ma chad pas don 'grub par bsams te/ 'khor lo dang po ste mchog tu gyur pa'i khongs su gtogs pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs rnams dang*/ 'khor lo tha mar gtogs pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs kyi mtshan rnams zin par bya ste/ de rnams kyi brgyud pa'ang mdo dang brgyud lugs phal cher mthun pa rnams phyogs gcig tu byas te zlos pa ma bris la/ so so nas brgyud tshul mi 'dra ba ni/ rgyu ston pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po/ lam ston pa la thabs kyi cha ston pa gsang chen thabs la mkhas pa/ shes rab kyi cha ston pa ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po/

sa lam ston pa mdo sde sa bcu pa/ 'bras bu ston pa sangs rgyas kyi sa ste/ zab mo mdo lnga'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ 'jam dbyangs/ paṇ+ḍi ta chen po rat+na ka ra shān+ti pa/ bal po paṇ+ḍi ta shā na ta bha dra/ lots+tsha ba seng ge kar shākya 'od/ khyung po grags seng*/ she'u dgon pa ba/ byang 'chad dkon she mang dkar tsha lung gi stod ston dkon mchog skyabs/ glang nga ri'i brda ston bsod nams yon tan/ se mo ra ba grub thob yon tan dpal/ bla ma dam pa chos rgyal 'phags pa/ gnur ye shes rgyal mtshan/ bla ma gzhon tshul/ bla ma dharma kīrti shrī bha dra/ paṇa chen ma ti/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// rgyan stug po bkod pa/ dgongs 'grel/ gser 'od sa bcu pa/ lang kar gshegs pa ste/ sems tsam mdo lnga dang*/ rgya cher rol pa/ mya ngan 'das chen/ sprin chen/ sprin chen mdo las dga' ston la brtse ba/ chos yang dag par sdud pa/ 'di chos 'gro ba dang gcig zer/ sangs rgyas 'gro ba/ dkon mchog sprin/ theg chen man ngag ye shes snang ba rgyan/ rin chen drwa ba can gyis zhus pa/ rdo rje snying po'i gzungs/ byang sems so thar bzhi pa bsgrub pa/ seng ge'i sgra sgrogs pa/ dpal sbas/ nges pa dang*/ ma nges pa'i phyag rgya la 'jug pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyi ye shes rgyas pa mthar phyin pa/ snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ spyan ras gzigs zhes bya ba'i mdo/ byang sems kyi spyod yul thabs kyi rnam 'phrul bstan pa'i mdo/ dkon mchog 'byung gnas dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs 'dzin/ bskal bzang*/ bdud rtsi brjod pa ste/ nyer bdun gyi brgyud pa ni/ byams pa/ thogs med/ dbyig gnyen/ rnam grol sde/ seng bzang*/ ye shes zhabs/ shān+ti pa/ puṇ+ya shrī/ steng pa lots+tsha ba tshul khrims 'byung gnas/ khyung po grags she/ lha rje grags skyobs/ so ma shrī bha dra/ 'or ston/ chos seng*/ ston chos/ dbus pa sangs rgyas 'bum/ mchog ldan/ ra sa ston shag bla ma gzhon tshul ba/

bla ma dharma kīrti/ paṇa chen ma ti/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// 'jam dpal rnam rol/ 'jam dpal gnas pa/ 'jam dpal gyis dris pa/ nam mkha' mdzod kyis zhus pa/ rtog chen/ bzang spyod/ ljon shing*/ las dge sdig bstan pa/ rin chen zla bas zhus pa/ blo gros bzang mos zhus pa/ tshangs byin gyis zhus pa/ bsam pa yongs rdzogs/ dus ldan mas zhus pa/ seng ges zhus pa/ bdag med mas dris pa/ bzhi pa sgrub pa/ 'jig rten gyi rjes su mthun par sgrub pa/ dga' ba can gyi mdo/ bde ba can gyi bkod pa/ 'jam dpal rnam 'phrul/ 'jam dpal gyis bstan pa/ lhag bsam bstan pa/ rin chen mtha'/ sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i le'u/ kun rdzob dang don dam pa bstan pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan dang ye shes bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i yul la 'jug pa/ 'jig rten 'dzin gyis dris pa/ rab rtsal sems kyis zhus pa/ dam pa'i chos kyi rgyal po/ rgyal po la gdams pa/ dri ma med par grags pas bstan pa ste/ so gcig gi brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ 'jam dpal/ klu sgrub/ klu'i byang chub/ ḍom+bi pa/ 'jam dpal grags pa/ se'u ri pa/ rdo rje gdan pa che ba/ bar pa/ chung ba/ so ma shrī bha dra/ rwa hu la bha dra/ bi ma la shrī/ bhe na dha shrī/ paṇa chen shākya shrī/ khro phu lots+tsha ba/ lho pa thams cad mkhyen pa/ spang sgang pa grags rgyal/ shangs pa grags seng*/ zhal snga ba bsod rin/ thar gling ba gzhon ye/ shes rab dpal/ dge slong kun nyi/ bla ma gzhon tshul/ bla ma dharma kīrti/ chos rje paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// gzugs can snying pos bsu ba/ gser gyi bye ma lta bu/ dga' bo rab byung*/ bkra shis brgyad pa/ thar pa chen po phyogs su rgyas pa/ 'gyod tshangs kyi sdig pa sbyangs te sangs rgyas su grub pa/ dran pa nyer gzhag tshe'i mtha'i mdo/ byams pas zhus pa/ ga ya go ri/ rmad du byung ba/ sgra chen po/ spobs pa'i blo gros kyis zhus pa/ rgyal mtshan mchog

chos dang don rnam 'byed/ don rnam par nges pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs/ ta thā ga ta'i snying po/ bde legs kyi tshigs bcad de bcu bdun gyi brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ spyan ras gzigs/ byams pa/ gser gling pa/ jo bo rje/ nag tsho/ pu to ba/ sha ra ba/ bya yul ba/ mus sman pa/ mchims pa/ byang chen pa bsod nams 'phel ba/ bla ma gzhon tshul/ bla ma dharma kīrti/ paṇa chen ma ti/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// mdo pad dkar rnam gsum/ sangs rgyas kyi mtshan lnga stong bzhi brgya pa/ nyi ma'i snying po/ gzungs kyi dbang phyug rgyal pos zhus pa/ ye shes snang ba rgyan/ bu mo rin chen gyis zhus pa/ sangs rgyas 'gro ba/ lha mo dri med 'od kyis zhus pa/ mchog gi spyod pa'i smon lam/ kun tu rgyu ba dang kun tu rgyu ba ma yin pa/ mdo chen po 'dus pa/ gser mdog gi sngon gyi sbyor ba/ zas kyis 'tsho ba/ 'da' ka ye shes/ srid pa 'pho ba/ kun la'i rtogs brjod/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i dpal gyi dam tshig khams mang po/ tshul khrims yang dag par ldan pa/ chos bzhi pa/ chos bzhi bstan pa'am chos bzhi mi btang ba yang zer/ rgyal po kun tu dgas zhus pa/ phag mo'i rtogs brjod/ 'khar gsil/ sbyin pa'i phan yon bstan pa/ don rgyas pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs/ gzhon nu'i dpe/ dgongs pa'i rgyud kyi phreng ba/ yongs su bsngo ba'i 'khor lo/ dpal dbyig gis zhus pa/ sangs rgyas mi spang ba/ lnga gsum pa/ sgyu ma'i drwa ba/ rgyal mtshan dam pa/ yul 'khor skyong*/ rnam par 'phrul ba'i rgyal po/ chos kyi tshul/ chos kyi rgya mtsho/ mdzangs blun/ phyogs bcu mun sel/ dkon mchog za ma tog sangs rgyas kyis/ sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin/ ting nge 'dzin mchog dam pa/ tshangs pas zhus pa/ byams pa lung bstan/ grong khyer gyis 'tsho ba/ lha'i mdo/ sangs rgyas bcu pa/ gaṇ+ḍi'i mdo/ mi rtag pa nyid kyi mdo/ bcom ldan 'das kyi gtsug tor chen po/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsang ba sgrub pa mngon par thob pa'i rgyud/

byang sems spyod pa dpa' bar 'gro ba ste lnga bcu nga bzhi'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ byams pa/ klu sgrub/ skal ldan grags/ zla grags/ chos grags/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ zhi ba'i bshes gnyen/ dz+nyā na shrī/ gnyan lots+tsha ba/ khyung po grags she/ 'or ston lha dbang*/ so chos she/ zhang dar seng*/ chos mgon sangs rgyas 'bum/ mchog ldan/ bla ma gzhon tshul/ bla ma dharma kīrti/ paṇa chen ma ti/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// mdo sde mig bcu gnyis pa/ stag rna'i rtogs pa brjod pa/ drang srong gargas ltas bstan pa/ 'phags pa byā ka ra ṇa'i nang nas byung ba/ gza' dang rgyu skar gyi rang bzhin bstan pa/ zla ba'i khyim rgyu skar gyi rtsa ba mdo sde las byung ba/ glang ru lung bstan pa/ bsod nams bsdus pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ yul 'khor skyong gis zhus pa/ gang po la sogs pa'i rtogs brjod/ las rnam par 'byed pa/ 'di las kyi rnam par 'gyur ba bsdus pa dang gcig tshangs pa'i dpal lung bstan pa/ sbyin pa'i legs pa/ las brgya pa/ ched du brjod pa'i tshoms/ za ma tog bkod pa/ yi ge med pa'i za ma tog mar me mdzad kyis lung bstan pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'gro ba/ sangs rgyas kyi sde snod tshul khrims 'chal pa tshar gcod pa/ dad pa'i stobs bskyed pa/ nam mkha' mdzod kyis zhus pa/ tshangs pa khyad par sems kyis zhus pa/ ta thā ga ta'i gzugs brnyan bzhag pa'i phan yon/ sen ring gis zhus pa/ rten 'brel gyi mdo/ sangs rgyas kyi rtogs brjod/ shes ldan gyi mdo/ phyir mi ldog pa'i 'khor lo'i mdo/ chos kyi phyag rgya'i mdo/ bgres mos zhus pa/ theg chen la dad pa bsgom pa/ sbyin pa'i phar phyin/ mi'am ci'i rgyal po ljon pas zhus pa/ yang dag par spyod pa'i tshul/ nam mkha' mdog gi 'dul ba bzod pa'i mdo/ bsod nams stobs kyi rtogs brjod/ rgyu gdags pa/ rgyal bu don grub kyi mdo/ mngon par 'byung ba'i mdo/ mdo chen po stong pa nyid/

mdo chen po stong pa nyid chen po/ blo gros mi zad pas bstan pa/ drin lan bsabs pa/ gsal rgyal gyi tshigs bcad/ me tog gi tshoms/ las kyi sgrib pa rgyun gcod/ don dam pa'i chos kyi rnam par rgyal ba/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa bstan pa/ rnam par 'thag pa thams cad bsdus pa/ bud med 'gyur ba lung bstan pa/ zla mchog lung bstan pa/ mar me 'bul ba/ glang po'i rtsal lta bu'i mdo/ sangs rgyas kyi dbu rgyan/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i ting nge 'dzin/ chos kun 'gro ba/ sā lu ljang ba/ chos kyi phung po/ blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa/ ma dros pas zhus pa/ sa'i snying po 'khor lo bcu pa/ khye'u bzhi'i ting nge 'dzin/ ma skyes dgra'i 'gyod pa bsal ba/ klu'i rgyal po rgya mtshos zhus pa/ rgya mtshos zhus pa chung ba/ rkang ga'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la zung gi yang zer/ las kyi sgrib pa rnam par dag pa/ dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ rab tu zhi ba rnam par nges pa'i cho 'phrul gyi ting nge 'dzin/ rnga bo che chen po'i mdo/ da ltar gyi sangs rgyas mngon sum du bzhugs pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ 'phags pa chos bzhi pa/ gnas 'jog skyes bu dam pa'i mdo/ bsam gyis mi khyab rgyal po'i mdo/ chos thams cad 'byung ba med par bstan pa/ phar phyin drug bstan pa/ spyod yul yongs su dag pa ste/ mdo don lnga'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ 'jam dpal/ ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ sman zhabs/ rgyal bas byin/ rat+na shrī/ shān+ti badz+ra/ karma badz+ra/ puṇ+ya shrī/ badz+ra rak+ṣi ta/ thar lo nyi rgyal/ phag 'gur dkon bla/ bla ma gzhon tshul/ bla ma dharma kīrti/ paṇa chen ma ti/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// rgya nag las 'gyur ba'i sangs rgyas phal po che/ mya ngan 'das chen/ gtsug tor bam dgu las bdud kyi las nyi tshe phyung ba'i le'u dang po/ le'u gnyis pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyi gtsug tor chen po'i mdo las bam po gnyis pa/

gser 'od dam chen le'u so gcig pa/ thabs la mkhas pa/ drin lan bsabs pa bam po bdun/ tshe dpag med rgyas pa/ lang kar gshegs pa rin po che'i mdo las sangs rgyas kyi gsung gi snying po/ 'di lang gshegs rgya nag 'gyur du grags pa de yin/ ri bo chen po'i mdo/ 'od zer can gyi mdo rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ 'jam dbyangs/ klu sgrub/ byang chub bzang po/ 'jam dbyangs sprul pa/ rgya nag zhu zhun/ gyim btsun ja/ tan zhing du go zhi/ tshang lang go zhi/ ha thi tha/ go chen kyin/ sing ka lang*/ gyang chu/ lots+tsha ba mchog ldan/ ra sa ston shaka bla ma gzhon tshul/ bla ma dharma kīrti/ paṇa chen ma ti/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// yang 'khon spyil phu ba/ stag ston shes rab 'od zer la/ bla ma chos kyi rgyal po'i gsung gis mdo mang gi lung dag pa gcig tshol gsungs nas btsal ba ni/ shangs pa grags seng la/ mnga' bdag nyang la brgyud pa dag par yod pa gsan nas blangs pa de/ bla ma blo chen las yod pa gsan pa'i mdo grangs ni/ bstod pa dgu the ba'i mdo nyis brgya dang nyer lnga'i steng du/ gser 'od dam pa/ bklag pa tshe'i mdo/ byams pas dam bcas pa/ rdo 'phang ba/ 'jig rten gyi chos kyi yi ge mauṅgal gyi mdo/ mdzod dang 'jig rten brjod pa'i mdo/ bar mtshams ma las par 'gro ba'i mdo/ klu'i rgyal po rnga sgra'i tshigs bcad/ chos kyi rgyal po/ dgra bcom pa dge 'dun 'phel lung bstan pa/ sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i ting nge 'dzin rgya mtsho/ 'jig rten bzhag pa/ nor bu rin po che thabs la mkhas pa/ tshangs pa'i drwa ba/ byams pas zhus pa/ rnam par mi rtog pa la 'jug pa'i gzungs/ byang chub kyi phyogs bstan pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ phyag 'tshal ba'i bstod pa/ sangs rgyas kyi stobs bskyed pa'i cho 'phrul bstan pa/ rgyal ba'i blo gros kyis zhus pa/ gnam du skye ba blangs pa'i mdo/ sangs rgyas rjes dran gyi mdo/

li yul lung bstan pa/ theg chen chos kyi mdzod/ rten 'brel 'byung ba'i dang po dang rnam dbye bstan pa/ sangs rgyas dbang bskur ba'i bstod pa/ las gdags pa/ byams pa dga' ldan tu skye ba blangs pa'i mdo/ dam chos dran pa nyer gzhag gi tshig le'ur byas pa/ ljon shing*/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan bsngo ba/ mtshan mo bzang po/ gsung gi snying po zhes bya ba'i le'u/ thabs la mkhas pa chen po'i mdo/ nor bu rin po che thabs la mkhas pa bsngo ba'i rgyal po/ sangs rgyas mdzod kyi chos kyi yi ge shes pa mthar phyin pa grub pa'i mchod rten gyi gzungs/ ting nge 'dzin mchog dam pa/ theg chen gcig tu bstan pa/ don dam sgrub pa'i le'u/ chos bdun pa'i mdo/ spyan ras gzigs kyis zhus pa'i chos bdun pa/ yon tan mdo sde rnam par gdon mi za ba'i mdo/ las bde ba/ don thob pa/ yongs su gdams pa theg pa chen po'i rgya mtsho/ mauṅgal gyi ma dmyal ba nas drangs pa/ chos thams cad kyis yon tan bskyed pa/ spyan ras gzigs kyis zhus pa'i mdo sde zhe drug dang bcas pa dril bas nyis brgya don gcig gi brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ byams pa/ thogs med/ dbyig gnyen/ sangs rgyas skyong*/ sangs rgyas ye shes/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ dri med sbas pa/ rin chen rdo rje/ dharmā ka ra shān+ti/ de las paṇ+ḍi ta dz+nyā na shrī dang*/ jo bo puṇ+ya gnyis kyis gsan/ brgyud pa de las gyes pa dag ces smra'o// de gnyis ka las paṇ+ḍi ta su ma ti kīrti/ smṛ ti dz+nyā na kīrti/ rong zom chos bzang*/ mnga' bdag nyang ting nge 'dzin bzang po/ mnga' bdag nyang ral/ lho pa thams cad mkhyen pa/ spang sgang ba grags rgyal/ shangs pa grags seng*/ ga ston shes rab 'od zer/ glo chen sangs rgyas sras/ bla ma gzhon tshul/ bla ma dharma kīrti/ paṇa chen ma ti/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// yang rngog lo'i bu chen gro lung pa chos rjes/ steng pa lots+tsha ba rgya gar du btang nas/

bye brag bshad mdzod dang*/ skyes rabs dpag bsam 'khri shing la sogs pa sngar ma 'gyur ba rnams dang*/ khyad par mdo mang gi lung tshang ba cig tshol gsungs nas/ steng los/ dz+nyā na shrī dang*/ puṇ+ya shrī gnyis la mdo sum brgya so dgu'i lung yod/ gnyis po yang puṇ+ya shrīs mang zer nas/ de las steng pa lots+tshas gsan/ de las lho pa thams cad mkhyen pas gsan/ sngar mdo mang gi lung yod kyang yid ches bskyed pa'i phyir du bskyar nas gsan pa'i brgyud pa phag 'gur ba la yod pa/ bla ma gzhon tshul bas gsan pa'i mdo grangs ni/ sngar gyi nyis brgya don gcig pa'i steng du/ khang bu brtsegs pa/ ye shes can gyi mdo/ ye shes pad dkar/ bkod pa'i rgyal po/ tshe 'pho ba ji ltar 'gyur ba lung bstan pa/ zla ba'i mdo/ dkon mchog ta la la/ 'gro ba thams cad skyob pa bsngo ba'i mdo/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi bkod pa kun tu ston pa/ dkyil 'khor brgyad pa/ gnas brtan spyan drangs pa/ ba tsha'i chu klung gi mdo/ 'phags pa gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba/ sangs rgyas brgyad pa'i mdo/ sangs rgyas bcu gnyis pa'i mdo/ chos gsum pa'i mdo/ pha ma'i mdo/ dge slong la gces pa'i mdo/ ltung ba sde lnga'i dge sdig gi 'bras bu bstan pa/ rnam par grol ba'i mdo/ sbyangs pa'i yon tan gyi mdo/ sil 'chang ba'i mdo/ gaṇ+ḍi'i dus kyi mdo/ sher phyin zla ba'i snying po/ kun tu bzang po/ phyag na rdo rje/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi mdo/ chos nyid rang gi ngo bo nyid las mi g.yo ba'i mdo/ sgyu ma yin pa dang mthun pa'i mdo/ dpal chen po'i mdo/ gsang ba ring bsrel gyi za ma tog don dam pa'i chos kyi rnam par rgyal ba'i mdo/ chos thams cad kyi yon tan bkod pa'i rgyal po/ bden bzhi'i 'khor lo/ bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung chems/ gser mdog gi rtogs brjod/ dpal sde'i rtogs brjod/ ma ga dhā bzang mo'i rtogs brjod/ rin chen phung po'i mdo/

'jig rten las 'das pa'i mdo/ 'di phal chen gyi yin zer zhing bzhi bcu zhe gsum dang bcas pas sum brgya bcu bzhi dang*/ yang ga gon bzang po'i bkra shis/ rab dga' ldan gyi bstod pa'i bkra shis/ sangs rgyas nyid kyis gsungs pa'i bkra shis/ sangs rgyas rabs bdun gyi bkra shis/ bkra shis drug pa/ mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi bkra shis/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis/ klu sgrub kyi bkra shis/ bkra shis brgyad pa ste/ bkra shis dgu dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ 'jam dpal/ klu sgrub/ ār+ya de wa/ 'jam dpal grags pa/ rat+na ā ka ra shān+ti/ se'u ri pa/ a bha yā ka ra/ dge ba'i 'byung gnas sbas pa/ rdo rje gdan pa che ba/ bar pa/ chung ba/ puṇ+ya shrī/ steng lo/ so thams cad mkhyen pa/ so 'dzam gling rgyan/ lho pa thams cad mkhyen pa/ kong nag ral gri/ grags seng*/ zhang kun dga' 'bum/ phag 'gur dkon ye/ dkon bla/ bla ma gzhon tshul/ bla ma dharma kīrti/ paṇa chen ma ti/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// yang pad dkar gsum/ bskal bzang*/ rgya cher rol pa/ gser 'od le'u nyer dgu pa/ mchog tu rnam par rgyal ba/ glang po'i rtsal gyi mdo/ lha'i mdo nyung ngu*/ bzang spyod/ de'i 'grel pa/ chos kyi rgya mtsho/ bslab gsum bstan pa/ myang 'das chung ba/ sgrol ma'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ gnod 'dzin gyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ mun nag gi nags tshal gyi sgo zhes bya ba/ thar pa chen po'i phyogs su rgyas pa'i mdo la sogs pa mang po gsan pa'i brgyud pa ni/ phag 'gur ba'o// rin po che tog gi brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ phyag rdor/ dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa che ba/ chung ba/ ba ri lots+tsha ba/ gnyen ston grags rgyal/ dkon seng*/ de'i sras rngog sangs rgyas 'bum/ mchog ldan bla ma gzhon tshul/ bla ma dharma kīrti/ paṇa chen ma ti/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la bstod par bsngags pa las bstod par mi 'gyur bar bstod pa/

phyag 'tshal ba'i bstod pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid grub par bstod pa/ stobs dang mi 'jigs pa la bstod pa/ gsung rnam par dag pa la bstod pa/ rtsod pa mi mnga' bar bstod pa/ tshangs pa dang mthun par gsungs par bstod pa/ phan pa mdzad par bstod pa/ lan mi ldon par bstod pa/ sku'i phyogs gcig la bstod pa/ ljags la bstod pa rnams ma ti tsi tras mdzad cing*/ 'di rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ mdo nyis brgya dgu tsam yod pa'i brgyud pa dang gcig ces gsung bar snang*/ 'di rnams mdzad pa po la thug pa'i brgyud pa dag pa cig logs su byung na 'thad par mngon zhing*/ sngar gyi mdo sde mang po'i gseb tu bris nas lung dang brgyud pa phyogs gcig tu zhar las byung ba'i tshul gyis song ba srid pas/ mdo'i gseb tu bgrang ba dang*/ brgyud pa sangs rgyas la bsnyegs pa ni 'thad par mi mngon no// sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi yon tan brjod pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs/ gser gyi mdo/ sangs rgyas kyi chos bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pa snyan gyi gong rgyan/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ chos kyi rgyal po/ ting nge 'dzin gyi 'khor lo/ dpang skong phyag brgya/ sku gsum pa'i mdo/ byang chub ltung bshags/ mchog tu gdags pa/ 'jig rten dang rjes su mthun par 'jug pa/ tshigs su bcad pa gcig pa/ tshigs su bcad pa bzhi pa/ dkon mchog gsum rjes dran/ byams pa'i smon lam/ 'di dkon brtsegs su 'byung*/ rgyal po gser gyi lag pa'i smon lam/ 'di rnams kyi brgyud pa ni/ mdo snyan gyi gong rgyan/ bkra shis brtsegs pa la sogs pa'i mdo mang po'i thor bu rnams phag 'gur ba las/ bla ma gzhon tshul bas legs par rdzogs par zhus zhes gsungs pa dang*/ 'du shes bcu gcig pa/ tshigs su bcad pa gcig pa/ tshigs su bcad pa bzhi pa la sogs pa kun dga' 'od zer ba dang*/ phag 'gur ba la sogs la gsan pa na thams cad chud bdog zer bas/ phag 'gur ba las brgyud dam sems so// 'on kyang bla ma gzhon tshul ba'i gsan yig che ba la gtugs nas dag par bya dgos so// zhes bla ma dam pa 'phags pa'i gsan yig las 'byung ngo*// de ltar theg pa chen po'i mdo sna tshogs pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa la mdo sde zhes bod kyi mkhas pas brda mdzad pas 'di rnams kyi lung thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/

bla ma gzhon nu tshul khrims/ bla ma dharma kīrti/ chos kyi rje sa bzang paṇ+ḍi ta blo gros rgyal mtshan/ chos kyi rje sa bzang 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros/ des bdag la dges bzhin du gnang ba'o// mdo sde 'dzam gling rgyan gyi/ nga pa nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i mdo/ mdo chen po stong pa nyid/ mdo chen po stong pa nyid chen po/ ched du brjod pa'i tshoms/ cha pa nas ye shes snang ba rgyan/ ja pa nas sa bcu pa/ ta pa nas phyir mi ldog pa'i 'khor lo/ tha pa nas dgongs 'grel/ da pa nas blo gros mi zad pas bstan pa/ gzungs kyi dbang phyug rgyal pos zhus pa rnams nyan dgos/ sangs rgyas phal po che le'u bzhi bcu rtsa lnga pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ 'jam dbyangs/ klu sgrub/ ār+ya de wa/ byang chub bzang po/ 'jam dbyangs sprul pa/ rgya nag zhu zhun/ gyim btsun ja/ tan zhi du go zhi/ tshang long go zhi/ gyi rde'u/ haṃ swa ho thi/ tshang long ta go zhi/ ha hi tha/ gyi ju/ song chen gyin/ gyang ju/ saṃ gya ru/ 'dis bod skad gsungs nas/ lots+tsha ba mchog ldan/ slob dpon ra sa pa shākya brtan/ bla ma gzhon tshul/ bla ma chos grags dpal bzang po/ paṇa chen ma ti/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ de las bdag gis zhus pa ni rgya nag nas brgyud pa yin no// yang na rgya gar nas brgyud pa'i lugs ni/ sangs rgyas/ byams pa/ thogs med/ dbyig gnyen/ blo brtan/ paṇ+ḍi ta gang ba spel/ rat+na ā ka ra shān+ti/ rdo rje gdan pa/ bai ro tsa na rak+ṣi ta/ don yod rdo rje/ ba ri lots+tsha ba/ lho pa khyung ston/ gtsang pa ston grags/ g.yor po yug ston/ nyang bsod dbang*/ rgya ston dharma shrī/ kong nag ral gri/ shangs pa grags seng*/ zhang kun dga' 'bum/ slob dpon dkon mchog bla ma/ bla ma shar pa kun dga' seng ge slob dpon ra sa pa ston shag bla ma gzhon tshul/ bla ma chos grags dpal bzang po/ paṇ+ḍi ta ma ti/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// gnyis pa bstan bcos la/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i dbu ma bstod tshogs la/

chos kyi dbyings su bstod pa/ dpe med par bstod pa/ 'jig rten las 'das par bstod pa/ sems kyi rdo rje la bstod pa/ nam langs par bstod pa/ sku gsum la bstod pa rnams nag tsho'i 'gyur/ sher phyin la bsam gyis mi khyab par bstod pa/ bstod pa las 'das par bstod pa/ bla na med par bstod pa/ 'jam dpal la don dam par bstod pa/ snying rje la bstod pa/ gnas brgyad kyi mchod rten la bstod pa gnyis/ mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul la bstod pa/ phyag 'tshal ba'i bstod pa/ dmyal ba nas 'don pa'i bstod pa rnams pa tshab kyi 'gyur gyi brgyud pa ni/ lots+tsha ba mchog ldan/ dpang lots+tsha ba/ sa bzang lots+tsha ba/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// slob dpon ka ma la shī las mdzad pa'i dbu ma sgom rim bar ma'i brgyud pa ni/ dpang lo/ sa bzang lots+tsha ba man 'dra/ slob dpon dpa' bos mdzad pa'i skyes rabs kyi brgyud pa ni/ lots+tsha ba rin chen bzang po/ pu rong lo chung*/ rgya zur kha ba/ kha mo ze'u ba/ gtsang nag pa/ gro mo che/ sangs rgyas sgom pa/ mchims nam mkha' grags/ bcom ldan ral gri/ skyi ston shag 'bum/ skyi ston grags rgyal/ chos rje kun mkhyen/ chos rje paṇa chen ma ti/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// slob dpon zhi ba lhas mdzad pa'i bslab pa kun las btus pa'i brgyud pa ni/ zhi ba lha/ e la dha ri/ dpa' bo'i sde/ gser gling pa/ dī paṃ ka ra/ 'brom ston/ pu to ba rin chen gsal/ sha ra ba/ chos lung pa/ gtum ston blo gros grags/ gro mo che/ zhang btsun pa/ zhang ston pa/ sangs rgyas sgom pa/ mchims nam mkha' grags/ bcom ldan ral gri/ skyi ston grags pa rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen dol pu ba/ sa bzang paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// spyod 'jug gi brgyud pa ni/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ slob dpon zhi ba lha/ paṇ+ḍi ta mi brjed gzungs thob/ dze tā ri/ zla grags chung ba/ puṇ+ya shrī/ bal po ka na ka paṇ+ḍi ta su ma ti kīrti/

rngog lo/ zhang mdzes/ nyang ras pa/ gtsang nag pa/ yang na rngog lo/ slob dpon blo gros 'byung gnas/ phywa pa chos kyi seng ge gtsang nag pa/ dpal ldan gro/ mchims chen po/ skyi ston chen po/ skyi ston shag 'bum/ skyi ston 'jam dbyangs/ kun mkhyen dol po/ paṇa chen ma ti/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ de las bdag gis sa bzang pa'i ṭī ka dang bcas pa thos/ mdo sde rgyan gyi brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ byams pa/ thogs med/ dbyig gnyen/ blo brtan/ gang ba spel/ rin chen rdo rje/ sadz+dza na/ pa ra hi ta/ blo gros grags pa/ mar pa jo 'phan/ mchims ston don grub/ mchims brtson seng*/ mchims nam mkha' grags/ skyi ston khu dbon/ chos rje kun mkhyen pa/ ma ti paṇa chen/ 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros/ de las bdag gis sa bzang ba'i ṭī ka dang bcas pa thos/ rgyud bla ma'i brgyud pa ni/ byams pa/ thogs med/ dbyig gnyen/ blo brtan/ gang ba spel/ kha che rin chen rdo rje/ sadz+dza na/ sa ra hi ta/ blo gros grags/ mar pa jo 'phan/ mchims ston don grub/ mchims ston brtson seng*/ mchims nam mkha' grags/ bcom ldan ral gri/ skyi ston 'jam dbyangs/ chos rje kun mkhyen pa/ paṇa chen ma ti/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ de las bdag gis sa bzang ba'i ṭī ka dang bcas pa thos/ mngon pa kun las btus kyi brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ byams pa/ thogs med/ dbyig gnyen/ blo brtan/ gang ba spel/ dzi na mi tra/ ska cog zhang gsum/ snya nam zla ba'i rdo rje/ lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje/ dbas rgyal ba'i ye shes/ gru mchog gi ye shes/ se btsun gzhon nu dbang phyug gar mi yon tan g.yung drung*/ khu ston brtson 'grus g.yung drung*/ rwa khri bzang 'bar/ rgya tshul seng*/ li chos grags/ brang ti dar ma snying po/ ko ye 'byung*/ 'phan dkon mchog rdo rje/ tho kun dga' rdo rje/ 'jad pa ston skyabs/ slob dpon gzhon byang*/ mkhan po 'bring mchams pa zhong*/ bo dong rin rtse/ stag sde ba seng ge rgyal mtshan/

mkhan chen dpang lo/ sa bzang paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ de las bdag gis sa bzang pa'i ṭī ka che chung gnyis dang bcas pa thos/ byang chub gzhung lam gyi brgyud pa ni/ a bha yā ka ra gup+ta/ bi khyā ta de wa/ shākya shrī bha dra/ chag dgra bcom/ chag chos rje dpal/ poṭ+ṭa paṇa chen/ ri 'dab pa dge 'dun brtan/ dpang lo/ yang na a bha yā/ ni ska laṃ ka de ba/ re wen+d+ra/ chag gnyis/ mchog ldan/ mkhan chen dpang lots+tsha ba/ paṇa chen ma ti/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// chos rje sa bzang paṇ+ḍi ta blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i bka' 'bum yongs su rdzogs par thos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sa bzang paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ des bdag la'o// gnas brtan bcu drug gi cho ga'i brgyud pa ni/ jo bo rje bod du byon pa'i phyags phyi la/ sems tsam rnam brdzun gyi grub mtha' 'dzin pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta gcig la/ rngog byang chub 'byung gnas kyis zhus/ de las dge bshes pu to ba/ shar ba/ 'chad ka ba/ se spyil bu pa/ lha spyil bu pa/ 'dre lhas pa/ rgan mo lhas ba/ chos rje 'dzim pa chen po/ chos rje spang sgang pa/ chos rje ma ti paṇa chen/ chos rje 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros/ de las bdag gis bla ma nyid kyis mdzad pa'i cho ga shin tu rgyas pa'i lung dang bcas pa legs par zhus so// thos yig rgya mtsho las/ chos kyi rje sa bzang 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros kyis rjes su bzung ba'i skabs te lnga pa'o// //sde snod dang rgyud sde du ma'i mnga' bdag bla ma dam pa bkra shis rin chen pa'i drung du/ rgyud sde bzhi dang 'brel pa'i chos skor zhus ba la/ rnal 'byor bla med dang*/ rnal 'byor rgyud dang*/ bya spyod gsum gyi dang po la/ pha rgyud dang*/ ma rgyud dang*/ gnyis med rgyud dang gsum gyi dang po ni/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa spyan ras gzigs gtso bor gyur pa lha bcu dgu ma'i dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ jo bo chen po rje/

lha byang chub 'od/ 'am pa lcags ri ba gnyis chad pa 'dra/ bu ston pa'i gsan yig ni/ snga ma de las mi snang yang*/ rgya lcags ri bas/ jo bo ma zin no/ /rgya lcags ri gong ma/ rdzing bu kha pa shākya grags/ spen phug pa dar ma shākya/ zhang ye ba/ gze pa don grub/ par thang ba yab sras/ bsod nams dbang phyug lots+tsha ba mchog ldan/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge bu ston rin po che/ mkhas grub gzhon nu bsod nams/ bla ma dam pa bkra shis rin chen/ des bdag la'o// brgyud pa gong ma rnams shān+ti pa yan/ ye shes zhabs lugs dang 'dra'am bsams te/ jo bo shān+ti pa'i dngos slob yin pas so// yang na ku sa li che chung nas 'dod dam dpyad par bya'o// zhes bu ston rin po ches gsungs so// sgrub thabs rgyas pa dang*/ bsdus pa jo bos mdzad pa dang*/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi bstod pa jo bos mdzad pa dang*/ sgrub thabs kun tu bzang po/ dkyil chog bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa/ gsang 'dus 'phags lugs kyi gtor chog nag po pas mdzad pa/ rdo rje 'chang chen po'i lam gyi rim pa'i man ngag bdud rtsi gsang ba sgra dbyangs bcu gcig pas mdzad pa rnams thos/ phyag na rdo rje 'khor lo chen po'i dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ gzhan gong dang 'dra ba las/ dmar chos kyi rgyal po/ dmar shākya grub/ yang rtse ba rin chen seng ge bu ston rin po che/ bla ma rgyal mtshan grags/ bla ma dam pa bkra shis rin chen/ des bdag la'o// rgyud kyi 'grel pa bdud rtsi myu gu/ sgrub thabs rgyal pa 'khor lo chen po/ 'bring po bdud rtsi thigs pa/ sgrub thabs bsdus pa/ klu rigs bzhi'i sgrub thabs/ gnod sbyin gyi sgrub thabs/ bdud bzlog gi sgrub thabs/ sbyin sreg gi cho ga zhi drag gnyis/ bdud rtsi 'o ma'i mchod pa/ rmi ltas rim pa drug pa/ gzungs kyi gtor chog bsad pa/ bdud rtsis gso ba/ klu khro bo bsad pa'i phrin las/ klu rigs bzhi mnan pa'i cho ga

mdze nad kyi mtshan nyid/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bstod pa rnams slob dpon chen po dza ba ri pas mdzad pa 'gar chos kyi bzang po'i 'gyur dang*/ bshad rgyud drag po gsum gyi 'grel pa/ sgrub thabs che ba rnam dag 'od ldan/ sgrub thabs 'bring po gtor chog dang bcas pa/ dkyil chog rdzogs rim byin rlabs bzhi ldan rnam dmar chos rgyal gyis mdzad pa thos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ gong ma rnams dbang dang 'dra ba las/ bu ston rin po che/ bla ma gzhon nu bsod nams/ bla ma dam pa bkra shis rin chen/ des bdag la'o// bde chen ral gcig gi dbang bzhi re re la'ang*/ dbang bzhi bzhi sbyar ba'i dbang rgyas pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ mgon po kha sar+paṇi/ byang sems blo gros rin chen/ tai lo pa/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ grub chen mi tra dzo ki khro phu lots+tsha ba byams pa'i dpal/ bsod nams dbang phyug rin po che khro phu ba/ yang na khro phu lots+tsha ba/ bla ma dbon ston/ chos rje kun spangs pa/ bla ma rin chen seng ge bu ston rin po che/ bla ma gzhon nu bsod nams/ bla ma dam pa bkra shis/ rin chen/ des bdag la'o// ral gcig rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang rgyas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ khro phu lots+tsha ba yan gong dang 'dra ba las/ bla ma dbon ston/ chos rje kun spangs pa/ yang rtse ba rin chen seng ge man 'dra'o// ral gcig lha nyi shu rtsa lnga ma'i sgrub thabs/ lha bcu bdun ma'i sgrub thabs/ dbang chog bdun gsum nyer gcig ma/ zur 'debs lnga gsum bco lnga ma/ grol lam gtso bor byed pa'i dbang gong ma bsdus pa/ pho nya'i lam gtso bor byed pa'i dbang gong ma rgyas pa rnams khro los mdzad pa/ rdo rje slob dpon bdag po'i dbang chog rnams thos/ rdzogs rim zab mo sems nyid ngal gso'i brgyud pa ni/ bde chen ral gcig ma'i dbang dang 'dra/ yang na khro phu lots+tsha ba/ bla chen 'dzal phu ba/ rin po che khro phu ba/ gnyen mkhar ba bkra shis bzang po/

mkhas grub gzhon nu bsod nams man 'dra/ yang na rin po che khro phu ba/ slob dpon tshad ma'i skyes bu/ bu ston rin po che/ bla ma gzhon nu bsod nams/ bla ma dam pa bkra shis rin chen/ de las bdag gis so// rang gi sems nyid ngal gso bar byed pa'i man ngag tshigs su bcad pa nyi shu rtsa lnga pa/ de'i bsdus don/ 'grel pa gnad gyi sgron me/ zur 'debs gsal ba'i sgron me/ mi tra dzo kis mdzad pa bco brgyad pa rnams khro los mdzad pa/ ngal bso'i rgyud kyi lung sbyor bu ston rin po ches mdzad pa/ sngon 'gro'i khrid yig yang brtse bas mdzad pa rnams thos/ snying po don gsum gyi man ngag rtsa 'grel gyi brgyud pa ni/ khro phu lots+tsha ba/ bla chen bsod dbang*/ khro phu rin po che/ tshad ma'i skyes bu/ bu ston rin po che/ bla ma gzhon nu bsod nams/ bla ma dam pa bkra shis rin chen/ des bdag la'o// shin tu spros med kyi khrid/ byin rlabs/ 'od gsal 'char ba'i byin rlabs/ bdud rtsi lnga'i byin rlabs/ spros med kyi khrid yig glo bo lots+tsha bas mdzad pa/ rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang*/ 'od gsal 'char ba'i gzhung*/ spros med brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs rin rnam pas mdzad pa rnams thos pa'i brgyud pa ni/ gzhan gong dang 'dra ba las/ bu ston rin po che/ lots+tsha ba rin chen rnam rgyal/ bla ma dam pa bkra shis rin chen/ des bdag la'o// gshin rje gshed dmar po lha lnga'i mngon rtogs gshin rje kun 'joms/ de'i dkyil chog byin rlabs 'jug bde rnam gsal/ gshed dmar lha bcu gsum pa'i sgrub thabs/ de'i dkyil chog mchod phreng*/ sbyin sreg gtor ma drug cu rtsa bzhi pa/ las gshin gyi gtor chog 'jigs byed kyi dkyil chog 'khrul 'khor gnad kyi man ngag rnams bu ston rin po ches mdzad pa/ dgra nag 'jigs byed/ gdong drug rnams kyi sgrub thabs rnams lots+tsha ba rin rnam pas mdzad pa rnams thos/ rdo rje phag mo'i dbang sdud/

tsartsi ka'i drag bzlas/ dbyangs can ma'i shes rab blo 'phel/ gau ri'i char 'bebs te/ las tshogs kyi sgrub thabs bzhi dang*/ phyir bzlog gi 'khrul 'khor/ srung ba'i byin rlabs/ rdzas/ sngags/ rlung*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi phyir bzlog ste/ de rnams bram ze dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa'i brgyud pa ni/ slob dpon dpal 'dzin/ ma ti pa/ dar paṇa ā tsar+ya/ glo bo lots+tsha ba/ sprul sku sa pa/ lo mchog dpal ldan seng ge bu ston rin po che/ rin chen rnam rgyal/ bla ma dam pa bkra shis rin chen/ des bdag la'o// gnyis pa ma rgyud la 'khor lo bde mchog sbyangs pa'i yon tan gyi dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ lu hi pa/ ḍeṃ ki pa/ slob dpon la ba pa/ in+d+ra bhū ti/ ka tsa ṭa pa/ dril bu pa/ dza lan+dha ri pa/ nag po pa/ ku sha la/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ ma ṇi ka shrī dz+nyā na/ bal po bha thān+ta/ mar pa do pa/ gze pa blo ldan/ gze pa jo bde/ lho tshad pa/ lots+tsha ba mchog ldan/ dpal ldan seng ge bu ston rin po che/ bla ma gzhon nu bsod nams/ bla ma dam pa bkra shis rin chen/ des bdag la'o// slob dpon chen po lwa ba pas mdzad pa'i dkyil chog kyang thos/ bde mchog bcu gsum ma mai tri pa'i lugs kyi dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ blo gros rin chen/ sha ba ri pa/ mai tri pa/ rgya gar phyag na rdo rje/ ba reg lots+tsha ba/ gtsang shod pa/ sum pa 'jam mgon/ ba reg rin chen 'bar/ ba reg 'od zer/ ba reg jo 'bum/ byang chub gling pa/ ba reg bkra shis/ lots+tsha ba mchog ldan/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge bu ston rin po che/ bla ma gzhon nu bsod nams/ bla ma dam pa bkra shis rin chen/ des bdag la'o// yang na mai trai pa/ ti phu pa/ ras chung ba/ sum pa gling ras/ rgyal ba lo/ dbus ras/ rin chen dar dbang*/ sangs rgyas 'bum/ lo mchog man 'dra/ yang na ba reg lots+tsha ba/ dam pa rong chung ba/ lots+tsha ba rdor rgyal/ jo btsun me 'bar/
