rgyal tsha rin chen/ kun ldan ras pa/ khro phu lots+tsha ba/ bla chen bsod dbang*/ khro phu rin po che/ yang rtse ba rin chen seng ge bu ston rin po che man 'dra'o// sgrub thabs mai tri pas mdzad pa/ ba reg dang ba ri'i 'gyur la/ khro los bcos pa/ rtag pa'i rdo rje'i chos gsum/ yi ge bdun pa'i sgrub thabs/ gnyis med rdo rje lha bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs jo bos mdzad pa/ kha che rin chen rdo rjes mdzad pa'i bstod pa che chung gnyis rnams thos/ yang 'khor lo bde mchog gi spyi don ma rgyud don gsal/ rtsa rgyud dang de'i 'grel pa gsang ba'i de kho na nyid gsal ba rnams kyi steng nas/ bshad bka' legs par thos nas/ sa lugs kyis brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun rin po che yan dbang dang 'dra/ de nas nub pa rig 'dzin grags/ de gnyis kas dmar chos kyi rgyal po la/ des bla ma shākya gzhon nu/ lce blo ldan seng ge kun mkhyen 'phags 'od/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa/ lots+tsha ba rin chen rnam rgyal/ rgyud sde'i mnga' bdag bkra shis rin chen/ des bdag la'o// yang na jo bo lugs/ pu rong lugs kyi dbang dang 'dra'o// rnal 'byor ma kun spyod/ de'i ṭī ka don gsal ba'i steng nas bshad bka' thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta yan 'dra/ de nas bo dong rin po che/ khro phu ba/ yang rtse ba rin chen seng ge bu ston/ lots+tsha ba rin chen rnam rgyal man 'dra'o// bde mchog gi sgrub thabs/ nag po pas mdzad pa'i ṭī ka 'khrul pa spong ba/ nag po pa'i mngon rtogs 'khrul pa'i dri bral/ bde mchog sdom 'byung gi mngon rtogs/ de'i dkyil mchog rnams bu ston rin po ches mdzad pa rnams thos/ bde mchog sdom 'byung gi 'grel pa paṇ+ḍi ta rat+na shrī rak+ṣi tas mdzad pa dang*/ de'i bsdus don shong los mdzad pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rat+na rak+ṣi ta/ chag chos rje dpal/ go lung pa mdo sde dpal/ shong blo brtan/ thar pa lots+tsha ba/

thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston/ lots+tsha ba rin chen rnam rgyal/ bla ma dam pa bkra shis rin chen/ des bdag la'o// dpal sam+bu ṭa'i rgya cher bshad pa snying po rab gsal thos nas/ sa lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ gzhan gong dang 'dra ba las/ 'phags pa rin po che/ 'jam skya nam mkha' dpal/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge bu ston rin po che/ lots+tsha ba rin chen rnam rgyal/ bla ma dam pa bkra shis rin chen/ des bdag la'o// dpyal lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ ḍā ki bskal bzang*/ gu ru tsar+ya pa/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ 'jigs med pham mthing pa grags pa/ dpyal bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ dpyal kun dga' rdo rje/ lha lung pa/ dpyal lots+tsha ba chos kyi bzang po/ dpyal a mo gha chos 'od/ 'phags 'od/ bu ston rin po che man 'dra/ rwa lugs rwa pa nas brgyud pa'i man ngag rngog pas yi ger bkod pa'i bshad srol zer ro// kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ nag po pa/ gu h+ya pa/ rnam rgyal zhabs/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ pradz+nyā rak+ṣi ta/ bal po thugs rje chen po/ rwa rdo rje grags/ rngog chos rdor/ rngog mdo sde/ rngog thogs med grags/ gtsang smra seng*/ lce mdo sde seng ge lce blo brtan/ kun mkhyen 'phags 'od/ bu ston rin po che man 'dra/ sam+bu ṭa rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs/ sam+bu ṭa la brten pa'i thog srung ba'i cho ga rnams bu ston rin po ches mdzad pa thos/ rdo rje gdan bzhi'i rgyud kyi 'grel pa/ slob dpon bha ba pas mdzad pa'i brgyud pa ni/ ga ya dha ra/ 'gos lots+tsha ba/ rwa rdo rje grags/ rgya gling pa/ lce dbon tsha/ spug ston jo 'bum/ spug blo ldan/ jo ldan sgang pa/ dben sa gzhon byang*/ bla ma chos 'od/ blo ldan seng ge rje btsun bsod nams dpal/ bla ma gzhon nu bsod nams/ bla ma dam pa bkra shis rin chen/ des bdag la'o// rnal 'byor nam mkha'i sgrub thabs/ ye shes mkha' 'gro'i sgrub thabs/

dkyil chog snying po mdor bsags/ shing gcig gi dka' 'grel rnams ār+ya de bas mdzad pa/ gdan bzhi'i sgrub thabs bha wa bha dras mdzad pa/ rnam rgyal dpa' bos mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs/ mchan khung sbyor ba 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ gdan bzhi'i sgrub thabs bu ston rin po ches mdzad pa/ zhe sdang rdo rjes mdzad pa'i dkyil chog lde mig dang bcas pa rnams thos/ sangs rgyas thod pa'i rgyud kyi dka' 'grel ye shes ldan/ lha nyi shu rtsa lnga'i sgrub thabs dkyil mchog 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor chog rnams/ sa ra has mdzad pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sa ra ha/ klu sgrub/ ri khrod dbang phyug mai tri pa/ mar pa lots+tsha ba/ rgya pho ba lung pa/ ro mnyam rdo rje/ yon tan grags/ shākya rdo rje/ kham pa chos grags/ byang chub dpal/ byang chen pa bsod nams 'phel/ bag ston/ dus 'khor byang chub blo gros/ bla ma gzhon nu bsod nams/ bla ma dam pa bkra shis rin chen/ des bdag la'o// sangs rgyas thod pa'i rgyud kyi mi 'jigs pa'i gzhung 'grel/ slob dpon ku ku ri pas mdzad pa'i ma hā mā yā'i sgrub thabs rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum/ dkyil chog rdzogs rim de kho na nyid gsal ba'i rtsa 'grel/ sgyu ma chen mo'i mngon rtogs sgyu 'phrul mngon par 'byung ba/ dkyil chog rdo rje bdud rtsi gsum gyi mngon rtogs/ sgrol ma brtson 'don gyi cho ga rnams bu ston rin po ches mdzad pa rnams thos/ gsum pa gnyis med rgyud la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo rwa lugs kyi dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ dam pa dang po'i sangs rgyas/ dus kyi 'khor lo/ rgyal po zla ba bzang po/ lha dbang*/ gzi brjid can/ zla bas byin/ lha'i dbang phyug sna tshogs gzugs/ lha'i dbang ldan/ 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ pad+ma dkar po/ 'jam dbyangs sprul pa/ tsi lu ā tsar+ya/ paṇ+ḍi ta ā tsar+ya/ dus zhabs pa che ba/ dus zhabs pa chung ba/ mañdzu kīrti/ sa man+ta shrī/ rwa chos rab/ rwa ye shes seng ge

rwa 'bum seng*/ rje btsun rgwa lo/ bla ma shes rab seng ge bla ma dpal ldan seng ge bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa/ dus 'khor ba chos kyi dpal/ bla ma dam pa bkra shis rin chen/ des bdag la'o// 'bro lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ pad dkar/ zla ba bzang po/ rnam rgyal/ bshes gnyen bzang po/ phyag dmar/ khyab 'jug sbas pa/ nyi ma grags/ shin tu bzang*/ rgya mtsho/ rnam rgyal/ rgyal dka'/ nyi ma/ sna tshogs gzugs/ zla ba'i 'od/ mtha' yas/ sa skyong*/ dpal skyong*/ dus zhabs pa che ba/ dus zhabs pa chung ba/ kha che zla ba mgon/ 'bro lots+tsha ba/ sgom pa dkon mchog bsrungs/ spro ston gnam la brtsegs/ yu mo mi bskyod rdo rje/ sras dharme shā ra/ grub thob nam mkha' 'od/ se mo che nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ 'jam gsar shes rab 'od zer/ bla ma chos sku 'od zer/ chos rje kun spangs pa/ byang sems rgyal ye/ kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer/ bu ston rin po che/ bla ma chos kyi dpal/ bla ma dam pa bkra shis rin chen/ des bdag la'o// yang na kun mkhan chos sku 'od zer gyi rjes su 'phags 'od bcug kyang chog la/ 'jam gsar nas/ rgwa lo bzhin byas kyang rung ngo*// shong lugs kyi dbang bka' ni/ grub thob se mo che ba/ bo dong rin rtse/ stag sde pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ shong lots+tsha ba sku mched/ lots+tsha ba mchog ldan/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge man 'dra/ de ltar rwa 'bro shong gsum gyi phyag len gcig tu bsdus pa'i dbang rgyas pa thob nas/ dus 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi sgrub thabs/ thugs dkyil sogs kyi sgrub thabs/ lhan skyes kyi sgrub thabs/ dkyil chog de'i lhan thabs/ dbang gong ma/ mchod phreng*/ brgyud mchod/ bstod pa rgyas pa/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg las so so'i sbyin sreg dus tha ma'i cho ga rab gnas bkra shis dpal 'bar/ rdzogs rim ston pa dbang mdor bstan gyi ṭī ka rnams thos/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud 'grel/ de'i mchan bu/ chos 'byung*/

rgyud 'grel gyi sa bcad/ mdor bsdus dang po'i ṭī ka bshad thabs kyi man ngag nges don snye ma/ mkhan chen dharma shrī'i zin bris dang bcas pa'i steng nas bshad bka' thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ bla ma sher seng yan dbang bka' dang 'dra ba las/ rong pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ bu ston rin po che las rwa lugs dang*/ 'bro lugs la/ 'jam gsar yan 'dra ba las/ rgwa lo/ sher seng*/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa/ dus 'khor ba chos kyi dpal/ bla ma dam pa bkra shis rin chen/ de las bdag gis 'bro lugs kyi bshad pa thos/ rdo rje snying 'grel dang*/ phyag rdor stod 'grel gnyis thos pa'i brgyud pa ni rwa lugs ltar ro// gnyis pa rnal 'byor rgyud la/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje dbyings 'grel pa lugs kyi dbang rgyas pa dang*/ de nyid snang ba'i stod 'grel gyi brgyud pa ni/ longs sku rnam snang*/ sprul sku rdor sems/ phyag na rdo rje/ rab gsal zla ba/ sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po/ kun dga' snying po/ pradz+nyā wa li ta/ dharma pā la/ lo chen rin bzang*/ gur shing brtson 'grus rgyal mtshan/ gnyal pa nyi she/ gnur nyi ma 'od zer/ badz+ra sidha/ glan chos 'byung*/ rtsa skya ston 'bum/ rtsa skya khri brtan/ gnur ye shes rgyal mtshan/ chos 'phags rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen 'phags 'od/ bu ston rin po che/ bla ma gzhon nu bsod nams/ bla ma dam pa bkra shis rin chen/ des bdag la'o// dkyil chog rin chen bsam 'phel gzhal yas khang gi gnas lugs gsal byed/ yo ga'i mchod phreng*/ dbang chog rgyas pa'i kha skong*/ zhi rgyas dbang drag gi sbyin sreg bzhi/ bskal bzang stong gi bstod pa/ yo ga'i rab gnas bkra shis rgyas byed/ de'i sdom tshig rdul tshon spyan drang ba'i cho ga rnams thos/ khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ longs sku rnam snang*/ sprul sku rdor sems/ phyag na rdo rje/ rab gsal zla ba/

sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po/ kun dga' snying po/ pradz+nyā wa li ta/ dharma pā la/ lo chen/ gur shing*/ gnyal pa nyi she/ gnur chen po/ sras badz+ra sidha/ glan chos 'byung*/ rtsa skya ston 'bum/ khri brtan/ ye shes rgyal mtshan/ chos 'phags rgyal mtshan/ rgyal sras thogs med/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston/ bla ma gzhon nu bsod nams/ bla ma dam pa bkra shis rin chen/ de las bdag gis dkyil chog 'jig rten gsum rgyal 'byung ba'i lung dang bcas pa thos/ rtse mo rigs bsdus kyi dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag na rdo rje/ in+d+ra bhū ti gsum/ klu sgrub/ klu byang*/ ye shes rdo rje/ gtsug gi nor bu/ kun snying*/ tha ga na/ ngag dbang grags pa/ bram ze rin chen rdo rje/ kha che dz+nyā na shrī/ zangs dkar lots+tsha ba/ yang na phyag na rdo rje/ rdo rje chos/ in+d+ra bhū ti che ba/ rta mchog bi na shrī/ in+d+ra bhū ti bar pa/ chung ba/ lha lcam legs smin ka ra/ rgyal bu sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po/ legs pa'i sgrol ma/ klu sgrub/ ār+ya de ba/ klu byang*/ dharma badz+ra/ pad+ma badz+ra/ dz+nyā na badz+ra/ kun dga' snying po/ de las rgya gar shar phyogs dang*/ lho phyogs dang*/ dbus 'gyur dang srol gsum byung ba'i dang po/ dge slong a mo gha badz+ra/ rnal 'byor ma ka pa la wa ti/ nor bu gling pa bde ba'i rdo rje/ bi ka ma la wa ti/ bram ze rin chen rdo rje/ kha che dz+nyā na shrī/ zangs dkar lots+tsha ba/ gnyis pa lho brgyud ni/ pradz+nyā sid+dhi/ pradz+nyā wa li ta/ rab 'byor skyong*/ shrad+dhā ka ra/ pad+ma ka ra/ dz+nyā na shrī/ zangs dkar lots+tsha ba/ gnyen ston tshul 'bar/ thod pa dben tsha grags/ thod pa 'od zer/ bla ma chos mgon dpal bzang po/ lce blo brtan/ bla ma 'phags 'od/ bla ma gzhon nu bsod nams/ bla ma dam pa bkra shis rin chen/ de las bdag gis dkyil chog mkhas pa'i yid 'phrog rtse mo'i sa chog rgyas pa dang bcas pa thos/ dpal mchog rigs bsdus kyi dbang gi brgyud pa ni/

sangs rgyas/ phyag na rdo rje/ nyi ma'i dpal zhabs/ rdo rje go cha/ kun dga' snying po/ 'jam dpal dri med grags pa/ rab 'byor skyong*/ shrad+dhā ka ra warma/ lo chen rin chen bzang po/ lo chung legs she/ rkyang po chos blo/ sum ston ye 'bar/ lce zhar/ skru ston 'bar thog gtsang yang dag rdo rje/ gtsang smra seng*/ lce jo mdo/ bla ma chos 'od/ 'phags 'od/ dpal rtse gnyis la bu ston rin po che mi dgos gsung*/ bla ma gzhon nu bsod nams/ bla ma dam pa bkra shis rin chen/ de las bdag gis dkyil chog don yod pa thams cad kyi dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor 'byung ba/ bstod pa rgyas pa/ thig rtsa bkra shis rnams thos/ dpal mchog rdor sems kyi dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ phyag rdor/ rgyal po rab gsal zla ba/ de las slob ma bzhi ste/ sgra gcan 'dzin/ swa sti pha la/ ye shes rdo rje/ pradz+nyā sid+dhi dang bzhi las/ kun snying*/ de la pradz+nyā wa li ta/ rab 'byor skyong*/ pradz+nyā bod+dhi/ mu ti ko ṣa/ dharma pā la/ rin chen bzang po/ rgya ye tshul/ gnyal pa nyi she gnur nyi 'od/ rtsa skya ston grags/ mnyam skad pa chen po/ rtsa skya ston 'bum/ rtsa skya khri brtan/ gnur ye rgyal/ lots+tsha ba mchog ldan/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston/ bla ma gzhon nu bsod nams/ bla ma dam pa bkra shis rin chen/ de las bdag gis dpal mchog rdo rje sems dpa'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg sgrub pa rjes sgrub kyi cho ga rnams thos/ kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor du dbang zhus pa la/ stod lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das kun rig phyag rdor/ rab gsal zla ba/ sgra gcan 'dzin/ kun snying*/ pradz+nyā wa li ta/ pradz+nyā bo dhi/ mu ti ko ṣa/ dharma pā la/ dī paṃ ka ra/ shrī dz+nyā na/ do pa sgom chen/ skyi nor dz+nyā na/ gnyal pa nyi she/ gnur nyi 'od/ sras sidha/ gnur byang chub 'od/ gnur nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ rin chen

'dzim pa shes rab/ rin chen yang rtse ba seng ge thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston/ lots+tsha ba rin chen rnam rgyal/ bla ma dam pa bkra shis rin chen/ des bdag la'o// smad lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ slob dpon kun dga' snying po/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdo rje/ shrad+dhā ka ra warma/ lo chen/ lo chung*/ sum ston ye 'bar/ gnyan ston tshul 'bar/ thod pa dben tsha grags/ thod pa 'od zer/ ri lung phug pa chos mgon/ bla ma blo ldan seng ge bla ma 'phags 'od/ bu ston rin po che man gong bzhin las/ kun rig gi dkyil chog cho ga'i kha skong*/ sbyin sreg gi ṭī ka las bzhi'i rnga brdung ba'i cho ga rnams thos/ gtsug dgu stod lugs kyi dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ phyag rdor/ rab gsal zla ba/ ye shes rdo rje/ kun dga' snying po/ pra dz+nyā wa li ta/ go mi dge bsnyen/ shākya dz+nyā na/ jo bo rje/ go mi sgom chen/ skyi nor dz+nyā na/ gnyal pa/ gnur chen/ ltum ston ston grags/ rtsa skya'i mnyam skad pa/ khri brtan/ sras bsod nams bzang*/ de gnyis ka las gsal ba blo gros dpal/ grags chen pa/ 'phags 'od/ bu ston rin po che/ bla ma gzhon nu bsod nams/ bla ma dam pa bkra shis rin chen/ des bdag la'o// yang na gnur nas/ skru ston/ gtsang yang dag rdo rje/ de'i sras 'byung gnas seng ge mdo sde seng ge chos 'od/ blo ldan seng ge 'phags 'od man 'dra/ smad lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rab gsal zla ba las slob ma'i mchog bzhi ste/ pad dkar/ ye shes rdo rje/ sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po/ nyi ma'i snying po rnams la/ rgyal rigs sa ra pa/ kun snying*/ tha ga na pa/ ngag dbang grags pa/ bha len+d+ra shān+ti/ mi bskyod rdo rje/ shrad+dhā/ lo chen/ lo chung*/ sum ston/ gnyen ston/ thod pa dben tsha grags/ thod pa 'od zer/ rong pa chos mgon/ blo ldan seng ge 'phags 'od/ bu ston rin po che/ bla ma gzhon nu bsod nams/ bla ma dam pa bkra shis rin chen/

des bdag la'o// dkyil chog ngan song rgyun gcod thos/ phyag rdor 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ phyag rdor/ rab gsal zla ba/ sgra gcan 'dzin/ kun snying*/ pradz+nyā wa li ta/ pradz+nyā bo dhi/ mu ti ko ṣa/ dharma pa la/ dī paṃ ka ra shrī dz+nyā na/ go mi sgom chen/ skyi nor dz+nyā na/ gnyal nyi/ gnur chen nyi 'od/ sras badz+ra singha/ gnur byang chub 'od/ gnur nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ gnur ye rgyal/ gnur chos 'phags rgyal mtshan/ bla ma 'phags 'od/ thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston/ rin po che'i zhal nas/ ngas kun mkhyen 'phags 'od la phyag na rdo rje la 'jig rten pa'i dkyil 'khor drug gis bskor ba'i dbang thob mod gzhan rnams gsha' ma ma yin 'di la tshig yin gsung ngo*/ /slob dpon rgyal mtshan grags/ bla ma dam pa bkra shis rin chen/ de las bdag gis dkyil chog 'chi med grub pa/ bstod pa rnams thos/ mi 'khrugs pa'i dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ thub pa chen po/ kun dga' bo/ klu sgrub/ ār+ya de ba/ a wa dhū ti pa/ a bha yā ka ra/ gser gling pa/ jo bo rje/ 'brom ston/ pu to ba/ sha ra ba/ rgyal ye sgom/ grub thob hūm̐ 'bar/ zhang dge slong*/ dge slong dkon mchog ye shes/ bla ma khu ston/ rong pa dkon mchog 'bar/ mkhan po dbang rin/ kham pa sa phug pa/ dbus pa sangs 'bum/ chos 'od/ 'phags 'od/ yang na khu ston nas/ 'phags pa/ mkhan po 'phrang pa/ rin chen bla ma/ 'od chung ba gzhon nu 'od/ grags chen/ 'phags 'od/ yang na jo bo rje/ dbang rin/ shāka rdor/ sangs 'bum/ lo mchog 'od chung ba gzhon nu 'od/ grags chen 'phags 'od/ yang na kha che ye shes rdo rje/ lo chung grags 'byor shes rab/ sa chen/ rje btsun pa/ nub pa rig 'dzin grags/ bya rgod gshong*/ bo dong ra lung pa/ sha ba/ lung phu ba/ nam mkha' bsod nams/ nub gog pa/ dge bshes dar zhon/ ston pa don yod/ slob dpon rin rgyal/ grags chen/ 'phags 'od/

thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston/ bla ma gzhon nu bsod nams/ bla ma dam pa bkra shis rin chen/ des bdag la'o// dkyil chog ro sreg gi lung yang thos so// 'jam dpal nam mkha' dri med chung ba'i dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ nā ro pa/ kan dbang phyug blo gros/ 'gar ston rdo rje snying po/ nyang stod lce 'bar/ lam chog pa/ khri ston/ mkhan po chos rin/ chos 'od/ 'phags 'od/ bu ston rin po che/ bla ma gzhon nu bsod nams/ bla ma dam pa bkra shis rin chen/ des bdag la'o// dkyil chog 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa thos/ 'jam dpal yon tan kun 'byung gi dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ 'jam dbyangs/ 'jam dpal bshes gnyen/ sgeg pa'i rdo rje/ nyi ma'i snying po/ sūr+ya sid+dhi/ chos kyi rdo rje/ mu tra sid+dhi/ de be shwa ra/ smṛ ti dz+nyā na kīrti/ tshong sde ngag gi dbang phyug kham pa shes rab rdo rje/ rngog chos rdor/ spa sba ba can/ rngog mdo sde/ smra seng*/ lce mdo seng*/ chos 'od/ yang na rngog chos rdor/ rgya 'a ma can/ shākya seng ge khri ston kun dga' 'od/ chos rin chos sku ba/ 'phags 'od/ thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston/ bla ma gzhon nu bsod nams/ bla ma dam pa bkra shis rin chen/ des bdag la'o// sgrub thabs gsang ldan/ dkyil chog yon tan kun 'byung*/ mtshan brjod bklag pa'i bsgom khog sbyin sreg rnams byang chub mchog gis mdzad pa'i brgyud pa ni/ kham pa shes rab rdo rje yan 'dra ba las/ de nas rngog chos rdor ram rtsa ba can/ g.yar dar ma brtan/ dmar jo bo/ mkhas pa bsod rgyal/ ge re bla zur ba/ g.yar nam mkha'i mtshan can/ bla ma gzhon nu seng ge slob dpon chos mgon/ slob dpon seng rgyal/ bla ma gzhon nu bsod nams/ bla ma dam pa bkra shis rin chen/ des bdag la'o// gsum pa bya spyod la/ rnam 'joms dkar po'i rig gtad kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can/

sa wa ri pa/ dza wa ri pa/ de wa puṇ+ya ma ti/ lots+tsha ba 'gar chos bzang*/ rin chen dngos grub/ dmar chos rgyal/ sgang ston shes rab bla ma/ shes rab 'bum/ grags pa rdo rje/ bor ba dar byang*/ yang rtse ba rin chen seng ge bla ma rgyal mtshan mgon/ dh+wa dza kārti/ bla ma dam pa bkra shis rin chen/ des bdag la'o// dza ba ri pas mdzad pa'i dkyil chog rin chen snang ba dang*/ rin chen seng ges mdzad pa'i yig cha'i lung thos/ 'jam dbyangs yon tan ye shes bzang po'i bstod sgrub rig gtad kyi brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun 'jam dbyangs/ paṇ+ḍi ta 'bum phrag gsum pa/ rngog lo/ khyung rin chen grags/ rgya dmar byang chub grags/ phywa pa chos seng*/ gtsang nag pa brtson 'grus seng ge dan phag pa dar ma seng ge gnyal zhig 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ gzad ring dar ma tshul khrims/ gra thang ba/ bla ma bsod rgyal ba/ yang rtse ba rin chen seng ge thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston/ lots+tsha ba rin chen rnam rgyal/ bla ma dam pa bkra shis rin chen/ des bdag la'o// sman bla'i cho ga 'bring po'i lung gi brgyud pa ni/ thub pa/ 'jam dbyangs/ zhi ba 'tsho/ khri srong lde'u btsan/ sras mu ne btsan/ sad na legs mjing yon/ gtsang ma/ 'od srungs/ dpal 'khor btsan/ nyi ma mgon/ khri bkra shis mgon/ ye shes 'od/ lha byang chub 'od/ zhi ba 'od/ 'od lde/ rtse lde/ mnga' ris dgra bcom pa zhu ldan pa/ shes rab grags/ dar ma rgyal mtshan/ ras chu bzad pa/ gro mo che/ sangs rgyas sgom pa/ mchims nam mkha' grags/ tshad ma'i skyes bu/ thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston/ lots+tsha ba rin chen rnam rgyal/ skyid lde bla ma dam pa bkra shis rin chen/ des bdag la'o// sman bla'i rjes gnang thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ gro mo che yan chad cho ga dang 'dra/ gro mo che la/ rgyang mkhar zhu phu ba lha 'od/ de la skyi mkhar sde khud pa mkhan po ston ye/ de las mkhan chen sangs rgyas dpal/ lots+tsha ba rin chen rnam rgyal/ bla ma dam pa bkra shis rin chen/

des bdag la'o// dri med kyi cho ga btsan po'i phyag len du mkhan pos btus pa/ dri med kyi dkyil chog khyung chen pas mdzad pa/ 'od zer can lha lnga'i cho ga dga' ldan pa bkra shis dpal gyis mdzad pa/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan gyi sgrub thabs rgya gzhung*/ gzungs/ cho ga bstod pa rnams thos/ yang 'phags pa 'od zer dri ma med pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 'chi med 'byung ba/ gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i bstod pa 'dod dgu'i cha 'bebs/ gtsug tor dri med kyi 'grel pa la brten nas byang chub chen po'i mchod rten gyi chag tshad/ dpa' bo gcig grub la brten pa'i gnod sbyin pho 'khor mo 'khor gyi bri thabs dang*/ thog ser bzlog thabs/ bya ba'i rgyud kyi pad+ma'i rigs la/ don zhags kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i rgyu mtshan yid ches par byed pa'i khungs/ don yod zhags pa'i gzungs sgrub 'bring po/ don zhags kyi gzungs sgrub chen mo'i dkyil chog yid bzhin gyi nor bu/ don zhags kyi zhi rgyas kyi sbyin sreg gi cho ga nor bu'i rigs gar mkhan mchog gi rgyud la brten pa'i rgyal po rnam thos sras kyi sgrub thabs/ zhi drag gi rjes gnang*/ bstod pa chen mo/ phyag rdor la spro ba lnga'i bstod pa rnams bu ston rin po ches mdzad pa thos/ shes rab snying po/ mdo sgrub mchims nam mkha' grags kyis mdzad pa dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma/ jo bo rje/ dā na 'di jo bo rje'i dbon po yin/ shī la/ byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan/ dbang bka' bsdams pa/ skyer sgang pa ye shes seng ge sangs rgyas sgom pa/ nam mkha' grags/ tshad ma'i skyes bu/ thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che/ lots+tsha ba rin chen rnam rgyal/ bla ma dam pa bkra shis rin chen/ des bdag la'o// jo bo'i thugs dam tsha dgu ma yang thos/ sgrol ma'i bstod pa phyag 'tshal nyer gcig gi lung thos pa'i brgyud pa ni/

thub pa/ kun dga' bo/ nyi ma'i gung pa/ sha na'i gos can/ kha che thams cad mkhyen pa/ nyer sbas/ rgya mtsho skyong*/ dze tā ri/ ngag dbang grags pa/ kha che ma ṇi ka shrī/ mal jo/ la stod pa dbang rin/ mchims chos seng*/ mchims blo brtan/ chos rje 'jam gsar/ bla ma chos 'od/ 'phags 'od/ thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che/ slob dpon don grub rgyal mgon/ bla ma dam pa bkra shis rin chen/ des bdag la'o// sgra mi snyan gyi rang gzungs kyi brgyud pa ni/ dgra bcom pa blo gros dpal/ ha ngu*/ tsan+d+ra/ slob dpon dar ma grags/ bla ma mnga' ris pa/ ye shes rgyal po/ shes rab grags/ dz+nyā na sid+dhi/ de'i gcung po slob dpon bsod nams mgon/ rin chen seng ge bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston/ lots+tsha ba rin chen rnam rgyal/ bla ma dam pa bkra shis rin chen/ des bdag la'o// thub pa'i rmi lam brtag thabs bud+dha tsu ru ma'i brgyud pa ni/ paṇ+ḍi ta bi khyā ta de ba/ paṇa chen shākya shrī/ dā na shī la/ 'jam gsar/ rgwa lo/ mnga' ris pa sangs ye/ thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston/ lots+tsha ba rin chen rnam rgyal/ bla ma dam pa bkra shis rin chen/ des bdag la'o/ yang las dang po pa'i chos spyod nyams su blangs pa'i cho ga rnam mkhyen du bgrod pa'i bde lam/ dgas po sbrum pas zhus pa'i don du gson po'i bsngo ba/ su gi ti bhi'i dbon pos zhus pa'i don du gshin po'i bsngo ba rnams kyang thos/ gnas brtan phyag mchod chung ba'i brgyud pa ni/ jo bo rje/ sems tsam rnam brdzun pa'i grub mtha' 'dzin pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta/ rngog byang chub 'byung gnas/ dge bshes pu to ba/ sha ra ba/ 'chad ka ba ye shes rdo rje/ se spyil phu ba dar ma shes rab/ lha spyil phu ba 'od zer bla ma/ snyi mo 'dre lhas pa tshul khrims 'od zer/ rgan mo lhas pa hūm̐ tshul khrims 'bar/ mchims nam mkha' grags/ skyo ston pa/ 'dul 'dzin pa/ rgyang ro paṇa chen/ de gnyis las/ mchims blo bzang grags pa/

lots+tsha ba byang chub rtse mo/ bla ma dam pa bkra shis rin chen/ de las bdag gis thos/ khro phu lots+tsha ba'i man ngag brgya rtsa brgyad pa'i brgyud pa ni/ paṇa chen shākya shrī/ bud+dha shrī/ dz+nyā na shrī/ shrī dza ga ta mi tra ā nan+ta/ a nu sa ma ta/ de rnams las khro phu lots+tsha byams pa'i dpal gyis zhus/ de las bla ma bsod nams dbang phyug khro phu rin po che/ tshad ma'i skyes bu bsod nams mgon/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa/ lots+tsha ba rin chen rnam rgyal/ bla ma dam pa bkra shis rin chen/ des bdag la'o// thos yig rgya mtsho las/ bla ma dam pa bkra shis rin chen pas rjes su bzung ba'i skabs te drug pa'o// //skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang po chos kyi rje skyabs mchog dpal bzang po'i drung du/ bla ma lnga bcu pa'i bshad pa/ brtag gnyis ṭīka chen bla ma dam pas mdzad pa'i bshad pa/ gsang 'dus kyi spyi don bshad pa/ rtsa ltung bcu bzhi'i bshad pa/ lam 'bras snang ba gsum gyi khrid/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ thugs rje chen po'i sgom bzlas rnams thos/ bka' gdams lam rim gyi khrid rgyas pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ mchims blo bzang grags pa/ mkhan chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ lots+tsha ba skyabs mchog dpal bzang po/ des bdag la'o// blo sbyong don bdun ma'i khrid kyi brgyud pa ni/ rgyal sras thogs med/ lots+tsha ba byang chub rtse mo/ de gnyis ka las lots+tsha ba skyabs mchog dpal bzang pos zhus/ de las bdag gis zhus/ dbu ma rtsa ba shes rab/ 'grel pa tshig gsal dang bcas pa'i bshad pa/ rig pa drug cu pa dang*/ rgyud bla ma gnyis kyi ṭī ka chos kyi rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i bshad pa/ so sor thar pa'i mdo/ tshul khrims yang dag par ldan pa'i mdo/ bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam/ klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i smon lam nyi shu pa/ slob dpon dpa' bos mdzad pa'i smon lam bdun cu pa rnams thos so// thos yig rgya mtsho las lots+tsha ba skyabs mchog dpal bzang pos rjes su bzung ba'i skabs te bdun pa'o//

//yon tan rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag chos kyi rje// bshes gnyen rgya mtsho'i tshogs kun nyer bsten nas// dam chos rgya mtsho legs par thos pa'i tshul// thos yig rgya mtsho rnam par bkod pa las// dge ba rgya mtsho bdag gis gang thob des// srid pa rgya mtshor 'khyams pa'i 'gro kun gyi// sdug bsngal rgya mtsho mtha' dag nyer zhi nas// bde ba rgya mtsho'i dpal la spyod par shog /sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis legs gsungs shing*// phan bde rgya mtsho'i gzhi dang rten gyur pa'i// gsung rab rgya mtsho'i tshogs kun ma nyams par// bskal pa rgya mtshor mi nub gnas par shog /tshul khrims rgya mtsho rnam par dag pa yis// dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i tshogs kun zhabs brtan cing*// dam chos rgya mtsho'i sgra dbyangs legs bsgrags nas// bstan pa rgya mtsho yun ring gnas par shog /bdag kyang deng nas bzung ste byang chub bar// rnam dag dal 'byor lus bzang rab thob nas// don med 'jig rten bya bas ma bcings par// dam chos tshol la gcig tu brtson par shog /yon tan kun ldan dge ba'i bshes gnyen de// rnyed dang bkur sti sgrub pa'i mchod pa dang*// lus dang srog gi bar gyis mnyes byas pas// zab yangs chos tshul zab mo 'doms par shog /ji ltar thos pa'i dam chos zab mo rnams// lung rigs nyi ma'i 'od zer la brten nas// lam log mun pa'i tshogs kun sun phyung ste// ma nor lam gyi snang ba rgyas par shog /thos dang bsam pa'i shes rab mthar phyin nas// dben pa'i gnas su g.yeng ba kun spangs te// zhi gnas lhag mthong zung du 'jug pa yis// ting 'dzin zab mo bsgom la brtson par shog /dam chos sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen kun zhi zhing*// mthun rkyen phun sum tshogs pas legs 'byor nas// bde gshegs bstan la bya ba byed pa dang*// gcig tu 'gro la phan pa byed par shog/ //chos kyi rje dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams las dam pa'i chos ji ltar nod pa'i tshul gsal bar bshad pa thos yig rgya mtsho zhes bya ba 'di ni/

bdag dang gzhan gyi grub pa'i mtha' rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son pas/ bde bar gshegs pa'i ring lugs pa mtha' dag gi gtsug gi nor bur gyur pa/ chos kyi rje dpal ldan bla ma dam pa ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la sogs pa dam pa mang po'i bka' drin gyis nye bar bskyangs shing thugs brtse ba chen pos rjes su bzung ba/ shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang pos dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen por phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa'i yi ge pa ni/ mdo khams stod pa blo gros seng ge la sogs pas bgyis te re zhig rdzogs so// //sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
